hero.sub: Ganowa & mai sarrafa tabbatarwa don cibiyar sadarwa na Vortex peer-to-peer. Bude Rufaffen. Ba za a iya tsayawa ba.

network.label: NETWORK
network.body: Kowane takwarorina yana riƙe da sa hannun sa hannu. Abokan ciniki sun tabbatar kafin haɗawa, nodes suna tabbatar da mallakarsu a rajista. Babu wata hukuma ta tsakiya da za ta iya karya abin da cryptography ya riga ya tabbatar.
network.dual_body: Rijista tare da mai sarrafawa AND an rufe akan sarkar ta Solana. Shaidu masu zaman kansu guda biyu sun tabbatar da lambar zanta da maɓalli. Amintacce don zama masu hankali.
network.ctrl_body: Sa hannu yana tabbatar da kullin ya mallaki maɓalli na sirri, amma amincin lambar ba a haɗa shi akan sarkar ba. Mafi kyau ga yawancin zaman; kasada = amince da mai sarrafa.
network.unverif_body: An sani daga config ko tsegumi. Babu wata hujja ta sirri tukuna. Yi amfani da kawai don tayar da jerin tsararru - ba a matsayin manufa ta hannun hannu don zaman kai tsaye ba.

security.label: SECURITY
security.body: Maɓallan maɓalli huɗu masu zaman kansu Ed25519, kowanne tare da kunkuntar aiki ɗaya. Yin sulhu na kowane maɓalli ɗaya baya karya sauran.
security.release_verified: Abokan ciniki - an haɗa su a lokacin ginawa
security.controller_verified: Abokan ciniki - daga SNS ko gina fil
security.step1_d: Karanta vortexx.sol akan sarkar. Rubuce-rubucen da Solana walat ya sa hannu - ba zai yiwu a yi garkuwa da su ba.
security.step2_d: Kiran abokin ciniki /v1/integrity. Ya ƙi kowane amsa sai dai status: verified daga maɓallin sakin da aka liƙa.
security.step3_d: Kowane API kira yana dawowa {payload, sig, signed_by}. Abokin ciniki yana tabbatar da sa hannun Ed25519 kafin amincewa.
security.step4_d: Rufe nodes: abokin ciniki yana karanta code_hash daga rajista na Solana. Bambance-bambance daga mai sarrafawa = jerin baƙaƙe na dindindin.
security.check_auth: Sahihin amsa - ba zai yiwu a ƙirƙira /v1/nodes ba tare da maɓallin keɓaɓɓen mai sarrafawa ba.
security.check_integrity: Mutuncin lambar - fayilolin mai sarrafawa sun hashe kuma an bincika su a kowane farawa. Tampering yana dawowa 503 kafin kowane zirga-zirga.
security.check_identity: Gano sunan node - nodes dole ne su sanya hannu kan rajista da maɓalli nasu. Mai hari ba zai iya yin rajista a madadin maɓalli na kumburin wani ba.
security.check_dns: DNS Kariyar satar mutane — .sol records live on Solana. Maƙiyi yana buƙatar yin sulhu da walat, ba kawai mai rijista DNS ba.
security.check_handoff: Handoff Tsaro - Canja wurin zama yana ɗauke da alamun sa hannun Ed25519 tare da hana sake kunnawa, yana aiki kawai mintuna 5. Manufar ƙin yarda da tushen da ba a sani ba.
security.check_transport: Sirrin jigilar kaya - haɗi URL bayyane ga ISP / Cloudflare. Yi amfani da madubin Tor idan metadata yana da mahimmanci.
security.check_content: Abinda ke cikin saƙo - NOT mai sarrafawa ya taɓa shi. Ƙarshe-zuwa-ƙarshen ɓoye tsakanin masu amfani. Mai sarrafawa ba zai iya karanta komai ba ko da an daidaita shi sosai.
security.check_host: Mai watsa shiri OS / kernel - idan VPS ya kafe, ana iya sace maɓallan. Yi amfani da sa hannu mai goyan bayan hardware don tura kayan aiki.

access.label: ACCESS
access.body: Wuraren shigarwa da yawa yana nufin babu mahalli ɗaya da zai iya toshe damar ku. Shafukan madubi suna hidima iri ɗaya da aka sanya hannu daga abubuwan more rayuwa masu zaman kansu.
access.tunnel_body: Adireshin *.trycloudflare.com kyauta. Babu asusu da ake buƙata. URL yana canzawa lokacin da rami ya sake farawa - bi da shi azaman ephemeral.
access.tor_body: .adireshin albasa, ana iya samuwa ta hanyar Tor kawai. Hujja ta censor da metadata-mai zaman kansa, amma a hankali. Yana buƙatar abokin ciniki na Tor.
access.ipfs_body: Kwafin gaban da aka gabatar da abun ciki na a tsaye. Duk wata ƙofa IPFS tana iya hidimarta - babu uwar garken guda ɗaya da zai toshe.
access.direct_body: Yankin na yau da kullun + TLS. Zaɓin mafi sauri. Ana iya toshewa a matakin DNS/IP - faɗuwa ga wasu idan an tantance su.
access.mirrors_body: Madadin runduna masu aiki da ainihin sa hannun abun ciki iri ɗaya kamar wannan mai sarrafa. Ana bincika kowane madubi lokaci-lokaci - ɗigon kore yana nufin ana iya samuwa a cikin mintuna 5 na ƙarshe. Tor .onion madubai ba za a iya duba lafiyarsu ba tare da wakili na Tor na gida ba.

start.label: GET STARTED
start.step1: Saka Vortex akan na'urarka - wayar hannu ko tebur.
start.step2: Zaɓi Global yanayin hanyar sadarwa a cikin saitin maye.
start.step3: Manna mai sarrafawa URL (an warware ta atomatik ta hanyar SNS) ko kowane shigarwa URL daga shafin shigarwa.
start.step4: Tabbatar da pubkey a cikin app ɗinku yayi daidai da sawun yatsa mai sarrafawa a ƙasa. Rashin daidaituwa yana nufin tambari.
start.step5: An haɗa ku. Ana sarrafa lissafin node, sa hannun hannu, da kuma sarrafa hanya kai tsaye.
start.fingerprint_note: Saka wannan maɓalli a cikin abokin ciniki kafin amincewa da kowane amsa.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS
treasury.transparency_body: Duk kuɗaɗen yarjejeniya - kuɗaɗen rijistar node da yanke 20% na biyan kuɗi na ƙima - kwarara zuwa walat ɗin ajiya akan Solana. Kowane ma'amala kowa yana iya tabbatarwa a bainar jama'a.
treasury.rewards_body: Kashi 70% na kowane juzu'in ƙima yana zuwa wurin lada, rarraba pro-rata ga masu aikin node masu aiki. 20% yana ba da babban ci gaba. 10% yana ƙonewa ko yana zaune azaman inshora.

gravitixDocs.title: Maganar Harshen Gravitix
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Harshen rubutu mai inganci don gina bots. 96 fasali. Tsatsa baya.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix harshe ne na musamman na yanki (DSL) wanda aka ƙera daga ƙasa har don rubuta bots na Vortex. Inda wasu harsuna ke buƙatar ɗakunan karatu, sake kiran waya, da tukunyar jirgi, Gravitix yana ba ku masu gudanar da taron aji na farko, gudanawar tattaunawa, da ginanniyar yanayi - duk a cikin tsaftataccen tsarin rubutu wanda aka yi wahayi zuwa gare ta Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Ana iya karantawa - lambar tana karantawa kamar niyya, ba injina ba
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Amintacciya - nau'ikan a tsaye suna kama kurakurai kafin lokacin aiki
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Mai bayyanawa - kwarara, masu gadi, da daidaita tsarin an gina su
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Kadan - babu azuzuwan, babu gado, babu tsarin koyo
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix shine ga duk wanda ke son gina bot ɗin Vortex da sauri - ko ba ku taɓa rubuta lamba ba, ko kuma ku ƙwararren ƙwararren mai haɓaka ne wanda ya gaji da tukunyar jirgi na Python. Wannan tunani yana koyar da Gravitix daga ka'idodin farko: ba a buƙatar ƙwarewar da ta gabata.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Kowane sashe yana ginawa akan na baya. Idan kun kasance sababbi ga shirye-shirye, karanta daga sama zuwa kasa. Idan kun riga kun san wani yare, yi amfani da teburin abun ciki don tsalle kai tsaye zuwa ga abin da kuke sha'awar.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Hanya mafi sauri daga sifili zuwa bot mai gudu.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: a/fara {... } - yana bayyana ma'aikacin da ke gudana lokacin da mai amfani ya aika / farawa. emit "..." - yana aika sako ga mai amfani. {ctx.first_name} - yana haɗa sunan farko na mai amfani a cikin kirtani.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: A cikin Gravitix IDE, danna maɓallin Run a saman mashaya. Shigar da Bot Token na Vortex lokacin da aka sa. Bot yana farawa nan da nan - babu wani matakin ginawa da ake buƙata.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Kowane shirin Gravitix an gina shi daga tubalan gini guda uku: masu sarrafa, fitar da bayanai, da dabaru.
gravitixDocs.whatGoesAfterEmit: Abin da ke faruwa bayan fitarwa
gravitixDocs.multipleHandlers: Ma'aikata da yawa don faɗakarwa iri ɗaya
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Kowane ƙima a cikin Gravitix yana da nau'i. Nau'in tsarin yana tsaye: ana duba nau'ikan a lokacin tattarawa, kafin bot ɗin ku ya gudana.
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Masu aiki suna haɗa ƙima don samar da sababbin dabi'u.
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin Gravitix rubutu ne na UTF-8. Suna goyan bayan haɗin kai mai arziƙi da rukunin ayyukan ginannun.
gravitixDocs.stringOperations: Ayyukan kirtani ta hanyar ginannun abubuwan ciki
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Tsarin-daidaita ƙima da ƙima da yawa. Yi la'akari da shi azaman sanarwa mai ƙarfi mai ƙarfi.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Ayyuka su ne tubalan lambar da za a sake amfani da su. Suna taimaka maka ka guje wa maimaitawa kuma suna sauƙaƙan fahimtar lamba.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Masu sarrafa su ne zuciyar Gravitix bot. Kowane mai gudanarwa yana sauraron takamaiman nau'in taron kuma yana gudana lokacin da abin ya faru.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Masu gadi suna ba ku damar ƙara yanayi ga mai kulawa. Mai sarrafa yana gudana ne kawai idan mai gadin ya auna gaskiya.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: Abun ctx yana samuwa ta atomatik a cikin kowane mai kulawa. Ya ƙunshi bayani game da saƙon yanzu da kuma mai amfani da ya aika.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: Jiha yana barin bot ɗin ku tuna abubuwa tsakanin saƙonni. Ba tare da jiha ba, kowane saƙo yana da zaman kansa kuma bot ba shi da ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Yawo yana ba ku damar rubuta taɗi mai matakai da yawa a cikin layi, salo mai karantawa. Gudun ruwa na iya tsayawa da jira saƙon mai amfani na gaba.
gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Aika saƙonni shine farkon fitowar bot.
gravitixDocs.emitTo: emit_to - aika zuwa takamaiman mai amfani
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Gudun lambar ta atomatik akan jadawalin - babu ayyukan cron, babu sabis na waje da ake buƙata.
gravitixDocs.atSpecificTime: at - gudu a takamaiman lokacin rana
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Mai aiki da bututu |> yana ƙaddamar da ƙima azaman hujja ta farko zuwa aiki na gaba. Yana sanya ayyukan sarka su karanta, hagu zuwa dama.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix yana ba da ingantaccen sarrafa kurakurai tare da gwadawa / kama / ƙarshe.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Tsarin yana ba ku damar haɗa bayanai masu alaƙa a ƙarƙashin nau'in mai suna. Enums suna ayyana rufaffiyar saitin bambance-bambancen.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix yana jigilar cikakken ɗakin karatu na lissafi tare da ~ 180 ayyuka.
gravitixDocs.complexDesc: Gravitix yana da nau'in haɗe-haɗe na asali - nau'i biyu na 64-bit na iyo wanda ke wakiltar sassa na gaske da na tunani.
gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix ya haɗa da ƙididdiga na ƙididdigewa: abubuwan da aka samo asali da abubuwan haɗin kai waɗanda aka lissafta akan ayyuka na sabani.
gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Linear algebra shine lissafin vectors da matrices.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Ka'idar lamba tana nazarin kaddarorin lambobi. Tushen fasahar zamani.
gravitixDocs.statisticsDesc: Ƙididdiga na ba da kayan aiki don siffanta, nazari, da kuma zana ƙarshe daga bayanai.
gravitixDocs.specialDesc: Ayyuka na musamman sune mafita ga mahimman ma'auni daban-daban.
gravitixDocs.fftDesc: Canjin Fourier yana lalata sigina zuwa mitocin sa.
gravitixDocs.bp1: Koyaushe rike abin da ba a sani ba
gravitixDocs.bp3: Yi amfani da masu gadi maimakon sarƙoƙi don izini
gravitixDocs.bp5: Yi amfani da dawowa da wuri don rage gida
gravitixDocs.bp8: Yi amfani da jihar don hana spam
gravitixDocs.keepLearningDesc: Hanya mafi kyau don koyan Gravitix shine ginawa. Fara da sauƙi echo bot, sannan ƙara yanayi, sannan ƙara kwarara. Kowane sabon ra'ayi da kuka koya yana buɗe ƙarin dama.

intro.p1: Gravitix harshe ne na musamman na yanki (DSL) da aka tsara tun daga tushe har zuwa rubuta Vortex bots. Inda wasu harsuna ke buƙatar ɗakunan karatu, sake kiran waya, da tukunyar jirgi, Gravitix yana ba ku masu gudanar da taron aji na farko, tattaunawa flows, da ginanniyar state - duk a cikin tsaftataccen tsarin rubutu wanda za'a iya karantawa ta hanyar Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix shine ga duk wanda yake son gina bot Vortex da sauri - ko baka taba rubuta code ba, ko kuma kai kwararre ne wanda ya gaji da Python tukunyar jirgi. Wannan tunani yana koyar da Gravitix daga ƙa'idodin farko: ba a buƙatar ƙwarewar da ta gabata.
intro.p3: Kowane sashe yana ginawa akan na baya. Idan kun kasance sababbi ga shirye-shirye, karanta daga sama zuwa kasa. Idan kun riga kun san wani yare, yi amfani da teburin abun ciki don tsalle kai tsaye zuwa ga abin da kuke sha'awar.
intro.p4: A cikin wannan tunani, → yana nufin "ƙimantawa zuwa" ko "samarwa", kuma // ... yana nuna maganganun da mai tarawa yayi watsi da su.

math_special.p1: Ayyukan Gamma Γ(n) shine ci gaba da haɓaka abubuwa na abubuwa: Γ(n) = (n-1)! don tabbataccen lamba. Yana faɗaɗa ƙididdiga zuwa ainihin lambobi masu rikitarwa.
math_special.p2: Aikin kuskure erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(-t²)dt shine jigon Gaussian. Yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da na al'ada CDF kuma yana bayyana a cikin ma'auni na zafi da ka'idar yiwuwar.
math_special.p3: ζ(s) = Σ 1/nˢ don n=1,2,3,… (lokacin Re(s)>1). Haɗa zuwa babban rarraba ta hanyar samfurin Euler. Hasashen Riemann (ba a warware ba!) Ya shafi sifili na ζ a cikin hadadden jirgin sama.
math_special.p4: Ayyukan Bessel Jₙ(x) da Yₙ(x) sune mafita ga ma'auni na daban na Bessel: x²y''+ xy' + (x²−n²)y = 0. Suna fitowa a cikin yaɗuwar igiyar ruwa, zafin zafi a cikin silinda, da injiniyoyi masu yawa.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) da Bi(x) sune mafita ga y''= xy. Suna bayyana a cikin tunneling quantum (WKB kimanin) da na gani (diffraction).
math_special.p6: Waɗannan iyalai masu yawan jama'a sun taso azaman ayyukan eigen na mahimman masu aiki kuma ana amfani da su a cikin hanyoyin gani, quadrature, da injiniyoyi masu yawa.
math_special.p7: K (k) da E (k) cikakkun kayan haɗin kai ne na nau'in farko da na biyu. Suna ƙididdige lokacin pendulum marar layi da kewayen ellipse.
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoid ya wuceflow na babban x.
math_special.td5: Pₙ (x): orthogonal akan [-1,1]. Bangaren kusurwa na hydrogen wavefunctions.
math_special.td6: Hₙ(x): orthogonal w.r.t. e^(-x²). Quantum harmonic oscillator.
math_special.td7: Tₙ(x) = cos(n·acos(x)): madaidaicin ƙima mai yawa.
math_special.td8: Lₙ(x): orthogonal akan [0,∞) w.r.t. e^(-x). Hydrogen radial wavefunctions.

types.p10: Wasu dabi'u na iya zama babu. Filayen zaɓi a cikin ctx (kamar ctx.username) na iya zama null. Koyaushe bincika kafin amfani:
types.p11: Ƙara ? bayan nau'in yana nuna shi a matsayin optional - ƙimar na iya zama null. Wannan shine yadda sigogin aiki da filayen state ke bayyana "wannan na iya kasancewa ko a'a":
types.p12: Idan ƙima bazai kasance koyaushe ba, bayyana shi T? kuma koyaushe duba != null kafin amfani dashi. Samun shiga filin null baya rushe bot - yana returns null shiru.

architexDocs.title: Maganar Harshen Architex
architexDocs.subtitle: Harshen shela na UI don Vortex Mini Apps. Hali mai amsawa, shimfidu masu haɗawa, matakin gina sifili.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex karamin shela ne DSL da aka tsara don jigilar UI cikin manzo Vortex. Kuna bayyana yadda allon ya kamata ya kasance; lokacin gudu yana kiyaye pixels a daidaita tare da jiha ta atomatik. Babu kama-da-wane DOM, babu bundler, babu JSX - fayil ɗin `.arx` shine app ɗin.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Bayyanawa - kuna rubuta UI da kuke so, ba matakan gina shi ba
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~ count += 1` kuma kowane lakabin da ya karanta shi yana sabuntawa a wurin
architexDocs.goalPortable: Maɓalli - '.arx' iri ɗaya yana gudana akan gidan yanar gizo, iOS, da Android runtimes ba tare da gyara ba
architexDocs.goalTiny: Tiny — parser + jigilar jigilar kaya a ƙasa da 30 KB, don haka Mini Apps suna buɗe nan take
architexDocs.goalReadable: Ana iya karantawa - shigarwa shine tsari; an ɗaure masu gyarawa da `::`; babu harajin rubutu
architexDocs.whoDesc: Duk wanda ke son jigilar allo mai mu'amala a cikin Vortex - fom ɗin abokin ciniki, allon dashboards, shafukan zaɓe, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Idan kun taɓa rubuta HTML+CSS+JS, Architex zai ji saba amma da sauri rubuta. Idan ba ku yi ba, Architex kuma gabatarwa ce mai sauƙi ga shirye-shiryen amsawa saboda harshe yana kiyaye sawun ƙanƙanta.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Kowane sashe yana ginawa akan wanda ya gabata. Fara a Saurin Farawa, sannan karanta Syntax, Jiha, Layout, Masu gyarawa, Ayyuka, da ɓangaren ci gaba na ƙarshe. Tsallake ta cikin tebur ɗin abun ciki idan kun riga kun san React ko Svelte - taswirar ra'ayi a tsafta.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Hanya mafi guntu daga babban fayil zuwa mai gudana Mini App.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Hello

  ~name = "duniya"

  col :: pad (24) rata (12) tsakiya

    taken "Sannu, {~name}!" :: girman girman (28)

    shigarwa ~ suna :: pad (8) radius (6) iyaka (#ccc)

    Rubutun "Buga suna a sama - wannan rubutun yana sabuntawa yayin da kuke bugawa."
      :: girman (12) launi (#888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` ya bayyana tushen. `~name = "duniya"' yana haifar da canji mai aiki. `col`, `header`, `input`, `rubutu` an gina su a ciki. `::` yana haɗa masu gyara (padding, launuka, girma). Lokacin da mai amfani ya shiga cikin shigarwar, kowane '{~name}' yana sabuntawa - babu waya, babu biyan kuɗi, babu mai bayarwa da hannu.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Bude shafin Architex a cikin Vortex bot studio, liƙa lambar, danna Run. Lokacin gudu yana sanyawa cikin samfotin samfoti da kuma zazzage-zazzage akan ajiyewa. Lokacin da kuke bugawa, masu amfani da ku suna buɗe ƙa'idar daga kowace hira - babu shigarwa.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Kowane shirin Architex an yi shi ne da abubuwa huɗu: furucin da ya fara da `@`, masu canji masu amsawa waɗanda aka riga aka sanya su da `~`, abubuwan da aka rubuta a matsayin masu ganowa, da masu gyara da aka haɗe bayan `::`.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@ Sunan allo`, `@ theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, da `@ don abu a cikin ~list` duk suna farawa a shafi na 0. Duk abin da ke ƙasan su yana cikin wannan toshe.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Kayan aiki suna zaune akan layin nasu: `rubutu`, `button`, `image`, `header`, `label`, `lamba`, `divider`, `col`, ` jere`. Hujjarsu ta zo daidai bayan sunan: `rubu ~ saƙo`, `maballin "Ajiye", `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Bayan `::` zaku iya sarkar gyare-gyare gwargwadon yadda kuke so. Kowanne yana ɗaukar sifili ko fiye da mahawara a cikin baka: `:: pad (24) rata (16) girman girman tsakiya (20) launi (# 4f8ef7)`. Masu gyare-gyare sune matsayi, ba maɓalli ba - tsari ba shi da mahimmanci sai ga masu rubutun karshe-nasara kamar 'launi'.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` akan maballi (ko duk wani abu mai mu'amala) yana gudanar da aikin aiki ko kiran aikin da ke biyo baya. Yawan sarkar `=>` gefe-da-gefe: `button "Submit" => ~ aiki = gaskiya => aika (aikin: "ajiye", bayanai: ~ tsari)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Duk wani suna da aka riga aka kayyade tare da `~` tantanin halitta ne mai amsawa. Rubuta `~ƙidaya = 0` don ayyana, `~ƙidaya = 5` don sake sanyawa, `~ƙirga += 1` don ɗaukakawa. Kowane kumburi UI da ke karanta tantanin halitta - kai tsaye ko ta hanyar interpolation - yana sake yin sa lokacin da tantanin halitta ya canza.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Yi amfani da `:=` maimakon `=` don ayyana lissafin ƙididdiga: `~ jimlar : = ~ ƙidaya * ~mataki`. Gefen hannun dama yana sake kimantawa a duk lokacin da kowane abin dogaro ya canza. Babu biyan kuɗi na hannu kuma babu kwaro mai ƙima - idan kun karanta ''~a' a wani wuri a cikin furcin, kuna dogara ta atomatik.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Bayanin na zaɓi ne amma taimako tare da cikar atomatik da saƙon kuskure: `~ ƙidaya: lamba = 0`, `~name: string = """, `~ok: boolean = ƙarya`, `~ abubuwa: array = []`, `~ mai amfani: abu = {}`. Idan ka tsallake su ana samun nau'in daga mai farawa.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `lamba`, `string`, `boolean`, `array`, `abu`, `null`. Kwanan wata da tsutsotsi ana wucewa ta hanyar igiyoyi da abubuwa bi da bi. Lokacin gudu yana amfani da ƙa'idodin tilastawa JavaScript ƙarƙashin hular, don haka `~ ƙidaya + 1` yana aiki koda `~ ƙidaya' ya fara rayuwa azaman kirtani.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Duk wani kirtani na iya shigar da furci tare da `{...}`: `"Sannu, {~user.name}!"`, `"Jumla: {~ ƙidaya * ~ farashin}"'. Interpolation koyaushe yana amsawa.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex yana da kwantena biyu masu hadewa da kayan ganye dozin guda. Sanya su tare da indentation - babu alamun rufewa.
architexDocs.containersDesc: 'col' yana tara yara a tsaye, 'jere' a kwance. Dukansu sun karɓi `tazari(n)`, `pad(n)`, `tsakiya`, `girma`, da mai gyara faɗi/tsawo. Zurfafa yara matakin zurfi zuwa gida.
architexDocs.containerExample:
jere :: tazari (8) pad (16) tsakiya
  Hoton "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) radius(20)
  col :: girma tazara(2)
    rubutu ~ suna :: m
    rubutu ~ bio :: girman (12) launi (#888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: 'rubutu' - kowane kwafin jiki. 'header' - a ma'anar magana. 'lakabin' - ƙaramin rubutun rubutu. `maballin` - iko mai iya taɓawa. 'shigarwa' - filin rubutu daure zuwa var mai amsawa. 'hoton' - hoto daga URL. `alama` - alama mai siffar kwaya. `divider` — bakin ciki separator line. 'toast' - abincin ciye-ciye na ephemeral. `tabs` / `tab` — tab switcher.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: 'rubutu "Sannu"' yana sanya kirtani a tsaye. 'rubutu ~ saƙo' yana mayar da martani. Haɗa tare da interpolation: `rubutu "Total: {~ count}"'.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Rubutun kan layi. Matsaloli zuwa girma, mafi ƙarfi fiye da 'rubutu'. Hujjojin matsayi iri ɗaya: `header "Settings"'. Girman ma'auni tare da allo - wuce gona da iri tare da `girman (n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Abun iya taɓawa. Wurin matsayi shine lakabin; aikin `=>` yana gudana akan famfo. 'button "Ajiye" => ~ daftarin aiki = null'. Wuta da yawa `=>` cikin tsari.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Filin rubutu mai ɗaure ta hanya biyu. Maɓallin amsawa bayan sunan yana riƙe ƙimar halin yanzu: `input ~ imel`. Masu gyara: `Mai sanya wuri("…")`, `debounce(300)` don sabuntawa.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Loads daga hanyar HTTPS URL ko `/ uploads/...` hanya. Masu gyara `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` datsa akwatin. Faɗuwa zuwa silhouette mai riƙewa idan URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Mai raba gashin gashi, 1px, yana girmama launin jigon na yanzu. Babu gardama.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Kwayar da ke rungumar abun cikin ta: `lago ~ ƙidaya`, `lambar “sabo”`. Yi amfani da ƙididdiga marasa karantawa da guntuwar alamar.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Rubutun taken/mataimaki - an kasa cikawa da gani. Go od don sunayen filin filin.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Sanarwa mara toshewa. 'Toast ~ bayyane "Ajiye!" :: duration(2000)` yana nuna 2 s a duk lokacin da `~ bayyane` gaskiya ne, sa'an nan kuma auto-kore. Babu modal stacking, babu z-index yaƙe-yaƙe.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Akwatin tab daure zuwa kirtani mai amsawa: `tabs ~activeTab`. A ciki, kowane'tab"Label""maɓalli"' yana bayyana shafi ɗaya; Ana nuna jikin da ke ƙasa lokacin da maɓallin ya yi daidai.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Masu gyara su ne kawai hanyar da za a iya salon abin da ke ciki. Sarkake su bayan `::`. Suna zuwa cikin iyalai biyar: tazara, girma, launi, rubutun rubutu, da ɗabi'a.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` - padding a kowane bangare. 'pad (x, y)' - a kwance + a tsaye. 'pad (sama, dama, kasa, hagu)' - CSS-oda. `tazari (n)` - sarari tsakanin yaran 'col' / 'jere'. `margin(n)` - tazarar waje daga 'yan'uwa.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` - kafaffen nisa. `h(px)` - tsayayyen tsayi. 'girma' - cike sauran sarari a jere/kol. 'tsakiya' - tsakiya tare da giciye axis; a cikin 'col' yana tsakiya a kwance, a cikin 'jere' yana tsaye a tsaye.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `launi (#rrggbb)` - gaba. `bg(#rrggbb)` - bango. Dukansu suna karɓar alamun jigo: `launi (~ firamare)` suna karantawa daga toshe `@ theme` na yanzu. Baffa yana wucewa ta hex mai lamba 8: `#00000080` shine 50 % baki.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `girman (px)` - Girman rubutu. `m` / `italic` — nauyi da salo. `align (hagu|tsaki|dama)` - daidaita rubutu.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `boye (~ tuta)` - yana kwance kumburi lokacin da tuta ta kasance gaskiya. 'bayyane (~ tuta)' - inverse. Nodes marasa hawa suna zubar da DOM, don haka sharadi UI yana da arha.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: 'debounce(ms)' akan sabuntawar abubuwan shigar da abubuwa. `Mai sanya wuri("…")` yana nuna kirtani mai nuni. `tsari (irin, arg)` akan ''rubutu' suna tsara lamba: `tsara ("kudin", "USD")', 'tsara ("kashi")', 'tsara ("m").
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: 'radius(px)' zagaye sasanninta. 'iyaka(#rrggbb)' yana zana bugun bugun 1 px. `iyaka(px, #rrggbb)` yana saita kauri kuma.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Ayyuka suna canza yanayi ko magana da duniyar waje. Suna aiki tare a cikin maɓalli/maɓallin maɓalli.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~ ƙidaya = 0`, `=> ~ aiki = gaskiya`, `=> ~jeri = []`. Duk wani canji mai amsawa ana iya rubutawa.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~ƙidaya += 1` yana da ma'ana ga masu kirga.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Da yawa `=>` akan layi daya wuta sama-zuwa ƙasa a cikin kaska ɗaya, don haka UI yana sabunta sau ɗaya a ƙarshen: `button "Sayi" => ~ aiki = gaskiya => aika (aikin: "sayi") => ~ aiki = ƙarya'. Don aikin async, fi son lissafin `@reaction`.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `aika (aiki: "name", ...args)' shine gadar komawa zuwa bot. Mai watsa shiri (Vortex runtime) yana karɓar shi azaman saƙon JSON RPC kuma yana iya kiran lambar bot ɗin ku. Yi amfani da shi don shiga, API fetches, biya - duk abin da DSL da kansa ba zai iya bayyanawa ba.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("ScreenName", arg: value, ...)` yana tura wani `@allon` akan tarin; 'baya()' ya tashi. Lokacin gudu yana raye ta tsohuwa.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `kwafi (~ rubutu)`, `share (~ rubutu)`, `haptic ("haske" | "matsakaici" | "nauyi")', `vibrate(ms)`, `gaggawa("…")`, `tabbatar ("…") => ~ok = it` - 'shi' gajeriyar hannu ita ce ƙimar dawowar maganar da ta gabata.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Bayyana palette sau ɗaya, sake amfani da ko'ina. Alamu sun zama masu canji na yau da kullun don haka app ɗinku zai iya jigilar yanayin jujjuyawar duhu cikin layi uku.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` yana jan kowane `@bangaren` da `@screen` daga waccan fayil zuwa iyakar yanzu. Hanyoyi sun danganta da fayil ɗin shigo da; Ana gano shigo da madauwari da kuma bayar da rahoto a lokacin tantancewa.
architexDocs.components: @component - abubuwan da aka gyara na al'ada
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Ƙayyade sau ɗaya, yi amfani da yawa: `@component Avatar url size\n image url :: w(size) h(size) radius( size / 2)`. A cikin jikin sassan sigogin da aka ambata suna cikin iyaka a matsayin masu ganowa a sarari (ba tare da `~` ba).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@ don abu a cikin ~jeri` yana sanya jere ɗaya a kowane kashi. `@ don abu, idx a cikin ~list` shima yana ɗaure fihirisar tushen sifili. Lokacin gudu yana gano ainihi ta hanyar sigar kanta, don haka ƙara abubuwa a saman jerin jere 10 000 yana biyan O(1) DOM aikin.
architexDocs.forExample:
@ga abu, idx a cikin ~ abubuwa
  jere :: tazarar (8) pad (4)
    lamba ~ idx
    rubutu ~ abu :: girma
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: 'kwarya? a : b` yana aiki a duk inda aka karɓi magana. Nest for enums: `~ matsayi >= 10 ? "high": ~ matsayi >= 5 ? "mid": "ƙananan"'.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: A cikin sanarwar abubuwan, `slot` alama inda jikin mai kiran ya toshe a ciki. Yi la'akari da shi azaman React children / Vue default slot.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: Kowane `~var` sigina ce. Lokacin da kuka karanta shi a cikin ƙididdigewa, gardamar gyarawa, ko tsaka-tsaki, lokacin aiki yana lura da karatun a cikin jadawali na dogaro na yanzu. Lokacin da kuka rubuta, kowane kumburin da ya karanta yana sake kimantawa - sau ɗaya, a ƙarshen microtask na yanzu.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Rubuce-rubuce da yawa a cikin mai kulawa iri ɗaya an haɗa su. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` yana haifar da fasinja daidai gwargwado.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Ta hanyar tsoho, lokacin aiki yana amfani da daidaito mai tsauri (`===`). Rubutun ƙima ɗaya ba ya sake gudanar da komai. Wuce sabon abu/tsari don tilasta sabuntawa; Ana ƙarfafa rashin iya canzawa amma ba a buƙata ba.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Aikace-aikace na canonical guda huɗu, kowane mai ɗaukar kansa kuma ƙasa da layi 40. Kwafi kowane ɗayansu zuwa shafin Architex kuma danna Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter - yanayin amsawa, ƙididdigewa, masu sarrafa maɓalli, ɗaurin rubutu.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo - yin lissafin, ƙara / cirewa, gyaran layi.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Bayanan martaba - hoto, bajis, ganuwa na sharadi, kewayawa.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Fasalolin kisa - jigogi, shigo da kaya, shafuka, toasts, tsararrun lambobi, ternaries, nau'ikan vars.
architexDocs.errors: Kurakurai gama gari da abin da za a yi
architexDocs.errUnknownName: 'Sunan da ba a sani ba ~ foo' - kun yi amfani da madaidaicin amsawa kafin bayyana shi. Ƙara `~ foo = …' a saman rufewa `@screen`.
architexDocs.errIndent: 'Indent ɗin da ba zato ba tsammani' - dole ne yara su kasance zurfi fiye da iyayensu. Architex yana amfani da daidaitattun wurare biyu a kowane matakin; Ana ƙi shafuka don guje wa kurakuran da ba a iya gani-farin sarari.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — kun rubuta `:: inuwa` amma lokacin aiki baya goyan bayan sa. Duba lissafin gyare-gyare a sama; Architex yana da tsattsauran ra'ayi game da sunayen da ba a san su ba don kare dacewa ta gaba.
architexDocs.errType: 'nau'in rashin daidaituwa' - misali. kun wuce kirtani inda ake tsammanin lamba. Bayyana ma'anar amsawa ('~ ƙidaya: lamba') kuma mai binciken zai gaya muku inda mummunar ƙimar ta samo asali.
architexDocs.errDebug: Don yin kuskure a lokacin aiki, kunsa abin da ake zargin a cikin `debug(...)` - lokacin gudu yana yin rikodin kowane ƙima zuwa na'ura wasan bidiyo ba tare da shafar ƙimar ba.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Yanar gizo - yana fassara zuwa vanilla DOM tare da CSS masu canji don alamun jigo. Babu React / Vue / Svelte dogaro.
architexDocs.compatIOS: IOS - '.arx' iri ɗaya ana rarraba kuma an sanya shi cikin ra'ayoyin SwiftUI ta hanyar Vortex mai watsa shiri na iOS. Kowane taswirori masu gyara zuwa salon SwiftUI.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android - Mai watsa shiri yana sanyawa cikin Jetpack Compose. Masu gyara motsi (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) fassara zuwa Shirya daidai.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Manufofin sigar - Architex yana ba da garantin dacewa da baya don fayilolin `.arx` a cikin ƙananan juzu'i. Fayil ɗin `.arx` da aka rubuta akan 0.1 har yanzu yana aiki akan 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Karanta littafin dafa abinci don alamu (jeritoci marasa iyaka, fom, biyan kuɗi), jagorar kayan aiki don plugin ɗin lambar CLI da VS, da jagorar gudummawa idan kuna son ƙara abubuwan da aka gina a ciki. Cikakken tushen yana a github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Magana
meta.subtitle: Kowane tsarin ƙasa na Vortex a wuri ɗaya.
meta.intro: Wannan tunani ya ƙare ta hanyar ƙira. Fara ko'ina - kowane babi na da kansa. Kowane bayani yana danganta komawa zuwa hanyoyin tushe idan ya dace. Ana kiran kowane sabani a bayyane.
meta.howToUse: Teburin abubuwan da ke gefen hagu yana kwatanta surori anan. Danna wani babi don tsalle zuwa gare shi; kowane babi yana da ƙananan kanun labarai da jerin abubuwan da za ku iya bincika cikin daƙiƙa 30 kafin nutsewa a ciki.
meta.updatedBy: An ƙirƙira daga `scripts/build_vortex_docs_v2.py`. Sake ginawa tare da 'rubutun Python3/build_vortex_docs_v2.py`.

architecture.title: Bayanin gine-gine
architecture.subtitle: Hanya guda uku - abokin ciniki, kumburi, mai sarrafawa - da yarjejeniya ɗaya wacce ke ɗaure su.
architecture.intro: Vortex Manzo ne da aka raba gari. Maimakon ƙarshen baya guda ɗaya mallakar kamfani ɗaya, yana haɓaka buɗaɗɗen raga na ** nodes ***, wanda ƙaramin ** mai sarrafawa ** ya gano kuma ya tabbatar da shi wanda ke buga takardar sa hannu ta lambar da ta tabbatar. ** Abokan ciniki ** suna riƙe duk maɓallan sirri kuma suna ba da UI. Sauran wannan babi na tafiya ne akan matakai guda uku, iyakokinsu, da bayanan da ke gudana a tsakanin su.
architecture.h1: Me ya sa aka raba gari
architecture.h1p1: Manzannin tsakiya wuri guda ne na tilastawa. Umurnin kotu, katsewar mai ba da gajimare, ko saye mara kyau duk suna fassara zuwa "masu amfani sun rasa damar shiga". Vortex ta hanyar barin kowa ya gudanar da kumburi da barin abokan ciniki su motsa tsakanin nodes ba tare da sake yin rajista ba.
architecture.h1p2: Rarraba jama'a dole ne a kiyaye sirri da mutunci. Ƙungiyar sabar marasa amana tana aiki ne kawai idan uwar garken ba za su iya karanta rubutu ba kuma ba za su iya ƙirƙira saƙonni ba. Vortex yana aiwatar da duka biyu ta hanyar ɓoye-ɓoye-ƙarshen-zuwa-ƙarshe da shaidar Ed25519 akan kowane saƙon giciye.
architecture.h1p3: Mai sarrafawa shine yanki na tsakiya, amma ƙarami ne. Yana buga `INTEGRITY.sig.json` kawai da jerin amintattun wuraren shigarwa. Kowa na iya daukar nauyin madubi da kansa, don haka ko da mai sarrafawa ba maki guda ne na gazawa ba - tushen gaskiya guda ɗaya ne don "waɗanne alamun pubkey na hukuma ya fito".
architecture.h1l1: Babu kulle-kulle mai siyarwa: abokan ciniki za su iya yin ƙaura tsakanin nodes kowane lokaci ta sake sanya hannu kan maɓalli na X25519 tare da sabon JWT.
architecture.h1l2: Babu haɗin kai: lokacin da kumburi ɗaya ya faɗi, masu amfani akan wasu nodes ba sa lura.
architecture.h1l3: Babu hurumi guda ɗaya: masu aiki suna zaɓar gidansu na doka, kuma masu amfani suna zaɓar ma'aikacin su.
architecture.h1l4: Babu guda UI: iOS, Android, yanar gizo takwarorina ne na aji na farko - babu wani dandali da ke rufe wani bakin ciki.
architecture.h2p1: Abokin ciniki yana aiki akan na'urar mai amfani. Wannan shine kawai wurin saƙon rubutu na zahiri, maɓallan sirri, da fayiloli-cikin-tsara kai tsaye. Kumburi bai taba ganin su ba.
architecture.h2p2: Kowane dandali mai tallafi yana aiwatar da ka'idojin waya iri ɗaya (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-Rarraba nau'ikan nau'ikan fasali ('api/` ladabi, lambar 'impl/`, ra'ayi 'ui /') kiyaye kwangilar da ƙarfi da takamaiman lambar dandamali.
architecture.h2p3: Adana akan na'urar: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpKuki kawai don alamomi; SQLite (GRDB akan iOS, Daki akan Android, IndexedDB wrapper akan gidan yanar gizo) don rubutun ciphertext + ma'aunin FTS.
architecture.h2l1: iOS - Kunshin Swift tare da nau'ikan fasali 30+. Min tura manufa iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android - Kotlin + Rubuta + Hilt. minSdk 26, manufaSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Yanar gizo — vanilla JS PWA, ma'aikacin sabis, babu wani matakin ginawa da ya wuce ES haɗaɗɗen module.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop - Tauri wrapper a kusa da abokin ciniki na yanar gizo; daure iri ɗaya, mai yin Chrome na asali.
architecture.h3p1: Kumburi tsari ne na Python ('python -m app.main', ko 'run.py' da aka haɗe) yana sauraron 9000 ta tsohuwa. Yana dagewa da rubutu, magoya baya WebSocket abubuwan da suka faru, yana riƙe da takaddun shaidar TURN, da ƙungiyar dillalai tare da sauran nodes.
architecture.h3p2: Ƙididdigar kumburin yana da siriri da gangan. Yana fallasa kusan hanyoyi 120 a fadin bishiyar `/api/*` da `/ws' don fitowar fan-da-da-wane. An ƙididdige ɗagawa mai nauyi (crypto, kasancewar, tsarawa) zuwa cikin 'app/security/', `app/transport/`, `app/peer/`.
architecture.h3p3: Kumburi ɗaya a cikin tsohuwar yanayin SQLite yana ɗaukar ~50 masu amfani na lokaci ɗaya cikin kwanciyar hankali akan M1. Tare da kunna Postgres da Redis, lambar sikeli iri ɗaya a kwance - kowane kumburi ya zama mara ƙasa ya wuce DB da fan-out.
architecture.h3l1: Abubuwan shigarwa: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/mutuma' da `/lafiya' don rayuwa.
architecture.h3l2: Dogara: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, matashin kai, Rust tsawo `vortex_chat` don hot-hanya crypto.
architecture.h3l3: Na zaɓi: Redis (gabatar fan-fita a fadin nodes da yawa), Postgres (samarwa DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit ( jigilar kaya).
architecture.h3l4: Girman binary: ~ 60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust tsawo. Hoton Docker kusan 400 MB kafin squash.
architecture.h4p1: Mai sarrafa shine keɓantaccen tsari na Python (`vortex_controller`) tare da kunkuntar manufa: buga kuma tabbatar `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, fallasa URLs na shigarwa, da bin lafiyar abokan tarayya.
architecture.h4p2: A lokacin farawa mai sarrafawa yana tafiya da bishiyar tushe, ya yi hashes kowane fayil, kuma yana kwatanta da bayyanar. Idan kowane zanta bai dace ba mai sarrafawa ya ƙi farawa. Wannan yana nufin fayil ɗin akan diski wanda aka lalata ba zai iya yin aiki da `status:"verified"'.
architecture.h4p3: Abokan ciniki sun buga `/v1/mutuma' kafin su amince da kumburi. Idan sun ga `status != "verified"' sun ƙi ba da takaddun shaida, lokaci. Wannan shine anga amana.
architecture.h4l1: Sa hannu tare da `maɓallai/release.key` (Ed25519). Rabin jama'a sun gasa cikin sakin abokin ciniki.
architecture.h4l2: Bayyana shigarwar: `{hanya, sha256, size}` ga kowane fayil da ba a gitige.
architecture.h4l3: Sake ginawa: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Fitowa `INTEGRITY.sig.json` a cikin tushen repo.
architecture.h4l4: Juyawa: masu aiki suna yin tuƙi Vortex maye gurbin `release.key`. Abokan ciniki da aka saita tare da maɓalli sannan su amince da cokali mai yatsa.
architecture.h5p1: Yi tafiya cikin abin da ya faru lokacin da Alice ta aika "hi" ga Bob:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Abokin ciniki yana duba maɓallin tushen ɗakin a cikin shagon sa na gida. Idan ba ya nan, tana ɗauko sabon ambulan daga `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` don maɓalli na kansa. DMs na farko suna gudanar da Diffie-Hellman zagaye ɗaya akan prekeys.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Abokin ciniki yana tsara nauyin kuɗin kamar CBOR `{v:1, rubutu:"hi", reply_to:null, sent_at:...}`, yana haifar da bazuwar 96-bit nonce, hatimi tare da AES-256-GCM, da POSTs `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` tare da: hexpher nonce hex}'.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node yana adana jere kuma magoya baya fitar `{type:"m", room:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}' zuwa kowane haɗi WebSocket sun shiga dakin.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Abokin ciniki na Bob yana karɓar firam ɗin, yana yanke maɓalli iri ɗaya, yana tabbatar da madaidaicin matches masu aikawa da ake tsammanin zama memba, kuma yana ba da kumfa.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Abokin ciniki na Bob yana aika 'POST /api/rooms/{id}/read' tare da id ɗin saƙon karantawa na ƙarshe. Wannan yana haifar da watsa shirye-shiryen `{type:"r"} don haka kumfa Alice ya nuna alamar.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) mai tsauri ne, binary, kuma yana da sauri don ɓoyewa. Idan aka kwatanta da JSON yana yanke girman abin biya da ~30% akan rubutun taɗi na yau da kullun kuma yana kawar da shubuhar sararin samaniya.
architecture.h6p2: Idan aka kwatanta da Protobuf baya buƙatar janareta mai ƙira kuma baya daskare lambobin filin. Wannan yana da mahimmanci saboda Vortex ya samo asali - mun ƙara `thread_id`, `amsa_to`, `ƙimar_ƙidaya`, `kyakkyawan' akan sakewa ba tare da karya tsoffin abokan ciniki ba.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR shine kuma sigina, Matrix, da NIP-29 suke amfani dashi akan dalilai iri daya. Daidaita zaɓi nasu yana nufin ƙa'idar mu ta fi sauƙi don tantancewa ta masu binciken tsaro waɗanda suka riga sun san rufaffiyar.
architecture.h7p1: Kowane firam yana ɗaukar `v:<int>`. Nau'in na yanzu shine 1. An jefar da firam ɗin da ba a sani ba; abokan ciniki sun shiga gargadi kuma su ci gaba da firam na gaba.
architecture.h7p2: An tabbatar da dacewa da baya ga kowane firam wanda har yanzu yana ɗauke da `v:1`. Daidaitawar gaba shine mafi kyawun ƙoƙari: ana ƙara sabbin filayen a ƙarshen dict, tsoffin abokan ciniki sunyi watsi da su.
architecture.h7p3: An keɓance ɓarna mai ƙarfi don sauye-sauye masu mahimmanci na tsaro (misali musanyawa HKDF igiyoyin mahallin mahallin). A waɗancan lokuta sigar ta bumps zuwa 2 kuma an buga taga ƙaura.
architecture.h1_a: Cibiyar sadarwa ta Vortex ta rabu gida uku. Kowanne yana gudanar da kansa, yana magana da sauran ta hanyar ƙayyadaddun ka'idojin waya, kuma ana iya maye gurbinsa da kansa. Babu monolith - kowane fasali yana toshe ɗaya daga cikin ayyuka uku.
architecture.h1_b: Abokin ciniki yana riƙe da maɓalli yana yin UI. Kullin yana ci gaba da rubutun, magoya baya suna fitar da abubuwan da suka faru sama da WebSocket, da dillalai WebRTC sigina. Mai sarrafawa yana buga bayanan sa hannu da URLs masu shigowa. Suna sadarwa ta HTTPS + WebSocket ta amfani da CBOR-encoded lodin kaya a cikin envelopes AES-GCM.
architecture.h1_c: An gabatar da rarrabuwa a cikin v0.0.3 bayan sigar farko ta monolith ta shiga cikin matsaloli guda biyu: an ɗaure shaidar saki ga kumburin gudu (don haka kumburin da aka daidaita zai iya yin ƙarya game da lambar kansa), kuma tarayya ba ta yiwuwa saboda yanayin kumburi da kuma amintaccen jihar suna zaune a cikin tebur guda. Rarraba shaida a cikin tsarin nasa ya ba kowane ma'aikacin maɓalli guda ɗaya don fiɗa kuma bari mu daidaita tarayya zuwa N.
architecture.h1_f:
abokin ciniki --HTTPS/WSS--> kumburi
  ^ |
  |                        v
  +--/v1/mutunci-- mai sarrafawa (bayyanuwar sa hannu)
architecture.h2_a: Rarraba kumburi/mai sarrafawa ya keɓance mafi kyawun kayan aikin tsaro (bayanin da aka sanya hannu) daga saman mafi girman harin (sabar API).
architecture.h2_b: Mai sarrafawa yana adana ƙaramin SQLite DB: amintattun mashaya, URLs madubi, da maki lafiya. Ya ƙi farawa idan INTEGRITY.sig.json bai dace da bishiyar kan-faifai ba - fayil ɗin da aka lalata ba zai taɓa yin hidimar `status:'tabbaci''. Kullin yana gudana akan nasa Postgres/SQLite kuma baya riƙe maɓallin saki.
architecture.h2_c: Tsarin ya fito ne daga rarrabuwar tushen-store na Chrome (takaddun shaida suna rayuwa akan waƙar sakin mai binciken, ba asalin gidan yanar gizo ba) da Release.gpg na Debian (bayyanar da sa hannu, fakitin da ba a sanya hannu ba). An karɓo saboda duka ƙira biyu sun tsira shekaru da yawa na bita na gaba.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 akan kowane hop, ƙarshen-zuwa-ƙarshen ɓoyayyen kaya a ciki. TLS sarrafa abin hawa; AES-GCM yana sarrafa abun ciki.
architecture.h3_b: Tsakanin abokin ciniki da kumburi: HTTPS (`/api/*`) da WSS (`/ws`). Tsakanin nodes: HTTPS (`/ tarayya/*`). Tsakanin kumburi da mai sarrafawa: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Duk ana amfani da TLS 1.3 tare da Chrome 120 yatsa don tsayayya DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Farkon Vortex an yi amfani da danyen TCP tare da musafaha na al'ada na amo-protocol. An canza zuwa TLS 1.3 a cikin v0.0.4 bayan sanin cewa ka'idodin al'ada suna sigina "mai ban sha'awa" ga masu sa ido. TLS 1.3 yana da ban sha'awa, a ko'ina, kuma ECH- shirye - abubuwa uku da muke so.
architecture.h3_f:
layin sufuri: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + na zaɓi ECH (RFC 9460)
Layer abun ciki: AES-256-GCM an rufe shi a ciki CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Saƙo ɗaya mai fita yana tafiya ta matakai huɗu: frame → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Abokin ciniki yana ƙididdige maɓallin ɗakin (X25519 + HKDF), yana tsara saƙon azaman CBOR, hatimi tare da AES-256-GCM ta amfani da bazuwar 96-bit nonce, POSTs zuwa `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node yana adana jeren rubutun kuma magoya baya ga kowane haɗin WebSocket da aka yi rajista a ɗakin. Abokin ciniki na mai karɓa yana yanke bayanan da maɓalli iri ɗaya. Jinkirin tafiya zagaye ƙasa da 50 ms akan gida LAN, ~120 ms hankula WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Bututun mai matakai huɗu daidai yake da Siginar da aka yi amfani da shi a cikin 2014; mun canza abin jigilar kaya ne kawai (WebSocket maimakon Signal's TCP) da codeing (CBOR maimakon protobuf). Daidaita ingantaccen ƙira yana bugun ƙirƙira sabo.
architecture.h5_a: Mun zaɓi CBOR sama da JSON da Protobuf bayan kwatanta girman lodin kaya, haɓakawa, da ergonomics debug akan ayyukan taɗi na gaske.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR yana samar da ~30% ƙarami fiye da JSON akan saƙon unicode-nauyi, ba shi da shubuha, kuma yana goyan bayan ƙara filin ba tare da janareta na ƙira ba. Proto zai buƙaci fayil na .proto kowane saki kuma zai daskare lambobin filin.
architecture.h5_c: An canza siginar daga protobuf zuwa CBOR-kamar ƙira a cikin 2017 saboda dalilai iri ɗaya. Matrix yana amfani da CBOR a cikin matakin matakin jiha. CBOR shine ma'auni na IETF (RFC 8949) kuma kowane harshe da muka yi niyya yana da babban ɗakin karatu.
architecture.h5_f:
Girman CBOR: ~0.7 × JSON akan gauraye utf-8
          ~ 1.05 × protobuf akan tsari iri ɗaya
Ƙara filin = ƙarawa a ƙarshe. Tsoffin abokan ciniki sun yi watsi da su.
architecture.h6_a: Me yasa CBOR - wani ɓangare na babin gine-gine. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka yi ishara da su cikin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
architecture.h6_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Me yasa CBOR". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
architecture.h6_c: Tsarin "Me yasa CBOR" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.
architecture.h7_a: Sigar yarjejeniya - wani ɓangare na babin gine-gine. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka ambata a duk faɗin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
architecture.h7_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Sigar Protocol". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
architecture.h7_c: Tsarin "Protocol versioning" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.

crypto.title: Abubuwan farko na Cryptographic
crypto.subtitle: Kowane algorithm a cikin tari, manufarsa, sigoginsa, RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex yana amfani da abubuwan da aka bita kawai na tsara. Babu abubuwan toshe al'ada, babu KDFs na gida, babu tsarin sa hannu na labari. Wannan babin yana tattara kowane daɗaɗɗen da muke amfani da shi, ainihin ma'auni, da dalilin da ke bayan kowane zaɓi.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) a cikin sigarsa ta Montgomery, ana amfani da ita don Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. Maɓallai masu zaman kansu 32-byte, maɓallan jama'a-byte 32, fitowar sirrin 32-byte da aka raba.
crypto.h1p2: An yi amfani da shi don: ainihin na'urar, maɓallan zaman ephemeral, rufaffiyar ambulaf ɗin turawa, murɗa maɓallin ɗaki, ambulaf ɗin tarayya.
crypto.h1p3: Aiwatar da iOS: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` daga CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` ta hanyar JNI. Node: `cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` sama da OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Duk uku interop bit-for-bit. An gwada tafiya zagaye da RFC 7748 Alice/Bob gwajin vectors akan kowane gini.
crypto.h1p5: Aiki: ~ 100µs a kowace Diffie-Hellman akan iPhone 2020, ~ 30µs akan Mac 2020. Zagaye na makullin daki don ƙungiyar membobi 200 yana ɗaukar kusan agogon bango 10 ms.
crypto.h1p6: Matsakaicin lokaci: Ee, duka a cikin lissafin lanƙwasa da hanyar yanke hukunci da ɗanyen-byte.
crypto.h1p7: Matsayin tashoshi na gefe: Tsani na Montgomery ba shi da kariya daga nau'in hare-haren lokaci wanda ya kai ga lanƙwasa Weierstrass; OpenSSL da Swift CryptoKit duka suna amfani da shi.
crypto.h1p8: Serialisation maɓalli: 32-byte little-endian. Ana manne maɓallan jama'a akan shigo da su don haka abubuwan da ba su da kyau ba su haifar da ɗigo-ƙara-ƙasa ba.
crypto.h1l1: Me yasa X25519 kuma ba P-256: sauri, karami, babu damuwa NIST-curve.
crypto.h1l2: Me yasa fitowar 32-byte ba 64 ba: matches HKDF-SHA256 tsayin shigarwa daidai.
crypto.h1l3: Me yasa Montgomery kuma ba Edwards: kawai muna buƙatar DH, ba sa hannun hannu ba, akan wannan mahimmin kayan. Edwards zai buƙaci matakin juyowa kowane lokaci.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) sama da edwards25519. Maɓallin jama'a 32-byte, sa hannun 64-byte.
crypto.h2p2: An yi amfani da shi don: shaidar kumburi akan saƙon tarayya, sa hannun maɓalli na sakin sa hannu kan ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun bayanai, sa hannu na bot, ainihin na'urar dogon lokaci don Ratchet Double.
crypto.h2p3: Ƙaddara: bambancin RFC 8032 da muke amfani da shi yana samar da sa hannu iri ɗaya sau biyu don maɓalli iri ɗaya +. CryptoKit na Apple akan iOS 17+ yana amfani da RFC 8032bis bazuwar bambance-bambancen - duka biyun suna da inganci kuma duka suna tabbatarwa tare da kowane mai tabbatarwa.
crypto.h2p4: Kudin tabbatarwa: ~ 200µs akan zamani CPU. Tabbatar da tsari ('batch_verify([msg,sig,pk]*N)') shine ~10× cikin sauri kowace sa hannu.
crypto.h2p5: Tsarin sa hannu: `R || S`, 32 bytes kowane, ƙaramin-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Wakilin maɓalli na jama'a: 32-byte matsa lamba. Koyaushe mai aiki - babu "ma'ana a rashin iyaka".
crypto.h2l2: Wakilin maɓalli mai zaman kansa: iri 32-byte. Ana samun faɗaɗa scalar akan tashi ta SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Me yasa ba ECDSA: ECDSA yana buƙatar ingantaccen RNG ga kowane sa hannu; mai son zuciya RNG yana zubda makullin sirri. Ed25519 yana da kayyadewa, babu RNG da ake buƙata a lokacin sa hannu.
crypto.h3p1: AES a cikin Yanayin Galois/Counter (NIST SP 800-38D). Maɓallai 256-bit, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit tags.
crypto.h3p2: An yi amfani da shi don: ambulaf ɗin saƙon ciphertext, envelopes chunk file, rufaffen kayan ajiya na ajiya, kayan aikin tura hatimi.
crypto.h3p3: Gine-ginen da ba a yi ba: kowane saƙo yana haifar da sabon bazuwar 96-bit bazuwar. Kullin yana bin 10^6 nonces na ƙarshe a kowane ɗaki kuma yana sauke kwafi da kariya - dole ne abokin ciniki ya samar da kwafi a farkon wuri, amma ɗauka-babu wani abu mai arha.
crypto.h3p4: Me yasa 96-bit nonces kuma ba 128-bit ba: 96 bits shine GCM-misali "ƙaddamarwa" tsayin daka, kuma yana ba mu 2 ^ 32 bazuwar nonces kafin karon ranar haihuwa ya zama damuwa. Ana juya maɓallin daki ɗaya tun kafin wannan, don haka yana da lafiya.
crypto.h3p5: Girman tag: cikakken 128 bits. Ba mu yanke - tanadin ajiya ba ya da komai kuma guntu yana ƙara yuwuwar jabu.
crypto.h3l1: Haɓakar kayan aiki: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A kari na crypto, keɓaɓɓun tubalan crypto akan Apple Silicon. Sigar ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: A kan tsoffin na'urori ARM ba tare da kari na crypto ba: ~ 300 MB/s ta software. Har yanzu yana sauri fiye da faifai IO.
crypto.h3l3: Bayanai masu alaƙa: maɓallin firam (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) an wuce shi azaman AAD don haka jabun rubutun ba zai tantance ba.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) tare da SHA-256. Yana samun maɓalli 32-byte da yawa daga shigarwar 32-byte guda ɗaya.
crypto.h4p2: Ana amfani da shi don: raba fitarwar X25519 zuwa maɓallin ɓoyewa + MAC maɓallin + maɓallin kai; samun tushen ratchet key daga wani zagaye na Diffie-Hellman; gina maɓallan fayil na kowane-chunk daga tushen fayil ɗin.
crypto.h4p3: Ƙididdigar bayanai koyaushe suna da ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun bayanai ASCII: `"v1: boye-boye"`, `"v1:mac", `"v1: header", `"v1: madadin"`. Siffar tana ba mu damar jujjuya dukkan matakan maɓalli ta hanyar canjin bayanai.
crypto.h4p4: Gishiri na zaɓi ne. A cikin Vortex muna amfani da id na dakin azaman gishiri don samun maɓallin ɗaki don haka dakuna daban-daban ba za su iya sake amfani da maɓallan da aka samu ba da gangan ko da fitowar X25519 iri ɗaya ta bayyana.
crypto.h4l1: Me yasa SHA-256 kuma ba SHA-512: duk dandamali suna da hardware SHA-256 hanzari; SHA-512 yana da sauri da sauri akan CPUs 64-bit amma ba akan wayoyi ba.
crypto.h4l2: Me yasa ba tushen KMAC KDF: KMAC shine alkuki. HKDF yana cikin kowane ɗakin karatu na crypto da muke amfani da shi.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106). Siga: m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5p2: Ana amfani da shi don: hash kalmar sirri ta gefen uwar garken (`users.password_hash`), maɓalli na kundi na gida, ƙaddamar da saƙon iri.
crypto.h5p3: Me yasa waɗannan sigogi: OWASP 2023 shawarwari. 64 MiB + 3 iterations yana ɗaukar ~ 0.5 s akan iPhone X - na'urarmu mafi jinkirin tallafi. Har yanzu mai hari ASIC mai girman 100× ƙwaƙwalwar ajiyar waya yana buƙatar ~5 ms a kowane ƙoƙari. Dogayen kalmomin sirri (entropy> 40 ragowa) sun zama ba su da yuwuwar ƙididdigewa a sikelin.
crypto.h5p4: Tsarin ajiya: `argon2:<encoded>`inda aka rufa masa asiri shine sigar RFC-tsara gami da gishiri, ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya, iterations, da hash.
crypto.h5l1: Me yasa Argon2id kuma ba Argon2i ko Argon2d: 2id shine matasan - izinin farko yana tsayayya da tashoshi na gefe (i-yanayin), wucewar wucewa ta gaba tana tsayayya GPU/ASIC (d-yanayin). Sigina yana amfani da iri ɗaya.
crypto.h5l2: Dummy-hash kwatankwacin: ko da mai amfani bai wanzu ba, har yanzu muna gudanar da tantancewar Argon2 na karya tare da ci gaba da zanta. Wannan yana daidaita lokacin shiga don haka maharan ba za su iya ƙididdige sunayen mai amfani ta lokacin amsawa ba.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash lokacin shiga: idan mai gudanarwa na uwar garken ya ci karo da farashin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya, ana sake sa tsofaffin hashes a shiga na gaba mai nasara. Bayyana ga mai amfani.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024). ML-KEM-768. Maɓallin jama'a 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertext, sirrin raba-byte 32.
crypto.h6p2: An yi amfani da shi don: maɓallan zaman jimlar jimla bayan jimla. Lokacin da takwarorinsu biyu ke tallata tallafin Kyber, maɓallin zaman shine `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Me yasa matasan: ko da Kyber ya karye daga baya (kwatankwacin matashi ne), sashin X25519 yana kare mu. Haɗuwa yana ba da mafi kyawun-na-biyu.
crypto.h6p4: Me yasa Kyber kuma ba sauran 'yan takara NIST: shine wanda aka zaba don daidaitawa. Samun lambar yana da faɗi (liboks, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Aiki: maɓalli ~ 100 µs, encapsulation ~ 30 µs, decapsulation ~ 50 µs. Babu komai idan aka kwatanta da jinkirin tafiya.
crypto.h6l2: Farashin Bandwidth: 1088 bytes a kowace rubutun zama, 1184 bytes don maɓallin jama'a. Ana biyan zaman a tuntuɓar farko; daga baya sifili ne.
crypto.h6l3: Gefen uwar garken: 'pqcrypto` Python kunshin tare da `kem.ml_kem_768`. Gefen abokin ciniki: liboqs ta hanyar daurin dandamali.
crypto.h7p1: Sigina's Double Ratchet (kamar yadda aka ƙayyade a cikin 2016 na jama'a ƙayyadaddun bayanai). Haɗa ratsan Diffie-Hellman tare da sarkar maɓalli na simmetric.
crypto.h7p2: Ana amfani dashi don: saƙonni kai tsaye tsakanin na'urori biyu. Dakunan rukuni suna amfani da tsarin "maɓallin mai aikawa" mafi sauƙi wanda aka kulle tushen ɗakin.
crypto.h7p3: Kayayyakin: sirrin gaba (lalata na'urar kawai yana fallasa saƙonnin da ta rigaya ta karɓa, ba na gaba ba), tsaro bayan sulhu (sake dawo da warkewa bayan maɓalli mai mahimmanci), isarwa ba tare da izini ba (har zuwa saƙonnin 1000 na tsallakewa).
crypto.h7p4: Aiwatar da mu tana cikin `app/security/double_ratchet.py` da `ios/Modules/sources/Chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android/app/src/main/.../chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.kt`.
crypto.h7l1: Tsawon sarkar: saƙon 1000 a kowace sarkar kafin a tilasta sake yin bege. Yana iyakance lalacewa daga maɓallin sarkar da aka sace.
crypto.h7l2: Maɓallin maɓalli da aka tsallake: har zuwa maɓallai marasa tsari 1000 ana ajiye su a ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya kowace sarkar. Bayan haka, an ƙi saƙon a matsayin tsayayyen abu.
crypto.h7l3: Rufin rubutun kai: kunna ta tsohuwa. Kan kai yana ɗaukar metadata ratchet kuma an rufaffen shi tare da keɓaɓɓen maɓallin keɓaɓɓen da aka samo daga tushen ta hanyar HKDF.
crypto.h8p1: Asalin fayil ɗin da ba na sirri ba yana amfani da BLAKE3 saboda yana da sauri 10 × fiye da SHA-256 akan manyan ɓangarorin.
crypto.h8p2: An yi amfani da shi don: fayil `sha256` shafi a cikin DB (sunan tarihi; a zahiri BLAKE3 a ƙarƙashin hular tun v0.1.2), abin da aka makala, duba amincin loda fayil.
crypto.h8p3: Matsayin tsaro: BLAKE3 yana da ƙarfi a ɓoye (256-bit); muna kiran shafi 'sha256' don dacewa da ƙaura kawai.
crypto.h9p1: Ana samar da duk wani abu, prekeys, ƙimar ƙalubalen ta hanyar OS RNG: `SecRandom' akan iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom' akan Android, `sirrin.token_bytes' akan Python (rufe `/dev/urandom` ko makamancin haka).
crypto.h9p2: Kar a taba `random.random()`, taba `Math.random()`, taba `rand()`. Dokokin Lint sun hana amfani da su a cikin ƙirar crypto.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC kwatancen, tabbatarwa sa hannu, tabbatar da kalmar sirri ta hash - duk suna amfani da tsayayyen lokaci don hana tashoshi gefen lokaci.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 shine elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman akan Curve25519 a cikin sigar sa ta Montgomery. Maɓallan 32-byte, sirrin raba 32-byte. Kowane maɓalli na sirri / ainihin na'urar da ke tsaye / maɓallin zaman a cikin Vortex yana amfani da shi.
crypto.h1_b: Alice da Bob kowanne yana da maɓallan sirri a, b da maɓallan jama'a A = a·G, B = b·G inda G shine madaidaicin tushe. Suna lissafta s = a·B = b·A. Wannan sirrin-byte da aka raba yana shiga cikin HKDF-SHA256 don samo maɓallan AES-GCM daidai. Ana yin lissafin lanƙwasa a cikin lokaci akai-akai ta amfani da tsani na Montgomery; babu rassa akan bayanan sirri.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 Daniel J. Bernstein ne ya buga shi a cikin 2005 kuma IETF ya zaba a cikin RFC 7748 (2016). An karɓa ta sigina, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard. Vortex yana amfani da shi saboda yana da sauri fiye da P-256, yana da mafi girman girman maɓalli 32-byte, yana guje wa damuwa na NIST, kuma kowane dandamali yana jigilar aiwatarwa mai ƙarfi.
crypto.h1_f:
Maɓalli mai zaman kansa: a ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes ƙaramin-endian)
Maɓalli na jama'a: A = a · G (maƙalar matsewar 32-byte)
Sirrin da aka raba: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, →HKDF shigarwa)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 shine ɗan'uwan sa hannu na X25519, yana amfani da lanƙwasa iri ɗaya a cikin sigar sa ta karkace-Edwards. Maɓallan jama'a 32-byte, sa hannun sa hannun 64-byte, ƙaddara ta tsohuwa.
crypto.h2_b: Don sanya hannu m tare da maɓalli na sirri d: lissafta r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Sa hannu shine (R, S). Tabbatarwa: duba R + c·A = S·G. Ƙaddamar sa hannu yana guje wa haɗarin sake amfani da shi gaba ɗaya - sa hannu biyu na saƙo ɗaya tare da maɓalli iri ɗaya suna da ɗan kama.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) ya fito daga takardar Bernstein ta 2011 tare da Duif, Lange, Schwabe, da Yang. An karɓa da yawa bayan 2013. Apple's CryptoKit, Google's Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH duk suna amfani da shi. Vortex alamar kowane ambulaf na tarayya da kowane shaidar node tare da Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Alamar (d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = da G
              c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  S = r + ca
              dawo (R, S)

Tabbatar: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
crypto.h3_a: AES a cikin Yanayin Galois/Counter. Maɓallai 256-bit, 96-bit bazuwar nonces, 128-bit tags. Kowane ɓoyayyen ɓoye a cikin Vortex yana amfani da GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM yana gudanar da AES a cikin yanayin CTR kuma yana lissafta GHASH akan rubutun + AAD ta amfani da maɓalli na daban da aka samo daga maɓallin ɓoyewa. Tag = GHASH(AAD, rubutun kalmomi) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Ƙididdigar sake ƙididdigewa GHASH da kwatanta - kowane juzu'i guda ɗaya ya kasa tabbatarwa. Haɓaka kayan aiki akan kowane CPU na zamani ta hanyar AES-NI ko ARMv8-A kari na crypto.
crypto.h3_c: AES ya lashe gasar NIST AES a shekarar 2001. Vortex yana ɗaukar maɓallan 256-bit duk da cewa 128-bit zai isa a kan abokan gaba na gargajiya - tsalle zuwa 256-bit yana ba mu kusan 128 ragowa na tsaro bayan jimla a ƙarƙashin algorithm Grover.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypt (k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR(k, n, pt)
                          tag = GHASH_h (aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1)
                          dawo ct ∥tag
Kada a sake amfani da ⇒ sirrin + sahihancin karya.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (⟪1- tushen KDF, RFC 5869) yana juya maɓalli ɗaya zuwa da yawa. Yana ɗaukar babban shigarwar entropy da lakabin mahallin; yana fitar da bytes 32 akan kowane lakabi.
crypto.h4_b: Mataki Biyu: Cire da Fadada. Cire = HMAC-SHA256(gishiri, IKM) → PRK. Expand = HMAC-SHA256 (PRK, info∥counter) wanda aka haɗa don baiti na len. Muna amfani da wannan don raba fitowar X25519 zuwa maɓallin ɓoyewa, maɓallin MAC, da maɓallin kai tare da igiyoyin bayanai "v1: encryption", "v1: mac", "v1: header".
crypto.h4_c: Hugo Krawczyk ne ya buga HKDF a EUROCRYPT 2010 kuma an daidaita shi azaman RFC 5869 a cikin 2010. TLS 1.3 yayi amfani dashi don jadawalin sa, ta sigina don Double Ratchet, ta WireGuard don maɓallan zaman. Sigar da ke cikin igiyoyin bayanai suna ba mu damar jujjuya duk matakan maɓalli ta hanyar buga "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(gishiri, IKM)
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ info ∥ i)
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id shine hash ɗin kalmar sirri mai wuyar ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya wanda aka tsara don tsayayya GPU da ASIC maharan. Siga m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id yana haxa Argon2i (yana adawa da tashoshi na gefe ta hanyar rashin yin reshe akan bayanan da aka samo kalmar sirri) tare da Argon2d (cika ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya ba tare da tsinkaya ba don haka kayan aikin layi ɗaya ba zai iya yanke sasanninta ba). Rabin farko na farko shine mai zaman kansa na bayanai (i-yanayin); saura ya dogara da bayanai (d-mode). 0.5 seconds na ƙididdigewa akan iPhone X a sigoginmu, kusan 5 ms akan ASIC - saurin ~ 100 × kadan ne idan aka kwatanta da hashes na tushen SHA-256 inda ASICs suka ci nasara da 1 000 000 ×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 ya lashe gasar Hashing Password na 2015 wanda Dmitry Khovratovich da Alex Biryukov suka shirya. An daidaita shi azaman RFC 9106 a cikin 2021. Ana amfani da 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Ma'auni na Vortex sun fito ne daga shawarwarin OWASP 2023, an kunna su don yin shiga akan na'urar mu mafi jinkirin tallafi (iPhone X) a ƙarƙashin 1 seconds.
crypto.h5_f:
farashi (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0.5 s akan iPhone X
Farashin mai hari: m × t × (p / attack_parallelism)
A 10¹⁰ zato/s tare da entropy kalmar sirri 40-bit:
  10¹² seconds = 32 000 shekaru
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) shine tsarin NIST daidaitaccen madaidaicin madaidaicin mabuɗin maɓalli na bayan-kuɗi. Yana ba da maɓallan zaman amintaccen adadi haɗe da X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice ta haifar (pk, sk). Bob ya kira Encapsulate(pk) → (c, ss); aika c zuwa Alice. Alice ta kira Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Bangarorin biyu yanzu suna raba ss, sirrin 32-byte. Tsaro yana raguwa zuwa matsalar Module-LWE, wanda aka yi imani da yawa-hard. Muna haɗa shi da X25519: session_key = HKDF(x25519_output ∥ kyber_output). Idan rabi ya tsira, zaman yayi.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber ya zaɓi NIST a cikin Yuli 2022 bayan gasar shekaru 6. An daidaita shi azaman FIPS 203 a watan Agusta 2024. Vortex yana jigilar Kyber a matsayin zaɓi saboda yana ƙara ~2 KB musafaha kowane lokaci; an kunna ta tsohuwa don masu biyan kuɗi, ficewa a wani wuri. Sigina ya ba da shawarar tsarin haɗaɗɗiyar a cikin 2023 kuma Chrome ya karbe shi a cikin 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Decaps (sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
zaman matasan = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info = "zama-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Sigina's Double Ratchet yana ba da sirrin gaba da tsaro bayan sulhu don tattaunawar 1:1.
crypto.h7_b: Sarkoki guda biyu: sarkar aikawa da sarkar karba. Kowane saƙo yana ci gaba da sarkar sa ta HKDF. Sau da yawa Diffie-Hellman ratchet yana haɓaka tushen, yana sake maɓalli duka sarƙoƙi. Amincewa da maɓallin sarkar yana fallasa saƙonnin da aka rufawa kai tsaye kawai. Bayan ratchet DH, saƙonnin nan gaba ba su da lafiya ko da maharin ya saci maɓallin sarka.
crypto.h7_c: Trevor Perrin da Moxie Marlinspike ne suka tsara su a cikin 2013, an tura su cikin Siginar 2014, WhatsApp (2016) ya karbe shi, Tattaunawar Sirrin Facebook Messenger, Tattaunawar sirri ta Skype. Public spec in 2016. Vortex aiwatar da ita tashar jiragen ruwa kai tsaye; hulɗa tare da sauran abokan cinikin sigina-protocol yana kan taswirar hanya v0.4.
crypto.h7_f:
aika: CK = HKDF(CK, "mataki");  MK = HKDF(CK, "msg")
karba: CK' = HKDF(CK', "mataki"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "msg")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(mu_eph, su_eph), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing don fayiloli - wani ɓangare na babin crypto. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka yi ishara da su cikin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
crypto.h8_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "BLAKE3 hashing for files". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
crypto.h8_c: Tsarin "BLAKE3 hashing for files" ya samo asali a cikin fitowar Vortex. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.

crypto.h9_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "ƙararrun lambar bazuwar". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
