cryptoWire.title: Tsarin waya na Crypto
cryptoWire.subtitle: Daidai madaidaicin shimfidu na byte don kowane ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoye.
cryptoWire.intro: Wannan babin yana fayyace bayanan bytes akan waya. Duk wanda ke aiwatar da madadin abokin ciniki ko kayan aikin bincike na iya karantawa tare.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Tsarin: `{v:1, nonce:<12-byte hex>, ciphertext:<mai canzawa hex>, sender_pseudo: <32-hex>, sent_at: <unix_ms>}`. An aika sama da HTTPS (POST) da WebSocket (nau'in firam'm').
cryptoWire.h1p2: abun ciki `ciphertext` bayan AES-GCM decryption: CBOR `{v:1, rubutu?:<string>, haše-haše?:[<file_id>, …], amsa_to?:<msg_id>, gyara?:[<prior_text>, …], ambaci?:[<mai amfani}`>.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag yana biye da ita: zaren 'ciphertext' byte string ne (rufe-rufe abin biya || tag 16-byte). Abokin ciniki ya rabu akan tsayi.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: ƙananan hex room id an wuce azaman bayanan haɗin gwiwa. Daure id na dakin yana hana sake yin wasan giciye.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Maɓallin tushen fayil bazuwar 32 bytes ne. Maɓalli ɗaya: `HKDF (tushen, bayani: "fayil: chunk:" + <offset>, len: 32)'.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Ciphertext: AES-GCM tare da maɓalli guda ɗaya, bazuwar 96-bit ba haka ba, AAD: `<file_id> || <fitarwa>'. Matsakaicin girman 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Cikakken cikakken fayil: abokin ciniki yana ƙididdige BLAKE3 akan rubutu mai haske kuma ya aika a matsayin 'plain_blake3' ga mai karɓa ta saƙon ɗakin. Mai karɓa yana ƙididdigewa bayan zazzagewa kuma ya tabbatar.
cryptoWire.h3p1: Abokin ciniki yana loda `p256dh_pub` (32-byte X25519) zuwa kumburi.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Lokacin turawa, kumburi yana haifar da maɓallin ephemeral X25519, yayi DH tare da `p256dh_pub`, yana samun maɓallin AES-GCM ta HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Rufin da aka rufe: `{ƙarshen, p256dh: mashaya abokin ciniki, auth: 16 bytes, bayanai: ciphertext||tag}`. APNs/FCM duba 'bayanai' kawai.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Abokin ciniki yana yanke ɓoyewa yayin karɓa ta amfani da maɓallin keɓaɓɓen sa da kuma `p256dh` (wanda shine ainihin gidan giya na kumburi a cikin ambulaf).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Kalmar wucewa tana samun maɓallin madadin ta hanyar Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, gishiri=<bazuwar 16B>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{gishiri, nonce, ciphertext}`. Ciphertext shine CBOR na `{v:1, dakuna:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], profile:{...}, lambobin sadarwa:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: An adana ko dai a cikin gida (iCloud / Google Drive) ko kuma akan kumburi a cikin ɗakin keɓaɓɓen mai amfani.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Saƙon kuɗaɗe: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, ciki: {... daidai da ambulaf ɗin ɗaki ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}'.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` yana rufe CBOR-jeri-jerin `{source_node, target_user, ciki}`. Maƙasudin yana tabbatar da maɓalli na tushen_node' daga 'trusted_nodes'.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Saƙon ɗaki ɗaya akan waya shine CBOR dict tare da ɓoyayyen kaya, bance, sunan mai aikawa, da tambarin lokaci. Ambulan yana daya ko yana hawa HTTPS (POST) ko WebSocket (nau'in 'm' frame).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Abokin ciniki yana tsara sashin saƙon `{v:1, rubutu, amsa_zuwa, aika_a}` kamar yadda CBOR → `pt`. Yana haifar da bazuwar 12-byte nonce. Yana lissafin `aad = hex(room_id)`. Kira `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt(key_key, nonce, pt, aad)`. Kunna cikin `{v:1, ciphertext: hex(ct), nonce: hex(nonce), sender_pseudo: hex(pseudo), sent_at: unix_ms}` da aika. Mai karɓa yana tabbatar da alamar GCM yayin cire ɓoye bayanan, sannan CBOR-nazartar da rubutu.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Siffar wayar sigar sigar alama ce tun v0.0.4 bayan sakin v0.0.3 mai zubar da ciki wanda ba shi da filin `v` - dole ne mu dunkule tsarin gaba ɗaya lokacin da muka ƙara 'thread_id' saboda tsoffin abokan ciniki sun yi karo akan maɓallin da ba a sani ba. Darasi da aka koya: kowace siffar waya ta gaba tana ɗauke da `v:N' a filin sa na farko don haka dacewa da gaba a bayyane yake.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Ana raba fayiloli zuwa gaɓoɓin ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun girman, kowannensu yana da nasa maɓalli wanda aka samo daga tushen fayil ɗin da maɓalli. Rufe-ɓoye-ɓoye ɗaya yana ƙyale mai aikawa ya ɗan dakata/ci gaba akan kowace iyaka.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Maɓallin tushen fayil bazuwar 32 bytes ne. Maɓalli ɗaya ɗaya shine `HKDF(tushen, info = "file: chunk:" + str(offset), len=32)'. Kowane gunki an rufaffen AES-GCM tare da nasa maɓalli, bazuwar 96-bit, da `aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Chunks tsoho zuwa 512 KiB; 4 MiB. Ana aika cikakken fayil BLAKE3 azaman `plain_blake3` a cikin saƙon ɗakin da ke nuni da fayil ɗin don haka masu karɓa zasu iya tantancewa bayan ɓoye bayanan.
cryptoWire.h2_c: An ƙaddamar da ɓoye E2E ɓoye tare da maɓallan kowane-chunk ta Mega.nz a cikin 2013 kuma an daidaita shi ta hanyar tallafin manyan fayiloli na Sigina a cikin 2019. Vortex's 512 KiB tsoho shine girman wanda TCP sarrafa kwararar ke kiyaye bututun ta hannu ba tare da dogon wutsiya ba. Mun gwada 256/512/1024/4096 KiB kuma 512 shine wuri mai dadi a ma'aunin mu.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Rufe ambulan turawa yana ɓoye nauyin sanarwa daga Apple / Google / Mozilla ta hanyar ɓoyewa tare da takamaiman maɓalli X25519 na'urar.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Abokin ciniki yana yin rijistar `p256dh_pub` da `auth` a kumburi. Lokacin da turawa ya ƙare, kumburi yana gudana ephemeral-ECDH tare da p256dh_pub, yana samun maɓallin + nonce ta hanyar HKDF tare da sirrin sirri azaman gishiri. Yana ɓoye `{ take, jiki, ɗakin_id, saƙon_id}` tare da AES-GCM. Yana aika rikodin azaman filin 'bayanai' mara ƙarfi zuwa mai ba da turawa. Tsawancin na'ura yana sake samowa, ɓarnawa, sakewa.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Rufewar turawa shine ƙayyadaddun ɓoyewar saƙon Yanar gizo (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple an ɗauke shi a cikin Sabis na Sabis na Fadakarwa na iOS 16. Kafin tura hatimin ya sami tallafi ko'ina, Sigina da WhatsApp sun aiko da shiru "wani abu ya zo" pings ba tare da abun ciki ba kuma app ɗin ya ɗauko saƙon a farke - wanda a hankali. Rufewar turawa yana ba mu keɓantawar ƙarshen-zuwa-ƙarshe tare da bayarwa nan take.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Rufaffen ɓangarorin ajiya yana bawa mai amfani damar maido da maɓallan ɗaki + bayanin martaba + kwanaki 90 na ƙarshe akan sabuwar na'ura daga kalmar sirri kaɗai.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Maɓallin Ajiyayyen yana samuwa daga kalmar sirri ta Argon2id tare da bazuwar gishiri 16-byte. Ana biya shine CBOR: `{v:1, dakuna: [{id, key, msg_ref_ids}], profile, contacts}`. Rufaffen ɓoye tare da AES-GCM ƙarƙashin maɓallin da aka samo. An adana ko dai a cikin gida (iCloud / Google Drive) ko azaman fayil a cikin ɗakin girgije mai zaman kansa na mai amfani. Mayar: shigar da kalmar sirri → Argon2id → decrypt → sake shigo da maɓallan da nassoshi.
cryptoWire.h4_c: An ƙirƙiri tsarin akan 1Password's OPVault (2013) da ɓoyayyen fitarwa na Bitwarden (2017). Dukansu suna amfani da KDF-sai-AEAD tare da metadata mai cike da gishiri. Vortex ya kara datsawar kwanaki 90 saboda cikakkun bayanan tarihi sun kasance 100 MB+ a gwaji; Mafi yawan masu mayarwa kawai suna buƙatar saƙonnin kwanan nan, kuma tsofaffin abun ciki har yanzu ana iya samun su ta hanyar rubutun sabar lokacin da mai amfani yana da haɗin kai.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Saƙon ƙungiyar ƙetarewa yana nannade ambulan da aka riga aka rufaffen ciki a cikin ambulaf ɗin waje da aka sa hannu wanda ke tabbatar da kumburin tushe.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A serials `{source_node, target_user, inner_ct, inner_nonce, sent_at}` as CBOR. Alamomi tare da maɓallin saki na sirri na Ed25519 → `sig`. POSTs `{ambulan, sig}` zuwa kumburin B's `/ tarayya/ba da'. B yana tabbatar da 'sig' akan maɓalli don 'tushen_node' a cikin' tarayya', yana bincika tambarin lokaci a cikin tagar skew na mintuna 5, sannan ya rubuta rubutun ciki zuwa teburin 'saƙonnin' nasa don mai amfani.
cryptoWire.h5_c: An yi aro ambulan da aka sa hannu daga Matrix's Federation spec (2015) da ActivityPub's HTTP Sa hannu (2018). Tagan na mintuna 5 yayi daidai da shawarwarin SMTP's RFC 5321 kuma yana hana sake yin harin inda maharin ya kama tarayya guda POST sannan ya sake yin sa'o'i bayan haka. Vortex ya zaɓi Ed25519 akan RSA-PSS saboda sa hannun Ed25519 shine bytes 64 vs RSA-PSS-2048's 256 bytes - al'amura lokacin da tarayya ke hira.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
file_root = Rand (32)
chunk_key (o) = HKDF (fayil_tushen, "fayil: chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct(o) = AES-GCM(chunk_key(o), rand(12), plaintext, aad=file_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(plaintext_bytes_of_full_file) // aika a matsayin plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
ephemeral = (priv, mashaya);  ikm = ECDH(ephemeral.priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256 (auth, ikm)
maɓalli = HKDF- Expand (prk, "Tsarin-Tsarin Abun ciki: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF- Expand (prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM (maɓalli, nonce, CBOR{ take, jiki, ɗakin_id, saƙon_id})
waya = gishiri (16) ∥ rs (4) ∥ rago (1) ∥ ephemeral.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
gishiri = rand (16)
key = Argon2id (kalmar sirri, gishiri, m = 64MiB, t=3, p=4, len=32)
nonce = rand (12)
ct = AES-GCM(maɓalli, nonce, CBOR{dakuna, bayanin martaba, lambobin sadarwa}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
file = {v:1, gishiri, nonce, ct}

auth.title: Tabbatarwa
auth.subtitle: Yi rijista, shiga, sabunta, sokewa. JWT + X25519 + lambar wucewa / iri / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex yana fitar da JWTs na ɗan gajeren lokaci (samun minti 15, wartsakewa na kwanaki 30) tare da maɓallin jama'a na X25519 mai amfani daure a ciki. Kowane maɓalli mai mahimmanci yana bincika JWT + yana tabbatar da cewa ba a soke maɓallin ba. Wannan babin ya ƙunshi kowane kwarara daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe.
auth.h1p1: Abokin ciniki yana farawa ta hanyar samar da sabon maɓalli na sirri 32-byte X25519 tare da OS RNG. Yana samo maɓalli na jama'a, yana ɓoye azaman chars hex 64.
auth.h1p2: Abokin ciniki yana aika 'POST /api/authentication/register' tare da `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, phone, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}`.
auth.h1p3: Node yana inganta: matches sunan mai amfani `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (ƙananan harka don guje wa squats na homograph); kalmar sirri ta wuce ƙarfin salon zxcvbn (maki na 2); wayar ta dace da E.164 idan an bayar; matches imel RFC 5322 regex na asali idan an ba su.
auth.h1p4: Node yana bincika keɓancewar `x25519_public_key` - kowane maɓalli na iya yin rajista daidai asusu ɗaya. Wannan yana dakatar da hare-haren rajista masu yawa waɗanda ke sake amfani da maɓalli iri ɗaya.
auth.h1p5: Node yana gudanar da Argon2id akan kalmar sirri (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) kuma yana adana 'argon2:$...$` a cikin 'users.password_hash'.
auth.h1p6: Node mints biyu JWTs: samun dama (minti 15, `jti: <na'urar_id>`) da wartsake (30 d). Da'awar: `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access| refresh, exp: ...}`. Sa hannu HS256 sama da sirrin uwar garken 64-byte wanda aka loda daga `.env`.
auth.h1p7: Node yana ƙirƙirar jeren 'na'urori' masu amfani: `{user_id, device_id, user_agent, created_at}`. Kowane sabuntawa yana daura da na'urarsa_id; soke na'urar yana kashe wannan rafi kawai.
auth.h1p8: Martani: `{ok, user_id, username, access_token, refresh_token, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key, display_name, avatar_url, phone, email}`.
auth.h1p9: Abokin ciniki yana adana alamu a cikin Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Cikin kukis (yanar gizo).
auth.h1l1: Ƙimar ƙima: Rajista 5 a cikin daƙiƙa 60 a kowace IP. TESTING=gaskiya yana kashe wannan.
auth.h1l2: Yanayin gayyata: idan `REGISTRATION_MODE=gayyata`, dole ne jikin ya ƙunshi invite_code' mai aiki. Ana samar da lambobin ta hanyar admin API.
auth.h1l3: Yanayin Rufe: `REGISTRATION_MODE=rufe'. Manajan iri ne kawai zai iya yin rajista. Masu amfani na gaba suna zuwa ta hanyoyin haɗin gayyata zuwa takamaiman ɗakuna.
auth.h2p1: Rubutun abokin ciniki `POST /api/authentication/login` tare da `{username, kalmar sirri}`.
auth.h2p2: Node queries 'masu amfani' ta ƙananan sunan mai amfani. Idan ba'a samo shi ba, har yanzu yana gudanar da juzu'i Argon2 tabbatarwa akan madaidaicin zanta don daidaita lokaci (~ 0.5 s kowace hanya).
auth.h2p3: Idan Argon2 tabbatar ya yi nasara kuma asusun bai kashe ba, kumburi zai dawo da ambulaf iri ɗaya kamar rajista. An ƙirƙiri sabon jere 'na'urorin_mai amfani'; Layukan da ake da su an bar su su kaɗai don haka za a iya shigar da mai amfani akan na'urori da yawa.
auth.h2p4: Idan tabbatarwa ya gaza, kumburi zai dawo da 401 tare da `{kuskure:"shararrun shaidar da ba daidai ba"}`. Babu bambanci tsakanin "sunan mai amfani mara kyau" da "maɓallin kalmar sirri" a cikin martani.
auth.h2l1: Ƙimar ƙima: Ƙoƙarin 10 da ba a yi nasara ba a cikin daƙiƙa 60 a kowace IP. Ya wuce dawowa 429 tare da taken 'Sake gwada-Bayan'.
auth.h2l2: Kulle asusu: Ƙoƙarin 20 da ba a yi nasara ba a cikin sa'o'i 24 da alama asusun don bitar gudanarwa. Masu amfani da Legit kawai kalmar sirri-sake saita hanyar shiga.
auth.h2l3: Bibiyar zame: `/api/authentication/na'urori' suna lissafin duk zaman aiki; mai amfani zai iya soke kowane.
auth.h3p1: Lokacin da alamar samun dama ta kusa ƙarewa (waƙoƙin abokin ciniki 'exp' a gida) ko lokacin da buƙatun ya dawo 401 tare da 'alamar ƙarewa', abokin ciniki yana aika 'POST /api/authentication/refresh' tare da `{refresh_token}`.
auth.h3p2: Node yana yanke wartsakewa, yana bincika `jti` har yanzu yana nan a cikin `na'urorin_mai amfani' (ba a soke ba), yana bincika 'exp', kuma ya sanya alamar samun dama.
auth.h3p3: An kashe jujjuyawar sabuntawa ta tsohuwa. Kunna tare da `ROTATE_REFRESH=gaskiya' don fitar da sabon wartsake kuma.
auth.h3p4: Idan refresh ya ƙare, sokewa, ko ƙirƙira, node ya dawo 401. Abokin ciniki ya fita a cikin gida kuma ya nemi sake shiga.
auth.h4p1: Abokan gidan yanar gizo na iya yin rijistar mai tabbatar da dandamali (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Ma'ajiyar uwar garke `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`.
auth.h4p2: Shiga: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → uwar garken ya dawo kalubale; alamun abokin ciniki tare da maɓallin wucewa na sirri (wanda aka gudanar a cikin Amintaccen Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → uwar garken ya tabbatar da batutuwan JWT.
auth.h4p3: Tabbatar da ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun bayanai: kowane tabbaci dole ne ya ƙara ma'aunin. Idan ba haka ba, ana ɗaukar maɓallan wucewa azaman cloned kuma an ƙi.
auth.h5p1: A matsayin hanyar dawowa da bala'i, mai amfani zai iya fitar da iri 24 kalma BIP-39. Shigo da shi akan kowace na'ura yana sake gina ainihin X25519 (iri → HKDF → maɓalli na tsaye) kuma yana tabbatar da mallaka ta hanyar ƙalubalen sa hannu.
auth.h5p2: iri baya barin na'urar. Kullin yana ganin maɓallin jama'a X25519 da aka samo kawai da sa hannu kan ƙalubalen sabar.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: 256 bits (32 bytes). BIP-39 checksum daidai yake, don haka ana kama buga rubutu kafin isa ga uwar garke.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) tare da matakai 30-s da lambobin lambobi 6. Na zaɓi kowane mai amfani.
auth.h6p2: Shiga: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` yana dawo da sirri + otpauth URI + QR. Mai amfani yana dubawa tare da Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password. Mai amfani yana aikawa da samfurin lambar lamba 6 don tabbatar da aikin app ɗin.
auth.h6p3: Shiga tare da 2FA: bayan wucewar kalmar sirri, kumburi yana dawowa `{needs_2fa: gaskiya}`. Abokin ciniki ya nemi lambar da aika zuwa `/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Ƙimar ƙima: 5 TOTP ƙoƙari a kowane minti 5 ga kowane mai amfani. Wucewa yana haifar da sanyi na daƙiƙa 60 da gargaɗin imel.
auth.h6p5: Lambobin Ajiyayyen: Lambobin lambobi 12 × 10 da aka nuna sau ɗaya a lokacin yin rajista. Ana iya amfani da kowace lamba daidai sau ɗaya.
auth.h7p1: Wayar da aka shiga zata iya shiga sabuwar kwamfutar hannu mai lambar QR. Na'urar A tana aika 'POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → uwar garken ba ta dawo ba kuma TTL.
auth.h7p2: Na'urar A tana nuna QR mai ɗauke da `nonce + user_id + uwar garken_url`. Na'urar B ta duba da aika 'POST /api/authentication/qr/verify' ba tare da komai ba.
auth.h7p3: Uwar garken ta tabbatar da cewa babu wani abu har yanzu yana raye (TTL 60 s, harbi daya), sabobin na'urar B's sabo X25519 pubkey zuwa asusun mai amfani A (sabbin 'na'urorin_mai amfani'), kuma ya dawo JWT zuwa na'urar B.
auth.h7p4: Na'urar A tana karɓar sanarwar WebSocket `{type:"n", taron:"new_na'ura"}' don haka mai amfani zai iya tabbatarwa/ sokewa a ainihin lokacin.
auth.h8p1: Mun dawo da gangan kuskure iri ɗaya don "unknown username" da "password kuskure". Ƙididdiga ƙimar rajista yana ɓoye sunayen masu amfani.
auth.h8p2: Ƙarshen bayanan bayanan (`/api/users/{username}`) na buƙatar auth. Maharin ba zai iya ƙididdige sunayen masu amfani ba tare da ingantacciyar alama ba.
auth.h8p3: Ƙimar ƙima akan `/api/authentication/login` yana riƙe da ƙarfi zuwa rarrafe.
auth.h1_a: Rajista yana ƙirƙirar sabon asali: X25519 maɓalli akan na'urar, Argon2id kalmar sirri hash akan sabar, JWT biyu da aka fitar akan nasara.
auth.h1_b: Mataki 1: abokin ciniki yana gudanar da 'crypto.randomBytes(32)' don maɓallin sirri na X25519, yana samun maɓallin jama'a (~ 100 µs akan waya). Mataki 2: POST /api/authentication/yi rijista tare da `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, phone, email, avatar_emoji}`. Mataki na 3: kumburi yana inganta ta hanyar Pydantic (sunan mai amfani regex, kalmar sirri ≥ 8 chars, waya E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). Mataki na 4: kumburi yana gudanar da Argon2id(password) → `argon2:...`, ana adanawa a cikin `users.password_hash`. Mataki na 5: matsalar kumburin shiga JWT (minti 15) + wartsake JWT (kwanaki 30), yana ci gaba da jeren 'na'urorin_mai amfani'.
auth.h1_c: Magudanar ruwa shine juyin zamani na PHP's mysql_real_escape_string zamanin. Kowane tarin auth na zamani - Auth0, Firebase, Supabase - yana yin kusan wannan siffa. Takamaiman jujjuyawar a cikin Vortex shine aika X25519 pubkey a cikin kiran rajista: yana nufin an ɗaure asusun da ainihin E2E na dogon lokaci daga frame one, ba a ƙara shi daga baya ba. Ƙwarewa ta hanyar siginar ƙirar yarjejeniya ta 2013.
auth.h2_a: Shiga yana tabbatar da kalmar wucewa akan hash ɗin Argon2 da aka adana kuma yana fitar da sabon JWT biyu idan ya dace.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/authentication/login tare da `{username, password}`. Node queries 'masu amfani' ta ƙananan sunan mai amfani. Idan an samo shi, yana tabbatar da Argon2id akai-akai akan 'users.password_hash'. Idan ba'a samo shi ba, har yanzu yana gudanar da juzu'i Argon2 tabbatarwa akan madaidaicin kirtani don daidaita lokaci. Nasara → sababbi JWT biyu + sabbin 'na'urorin_mai amfani' jere (daya akan kowace na'urar shiga). Kasawa → 401 tare da “shararrun bayanan da ba daidai ba” - babu bambanci tsakanin mummunan sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri mara kyau, don tsayayya da ƙididdigewa.
auth.h2_c: Tabbatar da lokaci-lokaci da ɓacin rai ga masu amfani da ba su wanzu shine siginar siginar da aka ɗauka a cikin 2014 bayan masu bincike sun nuna ƙidayar lokaci akan ƙarshen shigar su. Tun daga wannan lokacin an karɓe shi sosai - django-axes, authelia, Keycloak duk suna amfani da shi. Ayyukan yana ƙara ~ 0.5 s ga kowane yunƙurin shiga da ya gaza, wanda yayi kyau; muna kimanta-iyakan shiga a 10/min/IP ta wata hanya.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id ("__time_equaliser__", gishiri = gyarawa, ...)

shiga (u, p):
  jere = masu amfani.find (sunan mai amfani=u.lower())
  idan jere babu:
      Argon2Verify(dummy_hash, p) // daidaita lokaci
      girma 401
  idan ba Argon2Verify(rou.password_hash, p):
      girma 401
  dawo fitowar_jwt(jere)
auth.h3_a: Alamomin shiga zasu ƙare bayan mintuna 15. Refresh yana musanya alamar wartsakewa mai tsayi don sabon alamar shiga ba tare da sake tambayar mai amfani kalmar sirri ba.
auth.h3_b: Waƙoƙin abokin ciniki 'exp' a gida. Lokacin da `yanzu + 30s> exp`, ko lokacin da buƙatun ya dawo 401 tare da `alama_ ƙarewa`, abokin ciniki ya aika alamar wartsakewa zuwa `/api/authentication/refresh`. Ƙididdigar Node, bincika `jti` yana cikin 'na'urorin_mai amfani' kuma ba'a soke_a' ba, yana bincika 'exp', kuma yana fitar da sabon alamar isa ta mintuna 15. Juyawa wartsake yana shiga ta hanyar `ROTATE_REFRESH=gaskiya` - kashewa ta tsohuwa saboda jujjuya alamun wartsakewa a kowane farfaɗowar shiga yana haifar da tseren lokacin da abokan ciniki biyu suka wartsake lokaci guda.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) ya gabatar da damar + wartsakewa. Tsawon rayuwa na samun damar minti 15 shine tsaka-tsaki a cikin masana'antar - Google yana amfani da sa'a 1, Auth0 ba daidai ba zuwa awanni 24, Okta zuwa awa 1. Mun ɗauki mintuna 15 don rage girman taga lokacin da alamar samun sata ta ke da amfani. Wartsakewa na kwanaki 30 ya yi daidai da abin da yawancin aikace-aikacen wayar hannu ke buƙata don ci gaba da shigar masu amfani cikin tsawon wata guda na rashin aiki.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / kalmar wucewa tana amfani da mai tantance dandamali (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) maimakon kalmar sirri.
auth.h4_b: Shiga: uwar garken yana aika kalubale; mai tabbatar da abokin ciniki ya haifar da sabon maɓalli a cikin amintaccen amintaccen sa kuma ya aika da maɓalli na jama'a + shaida. Ma'ajiyar uwar garke `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`. Shiga: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → uwar garken ya dawo da kalubale; alamun abokin ciniki tare da maɓallin keɓaɓɓen mai tabbatarwa (wanda aka riƙe a cikin Amintaccen Enclave, baya barin guntu); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → uwar garken yana tabbatar da sa hannun akan maɓallin jama'a da aka adana. Ƙa'idar monotonic tana gano masu tabbatar da cloned.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn an daidaita shi ta W3C a cikin 2019 bayan shekaru na aiki ta FIDO Alliance. Apple ƙara tallafin dandamali-mai tabbatarwa a cikin iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Password ana bi. Vortex an karɓi WebAuthn a cikin v0.0.8. Yana da na zaɓi amma ana ba da shawarar sosai - masu amfani da maɓallin wucewa ba su taɓa ganin karɓar asusun da ke tushen phishing ba saboda maɓallin keɓaɓɓen ba ya ketare iyakar na'urar.
auth.h5_a: Farfado da jimla-iri yana sake gina ainihin X25519 akan sabuwar na'ura daga kalma 24 BIP-39 mnemonic. Kada ya taɓa buƙatar uwar garken ya riƙe kowane kayan ɓoyayyen abu.
auth.h5_b: Mai amfani yana rubuta mnemonic a farkon ƙaddamarwa (na zaɓi, saurin lokaci ɗaya). Don dawo da: akan sabuwar na'ura, mai amfani ya shiga cikin mnemonic; abokin ciniki yana gudana PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (mnemonic, "mnemonic", zagaye na 2048) → 64 bytes na iri. Bites 32 na farkon iri sun zama maɓalli na sirri X25519; Maɓallin jama'a ya samo asali. Sabuwar maɓalli na jama'a kawai ake gaya wa uwar garken; yana tabbatar da mallaka tare da amsa ƙalubalen Ed25519 (sa hannu ba tare da izini ba), sannan ya ba da JWTs.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bayanin Haɓaka Bitcoin 39, 2013) ita ce hanya ta canonical don ɓoye sirrin sirri azaman jerin kalmomin da ba za a iya mantawa da su ba. Kamus na Turanci na 2048-kalmomi tare da adadin 4-byte a ƙarshen. Vortex yana amfani da kalmomi 24 saboda ma'auni na masana'antu don manyan wallet ɗin tsaro (Trezor, Ledger) shine 24. Kalmomi 12 zasu isa ga tsaro na 128-bit amma ba su da isa ga yawancin masu amfani.
auth.h5_f:
kalmomi = BIP39_Encode(entropy=256_bits + 8_bit_checksum)
iri = PBKDF2-SHA512(kalmomi, "mnemonic", zagaye=2048, len=64)
sk = iri[0:32] // X25519 na sirri
pk = sk · G // X25519 jama'a
auth.h6_a: Tabbatar da abubuwa biyu yana ƙara matakin tushen kalmar sirri na lokaci ɗaya (TOTP) bayan tantance kalmar sirri.
auth.h6_b: Shiga: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → uwar garken yana samar da sirrin bazuwar 160-bit, yana mayar da shi azaman silar base32 + wani otpauth: // URI don QR scanning. Mai amfani yana dubawa tare da Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password; ya mayar da samfurin lambar lamba 6 don tabbatar da saitin ya yi aiki. Shiga: bayan wucewar kalmar sirri, uwar garken yana dawowa `{needs_2fa: gaskiya}` maimakon JWTs. Abokin ciniki ya nemi lambar lambobi 6 da POSTs `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Sabar tana tabbatar da HOTP(asiri, T=now_unix / 30) akan lambar.
auth.h6_c: An daidaita TOTP azaman RFC 6238 a cikin 2011 ta Mark Pei. Kafin haka, RSA SecurID yayi amfani da algorithm na mallakar mallaka; Bayan haka, kowane app na 2FA ya daidaita akan TOTP. Vortex Mataki na daƙiƙa 30 da tsayin lambobi 6 sune RFC rashin kuskure. Lambobin Ajiyayyen (lambobi 12 × 10, an nuna sau ɗaya) ana aro su daga ƙirar GitHub daga 2012.
auth.h6_f:
sirrin = rand(20 bytes) // 160 ragi a kowace RFC 6238
TOTP(asiri, t) = HOTP(asiri, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP (k, c) = gangar jikin (HMAC-SHA1 (k, c)) mod 10⁶

taga: ± 1 mataki da aka jure don skew na agogo
auth.h7_a: QR login ya haɗa wata sabuwar na'ura zuwa wani asusu mai zaman kanta ba tare da sake buga kalmar sirri ba. Wayar da ta riga ta shiga tana nuna alamar cewa sabuwar na'urar tana amfani da ita don tantancewa.
auth.h7_b: Na'ura A tana aika '/api/authentication/qr/begin'. Sabar yana haifar da 128-bit nonce tare da TTL 60s, yana ɗaure shi zuwa mai amfani da A's, yana mayar da shi. Yana nuna nonce da aka sanya a matsayin QR (ya haɗa da `nonce + user_id + uwar garken_url`). Na'urar B tana dubawa, aika ''/api/authentication/qr/verify' ba tare da komai ba. Server: babu inganci kuma harbi daya? Sabbin maɓalli na Associate B tare da mai amfani_id (sabbin 'na'urorin_mai amfani' jere), Mint JWTs na B. Na'urar A tana karɓar sanarwar WebSocket don haka mai amfani zai iya gani kuma zai iya sokewa.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing an fara samun karbuwa ta hanyar yanar gizo ta WhatsApp a shekarar 2015. Telegram ya biyo baya; Sigina sun kwafi shi don tallafin na'urori da yawa a cikin 2021. Vortex's murguda: kowane taron haɗakarwa yana saman na'urar ta asali tare da maɓallin "tabbatar", don haka maharin da ya ɗauki QR daga hoton allo ba zai iya gama haɗawa ba tare da hulɗar mai amfani akan na'urar A ba.
auth.h8_a: Juriya na ƙidayar asusu - ɓangare na babin talla. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka ambata a duk faɗin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
auth.h8_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "juriyawar ƙidayar asusu". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
auth.h8_c: Tsarin "juriyawar lissafin lissafi" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.

rooms.title: Dakuna da saƙo
rooms.subtitle: Nau'in ɗakuna huɗu, membobinsu, jujjuyawar maɓalli, saƙonni.
rooms.intro: Duk nau'ikan ɗakuna huɗu - DM, ƙungiyar masu zaman kansu, ƙungiyar jama'a, tashoshi - raba teburin 'dakuna' ɗaya na asali. Halayen an rufe su da tutocin boolean.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: daidai mambobi biyu, `is_dm=gaskiya`, `mai zaman kansa=gaskiya’. Sunan saitin atomatik zuwa hannun sauran memba.
rooms.h1p2: **Kungiya mai zaman kanta**: gayyata-kawai, `mai zaman kansa=gaskiya`, `tashar_tashar = karya`. Max 5000 mambobi ta tsohuwa.
rooms.h1p3: **Rukunin jama'a**: `mai sirri ne=karya`. Duk mai hanyar gayyata zai iya shiga; da aka jera a cikin kundin adireshi na jama'a idan mai shi ya zaɓi shiga.
rooms.h1p4: **Tashoshi ***: watsa shirye-shirye-kawai, `is_channel=gaskiya'. Masu mallaka/masu gudanarwa ne kawai zasu iya aikawa; mambobi na yau da kullun suna karantawa.
rooms.h2p1: Matsayi: `mai shi`, `admin`, `memba`. Mai gida ɗaya kawai a kowane ɗaki (wanda za a iya sanyawa).
rooms.h2p2: Admins na iya gayyata, shura, bebe, da gyara saitunan ɗaki. Membobi zasu iya aika saƙonni, mayar da martani, gyara nasu, share nasu.
rooms.h2p3: Cascade na izini: masu mallakar suna da kowane ikon gudanarwa. Admins ba za su iya rage ma mai shi daraja ba.
rooms.h2p4: Canje-canjen rawar yana haifar da saƙon tsarin ('irin: "role_changed") ga kowane memba.
rooms.h3p1: Kowane ɗaki yana da maɓalli 32-byte ** tushen maɓalli ** wanda aka ƙirƙira ta hanyar ''asiri.token_bytes(32)'' akan na'urar mahalicci.
rooms.h3p2: Kowane memba yana samun ambulaf `{member_id, ambulan: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` da aka adana a cikin `maɓallan_daki'.
rooms.h3p3: Lokacin da memba ya shiga, kowane abokin ciniki na memba yana buɗe musu sabon ambulan. Mintin ambulaf shine O(1) kowane haɗin gwiwa.
rooms.h3p4: Lokacin da memba ya fita, ɗakin yana jujjuya: mahalicci (ko admin na farko mai aiki) yana samun sabon tushe, sake ambulan zuwa sauran membobin, posts `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` via WebSocket. Tsohuwar sifar rubutu tana tsayawa abin karantawa tare da tsohon maɓalli wanda abokan ciniki har yanzu suna adanawa.
rooms.h3l1: Maɓallin maɓalli na Bambanci-B: don ɗakunan jama'a a> mambobi 1000, ambulaf suna daina ƙima. Madadin haka, mai shi yana sanya hannu kuma yana buga tushen maɓallin yanzu a cikin tebur `room_jama'a'. Abokan ciniki sun tabbatar da sa hannu akan maɓalli na mai ɗakin. Juyawa akan hutun memba saboda haka babu-op don dakunan Bambancin-B.
rooms.h3l2: Rubutun ɗaki: kowane ɗaki kuma yana da `ɗaki_gishiri_gishiri'. Sunayen memba a cikin saƙonni sune `HMAC-SHA256(gishiri, mai amfani_id)` an yanke su zuwa chars hex 16. Node ba zai iya faɗi wane mai amfani ya aiko da saƙo ba tare da taswirar gefen abokin ciniki ba.
rooms.h4p1: Saƙonni suna da ID na monotonic a kowane ɗaki (ƙara-ƙara ta atomatik 64-bit, 'babban serial' a cikin Postgres, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` a cikin SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: An sanya oda-sabar. Abokan ciniki ba sa yin faɗa akan tamburan lokaci; suna yin oda ID kuma suna nuna lokacin agogon bangon mai aikawa azaman UI metadata kawai.
rooms.h4p3: Gyara: sabon ciphertext yana maye gurbin tsohon a-wuri, sabuntawar `edited_at`. Abokan ciniki suna nuna alamar `(edited)`.
rooms.h4p4: Gogewa: saita `deleted_at`, batar da rubutun. `{nau'in:"m", an share:gaskiya}' watsa shirye-shirye.
rooms.h4p5: Amsa: `amsa_to` = id saƙon da aka ambata. Abokan ciniki suna ba da ɗan ƙaramin abin kai.
rooms.h5p1: Amsoshin sune layuka a cikin `masu amsa (saƙon_id, mai amfani_id, emoji, ƙirƙira_at)`. POST na abokin ciniki `/api/messages/{id}/reactions/{emoji}`. DELETE don rashin amsawa.
rooms.h5p2: Magoya bayan '{type:"m", martani:[...]}' ga kowane mai biyan kuɗi. Abokan ciniki tara.
rooms.h5p3: Babu ƙuntatawa akan emoji - kowane Unicode. Abokan ciniki sun cire-dupe kuma suna ƙirga.
rooms.h6p1: Zare wani ɗaki ne na bogi wanda aka kafe akan saƙo. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` yana ƙirƙirar `{id: <new_room_id>, parent_message_id: <msg_id>, parent_room_id: <asali>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Dakunan zaren sun gaji memba daga iyaye. Kowane memba na ɗakin iyaye na iya aikawa zuwa kowane zare.
rooms.h6p3: Samuwar maɓalli: maɓallin tushen zaren = `HKDF(tushen_parent, bayani: "thread:" + <parent_message_id>, len: 32)'. Amincewa da maɓallin zaren ba ya zubar da iyaye.
rooms.h7p1: Admins na iya aika saƙonni har zuwa 10 kowane ɗaki. `POST /api/rooms/{id}/pin` tare da `{message_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: An ɗora saitin da aka liƙa akan buɗaɗɗen ɗaki; abokan ciniki suna yin rubutun da aka liƙa a saman.
rooms.h8p1: Rubuce-rubucen daki-daki suna ci gaba da kasancewa a kan kumburi: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` tare da `{rubutu}`. `GET` yana dawo da halin yanzu. `DELETE` share.
rooms.h8p2: Abokan ciniki suna daidaita daftarin aiki a cikin na'urori don haka buga wayar ya ƙare akan tebur. Ba a rufaffen daftarin aiki daga karshen-zuwa-karshe - rubutu ne mai bayyana uwar garken. Wancan ciniki ne da gangan don na'urori UX. Masu amfani waɗanda suka ƙi suna iya kashe aiki tare kowane ɗaki.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` tare da `{room_id, ciphertext, send_at}`. Ana adana node a cikin 'saƙonnin da aka tsara'; ma'aikacin cron yana aikata akan lokaci.
rooms.h9p2: Ana iya gyarawa kuma za'a iya sokewa har sai alamar send_at ta ƙone. Bayan aika, saƙon ya zama layi na yau da kullun a cikin 'saƙonni'.
rooms.h1_a: Duk nau'ikan ɗakuna huɗu (DM, ƙungiyoyi masu zaman kansu, rukunin jama'a, tasha) suna raba tebur 'dakuna' ɗaya. Bambanci yana cikin tutocin boolean guda uku.
rooms.h1_b: Tutoci: `is_dm`, `mai zaman kansa`, `tashar_shine`. DM: is_dm=gaskiya, shine_private=gaskiya, membobi 2 daidai. Rukunin sirri: is_private=gaskiya, is_channel=karya, har zuwa membobi 5000. Ƙungiyar jama'a: is_private=ƙarya, jera a cikin kundin adireshi idan mai shi ya zaɓi shiga. Channel: is_channel=gaskiya, masu mallaka/admins kawai. Duk raba key management, fan-out, reactions, zaren.
rooms.h1_c: Polymorphism mai tebur guda ɗaya ne daga Martin Fowler's *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002). Telegram yana amfani da nau'ikan ɗaki daban-daban a ciki; Slack yana amfani da tashoshi + DMs + DM jam'iyyu da yawa azaman iri huɗu; Discord yana amfani da "tashoshi" don komai. Mun zaɓi tebur ɗaya bayan bayanan martaba ya nuna babban farashi shine fan-out (wanda shine uniform a cikin nau'ikan) kuma bayan v0.0.3 refactor ya haɗa tebur iri ɗaya guda uku zuwa ɗaya.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE dakuna (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  nau'in VARCHAR(16), -- Legacy, m tare da tutoci
  suna VARCHAR(256),
  na sirri BOOLEAN,
  tashar BOOLEAN,
  dm BOOLEAN,
  Memba_ƙidaya INT,
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512),
  halitta_a TIMESTAMP,
  halitta_ta BIGINT REFERENCES masu amfani(id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Matsayin mataki uku ne: mai shi, admin, memba. Daidai mai gida ɗaya a kowane ɗaki, aƙalla admin guda ɗaya, membobin da yawa ba bisa ka'ida ba.
rooms.h2_b: `Yan dakin_(room_id, id_user, role, join_at, muted_har)`. Roles cascade: masu mallakar suna da kowane ikon gudanarwa. Admins na iya gayyata, shura, bebe, da gyara saitunan ɗaki amma ba za su iya rage mai shi ƙasa ba. Membobi zasu iya aika saƙonni, mayar da martani, gyara nasu, share nasu. Canja wurin mai shi ta hanyar `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` tare da `sabon_owner_id` - tsohon mai shi ya sauke zuwa mai gudanarwa.
rooms.h2_c: Mai shi / admin / memba shine nau'in bangare uku IRC op/murya/samfurin mai amfani daga 1988, daga baya Slack, Discord, Telegram ya karbe shi. Zaɓin takamaiman don samun ainihin mai shi ɗaya (ba mai yawa ba) ya fito ne daga la'akari na doka: a cikin hukunce-hukuncen da ke da dokokin alhaki na rukuni, samun bayyanannen mai shi ɗaya yana sauƙaƙa DMCA da buƙatun makamantansu.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE membobin_ daki (
  dakin_ID BIGINT,
  mai amfani_id BIGINT,
  rawa
  shiga_a TIMESTAMP,
  bebe_har zuwa TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (daki_id, mai amfani_id)
);
rooms.h3_a: Kowane ɗaki yana da maɓalli na simmetric 32-byte. Membobi suna riƙe kwafi a nannade a ƙarƙashin maɓalli na X25519.
rooms.h3_b: A kan ƙirƙira, abokin ciniki yana haifar da `tushen_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)`. Ga kowane memba, abokin ciniki yana ɓoye 'tushen_key' ƙarƙashin `X25519(member_pubkey)` → ambulan. Ambulan suna zaune a cikin `maɓallan_ɗaki (daki_id, mai amfani_id, ambulaf)`. Lokacin da mai amfani ya shiga, kowane abokin ciniki na memba na yanzu yana sanya musu sabon ambulan. Lokacin da mai amfani ya fita, mai shi ko mai gudanarwa na farko yana jujjuya - yana haifar da sabon tushen_key, sake-sake envelopes ga sauran membobin, watsa shirye-shirye `{nau'in:"k", dakin:..., sabbin_envelopes:[...]}' sama da WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Kundin kowane memba shine tsarin siginar da aka fara aiki a cikin 2014 don ƙungiyoyin sa-v2. Matrix's Megolm yana amfani da tsarin "maɓallan aikawa" makamancin haka. Vortex ya tafi tare da ambulan kowane memba saboda yana da sauƙin yin tunani game da: babu wani ɓoyewar sirri tsakanin masu aikawa. Kasuwancin-kashe O(N) ambulan ne akan canjin membobin, wanda ke da kyau har zuwa ~5000 membobi; Tashar jama'a Variant-B ya kaucewa iyaka.
rooms.h3_f:
akan ƙirƙira:
  tushen_key = rand (32)
  ga m a cikin membobin:
    ambulan [m] = X25519_Encrypt (m.pubkey, tushen_key)

a kan hutu:
  new_tushen = rand (32)
  rebroadcast(sabbin envelopes ga sauran membobin)
rooms.h4_a: Bambancin-B mabuɗin yana maye gurbin ambulan kowane memba tare da maɓalli ɗaya da aka sa hannu, wanda aka buga zuwa teburin karantawa na jama'a. Ma'auni zuwa mambobi 100k+.
rooms.h4_b: Maimakon O(N) envelope mining, mai shi ya sanya hannu akan tushen_key da turawa zuwa 'dakin_keys_jama'a(id_id, key, sign_by, sign_at)`. Abokan ciniki sun debo, tabbatar da maɓalli na Ed25519 na mai shi, da amfani. Juyawa babu-op don sauye-sauyen membobinsu - duk wanda ke da maɓalli har yanzu yana da shi ko da an harbe shi. Wannan abin karbuwa ne ga tashoshi na jama'a inda "tsari mai zurfi" ba samfurin barazana bane amma isa da sikelin suke.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B an ƙirƙira shi akan hangen nesa na tarihi na "za'a iya karantawa" na Matrix haɗe tare da jujjuya maɓallin sa hannu. An ƙara zuwa Vortex a cikin v0.0.8 bayan beta yana da tashar jama'a mai mutane 50k wacce ta sake fashe ambulan lokaci-lokaci. Hanyar da aka rattaba hannu-da-buga ta yi daidai da ma'auni tare da maɓalli maɓalli (waɗanda ba su da yawa) maimakon tare da canje-canjen membobin (waɗanda ke dawwama).
rooms.h4_f:
Bambance-B:
  Alamomin mai shi: sig = Ed25519Sign(owner_priv, room_id ∥ tushen_key ∥ sigar)
  buga: room_public_keys += {room_id, tushen_key, sigar, sig}
  abokin ciniki: GET /api/rooms/{id}/public-key → tabbatar da sig a kan owner_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: Lambobin gayyata sune 32 hex Chars. Zabin max_uses, ƙarewa_at, sanya_role, mai iya sokewa.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (mai gudanarwa kawai) yana ƙirƙirar layi a cikin `gayyata(lambar, ɗakin_id, ƙirƙira ta, max_uses, used_count, expire_at, assign_role, revoked_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join' tare da ingancin tantance lambar (ba a soke, ba ta ƙare ba, ƙidaya <max_uses), haɓaka `ƙididdigar da aka yi amfani da su, ƙirƙira jeren 'mambobin ɗaki, dawo da metadata na ɗaki. Shake ta hanyar `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` - haɗin gwiwa daga baya ya kasa.
rooms.h5_c: Lambobin gayyata azaman tsoho sun kai girman yanayin IRC'+i` (1988). Telegram's jama'a gayyata links tare da expiry da amfani iyaka aka gabatar a cikin 2017. Vortex's bambance-bambancen yana ƙara `assign_role` don haka masu iya ba da admin-ban da codes lafiya a cikin wani-shot format - mai amfani ga onboarding wani sabon moderator ba tare da bukatar sanin ainihin mai amfani id a gaba.
rooms.h5_f:
gayyata layi:
  code: VARCHAR(64) -- 32 hex chars
  dakin_ID : BIGINT
  max_uses: INT -- NULL = Unlimited
  amfani_count: INT
  expires_a: TIMESTAMP -- NULL = taba
  assign_role : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = memba
  soke_a: TIMESTAMP -- NULL = live
rooms.h6_a: Layin saƙo yana adana sifar rubutu + metadata; Ba a taɓa adana mai aikawa a cikin rubutu bayyananne.
rooms.h6_b: `saƙonni (id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at_at, edited_at?, goge_a?, amsa_zuwa?, thread_id?, iri)`. Akwai `sender_id` don sarrafa shiga kuma ana lissafta shi. `Sender_pseudo` shine madaidaicin zanta na kowane ɗaki na sender_id don haka fan-out baya buƙatar taɓa teburin masu amfani. 'irin' yana ɗaya daga: rubutu, hoto, fayil, murya, kira, tsarin. 'ciphertext' ba shi da kyan gani AES-GCM fitarwa; Membobin daki da maɓalli ne kawai za su iya yanke bayanan.
rooms.h6_c: Tunanin sender_pseudo ya fito ne daga Sigin da aka hatimce-sender (2018). Sigina yana amfani da shi don makantar uwar garken don aika ainihi; muna amfani da shi don irin wannan manufa amma kiyaye `sender_id` sharetext don ACL da iyaka. Rarraba yana ba mu damar tilasta "membobi ne kawai za su iya yin post" ba tare da sanin uwar garken ba wanda ya faɗi abin da ke cikin jujjuyawar DB.
rooms.h7_a: Yana gyara rubutun 'rubutu' a wuri kuma ya yi karo 'edited_a'. Yana share rubutun kuma saita 'Sharewa_a'.
rooms.h7_b: Gyara: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` tare da sabon `{ciphertext, nonce}`. Mai aikawa ne kawai zai iya gyara saƙon nasu. Rubutun jere/nonce an maye gurbinsa, `edited_at = now`, `irin` bai canza ba. Fan-out `{type:"m", id, ct, nonce, edited_at}`. Share: `DELETE /api/messages/{id}`. Mai aikawa ko admin na iya sharewa. `Deleted_a = yanzu`, `ciphertext = NULL`. Layi yana tsayawa don haka har yanzu ba da ma'ana. Fan-out `{type:"m", share:gaskiya, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Gyara-in-wuri shine tsarin Telegram/Slack; Discord ya kiyaye cikakken tarihin gyarawa da farko sannan ya jefar da shi don sirri. Vortex yana adana sabbin abubuwa kawai - tarihin gyara shine tushen PR abubuwan da suka faru lokacin da gyara-gyara yana iya dawo da shi. Shafe mai laushi tare da rubutun banza daga littafin wasa guda Telegram iri ɗaya kuma yana adana sarƙoƙin amsa ba tare da riƙe abun ciki ba.
rooms.h7_f:
gyara: UPDATE saƙonni
share: UPDATE saƙonni SET deleted_at = NOW(), ciphertext = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Rubuce-rubucen - ɓangaren babin ɗakunan. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka ambata a duk faɗin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
rooms.h8_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Rubutun". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
rooms.h8_c: Tsarin "Drafts" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.
rooms.h9_a: Saƙonnin da aka tsara - ɓangaren babin ɗakuna. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka ambata a duk faɗin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
rooms.h9_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "saƙonnin da aka tsara". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
rooms.h9_c: Tsarin "Scheduled Messages" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.

files.title: Fayiloli da haɗe-haɗe
files.subtitle: Shot guda ɗaya don ƙarami, mai yiwuwa don babba, ɓoyayyen gefen abokin ciniki na duka biyun.
files.intro: Kowane fayil loda yana tafiya ta bututun boye-boye iri ɗaya. Bambanci tsakanin hanyoyi shine kawai game da juriyar hanyar sadarwa: mai sake dawowa yana jure wa hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa.
files.h1p1: Tafi: 5MB. Ana amfani dashi don hotuna, bayanin kula na murya, gajerun shirye-shiryen bidiyo.
files.h1p2: Abokin ciniki yana rufaffen dukkan fayil ɗin tare da AES-GCM, bazuwar 96-bit nonce, maɓalli = `fayil_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs `multipart/form-data` zuwa `/api/files` tare da filaye `fayil` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (da'awar mutunci), `mime_type` (alamu; sabar sabar sake duba tare da `python-sihiri`).
files.h1p4: Node yana adana a ƙarƙashin `loads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` kuma yana mayar da `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Abokin ciniki sai ya aika saƙon daki wanda ke yin nuni ga file_id kuma yana ɗauke da file_root a cikin rubutun sa don haka membobin ɗakin su iya yanke bayanan.
files.h2p2: Mataki na 1: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` tare da `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}`. Node yana keɓance id ɗin lodawa, yana ɗaukar girman guntu (tsoho 512 KiB, wanda aka caje a 4 MiB), yana dawo da `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Mataki na 2: ga kowane yanki, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` tare da danyen jikin sifa. Dole ne a daidaita abubuwan da aka kashe zuwa 'chunk_size'.
files.h2p4: Mataki na 3: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` tare da `{plain_blake3}`. Node yana sake haɗuwa, yana tabbatar da girman, shaguna, yana dawo da `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Rashin kulawa: abubuwan da aka katse na iya ci gaba ta hanyar sake buga abubuwan da suka ɓace kawai. Waƙoƙin Node waɗanne ɓangarorin sun zo cikin Redis (ko a cikin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya don yanayin SQLite).
files.h2p6: TTL: Ana share abubuwan da ba a gama ba bayan sa'o'i 24.
files.h3p1: Loda hoto (MIME `siffa/*`) yana haifar da janareta na thumbnail na matashin kai a 256×256 JPEG q=80. Ajiye a ƙarƙashin `loads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg`.
files.h3p2: Hotunan takaitaccen siffofi kuma an rufaffen rufaffiyar gefen abokin ciniki - mai karɓa yana buƙatar tushen fayil ɗin don bayarwa. Ajiye bandwidth don samfotin jeri.
files.h3p3: Loda bidiyo (MIME `bidiyo/*`) yana haifar da cire fosta na tushen ffmpeg a kashi 10% na tsawon lokacin shirin, an adana shi daidai.
files.h4p1: Abokin ciniki-mime_type' alama ce. Sabar tana gudanar da 'python-sihiri' a kan 1 KB na farko kuma ya ƙi idan nau'in sniffed yana cikin jerin ƙin yarda: 'application/x-dosexec', 'application/x-sharedlib', 'application/x-mach-binary'.
files.h4p2: Wannan yana hana masu amfani da butulci rarraba malware cikin bazata ta hanyar manzo. Masu kai hari har yanzu suna iya ƙetarewa tare da kwantena masu lakabi daidai - kariyar ƙirƙira ce ta gefen abokin ciniki, ba sniff-gefen uwar garken ba.
files.h5p1: Default: tsarin fayil na gida. Go od don tura kuɗaɗe guda ɗaya.
files.h5p2: S3: saita `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. Ana watsa fayiloli kai tsaye zuwa S3 ba tare da taɓa faifan kumburi ba. Ana amfani da URL ɗin da aka tsara don zazzagewa.
files.h5p3: IPFS: gwaji. Uploads suna sanar da CIDs ta hanyar DHT; zazzagewa suna debo kowane kumburi.
files.h1_a: Loda-shot guda ɗaya hanya ce mai sauri ga duk abin da ke ƙasa da 5 MB - hotuna, bayanin kula na murya, gajerun shirye-shiryen bidiyo. Ɗayan HTTPS POST, rufaffen ɓatanci ɗaya, jere ɗaya cikin 'fiyiloli'.
files.h1_b: Abokin ciniki yana rufawa fayil ɗin rufaffiyar bytes daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe tare da AES-GCM ƙarƙashin bazuwar 32-byte `fayil_root`. POSTs `multipart/form-data` zuwa `/api/files` tare da filayen `fayil` (rubutun rubutu), `plain_blake3` (da'awar mutunci), `mime_type` (shafi). Node yana tilasta ma'auni na 5 MB a matakin buffer, yana gudanar da 'python-sihiri' don gano nau'in nau'in, ya ƙi idan MIME yana kan lissafin ƙi, yana adanawa ƙarƙashin 'loads/<category>/<hash>.bin', yana mayar da `{file_id, url, mime_type. Abokin ciniki sai ya aika saƙon daki yana nufin `file_id` da ɗauke da `tushen_fayil' a cikin rubutun sa.
files.h1_c: Hul ɗin 5 MB lamba ɗaya ce Slack kuma Telegram suna amfani da hanyar "layi" ta hanyar lodawa. Manyan fayiloli suna zuwa hanyar da za a sake dawowa. Farkon Vortex yana da hular harbi guda 100 MB; mun ragu zuwa 5 MB bayan bayanan bayanan da aka yi sun nuna cewa abubuwan da aka ɗora hotuna guda ɗaya sama da 5 MB sun sami raguwar kashi 40% akan hanyoyin sadarwar wayar hannu. Hanyar da za a sake dawowa ta fi dacewa don manyan fayiloli ko da yake yana da ƙarin tafiye-tafiye akan hanyoyin farin ciki.
files.h2_a: Resumable upload shine hanya don manyan fayiloli. Abokin ciniki yana loda ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun ƙira, zai iya tsayawa, zai iya ci gaba akan kowace iyaka, zai iya murmurewa daga ɓoyayyen hanyar sadarwa.
files.h2_b: Yarjejeniya ta mataki uku. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` tare da `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}` → kumburi yana ware `upload_id` + yana tabbatar da girman guntu. Chunks: ga kowane biya diyya, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` tare da danyen jikin ciphertext. Matsalolin dole ne su kasance masu yawa na chunk_size. Ƙarshe: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` tare da `{plain_blake3}` — kumburin sake haduwa, yana tabbatar da girman + tag, shaguna, dawo da `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Yarjejeniyar matakai uku iri ɗaya ce da tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 uploads multiparts, da Google Fitar da abubuwan da za'a sake farawa. Vortex ya karɓi siffar tus.io saboda shine mafi sauƙin wasa don yawo na FastAPI +. 24 h TTL akan abubuwan da ba a gama ba da matches na S3 tsoho da ma'auni sun dawo da sassauci akan amfani da faifan sabar.
files.h3_a: Ana samar da ƙananan hotuna-gefen uwar garken yayin lodawa amma a kasance a ɓoye a ƙarƙashin tushen fayil iri ɗaya, don haka membobin daki ne kawai za su iya sanya su.
files.h3_b: Don `hoto/*` MIME, matashin kai yana samar da 256×256 JPEG q=80 daga samfotin da aka yanke. Jira - a'a, uwar garken ba ta taɓa samun bayyananniyar rubutu ba. Madaidaicin kwarara: abokin ciniki yana haifar da babban yatsan yatsan hannu a gida, yana ɓoyewa tare da tushen fayil iri ɗaya + sabon nonce, abubuwan lodawa azaman ɓacin rai, da nunin `thumb_id` a cikin saƙon ɗakin. Sabar tana adana rubutun. Don `bidiyo/*`, abokin ciniki yana yin haka tare da maɓalli da aka samo daga ffmpeg.
files.h3_c: Farkon Vortex yana da ƙarni na thumbnail na gefe daga saƙon rubutu - mun cire wannan damar a cikin v0.0.4 bayan nazarin tsaro ya nuna ya keta garantin E2E. Babban yatsan yatsan hannun abokin ciniki shine siginar siginar da aka yi amfani da shi tun 2018 da WhatsApp tun 2020. Farashin bandwidth ba shi da tsada — 256×256 JPEG yana ƙasa da 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Sabar tana tilasta lissafin ƙaryata MIME a layin sniff don dakatar da aiwatarwa da aka rarraba bisa kuskure.
files.h4_b: Bayan cikar loda (harbi ɗaya) ko kammalawa (mai yiwuwa), uwar garken tana gudanar da 'python-sihiri' a kan farkon 1 KB na rumbun rundunan ciphertext don gano ainihin nau'in. Idan sniff ya ba da rahoton 'application/x-dosexec' (Windows PE), 'application/x-sharedlib' (Linux ELF), ko 'application/x-mach-binary' (macOS Mach-O), an ƙi aikawa tare da nau'in Media mara tallafi na 415. Wannan manufar uwar garke ce, ba iyaka ta tsaro ba - ƴan ɗakin abokin ciniki har yanzu suna iya shigar da tsarin naɗa wanda ke ƙetare sniff.
files.h4_c: MIME sniffing azaman manufar hanawa shine IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X daga 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram duk suna yi. Ƙayyadaddun (zipped/ ƙunshin abubuwan aiwatarwa ta hanyar wucewa sniff) an san shi tun daga 2016 - tsaron mu yana kan layi: da gargaɗin gefen mai amfani akan kowane fayil tare da tsawaita aiwatarwa.
files.h5_a: Ma'ajiyar baya - ɓangaren babin fayiloli. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka ambata a duk faɗin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
files.h5_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Ma'ajiyar baya". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
files.h5_c: Tsarin "Ajiye baya" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.
files.h1_f:
POST /api/files
  Nau'in abun ciki: Multipart/form-data
  fayil: <ciphertext bytes ≤ 5_242_880>
  plain_blake3: <64 hex Chars>
  mime_type: "image/jpeg" (alama; sake duba kumburi)

→ 201 { file_id, url: "/ uploads/...", mime_type, size }
files.h3_f:
abokin ciniki yana haifar da babban yatsan yatsan yatsan yatsa = sake girman (cikakken, 256, 256, JPEG, q=80)
thumb_ct = AES-GCM(file_root, new_nonce, thumb_plain, aad=thumb_id)
loda thumb_ct, tunani thumb_id a cikin saƙon daki tare da file_id

presence.title: Alamun halarta da isarwa
presence.subtitle: Alamun bugawa, karanta rasit, gani na ƙarshe - duk ephemeral.
presence.intro: Waɗannan sigina suna hayaniya. Vortex yana kiyaye su dagewa ta hanyar tsoho: buga rayuwa a cikin Redis (ko a cikin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya), karanta rasit shine kawai siginar da ke tsira daga sake farawa.
presence.h1p1: Abokin ciniki yana aika `{type:"t", room:..., state:"star"|"tsayawa"}' akan maɓalli. An ba da shaida ga aƙalla taron guda ɗaya a cikin 3 s.
presence.h1p2: Node yana watsa `{nau'in:"t", daki:..., mai amfani:..., jiha:...}' ga duk masu rajista WebSockets.
presence.h1p3: Karewa ta atomatik: 'farawa' ba tare da 'tsayawa' lokuta masu zuwa ba bayan 10 s a gefen abokin ciniki.
presence.h2p1: POST na abokin ciniki `POST /api/rooms/{id}/karanta' tare da `{arshe_read_message_id}`.
presence.h2p2: Node yana ci gaba a cikin `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` da watsa `{type:"r", room:..., user:..., message_id:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Abokan ciniki suna yin "gani ta N" ƙarƙashin saƙonnin da ke fita.
presence.h2p4: Sirri: mai amfani zai iya kashe "gani" gaba ɗaya; to kumburin baya dage musu rasit. Ciniki-kashe: su ma ba sa ganin rasit ɗin wasu (symmetry).
presence.h3p1: Node yana bin 'gabatar. Last_seen_at' (unix ms) kowane mai amfani. An sabunta akan kowane WebSocket firam.
presence.h3p2: Matakan ƙwanƙwasa (zaɓi mai amfani): daidai, zagaye zuwa mafi kusa 5 min, zagaye zuwa sa'a mafi kusa, "kwanan nan", ko a kashe.
presence.h3p3: Tambaya ta hanyar `GET /api/users/{id}/presence`. An yi rajista ta hanyar `{nau'in:"sub_presence", mai amfani:...}`.
presence.h4p1: Mai amfani yana "kan layi" idan suna da aƙalla mai aiki WebSocket akan kowace na'urorinsu.
presence.h4p2: Ganuwa ga lambobin sadarwa kawai - waɗanda ba lambobin sadarwa ba suna ganin gani na ƙarshe amma ba digo mai rai ba.
presence.h1_a: Ana aika alamar bugawa ta hanyar WebSocket frame `{type:"t", room, state:"start"|"tsayawa"}` da kuma watsa ta kumburin ga kowane mai biyan kuɗi a cikin ɗakin.
presence.h1_b: Abokin ciniki ya karyata a 3 s - maɓalli na farko yana aika 'farawa', daga baya a cikin 3 s ba ya yin komai. 10 s bayan bugun maɓalli na ƙarshe, abokin ciniki yana aika 'tsayawa'. Node yana watsa firam ɗin a zahiri, wanda aka riga aka sanya shi da `user_id`. Babu dagewa - buga jihar yana rayuwa a cikin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiyar kowane ɗaki (ko Redis mashaya/sub don kulli da yawa). Karewa ta atomatik s 10 a gefen mai karɓa: idan babu sabuntawa ya zo, abokan ciniki suna ɗauka sun tsaya.
presence.h1_c: Alamun bugawa suna komawa zuwa AIM / ICQ (1997). Modern debounced kayayyaki alama zuwa Skype 2006 da iMessage 2011. The 3 s / 10 s lambobin daga iMessage ta lura hali - mu A / B gwada 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 da 3/10 na da mafi kyau batun batun "matches rhythm mutum" feedback.
presence.h2_a: Karɓi karatun ya ci gaba: POST na abokin ciniki id saƙon karantawa na ƙarshe; ana adana node a cikin 'kartuwar_kartu' da watsa shirye-shirye.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/karanta' tare da `{arshe_read_message_id}`. Sabunta node `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` tare da UPSERT tarukan ma'ana. Watsawa `{type:"r", room, user, message_id, read_at}`. Abokan ciniki suna yin "gani ta N" ƙarƙashin saƙonnin da ke fita. Keɓantawa: mai amfani zai iya kashe rasidu gaba ɗaya; to node baya dage musu AND basa ganin rasit din wasu (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Karatun karatun ya zama ko'ina bayan iMessage 2011 da WhatsApp 2014. Ka'idar simmetry (idan kun ɓoye naku, ba ku ganin wasu) daga Telegram 2014 kuma ita ce hanya ɗaya kawai don guje wa tashar sa ido ta hanya ɗaya. Vortex yana aiwatar da daidaito a uwar garken - ba abokin ciniki kawai ba - don haka abokan cinikin da suka yi ƙarya game da tuta har yanzu ba su sami ganuwa ba.
presence.h3_a: Abun gani na ƙarshe shine tambarin lokaci ɗaya na kowane mai amfani, wanda aka sabunta akan kowane firam WebSocket da tsufa lokacin da babu firam ɗin da ya zo.
presence.h3_b: Node yana bin 'bangaren.arshe_wanda aka gani a' azaman unix ms. An sabunta akan kowane ingantaccen WebSocket firam daga mai amfani. Karanta ta hanyar `GET /api/users/{id}/presence'. Yi rijista ta hanyar `{type:"sub_presence", mai amfani}` don samun turawa kai tsaye kan canji. Granularity abu ne mai daidaitawa mai amfani: ainihin tambarin lokaci, zagaye zuwa 5 min, zagaye zuwa 1 h, "kwanan nan", ko a kashe.
presence.h3_c: Matakan ƙwararru sun gano sabunta sirrin WhatsApp na 2012 bayan koke-koke game da sa ido na ƙarshe. Telegram a cikin 2013 ya kara da "kwanan nan / cikin mako guda / cikin wata daya". Vortex's 5 min / 1 h / "kwanan nan" ya sake maimaitawa Telegram. Zaɓin "kashe" a zahiri yana ɓoye mai amfani daga ganin abin da wasu suka gani na ƙarshe saboda dalili ɗaya kamar yadda aka karanta rasit.
presence.h4_a: Alamar kan layi: mai amfani yana "kan layi" idan suna da aƙalla live WebSocket akan kowace na'urorinsu.
presence.h4_b: Node yana adana 'active_ws_count(user_id)' cikin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya. Haɓakawa akan haɓakawa WS, raguwa yana kusa. `online = aiki_ws_count(user_id)> 0`. Ganuwa ga lambobin sadarwa kawai - waɗanda ba lambobin sadarwa ba suna ganin gani na ƙarshe (batun granularity) amma ba ɗigon kore mai rai ba. Canja abubuwan da suka faru suna wuta lokacin da ƙididdigewa ta haye sifili ta kowane bangare.
presence.h4_c: Gani-kawai ganuwa shine samfurin kowane manzo mai mahimmanci ya daidaita bayan abubuwan da suka faru da yawa (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Farko Vortex sanya kan layi ga kowa da kowa; mun karkatar da tsoho bayan mai bita na beta ya nuna cewa ɗakunan jama'a za su zubar da kasancewar dubban baƙi ga dubban sauran baƙi.
presence.h2_f:
POST /api/rooms/{id}/karanta { last_read_message_id}

idan mai amfani.hides_receipts:
   kar a dage; kar a watsawa
   kar a ba da rasidun wasu ga wannan mai amfani
wani:
   UPSERT read_receipts VALUES (room_id, user_id, message_id, NOW())
   watsa shirye-shirye {nau'in:"r", daki, mai amfani, message_id}
presence.h3_f:
granularity:
  daidai → dawo last_seen_at
  5_min → dawowa ⌊ karshe_seen_at / 300000⌋ · 300000
  1_hour → dawowa ⌊ karshe_seen_at / 3600000⌋ · 3600000
  kwanan nan → komawa 'kwanan nan' idan (yanzu - last_seen_at) < 7d kuma 'da dadewa'
  kashe → koma baya; wannan mai amfani kuma baya iya ganin wasu
presence.h4_f:
online(u) = (|{ws ∈ bude_ws: ws.user_id == u}| > 0)
ganuwa: lambobin sadarwa-kawai (ba lambobin sadarwa ba gani na ƙarshe kawai)
canza abin da ya faru gobara idan online(u) canja wuri 0 ↔ 1

calls.title: WebRTC kira
calls.subtitle: Bidiyo na murya +, 1:1 da rukuni, an yi siginar sama da WebSocket, wanda aka watsa ta hanyar coturn.
calls.intro: Vortex yana amfani da haja WebRTC tari. Node yana sigina-kawai. Da zarar takwarorinsu sun haɗa 'yan takarar su ICE, kafofin watsa labaru suna gudana kai tsaye (tsara-zuwa-tsara) ko ta hanyar TURN relay on bad NAT.
calls.h1p1: Mai kira: `POST /api/calls/{room_id}/fara` tare da `{bidiyo: bool, audio: bool}`. Node yana keɓance call_id, watsawa `{type:"c", irin:"gayyata", call_id, bidiyo, audio}` zuwa daki.
calls.h1p3: Offer/amsa musayar: `{irin:" tayin", sdp:...}` → `{irin:"amsa", sdp:...}` → `{irin:" ɗan takara", ice:...}` × N har sai an haɗa su.
calls.h1p4: Kira yana ƙarewa: `POST /api/calls/{call_id}/end`. Kowane bangare na iya yin waya. Node yana rikodin' rikodin_kira (kira_id, tsawon lokaci_, bidiyo, sauti, jam'i)'.
calls.h2p1: Ƙirƙirar Haɗin Sadarwar Sabar uwar garke. Takwarorinsu suna musayar 'yan takara (mai masaukin baki, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: hade da kwakwa. Yanayin stun-kawai da ake amfani da shi don gano simmetric-NAT.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn tare da HMAC- sa hannu na gajeriyar takaddun shaida. Kowane kira yana samun sabbin ƙididdiga masu inganci na sa'o'i 24.
calls.h2p4: Takardun shaida: `{username: <timestamp>:<user_id>, kalmar sirri: base64(HMAC-SHA1(asiri, sunan mai amfani))}'. Daidaitaccen RFC 5389 shimfidawa.
calls.h3p1: Audio: Opus 48 kHz m bitrate (6-128 kbps). DTX kunna don shiru shiru.
calls.h3p2: Bidiyo: VP9 (wanda aka fi so) / H.264 / AV1 (ficewa). Simulcast don kiran rukuni: mai kira yana ɓoye ƙuduri uku lokaci guda.
calls.h3p3: FEC: koyaushe yana kunne don sauti; don bidiyo idan bitrate headroom damar.
calls.h4p1: Don> mahalarta guda 2, Vortex yana haifar da SFU (Sashin Gabatar da Zaɓaɓɓen) akan kumburi. Kowane ɗan takara yana loda sau ɗaya, SFU magoya baya.
calls.h4p2: A halin yanzu audio-kawai har zuwa mahalarta 100; Ƙungiyoyin bidiyo sun rufe a 8 a cikin v0.1 (bidiyo SFU hardening a cikin taswirar hanya v0.3).
calls.h4p3: SFU yana amfani da relay guda ɗaya don tafiya; babu ƙarin sabis da ake buƙata.
calls.h5p1: Ta hanyar 'getDisplayMedia'. Abokin ciniki yana ƙara sabon waƙa zuwa PeerConnection data kasance; sake tattaunawa tayi/amsa.
calls.h5p2: Masu karɓa suna sanya allon rabawa azaman waƙar bidiyo daban. A kan wayar hannu, raba allo yana buƙatar izinin matakin OS - iOS yana faɗakarwa, Android yana nuna maganganun tsarin.
calls.h6p1: NetEQ na ginanniyar WebRTC yana sarrafa asara da jitter. A kan mummunan lalacewa abokin ciniki yana sauke ƙuduri ko ya kashe bidiyo gaba ɗaya yayin da yake raya sauti.
calls.h6p2: Daskarewar 500 ms yana haifar da ƙoƙarin sake haɗawa (ICE sake farawa). Masu amfani suna ganin "Sake haɗawa..." mai rufi.
calls.h1_a: Siginar kira yana tafiya iri ɗaya WebSocket da ake amfani da shi don hira. Node yana sigina-kawai - dillalai SDP da ICE tsakanin takwarorinsu amma baya taba kafafen yada labarai.
calls.h1_b: POST mai kira `/api/kira/{room_id}/fara` tare da `{bidiyo, audio}`. Node yana ware `call_id`, watsa `{type:"c", irin:"invite", call_id, video, audio}` zuwa dakin. Calee posts `/api/calls/{call_id}/accept` → `{type:"c", irin:"an yarda"}`. SDP tayi/musayar amsa: `{irin:" tayin", sdp}` → `{irin:"amsa", sdp}`. ICE 'yan takara: `{irin:" ɗan takara", ƙanƙara}` × N har sai PeerConnection ya ba da rahoton 'an haɗa'.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE sigina shine ma'auni WebRTC da aka kwatanta a cikin RFC 8839 da 8841. Yana gudana guda Chrome, Firefox, da kowane WebRTC kayan aikin laburare. Zaɓin node-as-signing-kawai ya fito ne daga fahimtar cewa SFU-style media isar da saƙon bandwidth kuma yana buƙatar kayan aikin da ba ma son jigilar kaya a cikin tushe.
calls.h2_a: ICE ya sami hanya ta hanyar NATs ta amfani da mai watsa shiri + uwar garke-mai rahusa + yan takarar relay. hannun coturn STUN da TURN a gefen Vortex.
calls.h2_b: Kowane takwarorinsu yana ƙididdige 'yan takara: mai watsa shiri (IPs na gida), srflx (server-reflexive via STUN), relay (TURN-wanda aka ware). Takwarorinsu suna musayar duk 'yan takara; kowane nau'i-nau'i suna samar da "biyu", duban haɗin kai yana aika buƙatun ɗaurin STUN akan UDP. Nasara na farko ya zama hanyar da aka zaɓa. Bayan simmetric NAT, nau'i-nau'i nau'i-nau'i ne kawai ke aiki - shi ke nan lokacin da TURN relay ɗin ke watsa kafofin watsa labarai.
calls.h2_c: An daidaita ICE azaman RFC 5245 a cikin 2010 kuma an sabunta shi azaman RFC 8445 a cikin 2018. Bayan mai ɗaukar kaya-NAT, STUN yana kasawa kusan kashi 15% na lokacin da ba a iya gani ba. coturn shine tushen tushen tushen sabar TURN; muna jigilar shi saboda madadin (na kasuwanci Twilio/Vonage TURN) yana biyan kuɗi a cikin minti ɗaya na sake kunna sauti.
calls.h3_a: TURN takardun shaida suna ɗan gajeren lokaci HMAC- sanya hannu akan sunan mai amfani/Password nau'i-nau'i na kowane kira, ba sirrin da aka daɗe ba.
calls.h3_b: A farkon kira, kumburi yana haifar da `sunan mai amfani = "<expiry_unix>:<user_id>"' da 'password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(asirin_uwar garke, sunan mai amfani))'. Dukansu suna da TTL 24h. Abokin ciniki yana amfani da su a cikin tsarin sa na RTCPeerConnection. coturn ya tabbatar da HMAC a saitin zaman. Ƙididdigar da ba ta ƙare ba ta kasa yin rajistan HMAC - suna daina aiki ta atomatik ba tare da bayanan sokewa ba.
calls.h3_c: Kwanan lokaci HMAC creds sun fito daga RFC 5389 (STUN) kuma sune tsarin kowane samarwa WebRTC amfani da turawa. Twilio, Google, Xirsys duk suna yi. Madadin - madaidaicin TURN ƙididdiga - yana yoyo idan kowane abokin ciniki ya sami matsala. Ƙididdiga masu ɗan gajeren lokaci suna iyakance taga lalacewa zuwa sa'o'i 24.
calls.h4_a: Audio shine Opus a 48 kHz tare da DTX; bidiyo shine VP9 primary / H.264 fallback / AV1 shiga.
calls.h4_b: Audio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Cikakken watsawa) yana daina aikawa yayin shiru, yana komawa kan murya. FEC a koyaushe. Bidiyo: VP9 a asali; H.264 ana tallata don na'urori marasa kayan aiki VP9 yanke hukunci (iOS kafin A10 Bionic); An bayar da AV1 azaman ficewa don ƙima akan kayan aikin zamani. Simulcast don kiran rukuni: mai kira yana ɓoye ƙuduri uku a lokaci guda, SFU magoya baya suna fitar da wanda ya dace ga kowane mai kallo.
calls.h4_c: Opus shine codec na audio na kyauta mara sarauta (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 shine Google buɗaɗɗen H.265-daidai. H.264 ya koma baya saboda Apple yana ci gaba da VP9 goyon bayan har zuwa 2021. Vortex's codec mix iri daya ne Google Meet amfani.
calls.h5_a: Kiran rukuni suna amfani da SFU (Sashin turawa Zaɓaɓɓen) akan kumburi. Kowane ɗan takara yana loda sau ɗaya; SFU gaba ga kowa.
calls.h5_b: Don> 2 takwarorinsu mai kiran suna aika '/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start`. Node yana jujjuya misali SFU daure zuwa kiran. Kowane ɗan takara yana buɗe PeerConnection zuwa SFU maimakon kowane takwarorinsa. Uplink: kowanne yana aika rafi 1. Downlink: SFU yana tura rafi N-1. Yaduwar Simulcast yana nufin SFU yana ɗaukar ƙudurin da ya dace da yawan bandwidth na kowane mai kallo.
calls.h5_c: SFU kwanakin gine-gine zuwa Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Kafin SFU, WebRTC kiran rukuni sun kasance cikakke - kowane takwarorinsu sun sanya madaidaicin rafukan N-1, wanda ke da ma'auni guda hudu. Zuƙowa, Google Haɗu, Jitsi, kiran ƙungiyar sigina duk suna amfani SFU. Vortex kiran rukuni na sauti kawai da aka aika cikin v0.0.8; Kiran rukunin bidiyo suna kan taswirar hanya v0.3.
calls.h6_a: Rarraba allo sabuwar hanyar watsa labarai ce akan PeerConnection data kasance, an sake tattaunawa ta hanyar tayi/amsa.
calls.h6_b: Mai amfani ya danna Share Screen → browser / iOS / Android yana kiran ''getDisplayMedia()'. Maidowa MediaStream shine ƙaraTrack-ed zuwa PeerConnection. Tattaunawa ta gobara: sabon tayi/amsa tare da ƙara waƙa. Masu karɓa suna mayar da allon da aka raba azaman ɓangaren bidiyo daban. A kan iOS, raba allo yana buƙatar Tsawaita Uploading na Watsawa; akan Android, sabis na gaba + izinin MediaProjection.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia an daidaita shi a cikin 2017 kuma yana cikin kowane mai bincike tun 2019. Tsawaita Upload na Watsawa ta iOS ya shigo iOS 11 (2017). Android MediaProjection ya tsaya tsayin daka tun Lollipop (2015). Vortex raba allo wanda aka aika a cikin v0.0.8.

'yan takara:
  Mai watsa shiri: rtp: addr (na gida IP)
  srflx : STUN gano adireshin jama'a
  relay : TURN-adireshin mika wuya
