federation.title: Tarayyar
federation.subtitle: Amintattun maƙallan mashaya, sa hannu na tsegumi, DMs-node.
federation.intro: Ƙungiyar ta ƙyale masu amfani akan kumburin saƙon masu amfani da saƙo akan kumburin B. Yana shiga kowane mai aiki. An aminta da maɓallan node a sarari; babu atomatik "kowane kumburi zai iya yin tarayya da nawa" yanayin.
federation.h1p1: Kowane kumburi yana kula da 'taurayi (maɓallin rubutu, maƙallan ƙarshe, ƙimar lafiya, ƙarawa, ƙarawa_)'.
federation.h1p2: Ƙara takwarorinsu yana buƙatar aikin gudanarwa na sa hannun mai aiki. Admin UI yana nuna sawun yatsa na nesa don masu aiki su iya tantancewa daga bandeji.
federation.h1p3: Takwarorin da aka cire sun kasance a cikin DB da aka yiwa alama 'an soke_a' don tantancewa. Sabbin buƙatun tarayya daga maɓalli iri ɗaya ba a ƙi su har sai wani admin ya ƙi soke.
federation.h2p1: Fita daga A zuwa mai amfani@B: node A yana nannade ambulan saƙon a cikin ɓangarorin sa hannu da POSTs `/ tarayya/mai bayarwa' akan kumburin B.
federation.h2p2: Ambulaf: `{source_node, target_user, inner_ciphertext, inner_nonce, sent_at, sig}`. Sig ya rufe komai sai sig kanta.
federation.h2p3: Node B yana tabbatar da sa hannu akan maɓalli na maɓalli na tushen_node daga teburin 'tarraya'. Sig mara inganci → 401 + taron dubawa.
federation.h3p1: Idan B ba za a iya kaiwa ba, A cikin jerin gwano a cikin 'akwatin_fitarwa (manufa_node, ɗaukar nauyi, ƙoƙari, gaba_sake gwada_a)`.
federation.h3p2: Bayani mai ma'ana: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2minti, 10min, 1h, wanda aka rufe a 6h. Rashin nasara na dindindin bayan kwanaki 14.
federation.h3p3: Faɗakarwar mai aiki yana kunna wuta lokacin zurfin akwatin waje> saƙonni 1000 - yana nuna hanyar haɗin gwiwa ta makale.
federation.h4p1: Kowane s 60 kowane kumburi pings `GET / v1 / lafiya' akan kowane takwarorina. Lokacin amsawa + ana bin sawu.
federation.h4p2: Makin lafiya: farkon 100. Kowane lokaci ya rage 1; kowace nasara tana ƙara 1 (tafiya 100). Maki 0 ​​→ Tarayyar ta dakatar da wannan takwaran.
federation.h4p3: An buga ta `GET /v1/peers' don dashboards na aiki.
federation.h1_a: Tarayya a cikin Vortex dangantaka ce ta amincewa da juna tsakanin ma'aikatan kumburi guda biyu. Kowane kumburi yana buga maɓalli na jama'a 32-byte Ed25519; ɗayan kumburin yana ƙara shi zuwa teburin 'amintattun_nodes' tare da ƙarshen ƙarshensa da ƙimar lafiya.
federation.h1_b: Ƙara amintaccen maɓalli na pub yana buƙatar afaretan ya sanya hannu kan buƙatun mai gudanarwa tare da maɓallin saki na kumburin kansa. UI yana nuna sawun yatsa na nesa a cikin fom mai hex-char 64 don haka admins zasu iya tantancewa daga bandeji. Da zarar an ƙara, kowane ambulaf ɗin tarayya mai shigowa yana tabbatar da sa hannun sa hannun Ed25519 na pubkey - ana gano jabun nan da nan kuma a shiga. Sakewa yana da laushi: layin yana tsayawa alamar `an soke_a` don dubawa, amma sa hannun ambulaf ɗin yanzu ya gaza.
federation.h1_c: An samo tsarin ne daga ƙungiyar Matrix (inda kowane uwar garken ke tallata maɓallin sa hannu kuma kowane taron yana sanya hannu da shi) kuma daga imel na DKIM (inda DNS ke buga mabuɗin sa hannu). Matrix sun tabbatar da samfurin yana aiki a sikelin - hanyar sadarwar su tana da sabobin haɗin gwiwa sama da 100k. Bambancin Vortex ya bambanta ta hanyar buƙatar shigar da juna bayyane maimakon Matrix's "kowane sabar na iya tarayya ta tsohuwa" doka; mun yi musayar saukaka don samun ƙwaƙƙwaran kariya daga ƙungiyar damfara.
federation.h1_f:
dogara_nodes jere:
  pubkey: 32 bytes Ed25519
  karshen : https://…
  lafiya_maki: int [0, 100]
  add_at: unix_ms
  add_by : admin_user_id
  soke_at : unix_ms | NULL
federation.h2_a: Saƙon kuɗaɗen giciye yana hawa ambulan E2E iri ɗaya da na gida, nannade a cikin wata ambulan waje da aka sa hannu wanda ke tabbatar da kumburin aikawa zuwa kumburin karɓa.
federation.h2_b: Node A yana son isarwa zuwa mai amfani@B. Mataki 1: Serials `{source_node, target_user, inner_ciphertext, inner_nonce, sent_at}`. Mataki 2: Alamar serialed bytes tare da maɓalli na sirri na Ed25519 → `sig`. Mataki na 3: A POST tuple zuwa `POST / tarayya/Deliver` akan kumburin B. Mataki na 4: B ya duba `kumburi_rubutun` a cikin `trusted_nodes`, yana tantance `sig`, ya duba `aiko_a` a kan tagar sake kunnawa, sannan ya ci gaba da ambulan ciki a cikin tebur `sakonnin` na gida. Abokin ciniki mai karɓa yana ganin sa daidai kamar saƙon gida - ba a ganuwa Layer Layer ga masu amfani.
federation.h2_c: An aro ambulan da aka sa hannu na waje daga abubuwan tarayya na Matrix's `m.room.message`. Tagar sake kunnawa (minti 5) da buƙatun cewa tambarin sa hannu na tushe ya dace da agogon bango daga DKIM. Farkon Vortex (v0.0.2) ya gwada tarayya mara sa hannu tare da takaddun shaida na abokin ciniki TLS; mun canza zuwa sa hannu na biyan kuɗi a cikin v0.0.5 bayan sanin takaddun shaida na abokin ciniki kar su tsira daga ma'aunin nauyi da ɓoye ainihin tabbaci daga layin aikace-aikacen.
federation.h3_a: Lokacin da kumburin nesa ba zai iya isa ba, kumburin aikawa yana yin layi akan ambulaf ɗin a cikin 'akwatin_fitilar_tarayiyar' kuma ya sake gwadawa tare da koma baya.
federation.h3_b: Jadawalin baya: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2minti, 10min, 1h, wanda aka rufe a 6h. A kan kowane yunƙurin da bai yi nasara ba an saita ginshiƙin 'yunƙurin'' jere da 'sake gwada_a' zuwa yanzu + mataki na yanzu. Ma'aikacin bayan gida ('app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) yana farkawa kowane s 5 kuma ya ɗauki layuka inda `na gaba_sake gwada_a <= yanzu()`. Nasara tana share jere; Kwanaki 14 na gazawar alama ta dindindin kuma aika faɗakarwar admin.
federation.h3_c: Ƙwararren baya tare da rufi shine irin tsarin da Kafka ke amfani da shi don sake gwadawa da SMTP amfani da wasiku na bounced. Kwanan hular kwanaki 14 yayi daidai da shawarar SMTP's RFC 5321 shawarwarin. Siffofin farko sun yi amfani da ƙayyadaddun sake gwadawa na daƙiƙa 60 wanda ya haifar da tsawa-garken garken lokacin da takwarorinsu ya dawo kan layi bayan fita; Fassarar ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun abubuwa a cikin v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
jinkiri (n) = min (6h, 1s · 2ⁿ) na n = 0, 1, 2,…

sake gwadawa jadawalin: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, …, 6h
faɗakarwa: akwatin waje_depth> 1000 don> 5 min
federation.h4_a: Kowane daƙiƙa 60 kowane kumburi yana pings kowane takwarorinsu '/v1/lafiya' ƙarshen. Maki yana hawa kan nasara, ƙasa akan gazawa, an iyakance shi cikin [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Maki yana farawa daga 100 akan ƙari. Kowace nasara tana ƙara +1 (wanda aka caje a 100), kowane lokaci ya rage -1 (bene a 0). Maki 0 ​​yana dakatar da tarayya ga wannan takwarorinsa - sabbin layin saƙo a cikin akwatin waje, babu sabon ƙoƙarin isar da waje har sai maki ya haura sama da 20. An fallasa makin ta `GET /v1/takwarori' don dashboards na ma'aikata da ta hanyar `/ awo' na Prometheus. Maki ba zato ba tsammani ya faɗi a kan takwarorinsa da yawa a cikin gajeriyar taga yana haifar da faɗakarwar "bangaren cibiyar sadarwa".
federation.h4_c: Makin na AIMD yana da ban sha'awa ta hanyar TCP tagar cunkoso da kuma damshin duba lafiyar Akamai. Matakan asymmetric ± 1 (maimakon TCP ragewa) yana sa murmurewa a hankali fiye da gazawa, wanda ke lalata tsarin zuwa taka tsantsan - gwamma mu dakatar da tarayya lokacin da ba ta da tabbas da aika saƙonnin kwafin ta hanyar haɗin kai. An ƙara a cikin v0.0.6 bayan wani ɗan'uwan da ya yi kuskure ya mamaye takwarorinsu nagari biyu tare da sake gwadawa.
federation.h4_f:
akan nasara: maki = min (100, ci + 1)
akan lokacin ƙarewa: maki = max (0, ci - 1)
idan maki == 0: dakatarwa_federation (tsara)
idan maki>= 20: resume_federation (tsara) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Gosip da gano takwarorinsu
gossip.subtitle: Yadda nodes ke samun juna ba tare da babban wurin yin rajista ba.
gossip.intro: Bayan lissafin da aka tabbatar da mai sarrafawa, Vortex nodes suna tsegumi takwarorinsu a tsakanin su. Wannan yana gano sabbin nodes yayin da masu aiki ke juyar da su, koda kuwa mai sarrafawa bai shaida su ba tukuna.
gossip.h1p1: Kowane s 60, kumburi yana zaɓar ɗan'uwa bazuwar kuma yana aika matattar Bloom 256-bit na sanannun takwarorinsu. Takwaro yana amsawa takwarorinsa NOT a cikin tacewa, da nasa tace. Bandwidth shine 'O (sabbin takwarorinsu × 32 bytes)', yawanci ƙasa da 1 KiB a kowane zagaye.
gossip.h1p2: Kowane takwarorinsu da aka yi talla suna sanya hannu a kullin talla. Abokan ciniki suna tabbatar da sa hannu a tuntuɓar farko - maharin ba zai iya ƙirƙira ɗan'uwansa cikin tsegumi ba.
gossip.h1p3: Zagaye yana iyakantacce: musanya ɗaya ga kowane ɗan wasa a cikin 30 s (taga zamiya).
gossip.h2p1: Sabbin nodes suna farawa da 8 hardcoded bootstrap masu kula. Zagayen tsegumi na farko ya gano ɗimbin takwarorinsu; hanyar sadarwa tana haɗuwa a cikin ~ 1 minti.
gossip.h2p2: Ana iya daidaita lissafin Bootstrap ta hanyar `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Kowane takwarorinsu da aka yi talla dole ne su sanya hannu ta hanyar maɓallin sakin mai aiki na Ed25519. Ƙirƙirar sanarwar takwarorinsu na buƙatar satar maɓalli mai inganci.
gossip.h3p2: Tabbacin-aiki (daidaitacce, tsoho 2^18 jagoran sifili) akan sabbin rajistar takwarorinsu yana kiyaye raƙuman ruwa na Sybil-bot ba su da amfani.
gossip.h3p3: Tsarin suna: takwarorinsu waɗanda ba su da kyau (mummunan sa hannu, sanarwar jabu, maimaita lokaci) suna da ruɓa. Sunan sifili → jerin baƙaƙe.
gossip.h1_a: Kowane s 60 kowane kumburi yana zaɓar ɗan ɗan adam bazuwar kuma yana aika matattar Bloom 256-bit yana taƙaita sanannun takwarorinsu. Takwaro yana amsawa da sabbin takwarorinsa + tace nata. Bandwidth shine `O(sabon_takwarorinsu × 32 bytes)`.
gossip.h1_b: Bloom tace k=5 hashes, m=256 ragowa. Node A yana saka duk sanannun peer_ids. Aika zuwa takwarorinsu B. B yana tambayar tacewa tare da kowane takwarorinsa; duk abin da ya rasa, B aika zuwa A (da kuma nata tace). A yana yin wannan cak ɗin a baya. Bayan musayar duk nodes suna raba kusan ilimi iri ɗaya. Musanya na yau da kullun: 200-800 bytes. Sabuntawa suna haɗuwa a cikin hanyar sadarwa a cikin ~ 5 zagaye (minti 5) godiya ga kayan tsegumi.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-tace tsegumi kwanakin zuwa ga Cornell's 1998 bimodal multicast paper. Apache Cassandra yana amfani da shi don zama memba; Bitcoin don musayar ciniki; IPFS don DHT kulawa. Abubuwan haɗin haɗin O(log N) shine abin da ya sa ya dace don amfaninmu - ba ma buƙatar ra'ayoyin duniya, kawai a ƙarshe-daidaitaccen ilimin tsara. Girman tacewa (bits 256) ana saurara don haka ƙimar ƙimar karya shine <1 % a 100 takwarorina.
gossip.h2_a: Sabbin nodes suna farawa da 8 hardcoded bootstrap masu kula. Zagaye na farko ya gano ƙarin; yana haɗuwa a cikin ~ 1 minti.
gossip.h2_b: '.env' yana jigilar kaya tare da `BOOTTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`. A kan farawa, kumburi yana gwada kowane tsari. Farkon amsawa yana samar da jerin ƙwallo na farko (ta hanyar `GET /v1/trusted_nodes`). Node yana saka waɗancan a cikin tebur ɗin takwarorinsa na gida, ya yi musu alama a matsayin takalma, kuma ya fara madauki na tsegumi na 60s. Zagaye na gaba suna gano takwarorinsu.
gossip.h2_c: Hardcoded bootstraps iri ɗaya ne Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS amfani. Madadin - gano tushen tushen DHT - yana buƙatar shigarwa ta farko ta wata hanya. An zaɓi ƙidaya bootstrap 8 na Vortex saboda samun> 4 yana ba da juriya ga abubuwan da suka faru na lokaci guda 2-3, kuma <16 yana kiyaye fayil ɗin `.env` ana iya karantawa. Daidaita yawan turawa ta hanyar gyara `BOOTTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Kowane takwarorinsa da aka yi talla dole ne ya sanya hannu ta hanyar maɓallin sakin Ed25519 na asalin aikinsa. Mai hari ba zai iya ƙirƙira takwarorinsu cikin hanyar sadarwa ba.
gossip.h3_b: Lokacin da kumburin A ya tallata peer P a cikin tsegumi zuwa kumburin B, A ya haɗa da `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, da tambarin lokaci, duk maɓallan sakin P ya sa hannu. B yana tabbatar da sa hannun kafin amincewa da P. Idan B daga baya ya tuntuɓi P da P's TLS cert + bugun bugun zuciya na farko bai yi daidai da maɓalli da aka yi talla ba, tallan yana da alamar guba kuma ana yada shi zuwa ƙasa.
gossip.h3_c: Tallace-tallacen takwarorinsu masu sa hannun hannu sune daidaitattun anti-Sybil na farko daga Chord (2001) da Kademlia (2002). Saƙonnin addr na Bitcoin suna amfani da ƙira mai rauni (babu sa hannu, ya dogara da farashin haɗin kai azaman Sybil deterrent); Alamar Ethereum Discv5. Vortex an karɓi tallace-tallacen da aka sanya hannu a cikin v0.0.6 bayan wani maharin testnet ya tallata takwarorinsa na bogi 1000 ta hanyar kulli ɗaya na halal.
gossip.h1_f:
tace: k=5, m=256 bits
saka (x) = na i a cikin 0.k: tace[hash_i (x) mod m] = 1
tambaya (x) = na i a cikin 0.k: duba tace[hash_i (x) mod m]
karya-tabbatacce a takwarorinsu 100, 256 bits, k=5: ~ 0.4 %
gossip.h2_f:
.env:
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd…@https://a.example,efgh…@https://b.example

farawa:
  don takwarorinsu a BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    gwada: takwarorinsu ← peer.get('/v1/trusted_nodes'); karya
    sai dai: ci gaba
  fara gulma

stealth.title: Stealth cibiyar sadarwa
stealth.subtitle: Yadudduka biyar, hanyoyin 28. Komai daga TLS padding zuwa sabis na albasa Tor.
stealth.intro: Vortex yana ɗaukar abokin gaba mai daraja na ƙasa. An lissafta tari mai ɓoye don haka ko da an ketare yadudduka na waje, na ciki har yanzu suna ba da sabis na ƙasƙanci-amma mai aiki.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 - daidaita sawun yatsa. Dakatar da m classifiers.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 - siffar / girman morphing. Tsaida zirga-zirga-bincike classifiers.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 - ƙaho na yarjejeniya. Tsayawa aiki DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 - abubuwan jigilar kaya. Yana aiki a cibiyoyin sadarwar da ke toshe firamaren mu.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 - koma baya-baya. Albasa, BMP, relay multi-hop. Yana aiki lokacin da babu abin da ya aikata.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello yayi daidai da Chrome akan Windows 11 byte-for-byte. JA3/JA4 zanta yayi daidai da Chrome 120 - babu takamaiman sawun yatsa Vortex.
stealth.h2p2: Rikodi-Layer padding: duk TLS rikodin manne zuwa 16 KB. Girman fakiti sun dace da yawan zirga-zirgar burauza.
stealth.h2p3: Aika-ƙididdigar ƙididdigewa: jerin gwano suna fitar da firam ɗaya kowane N ms ba tare da la'akari da ayyukan aikace-aikacen ba. Lokaci marasa aiki suna fitar da firam ɗin datti da aka yiwa alama a cikin ambulaf na ciki don haka masu karɓa su watsar da su.
stealth.h2p4: Jitter lokaci: 0-50 ms bazuwar jinkiri akan ƙaura don kayar da tushen latency DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morpher: girman girman fakiti, fashe-fashe, da gibin shuru sun dace da rafin YouTube. Nassosi masu neman bugun zuciya na manzo sun kasa daidaitawa.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: guda guda ya rabu akan Wi-Fi, salon salula, da kowane aiki VPN lokaci guda. Sake haɗuwa a mai karɓa. Ya ci nasara da gyare-gyaren hanya guda.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC data channel tunnel: lokacin da TLS aka toshe amma WebRTC yana aiki, Vortex ramukan ta tashar DTLS-SRTP zuwa ga wanda aka sani.
stealth.h3p4: Haɗin kayan ado: 3 zaman banza TLS zaman banza zuwa Google, YouTube, da Cloudflare. Mai sa ido yana ganin halayen burauza na yau da kullun.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): duk DNS an warware ta DoH zuwa Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP yana ganin kawai HTTPS ga waɗancan masu warwarewa, ba ainihin jerin yanki ba.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Sannu): SNI rufaffen tare da maɓalli da aka buga a cikin rikodin DNS HTTPS. Masu sa ido ba su iya ganin sunan mai masaukin baki.
stealth.h4p3: Gano bincike: kumburi yana bin buƙatun ba tare da wani zama na ajali ba. Bincike guda uku da suka gaza daga IP a cikin mintuna 5 suna haifar da yanayin "shafin lalata" - wanda IP yanzu yana ganin shafi na HTML a sarari tare da 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Algorithm Generation na Domain): janareta mai ƙima wanda aka shuka tare da kwanan watan yau. Idan an katange wurin ƙarshe na farko, abokan ciniki suna lissafin ɗan takara na gaba kuma su gwada.
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: daidaitaccen salon jigilar V2Ray tare da saitin JSON mai toshe.
stealth.h5p2: Gaskiya: TLS-cikin-TLS rami. Maƙasudin musafaha na waje www.microsoft.com; musafaha na ciki shine Vortex. Ana gabatar da bincike game da waje zuwa Microsoft don haka bincike mai aiki bai bayyana komai ba.
stealth.h5p3: Dusar ƙanƙara: masu bincike na sa kai sun watsar da zirga-zirga sama da WebRTC. Masu amfani da ke shigar da tsawo na Snowflake suna ba da murfin.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: yana canza HTTPS bincike don haɗawa da halayen Chromium har zuwa microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Ayyukan Albasa: kowane kumburi kuma yana fallasa kansa a matsayin `.albasa`. Abokan ciniki tare da tallafin Tor sun faɗi cikin wannan lokacin da komai ya gaza.
stealth.h6p2: Makafin Akwatin Wasiku Protocol (BMP): kantin sayar da-da-gaba don saƙonni. Duba BMP babi.
stealth.h6p3: Relay Multi-hop: saƙonni na iya billa har zuwa 5 matsakaici nodes, kowanne yana ƙara Layer na ambulaf. Kamar Tor amma a cikin ragarmu.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): gafala HTTP ta hanyar relay. Babu wata ƙungiya da ke ganin buƙatu da amsa duka.
stealth.h1_a: An tsara Stealth azaman yadudduka masu zaman kansu guda biyar. Kowane Layer yana cin nasara a aji daban-daban na abokin gaba. Rashin gazawar Layer ɗaya yana ƙasƙantar da na gaba - ba ya raguwa.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 yana daidaita sawun yatsan mu TLS don haka m DPI ba zai iya rarrabawa ba. Layer 2 yana fitar da sifar zirga-zirga don yin kama da yawo. Layer 3 yana kama ka'idar ta hanyar ECH / DoH / dabarun amsawa. Layer 4 yana canzawa zuwa abubuwan jigilar kaya (vmess, gaskiya, Snowflake) lokacin da aka toshe firamare sosai. Layer 5 shine wuri na ƙarshe: Tor albasa, BMP, relay multi-hop.
stealth.h1_c: Samfurin da aka zana ya fito ne daga gine-ginen kayan aikin jigilar kayayyaki na Tor (2013). Vortex ƙara biyar yadudduka maimakon Tor's uku saboda zuwa 2025 yanayin gaba ya haɗa da DPI waɗanda suka gane Tor ta jigilar kansu (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). An gabatar da kowane Layer Vortex bayan wani lamari da ya faru a filin: L1 bayan Kazakhstan ta toshe (daidai da 2019), L2 bayan Iran ta fatattaki Iran 2022, L3 bayan China ta gano DoH 2020, L4 bayan shiri na Turkiyya 2023.
stealth.h1_f:
Adadin abokan gaba | Wanda ya ci nasara
------------------ | ------------
m DPI | L1 (hannun yatsa)
nazarin zirga-zirga | L2 (siffa)
aiki DPI | L3 (kamuwa)
toshewa ta IP | L4 ( jigilar kaya)
komai sauran | L5 (albasa / BMP)
stealth.h2_a: Layer 1 yana sa Vortex zirga-zirga ba za a iya bambanta da Chrome akan Windows 11 a Layer TLS.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello oda, jerin tsawaitawa, jerin abubuwan cipher suite, ALPN dabi'u - duk an daidaita su don dacewa da ainihin bytes na Chrome 120. JA3/JA4 hash yayi daidai da sakin Chrome na yanzu. TLS rikodin rikodin zuwa 16 KB. Mai aikawa na dindindin yana fitar da firam ɗaya kowane N ms tare da na'urori masu dumbin yawa yayin aiki. Lokaci jitter 0-50 ms don kayar da binciken latency. Haɗin lalata zuwa Google, YouTube, Cloudflare suna gudana a bango a tazarar s45.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 injiniyoyin Salesforce ne suka buga yatsan yatsa a cikin 2017. Zuwa 2019 ya kasance daidaitaccen a cikin masana'antu DPI. Vortex daidaitaccen hoton yatsa an tsara shi akan uTLS, ɗakin karatu na Go wanda Snowflake ke amfani da shi don wannan manufa. Masu aikawa da ƙididdigewa tashar jiragen ruwa kai tsaye ne na shawarar "rufe zirga-zirga" na WireGuard.
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 yana canza zirga-zirga don yin kama da mafi yawan kafofin watsa labarai maimakon taɗi mai mu'amala.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morpher: girman girman fakiti yayi daidai da rafin raye-raye na YouTube na 720p (tebur mai ƙima), fashe fashe ashana, daidaitattun gibin shuru. Multipath: rafi mai ma'ana iri ɗaya ya rabu akan Wi-Fi, salon salula, da kowane aiki VPN a lokaci guda; mai karɓa ya sake haɗuwa a cikin tsari na lamba. WebRTC data channel fallback: lokacin da TLS aka toshe amma WebRTC ya shiga, rami Vortex ta hanyar DTLS-SRTP data tashar zuwa ga sanannen tsara.
stealth.h3_c: Binciken morphing na zirga-zirga yana komawa zuwa Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 aiwatar da shi a matsayin "morph" sub-mode a cikin 2014. Meek + yanki-fronting ya koya mana cewa siffar tana da mahimmanci kamar yadda ɓoyayyen ɓoye yake. YouTube-musamman an zaɓi shi ne saboda shine mafi girman rukunin da ba a toshe shi a cikin mafi yawan cibiyoyin sadarwa masu ƙuntatawa - ɓoye cikin zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar YouTube yana "ɓoye a cikin taron jama'a".
stealth.h3_f:
fakiti_size[i] ~ P(girman | YT-720p)
send_delay[i] ~ P (jinkiri | YT-720p)
dummy_frames da aka saka yayin zaman banza don kula da surar ambulan
stealth.h4_a: Layer 3 yana kama da ainihin ƙa'idar da kanta - SNI, DNS, lambobin amsawa.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): duk DNS yana wucewa DNS-over-HTTPS zuwa Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP yana ganin HTTPS kawai ga wadancan masu warwarewa. ECH (RFC 9460): An rufaffen SNI tare da maɓalli da aka buga a cikin rikodin DNS HTTPS. Masu lura da hankali suna ganin ƙarshen gaba kawai IP. Gano bincike: nodes suna waƙa ba tare da izini ba IPs suna buga `/api/*`; kasawa uku a cikin mintuna 5 juya IP zuwa "yanayin lalata" - cewa IP yanzu yana ganin a tsaye HTML shafi na saukowa tare da 200 OK. DGA: babban janareta na yanki wanda aka shuka tare da kwanan watan don haka abokan ciniki su sami koma baya lokacin da aka toshe na farko.
stealth.h4_c: An ƙaddamar da DoH a cikin Firefox 2018 kuma ya zama tsoho don Chrome a cikin 2019. ECH ya wuce zane-zane guda biyar kafin daidaitawa a cikin 2024 - Vortex an aika da tallafi yayin daftarin-13 kuma yanzu yana goyan bayan ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun bayanai. An aro lamunin neman amsawa daga ƙira ta 2014 masu tawali'u kuma an tace su a cikin 2023 bayan masu bincike na Iran sun gano tawali'u ta hanyar lokacin mayar da martani.
stealth.h5_a: Layer 4 yana amfani da abubuwan da za a iya haɗawa - ramukan ɓangare na uku waɗanda suke kama da wani abu gaba ɗaya.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: daidaitattun jigilar kayayyaki masu fita irin na V2Ray; config JSON. Gaskiya: TLS-in-TLS rami inda aka kai hari a waje www.microsoft.com; musafaha na ciki shine Vortex. Ana aika bincike mai aiki zuwa waje zuwa Microsoft, don haka bincike bai bayyana komai ba. Dusar ƙanƙara: masu bincike na sa kai sun ba da izini Vortex sama da WebRTC; babu infra a gefenmu. NaiveProxy: yana gyara bincike HTTPS don haɗawa da ainihin halayen Chromium.
stealth.h5_c: An gabatar da V2Ray's Vmess a cikin 2015 ta al'ummar China masu adawa da cece-kuce. An ƙaddamar da Trojan a cikin 2019. Gaskiyar ita ce daga 2022 - amsa ga Babban Firewall's TLS gano hoton yatsa. Snowflake shine maye gurbin Tor Project na 2020 don obfs4; Vortex ƙara tallafi a cikin v0.0.9 bayan Iran ta 2023 cikakken toshe wuraren shiga Tor.
stealth.h5_f:
misali inbound na gaskiya:
  Sunan uwar garken: www.microsoft.com
  Shafin: www.microsoft.com:443
  shortIds: ["<random>"]
abokin ciniki ya haɗu da IP, SNI=www.microsoft.com, mu wakilci ainihin martanin Microsoft
idan hanya ta dace da gajeriyar Id+auth ⇒ hanya zuwa Vortex
stealth.h6_a: Layer 5 shine jakar dabara ta ƙarshe: sabis ɗin albasa, BMP kantin-da-gaba, relay mai yawa, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Kowane kumburi yana buga adireshin `.albasa'. Abokan ciniki tare da mai ba da damar Tor suna faɗuwa lokacin da TLS + L1-L4 duk sun kasa. BMP (Makafin Akwatin Wasiku Protocol): mai aikawa yana sauke ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoye a kowane kumburi da `HKDF(mai karɓa_pubkey, "bmp-v1")'; tsegumi yana yaɗawa; mai karɓa ya janye daga kullin gidansu. Multi-hop: saƙonni suna billa har zuwa 5 matsakaici nodes, kowanne yana ƙara ambulan - kamar Tor amma a cikin ragamar mu. OHTTP (RFC 9458): gafala HTTP ta hanyar relay don haka babu wata ƙungiya da ta ga buƙatu da amsa.
stealth.h6_c: Ayyukan Albasa sun koma 2004 a Tor. BMP shine namu ƙirƙira, wanda aka ƙirƙira akan tsegumi na ɓoyayyiyar sabis na Tor. Multi-hop gudun ba da sanda madubin sigina ta hatimin-mai aikawa da albasa. OHTTP daga shekarar 2024 ne, Cloudflare da Apple ne suka kirkiresu don kiyaye bayanan sirri; mun karbe shi a cikin v0.0.9 azaman koma baya na ƙarshe.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP mailbox_id = HKDF(mai karɓa_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Deposit: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id, blob}
Karɓa: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd)
TTL: 7200 s |  Mafi girman girma: 1 MB |  Matsakaicin kowane kumburi: 500 MB

bmp.title: Makauniyar Akwatin Saƙonni
bmp.subtitle: Shagon-da-gaba da ba a san su ba don saƙonni ta hanyar tsegumi.
bmp.intro: BMP yana barin mai aikawa ya ajiye saƙo a kowane kumburi ba tare da bayyana ainihi ba. Saƙon yana tsegumi har sai ya isa ƙofar gidan mai karɓa, inda yake yanke bayanan kamar yadda aka saba.
bmp.h1p1: Mai aikawa ya sami `mailbox_id = HKDF(mai karɓa_pubkey, bayani: "bmp-v1", ruwan tabarau: 32)`. Mai aikawa (wanda ya san recipient_pubkey) ne kawai zai iya lissafta shi; mai karɓa kuma ya sani.
bmp.h1p2: Aika sakonni `POST /bmp/deposit` tare da `{mailbox_id, blob}` zuwa kowane kumburin tsegumi.
bmp.h1p3: Kantin sayar da node har zuwa 7200 s. Node kuma ya haɗa da akwatin saƙon_id a cikin tace Bloom na zagaye na gaba.
bmp.h1p4: Sauran nodes suna jan tsummoki don mailbox_ids da suke kula da su a gida (masu karɓa akan kumburinsu).
bmp.h1p5: Kuri'ar abokin ciniki na mai karɓa'GET /bmp/saƙonni' kuma yana ɓoye duk wani sabon ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen abu tare da maɓalli na yau da kullun.
bmp.h2p1: Babu kumburin da zai iya haɗa tabo da mai aikawa - haɗin TLS mai aikawa yana gano tushen IP, amma sarkar albasa tsakanin mai aikawa da farkon BMP kumburi yana kawar da hakan ma.
bmp.h2p2: Ɓoye mai karɓa: an rufaffen ɓoyayyen ɓoye tare da maɓalli na mai karɓa. Ƙungiyoyin tsakiya suna ganin kirtani ta byte kawai da bazuwar mailbox_id.
bmp.h2p3: Babu tabbacin isarwa ga mai aikawa. A-mafi-mafi sau ɗaya.
bmp.h3p1: Matsakaicin girman bulo: 1 MB. Dole ne a murkushe manyan lodin kaya ta hanyar tafiyar da fayil na yau da kullun.
bmp.h3p2: Matsakaicin ajiya a kowane kumburi: 500 MB na adibas gabaɗaya. LRU korar da aka yi. Masu aiki za su iya kunnawa.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: per-IP adadin ajiya an iyakance shi zuwa 10 / min. ID na akwatin wasiku da aka lura fiye da sau 3 / awa akan kumburi guda ɗaya ana iyakance su azaman ambaliya.
bmp.h4p1: Babban masu karɓar tannewa: mai aikawa baya buƙatar sanin kullin gidan mai karɓa.
bmp.h4p2: Haɗin kai na ɗan lokaci: tsummoki suna jira har sai mai karɓa ya sake haɗawa da jefa ƙuri'a.
bmp.h4p3: Basu sani ba: Albasa ta gefen mai aikawa + BMP = babu metadata akan wanda ya ajiye me.
bmp.h1_a: BMP wani shafi ne da ba a san sunansa ba. Mai aikawa yana sauke ƙulli a kowane kumburi mai kunna tsegumi; tonon yana jira a cikin akwatin saƙon da aka maɓalli kawai ga maɓallin jama'a na mai karɓa kawai.
bmp.h1_b: Mai aikawa yana lissafin `box_id = HKDF(mai karɓa_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Sai kawai wanda ya san 'mai karɓa_pubkey' zai iya ƙididdige shi - mai karɓa ya sani, mai aikawa ya sani, wani ɓangare na uku bai sani ba. Aika POSTs `{mailbox_id, blob}` zuwa kowane kumburin tsegumi. Node yana adana biyun har zuwa 7200 s (2 h), kuma yana sanar da akwatin saƙon_id a cikin musayar tsegumi na gaba Bloom tace. Sauran nodes ganin akwatin saƙon_id a cikin gida wanda ya dace da akwatin saƙon mai amfani da aka adana ya ja guntun kuma tura zuwa abokin ciniki na mai amfani.
bmp.h1_c: BMP an tsara su ne daga farko ta ƙungiyar Vortex. Mun gina shi saboda babu wani babban manzo da ke shirye ya kashe albarkatun da ake buƙata don ɓoye ƙarshen metadata - kowane samfuri mai mahimmanci ya aika da ɓoyayyen abun ciki amma ya bar sashin isarwa a buɗe, don haka sabar har yanzu ta san wanda yayi magana da wa da yaushe. A cikin tawagar mun ci gaba da cewa "amintaccen manzo wanda ke ba da hoton zamantakewa yana da aminci rabin kawai." BMP ita ce amsarmu: mai aikawa, mai karɓa, da abun ciki duk sun zama mara kyau; babu kumburi guda ɗaya a cikin raga da ke riƙe isassun guda don sake gina tattaunawa. Yana gudana sama da masana'antar tsegumi na Vortex maimakon kayan aikin da aka kulle, wanda shine abin da ya sa farashin kasuwancin ya dace kuma ana iya tantance ƙira a cikin gida.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(mai karɓa_pubkey, info = "bmp-v1", len=32)

Deposit: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Sanarwa: tsegumi Bloom filter += mailbox_id
Daukewa: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → bugu don akwatin saƙon mai amfani_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  ma'auni na kowane kumburi: 500 MB |  Adadin ajiya: 10/min/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP yana ba da kaddarorin sirri masu zaman kansu guda uku: ɓoye-boye, ɓoye mai karɓa, ɓoye abun ciki.
bmp.h2_b: Boye-boye: TLS haɗi zuwa kumburin ajiya yana bayyana tushen IP; ƙara Tor hop ko sarƙar albasa da aka sarrafa zuwa kumburin BMP na farko yana kawar da hakan. Boye mai karɓa: mailbox_id zanta ce ta hanya ɗaya ta recipient_pubkey wanda aka yi masa gishiri tare da sigar sigar BMP - kumburin tsakiya yana ganin madaidaicin mai gano baiti 32. Boye abun ciki: an riga an rufa masa asiri E2E ga mai karɓa ta amfani da maɓallan Vortex ɗaki / DM na yau da kullun, don haka kumburin tsakiya yana ganin rubutun kawai.
bmp.h2_c: Tsarin kadara uku shine yadda Pond ya bayyana manufofinsa a cikin 2014. Vortex ta tace ta ta hanyar sa akwatin wasiku_id ya zama mai juriya (256-bit hash) don haka masu amfani biyu da ba su da alaƙa ba za su iya raba akwatin wasiku ba da gangan. 7200-na biyu TTL ya zo daga lura cewa 95% na masu karɓa a cikin beta sun ja a cikin sa'o'i 2; tsayin TTL ma'ajin kumburi na kowane kumburi ba tare da fa'idar isar da ganuwa ba.
bmp.h2_f:
Abokin gaba wanda yake ganin yanayin kumburi:
  - san mailbox_id yana wanzuwa a lokacin T
  - Shin NOT san mai aikawa (ya kasance TLS/Tor hop away)
  - ya san mai karɓa NOT (mailbox_id hash na hanya ɗaya ne)
  - ya san abun ciki NOT (blob is E2E-ruyayye)
bmp.h3_a: Iyakoki masu wuya akan girman ɓangarorin, ma'ajiyar kuɗaɗe ɗaya, da ƙimar ajiya suna kiyaye BMP daga zama matattun digo don bayanan sabani.
bmp.h3_b: Matsakaicin girman bulo: 1 MB. Manyan kaya dole ne su karkata ta hanyar tsarin fayil na yau da kullun, wanda ke da hanyar ajiyar kansa. Matsakaicin ma'ajiyar node: 500 MB jimlar BMP adibas. Lokacin da aka kai hular, korar mafi tsufa-na farko tana raguwa kafin TTL - masu aiki zasu iya daidaitawa ta hanyar 'BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Adadin ajiya a kowane IP: 10 a cikin minti daya, don tsayayya da ambaliya daga maharin guda. ID na akwatin wasiku da aka lura fiye da sau 3/sa'a a fadin hanyar sadarwa an iyakance su azaman "maƙasudin ambaliya da ake zargi".
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB madaidaicin madaidaicin madaidaicin IRC DCC-aika tarurruka da kuma siginar hatimin-aiki mai aikewa - babban isa don gajerun saƙonni da thumbnails, ƙaramin isa wanda maharin ba zai iya amfani da BMP don ɗaukar hoto ba. 500 MB kowane kumburi yana da OSS-tsoho mai hankali; manyan masu aiki suna ɗaga shi da 'BMP_MAX_BYTES'. Iyakokin ƙimar sun zo bayan v0.0.8 beta inda rubutun gwajin gwaji ya cika nodes 50 tare da adibas a cikin mintuna 20.
bmp.h3_f:
iyaka:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # a cikin minti daya a kowace IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # akwatin saƙo guda ɗaya a kowace awa
bmp.h4_a: BMP yana haskakawa cikin yanayi guda uku: manyan masu karɓar ba da izini, haɗin kai na tsaka-tsaki, ɓarna mai ɓoyewa.
bmp.h4_b: Babban-tace: mai aikawa bai san kullin gidan mai karɓa ba (kuma watakila ba zai iya isa gare shi ba). Sauke kowane takwarorinsu, bari hanyar tsegumi. Haɗin kai tsaye: mai karɓa yana layi na sa'o'i; buge-buge yana jira, ba a buƙatar sake gwadawa. Ba a san shi ba: Albasa ta gefen mai aikawa + BMP = babu metadata game da wanda ya ajiye abin. Haɗe da maɓallin ɗakin da aka sani kawai ga amintattun ɓangarorin, abun ciki kuma ba shi da kyau ga kowane mai shiga tsakani.
bmp.h4_c: Abubuwan da ake amfani da su guda uku suna bin abubuwan da ke motsa matattu a cikin leƙen asiri ta zahiri (zamanin Soviet), don 'alt.anonymous.messages' akan Usenet (1990s), da kuma na SecureDrop (2013 gaba). BMP shine ƙoƙarinmu na kawo wannan tarihin cikin manzo na zamani ba tare da buƙatar kayan aiki daban ba.

push.title: Tura sanarwar
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Gidan Yanar Gizo - duk tare da rufaffiyar ambulan don masu samarwa ba za su iya karantawa ba.
push.intro: Daidaitaccen sabis na turawa (APNs, FCM, Gidan Yanar Gizon Yanar Gizo) duba kowane kayan aiki. Vortex yana nannade kowane sanarwa a cikin wani nau'in E2E daban don haka mai ba da sabis yana ganin baƙar fata kawai ba tare da id, mai aikawa, ko rubutu ba.
push.h1p1: Abokin ciniki ya sami alamar dandamali (alamar na'urar APNs, FCM ID rajista, ko biyan kuɗin yanar gizo JWT).
push.h1p2: Abokin ciniki ya haifar da sabon maɓalli 32-byte X25519 'p256dh_pub' da sirrin 'auth' 16-byte. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` tare da `{ƙarshen, p256dh, auth, dandamali}`.
push.h1p3: Node yana ci gaba da 'tunanin biyan kuɗi (mai amfani_id, ƙarshen ƙarshen, p256dh, auth, dandamali, ƙirƙira_a)'.
push.h2p1: Lokacin da sanarwa ta ƙare (sabon saƙo a cikin ɗakin da aka rufe wanda aka saita don sanarwa, ambaton, gayyatar kira), kumburi yana ɓoye nauyin biyan kuɗi tare da AES-GCM ta amfani da maɓallin da aka samo daga `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` ta HKDF.
push.h2p2: Fakitin node `{ƙarshen, TTL, gaggawa, batu: <collapse_key>, bayanai: <ciphertext>}` kuma yana aikawa zuwa APNs / FCM / sabar Push Web.
push.h2p3: Mai bayarwa yana ganin 'bayanai' kawai (rubutun rubutu) + 'jigon'. Babu zub da jini a fili.
push.h3p1: Maɓallin jigo na ɗaki: `ɗaki:<id>`. Saƙonni da yawa a cikin ɗaki ɗaya sun rushe zuwa sanarwa ɗaya a matakin OS.
push.h3p2: Taken kiran kowane lokaci: `kira:<id>`. Amsa ko raguwa yana jan tuta; sabon kiran da aka gayyata zuwa daki daya maye gurbin tsohon.
push.h4p1: iOS: Tsawaita Sabis na Fadakarwa yana yankewa a cikin tsari na NSE (ban da babban app). Yana amfani da farkon CryptoKit iri ɗaya.
push.h4p2: Android: Sabis na FirebaseMessaging yana yanke bayanan sirri a cikin bayanan baya. JobScheduler yana tsara ainihin UI sabuntawa lokacin da app ɗin ya riga ya faɗi.
push.h4p3: Yanar Gizo: Ma'aikacin Sabis yana ɓoye bayanan a cikin mahallin SW, yana aika sanarwar gida ta hanyar Faɗin Yanar Gizo API.
push.h5p1: APNs: yana buƙatar alamar mai ba da wartsakewa kowane minti 60. Ana sabunta alamar alama ta atomatik ta Apple's `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 file key.
push.h5p2: FCM: Legacy HTTP ƙarshen maƙasudi; muna amfani da ƙarshen HTTP v1 tare da bayanan bayanan sabis na OAuth2. Juyawa kowane awa 1.
push.h5p3: Tura Yanar Gizo: VAPID maɓallai (keypair ɗaya a kowane kumburi). TTL an rufe shi a cikin kwanaki 28 ta yawancin masu bincike.
push.h1_a: Abokin ciniki yana yin rijistar alamar na'urar (APNs/FCM/Turawar Yanar Gizo) tare da sabon maɓalli na jama'a X25519 da kuma sirrin ingantaccen 16-byte.
push.h1_b: Abokin ciniki yana haifar da `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` da `auth = rand(16)`. Ya samo `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` tare da `{ƙarshen, p256dh, auth, dandamali, mai amfani_agent}`. Node yana ci gaba da 'tunanin biyan kuɗi (mai amfani_id, ƙarshen ƙarshen, p256dh, auth, dandamali, ƙirƙira_a, ƙarshe_refreshed_a)'. Juyawa: abokin ciniki ya sake yin rajista akan kowane ƙaddamar da app, wanda ke wartsakewa 'ƙarshe_sake_a'. An share biyan kuɗin da suka girmi kwanaki 30.
push.h1_c: Filayen p256dh + auth sun fito daga Gidan Yanar Gizon Push RFC 8291 (2017). Mun sake amfani da su don APNs da FCM duk da cewa waɗannan ayyukan ba sa buƙatar tsarin da aka rufe - yin haka yana kiyaye hanyar lamba ɗaya a duk ukun. Kafin v0.0.5 Vortex aika da kayan aikin rubutu na zahiri ta ayyukan turawa; bayan Apple's 2022 sabuntawar sirrin turawa da wani lamari na daban inda wani kuskuren aikin FCM ya fitar da sanarwar, mun matsar da komai zuwa ambulan da aka rufe.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = Rand (32)
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519
Auth = Rand (16)

POST /api/push/subscribe
  {ƙarshen, p256dh: hex(p256dh_pub), auth: hex (auth), dandamali}
push.h2_a: Lokacin da sanarwa ta ƙare, kumburi yana ɓoye abin da aka biya don haka na'urar mai karɓa kawai za ta iya karanta shi. Sabis ɗin turawa (Apple / Google / Mozilla) yana ganin baƙar fata kawai.
push.h2_b: Node yana zaɓar maɓalli na ephemeral X25519 maɓalli. Ya samo `ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Yana gudana HKDF(gishiri=auth, ikm, info = "aesgcm", len=32) → maɓalli. Yana ɓoye `{ take, jiki, ɗakin_id, saƙon_id}` kamar yadda CBOR → AES-GCM tare da maɓallin da aka samo + bazuwar 96-bit. Yana aika `{ƙarshen ƙarshen, TTL, gaggawa, batu: maɓalli: rushewa, bayanai: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {gishiri, pub_ephemeral}}' zuwa APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Na'urar tana karɓar, tsawo / ma'aikacin sabis yana gudanar da samo maɓalli iri ɗaya a baya, yana ɓoyewa, yana nuna sanarwa.
push.h2_c: Rufewar turawa kai tsaye shine ƙayyadaddun ɓoyewar saƙon Yanar gizo daga 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple's 2022 iOS 16 sabuntawa ya kara tallafin aji na farko don haɓaka sabis na sanarwa da ke yin lalata; Android ta tallafa masa ta hanyar saƙonnin bayanai FCM tsawon shekaru. Vortex yana ɗaya daga cikin 'yan manzanni waɗanda ke aiwatar da cikakken kwarara tare da lamba iri ɗaya akan duk dandamali guda uku - iOS yana amfani da 'NotificationServiceExtension', Android yana amfani da 'FirebaseMessagingService', Yanar gizo yana amfani da ma'aikacin sabis.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = Rand (32);  ephemeral_pub = ephemeral_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256 (auth, ikm)
maɓalli = HKDF- Expand (prk, "Tsarin-Tsarin Abun ciki: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF- Expand(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt(key, nonce, loadload)
aika {ƙarshen, bayanai: gishiri∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct}
push.h3_a: Maɓallai masu rugujewa suna hana sanarwa da yawa daga taɗi iri ɗaya tari kamar banners guda ɗaya - OS yana haɗa su zuwa ɗaya.
push.h3_b: Rushewar ɗaki: topic = `daki:<id>`. APNs 'apns-collapse-id' da FCM's''maɓallin rugujewa' suna gaya wa OS don maye gurbin sanarwar farko da jigo iri ɗaya. Mai amfani yana ganin tuta ɗaya a kowane ɗaki komai yawan saƙonnin da suka iso. Rushewar kowane kira: topic = `kira:<id>`; sabon kira gayyata zuwa daki daya maye gurbin na baya. Per-ambaci: topic = `ambaci: <mai amfani>: <daki>'; Banner ɗaya ambaton kowane ɗaki mai amfani.
push.h3_c: An saka maɓallai masu rugujewa zuwa APNs a cikin iOS 10 (2016) da kuma zuwa FCM a cikin 2014. Kafin haka, fashewar saƙon da yawa ya haifar da tarin banner da yawa waɗanda masu amfani suka ƙi. Telegram ya fara rugujewar daki daya UX a shekarar 2015; kowane babban manzo ya biyo baya. Rarraba Vortex zuwa ɗaki / kira / ambaton rugujewar ya fito ne daga martanin mai amfani a cikin v0.0.6 beta cewa "gayyatar kira ya maye gurbin banner taɗi" ya ji kuskure - batutuwa daban-daban sun gyara shi.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = dakin: 42 → maye gurbin tutocin da suka gabata
FCM: rushewa_key = kira:17 → yana maye gurbin tutocin da suka gabata
Yanar Gizo: topic = ambaton:u12:r5 → maye gurbin tutocin da suka gabata
push.h4_a: Kowane dandali yana da nasa samu. iOS yana buƙatar Tsawaita Sabis na Sanarwa; Android yana buƙatar FCM saƙonnin bayanai; Yanar gizo yana buƙatar ma'aikacin sabis + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: kunshin app ɗin yana jigilar maƙasudin ''NotificationServiceExtension'. Tsarin yana ba da kayan aikin da aka ɓoye zuwa NSE; NSE yana da 30 s na CPU + 25 MB na ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya don yankewa da canza sanarwar kafin a nuna shi. FCM: muna aika saƙon 'bayanai' (ba 'sanarwa') don haka sabis ɗin FirebaseMessaging na app yana gudana lokacin isowa - wanda ke ba mu iko akan ko za mu nuna banner. Tura Yanar Gizo: ma'aikacin sabis yana satar abubuwan ''push'', ɓata bayanan, nuni ta hanyar'self.registration.showNotification'.
push.h4_c: An gabatar da tsarin NSE ta Apple a cikin iOS 10 (2016) musamman don abubuwan amfani da saƙon-decryption. Kafin wannan, saƙon da aka rufaffen ƙarshen-zuwa-ƙarshen dole ne su zaɓi tsakanin kayan aikin turawa a sarari (keɓanta-maƙiya) da tura lamba-kawai (UX-maƙiya). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram duk sun yi tsalle zuwa NSE a cikin shekara guda. Vortex yana bin wannan tsari.
push.h5_a: Takamaiman quirks mai bayarwa - ɓangaren ɓangaren turawa. Wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin mahimman hanyoyin da aka ambata a duk faɗin Vortex. Karanta babin da ke kewaye don ƙarin mahallin; wannan sashe yana zuƙowa kan takamaiman ɗabi'a.
push.h5_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Takamaiman masu bayarwa". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
push.h5_c: Tsarin "Takamaiman quirks masu bayarwa" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.

controller.title: Sabis na sarrafawa
controller.subtitle: Tabbatar da gaskiya, gano shigarwa, kula da lafiya.
controller.intro: Mai sarrafawa wani tsari ne na daban na Python. Fushin kai harin kankanin ne (kimanin hanyoyi dozin) kuma an rataye amanar sa zuwa maɓalli guda ɗaya na Ed25519 wanda aka gasa cikin abokan ciniki.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/mutuma' - sakamakon shaida. Tsari: `{matsayi, sanya hannu, amintaccen_pubkey, sigar, ginawa, daidaitacce, rashin daidaituwa, ɓacewa, ƙari, saƙo}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/lafiya' - rayuwa. Tsari: `{status: "ok", sigar, pubkey, kididdiga:{online, yarda, duka}}'.
controller.h1p4: `GET /v1/ madubai` — madubi controllers (DNS + IPFS + .albasa bambancin albasa).
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` - node liveness bincike. Ana amfani da nodes masu haɗin gwiwa don ci gaba da sabunta rajistarsu.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` - sabon kumburi ya shafi amana. Yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa sai dai idan 'AUTO_APPROVE=gaskiya'.
controller.h2p1: Bayanin fayil: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Ya ƙunshi kowane fayil BLAKE3 hash + sa hannun Ed25519.
controller.h2p2: Generation: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Yana karanta maɓallin saki daga 'maɓallai/release.key', bishiyar tafiya, ya rubuta bayyani.
controller.h2p3: Tabbatarwa: Mai sarrafawa yana karanta bayyanuwa a farawa kuma yana kwatanta da faifai. Farawa ya gaza da ƙarfi akan rashin daidaituwa.
controller.h3p1: Madubai suna gudanar da lambar sarrafawa iri ɗaya tare da maɓalli iri ɗaya da aka kwafi. Abokan ciniki suna ganin 'sa hannu_ta' iri ɗaya a cikin madubai - hanya ɗaya don gano madubin karya shine kwatanta maɓallan mashaya.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS suna buga alamomi zuwa ɗayan madubai da yawa. Abokan ciniki suna gwada tsarin fifiko tare da ƙarewar lokaci.
controller.h3p3: Littafin `vortex.sol-mirror/` a cikin wannan repo madubin trycloudflare na shirye-shiryen tafiya don haɓakawa.
controller.h1_a: Filayen jama'a API mai sarrafawa kusan hanyoyi goma sha biyu ne. Duk ƙanƙanta, duk sun mai da hankali kan shaida da shigarwa-URL ganowa.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/mutuma' - sa hannu bayyanun shaida. `/ v1/lafiya` — rayuwa + maɓalli + ƙididdiga. `/v1/shigarwa' - URLs shigarwa don haɗawa. `/ v1/ madubai` — masu kula da madubi. `/ v1/trusted_nodes` - takwarorinsu na tarayya. `/v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` - binciken node liveness. `/v1/rejista` - sabon kumburi ya shafi amincewa (amincin gudanarwa sai dai idan 'AUTO_APPROVE=gaskiya'). Shi ke nan - kunkuntar da gangan don kiyaye saman harin kadan.
controller.h1_c: An sanar da ƙirar kunkuntar saman ta hanyar lura cewa tsarin tabbatarwa ya zama manufa mafi girman ƙima da zarar abokan ciniki sun haɗa shi. Karamin lamba = ƙarami saman. Kwatanta da kumburin da ke da hanyoyi 120+; Mai sarrafa yana da 12. Makamantan tsarin: Debian's apt-get ya amince da ƙaramin tsari na 'Saki.gpg' daban da kunshin hosting.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` yana tafiya da itacen tushe, yana hashes kowane fayil, alamomi tare da maɓallin saki, ya rubuta `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Kayan aiki yana karanta `maɓallai/release.key` (32-byte Ed25519 maɓalli na sirri). Tafiya `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (ban da fayilolin gitignon). Ga kowane fayil: `blake3(abun ciki) → hash`. Yana gina bayyanuwa `{siffar, gina_at, fayiloli: [{hanya, sha256, size}]}`. Yana lissafta `canonical_bytes = CBOR(bayyanannu)`. Alamomi: `sig = Ed25519-Sign (maɓallin_sakewa, canonical_bytes)`. Ya rubuta `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {bayyana, sanya hannu: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Abubuwan da aka sanya hannu suna komawa zuwa Debian's Release.gpg (1997) da PGP-sa hannun Linux kwaya kwaya. Sigstore (2021) ya sabunta samfurin don tabbatar da sarkar samarwa. Sigar Vortex ta fi nauyi saboda tana tabbatar da aiki guda, ba sarkar sakin jam'iyyu ba. Za mu iya ɗaukar Sigstore a cikin v0.4 don fitowar jama'a.
controller.h3_a: Madubai suna gudanar da lambar sarrafawa iri ɗaya tare da maɓallin saki iri ɗaya. Matsaloli da yawa DNS / SNS / IPFS shigarwar suna nuni zuwa daya daga cikin madubai da yawa.
controller.h3_b: Masu aiki suna saita N madubai (yawanci 3-5). Kowanne yana gudanar da lambar `vortex_controller` iri ɗaya tare da 'maɓallai/maɓallin saki' iri ɗaya. Abokan ciniki suna ganin 'sa hannu_ta' iri ɗaya a cikin madubai - ingantaccen duba lafiyar jiki. DNS/SNS/IPFS lissafin lissafin madubai tare da fifiko. Abokan ciniki suna gwada tsarin fifiko, tare da ƙarewar lokaci na daƙiƙa 7 kowane ƙoƙari. Littafin `vortex.sol-mirror/` a cikin wannan repo misalin madubi ne na trycloudflare wanda aka riga aka yi amfani da shi.
controller.h3_c: Madubai da yawa tare da neman fifiko iri ɗaya ne SMTP ake amfani da su don rikodin MX da HTTPS amfani don rikodin SRV. Hukumomin adireshi na Tor samfuri ne mai alaƙa - 9 hardcoded DAs + kuri'u. Vortex ya zaɓi "zabi madubi da ke aiki" akan "ƙirƙirar kuri'a" saboda ƙirar da aka yi amfani da kuri'a sun fi ƙarfin ƙarfi amma suna da hankali ga takalma.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/mutunci: GET → sakamakon shaida
/v1/lafiya: GET → {status, version, pubkey, stats}
/v1/ shigarwar: GET → [{protocol, url}, ...]
/v1/ madubai: GET → [controller_url, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes: GET → [{pubkey, endpoint, health}, ...]
/v1/heartbeat/{pk}: POST (daga nodes masu rijista kawai)
/v1/yi rijista: POST (don sabbin nodes)
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: dnslink=/ipfs/<CID>
SNS rikodin vortexx.sol: {" madubai": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json ya kwafi.
zaɓin abokin ciniki: mai amsawa na farko cikin tsari mai fifiko, lokacin ƙarewar s 7

storage.title: Layer ajiya
storage.subtitle: SQLite don dev, Postgres don prod, Alembic don ƙaura, GRDB/Daki/IndexedDB akan abokan ciniki.
storage.intro: Ma'ajiyar kumburin kumburin Vortex shine SQL. Canja tsakanin SQLite (dev) da Postgres (samfurin) shine canjin DATABASE_URL - babu cokali mai yatsa.
storage.h1p1: `masu amfani (id, sunan mai amfani, kalmar sirri_hash, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key?, display_name, avatar_url, waya, imel, ƙirƙira_at, is_active)` - Tebur na ainihi.
storage.h1p2: `user_devices(id, user_id, device_id, user_agent, last_seen_at, revoked_at)` — jeren zaman kowane na'ura.
storage.h1p3: `rooms (id, type, name, is_private, is_channel, is_dm, member_count, avatar_url, created_at, created_by, description)` - tebur dakin, jere daya a daki.
storage.h1p4: `Mambobin_daki(ID_id, mai amfani_id, rawar, shiga_a, muted_har zuwa)` - zama memba + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `saƙonni (id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at_at, edited_at?, goge_a?, amsa_zuwa?, zaren_id?, iri)` - kowane saƙo, da aka yiwa alama akan `(room_id, id)`.
storage.h1p6: `maɓalli (saƙon_id, mai amfani_id, emoji, ƙirƙira_at)` - maɓalli na farko `(saƙon_id, mai amfani_id, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: `files(id, user_id, mime_type, size, sha256 /* ainihin BLAKE3 */, hanyar ajiya, uploaded_at)` - metadata fayil.
storage.h1p8: `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` — ma'anar karantawa na baya-bayan nan kowane mai amfani da ɗaki.
storage.h1p9: `kasancewar (mai amfani_id, na ƙarshe_ganin_a,_yana_buga_cikin_ɗaki_id?)` - ephemeral, Redis-supported in prod.
storage.h1p10: `Tarayya(maɓallin rubutu, ƙarshen ƙarshen, ƙimar lafiya, ƙarawa_a, ƙarawa_ta, soke_a)` - jerin tsara.
storage.h1p11: `Akwatin_fitarwa (id, target_node, loadload, yunƙurin, next_retry_at)` — layin fita.
storage.h1p12: 'saƙonnin_da aka tsara (id, room_id, rubutun rubutu, nonce, send_at, created_by, created_a, cancelled_a)`.
storage.h1p13: `lambobi (mai amfani_id, contact_user_id, laƙabi, ƙara_a)` - littafin adireshi.
storage.h1p14: `saved_gifs (user_id, url, nisa, tsawo, kara_a)` - kowane mai amfani GIF tarin.
storage.h1p15: 'folders(user_id, id, name, room_ids, is_system, created_at)' - manyan fayilolin taɗi.
storage.h1p16: `bot_installations(user_id, bot_id, install_at)` - kowane mai amfani da bot.
storage.h1p17: `Sessions (jti, user_id, device_id, expires_at)` — refresh token rejist.
storage.h1p18: 'push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at)' - rajistar turawa.
storage.h2p1: Alembic a cikin ''alembic/versions/'. Tarihin layin layi, bita guda ɗaya a kowane saki (wani lokaci kaɗan a kowane saki).
storage.h2p2: Yanayin Dev: `ƙirƙiri_duk + ALTER TABLE koma baya' don saurin haɓakawa.
storage.h2p3: Yanayin samfur: 'kafin haɓakawa na alembic' kafin farawa. Hoton Docker yana gudanar da shi a wurin shigarwa.
storage.h3p1: 'saƙonni(daki_id, id DESC)' - fihirisar farko don ɗauko fakitin.
storage.h3p2: `saƙonnin(daki_id, aika_a DESC)` - don oda na tushen lokaci akan gyara.
storage.h3p3: `masu amsa (saƙon_id)` - don tarawa a buɗe ɗakin.
storage.h3p4: `karanta_rasibit(daki_id, saƙon_id)` - don duban '' gani ta N'.
storage.h3p6: FTS tebur mai kama-da-wane (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) don binciken cikakken rubutu.
storage.h4p1: 'yi db-ajiyayyen' yana samar da ma'aunin tarihin lokaci. Rufewa tare da maɓallin aiki.
storage.h4p2: Riƙewa: kullum don kwanaki 14, mako-mako don makonni 4, kowane wata don watanni 12.
storage.h4p3: Maidowa: `yi db-restore FILE=<hanya>`. Yana gudana a kan matakin DB farko; ma'aikaci ya tabbatar sannan ya canza.
storage.h1_a: Adana node shine SQL. SQLite don dev da ƙananan masu karɓar kai; PostgreSQL don haɓaka ko samar da kumburi da yawa. Haka SQLAlchemy 2.x async code yana tafiyar da duka biyun.
storage.h1_b: Sanya ta hanyar `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` ko `postgresql+asyncpg://user:pw@host/db`. Saita guda ɗaya, babu cokali mai yatsu. SQLite yana gudana a cikin tsari; Postgres yana gudana daban. Aiki: SQLite yana ɗaukar ~50 masu amfani na lokaci ɗaya cikin kwanciyar hankali akan M1; Postgres ya kai dubunnan. Hijira Postgres → SQLite hanya ɗaya ce ta `pg_dump --data-kawai' + shigo da SQLite; sauran alkibla daya ce.
storage.h1_c: Tsarin "ɗaya ORM, baya biyu" shine aikin SQLAlchemy na shekaru goma. Vortex yana amfani da async 2.x API don haka kowace tambaya tana jira. Mun zaɓi SQLAlchemy Core akan Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` don mafi kyawun labarin ƙaura da wasa tare da karin magana na async na FastAPI.
storage.h2_a: 18 ainihin tebur: masu amfani, na'urorin mai amfani, dakuna, ɗakin_members, saƙonni, halayen, fayiloli, read_receipts, gaban, tarayya, federation_outbox, saƙon da aka tsara, lambobin sadarwa, adana_gifs, manyan fayiloli, bot_installations, zaman, tura_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: Teburin masu amfani shine tushen ainihi. room_members yana riƙe (ɗaki, mai amfani, rawar, join_at, muted_har zuwa). saƙonni suna ɗauke da sifar rubutu + metadata; da aka liƙa a kan (room_id, id) don ɗauko fakitin. martani shine tebur na farko-maɓalli. Duk abin da yake kai tsaye. Ajiye yana girma a layi tare da ƙididdigar saƙo - kusan 1 KB kowane saƙo akan faifai bayan fihirisar sama.
storage.h2_c: Tsarin ya tsaya tsayin daka bayan v0.0.4. Tun da farko muna da Tables na 'saƙonnin_dm' da 'saƙonnin_ƙungiyoyi'; haɗe cikin v0.0.3 bayan an kwafi lambar fanout a cikin duka biyun. Tebura 18 sune mafi ƙanƙanta don cikakkiyar manzo; manyan turawa suna ƙara tebur na nazari amma ba a buƙatar waɗannan don aiki.
storage.h3_a: Alembic yana kula da ƙaura. Tarihin bita na layi, bita guda ɗaya a kowace fitowar. Kowane bita yana da ayyukan 'haɓakawa()' da 'downgrade()' ayyuka.
storage.h3_b: 'alembic/versions/' suna riƙe da bita. Kowanne fayil ne Python tare da haɓakawa / raguwa. CI yana gudanar da `alambic upgrade head` + `alimbic downgrade -1` + `alimbic upgrade head` don tabbatar da tafiya zagaye. Ƙaddamarwa: 'yi db-migrate' yana aiwatar da shi a wurin shigarwar Docker kafin fara app. Yanayin Dev yana amfani da 'ƙirƙiri_duk + ALTER TABLE koma baya' don haka haɓakawa yana da sauri ba tare da buƙatar ƙaura akan kowane tushe ba.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) shine kayan aikin ƙaura na SQLAlchemy na canonical. Tarihin layin layi (ba reshe ba) zaɓi ne - yana guje wa "masu haɓakawa biyu suna ƙirƙirar lambar bita iri ɗaya". Hijira na Django suna amfani da wannan hanyar. Rails sun ƙaura daga layin layi zuwa lokutan da aka buga a cikin 2014 amma an sake ɗaukar layin layi tare da haɗin kai a cikin 2020.
storage.h4_a: Ana ɗaukar fihirisar maɓalli a hankali don haka zazzafan karantawa (saƙonni, amsawa, karanta rasit) suna buga diski da wuya.
storage.h4_b: `sakonnin(daki_id, id DESC)` - fihirisar faginin farko. `sakonnin(daki_id, aika_a DESC)` --lokaci-lokaci-oda faduwa don gyarawa. `masu amsa (saƙon_id)` - tarawa a buɗe ɗakin. `karanta_rasipt(daki_id, saƙon_id)` - "gani ta N" ƙidaya. `mai amfani_na'urorin(user_id)` - jerin na'ura. FTS tebur mai kama-da-wane don bincike (FTS5 akan SQLite, tsvector akan Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Zaɓuɓɓukan fihirisa sun fito ne daga bayanin-tsari-tsari yayin gwajin kaya v0.0.4. Mun fara da fihirisar butulci kuma mun ƙara/cire bisa la'akari da alamun tambaya. 'saƙonnin (daki_id, id DESC)' shine ma'aunin mafi zafi guda ɗaya - kusan kashi 80 na karantawa sun same shi. Tsayawa ta kunkuntar (ba a haɗa da ginshiƙai) yana ba shi damar dacewa da ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya.

bots.title: Bot tsarin
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + kasuwa + antispam.
bots.intro: Bots mahalartan ajin farko ne. An sanya hannu kan saƙon tare da maɓallin bot na Ed25519 don haka ana iya gano jabun.
bots.h1p1: Zaɓuɓɓuka biyu: Python SDK ko Gravitix DSL. Python shine don hadaddun ayyukan aiki; Gravitix don bots ɗin taɗi na taron da ke buƙatar jigilar kaya da sauri.
bots.h1p2:
Python misali: `daga vortex_bot shigo da Bot
bot = Bot(alama=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo(msg): jira bot.send(msg.room_id, msg.text)
bot.run()`. SDK yana sarrafa WebSocket, sake haɗawa, musayar maɓallin ɓoyewa.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix misali: `kan / farawa {emit "Sannu, {ctx.first_name}!" }'. Yana haɗa zuwa bytecode kuma yana aiki a cikin mai fassarar yashi.
bots.h1p4: Ana fitar da alamar Bot a ƙirƙirar bot. Alamar bata? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` ya fitar da wata sabuwa.
bots.h2p1: Samfuran turawa guda biyu: in-process (corotine a cikin kumburi) da na waje (bot zaben `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: A cikin tsari: sifili na cibiyar sadarwa, mafi sauri, amma mai aiki dole ne ya amince da lambar bot. Good don bots na kansa.
bots.h2p3: Na waje: webhook ko dogon zabe. Ba a buƙatar amanar matakin kumburi. Good don bots na ɓangare na uku da kasuwa.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots koyaushe suna aiki cikin tsari a cikin akwatin yashi - ba su da tsarin fayil ko hanyar hanyar sadarwa sai fayyace API.
bots.h3p1: Bots na jama'a na iya mika wuya ga kasuwa. Masu dubawa sun tabbatar da lambar ba ta yin phish, ba sa lalata, ba ta fitar da bayanan mai amfani ba.
bots.h3p2: Categories: yawan aiki, wasanni, labarai, kayan aiki, ai, fassara.
bots.h3p3: Shigar: dannawa ɗaya. Node yana biyan mai amfani zuwa sunan mai amfani na bot don haka DMs suna hanya daidai.
bots.h3p4: Kudi: kyauta, siyan lokaci ɗaya, biyan kuɗi. Kuɗin dandamali 10% na jimlar.
bots.h4p1: Ana kula da kowane ɗaki ta hanyar bot ɗin da ba a iya gani ba. Dubawa: yawan haɗin haɗin gwiwa> 3 a cikin minti ɗaya, rabon babban haruffa> 70 %% don chars 10+, maimaita saƙonni, fashewar sabbin masu shiga asusun kwatsam.
bots.h4p2: Ayyuka: gargadi → ƙarewar lokaci (minti 5) → shura → ban. Kiran zuwa daki admin.
bots.h4p3: Ana iya kunna kowane ɗaki ta hanyar saitin bot.
bots.h1_a: Bots mahalartan ajin farko ne. Kowane yana da maɓallin Ed25519 da alama; duk saƙon da suka aika ana sa hannu ne, don haka ana iya gano jabu.
bots.h1_b: Ƙirƙiri: POST masu mallaka `/api/bots` tare da `{username, display_name, code}`. Node yana ƙirƙirar jere 'masu amfani' tare da `is_bot=gaskiya', yana haifar da maɓalli na Ed25519, yana mayar da alamar bot ɗin maɓalli na sirri ga mai shi (an nuna sau ɗaya). Gudu: bot ko dai yana rayuwa a cikin tsari azaman corutine ko kuri'a na waje `/api/bots/{id}/updates' tare da alamar sa. Saƙonni daga bots suna ɗauke da tutar 'daga_bot: gaskiya' kuma an sanya hannu tare da maɓallin keɓaɓɓen bot.
bots.h1_c: Bot APIs Slack ne ya yi majagaba (2014) kuma an daidaita su ta Telegram (2015). Juyawar Vortex: sa hannun bot suna ɗaure saƙonni zuwa ainihin bot, don haka kullin da aka daidaita ba zai iya ƙirƙira ba "@bot said X". Tallafin bot na Matrix ya kara wannan kadarorin a cikin 2021 ta hanyar sa hannun tarayya; Vortex yana da shi tun v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix yare ne na musamman na yanki don rubuta bots ɗin da ke gudana. Karamin, bayyananne, wanda aka harhada zuwa bytecode mai yashi.
bots.h2_b: Syntax: `on /fara {fitar da "Sannu, {ctx.first_name}!" }'. Masu sa ido suna ɗaure ga abubuwan faɗakarwa (umurni, regex, taron). Jiki jerin 'emit', 'bari', 'if', 'schedule', da sauransu. Compiler yana fitar da bytecode; lokacin gudu yana fassarawa a cikin akwatin yashi ba tare da tsarin fayil ba, babu hanyar sadarwa ta sabani, kawai Vortex's API. Cikakken bayani a cikin babin docs Gravitix.
bots.h2_c: An tsara Gravitix yayin v0.0.6 bayan lura da cewa mafi yawan bot code shine 80 % tukunyar jirgi don wayar da Vortex SDK, tare da kwaya na ainihin dabaru a tsakiya. A DSL yana ƙyale hikimar ta haskaka kuma tana hana yin shebur na sabani Python cikin yanayin bot-dev inda akwai yuwuwar tserewa akwatin yashi.
bots.h3_a: Kowane ɗaki yana da bot ɗin antispam mara ganuwa wanda ke kallon ambaliya, haɗin spam, maimaita saƙonnin, da sabon-asusun shiga fashe.
bots.h3_b: Dokokin: yawan haɗin haɗin gwiwa> 3 a cikin minti ɗaya daga mai amfani ɗaya, ALL-CAPS rabo> 70 % akan saƙonni ≥ 10 chars, maimaita saƙon> sau 3 a cikin 30s, fashe masu haɗin gwiwa tare da shekarun asusun <24h> 20 a cikin 60 s. Ayyuka suna ƙaruwa: faɗakarwa → ƙarewar minti 5 → bugun sa'a 1 → ban (amincin admin don ban). Ana iya kunna kowane ɗaki ta hanyar ''/antispam config'.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics sun fito ne daga haɓakar ƙa'idodin bot IRC-zamanin bot (Eggdrop, BitchX) da tsarin zamani kamar Discord AutoMod. Takaitattun madaidaitan ƙofofin a cikin Vortex an daidaita su akan tsarin beta na wata 6 na saƙonnin 200k; Adadin karya-tabbatacce shine ~0.3 % a kowace adadin ban-kara da aka lura.
bots.h4_a: Bots na jama'a suna mika wuya ga kasuwa. Masu bita sun tabbatar da cewa babu phishing / babu spam / babu leaks bayanai. Masu amfani suna lilo ta nau'i kuma su shigar da dannawa ɗaya.
bots.h4_b: Ƙaddamarwa: mai shi yana aika tushen bot + bayanin. Mai bita yana gudanar da lambar a cikin akwatin yashi, yana karanta ta don sanannun ƙirar ƙira, bincika duk wani kiran cibiyar sadarwa da ke wucewa ta APIs da aka yarda, yana tabbatar da manufofin keɓantawa. Lissafi: nau'i, farashi, ƙididdiga, ƙidayar shigarwa. Shigar: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` - kumburi yana haifar da biyan kuɗin kowane mai amfani. Samun kuɗi: kyauta / lokaci ɗaya / biyan kuɗi; dandamali yana ɗaukar 10%.
bots.h4_c: Kasuwancin App yana komawa zuwa 2008 App Store. Slack App Directory (2015), Discord Bot Lists (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Yanke kashi 10% na Vortex ya yi ƙasa da na Apple's 30 % kuma kaɗan kaɗan fiye da na Shopify's 20 %, wanda aka zaɓa don ƙarfafa masu haɓakawa don bugawa. An tsara manufar bita akan GitLab's "bita ta tsohuwa, zazzage kan ƙararraki".
bots.h3_f:
abubuwan jawo:
  link_density> 3/min → gargadi
  all_caps_ratio> 0.7 (≥10c) → gargadi
  repeat_count> 3 a cikin 30s → gargadi
  new_joiner_burst > 20 a cikin 60s → kulle daki

haɓakawa:
  Gargadi 2 → Minti 5 ya ƙare
  3 gargadi → 1 h harbi
  4 gargadi → ban (admin ya amince)
bots.h4_f:
Categories: yawan aiki, wasanni, labarai, abubuwan amfani, ai, fassara
farashin: kyauta | lokaci daya (USD adadin) | biyan kuɗi (USD/wata)
yanke: 90% ga mai haɓakawa, 10% zuwa Vortex
bita: manual, ~ 3 kwanakin kasuwanci manufa juyawa

ops.title: Ayyuka
ops.subtitle: Sanya, saka idanu, sake dawowa.
ops.intro: Kowane ɗawainiya yana da manufa 'make' ko umarni CLI. Shafukan Ops suna zaune a cikin 'aikin/'.
ops.h1p1: 'docker compose up' yana kawo kumburi, mai sarrafawa, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Juzu'i: `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs`. Dutsen zuwa masauki don dagewa.
ops.h1p3: Muhalli: `.env' a cikin tushen repo. Kar a taba aikatawa. `.env.example' shine samfurin.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-fetches Let's Encrypt certs. Ana amfani da iyakacin ƙima Let's Encrypt - yi amfani da tsari don gwaje-gwaje.
ops.h2p1: `yi install` — shigar Python deps + dev tools.
ops.h2p2: 'make dev' - uvicorn tare da sake kunnawa akan tashar jiragen ruwa 9000.
ops.h2p3: 'yi gwaji' - pytest + ɗaukar hoto; yana samar da 'shafi.xml'.
ops.h2p4: 'sanya lint' - ruff + mypy. CI toshe kan gazawa.
ops.h2p8: `make ci` — gudanar da cikakken CI bututun gida.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` kunshin PyInstaller ne tare da pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Gudun gudu na farko: zaɓi sunan kumburi → samar da maɓallan saki → saita TLS (Let's Encrypt / kawo naku / mai sanya hannu) → zaɓi URLs shigarwa → ba da damar stealth → buɗe tashoshin wuta ta wuta.
ops.h3p3: Bayan saitin, maye yana zama azaman na'ura wasan bidiyo na mai gudanarwa: farawa/tsayawa kumburi, duba rajistan ayyukan, maɓallan juya, ƙara abokan haɗin gwiwa.
ops.h4p1: Kowane sakin da aka yiwa alama a git. Hakanan an sanya hannu tare da maɓallin saki don tabbatar da alamar da kanta.
ops.h4p2: Juyawa: `git Checkout <tag> && sanya docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Gudun nodes suna matsewa kuma sake farawa.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` yana goyan bayan ƙaramin sigar baya ɗaya. Gaba baya yana buƙatar sa hannun hannu.
ops.h1_a: 'docker compose up' yana kawo cikakken Vortex tari: kumburi, mai sarrafawa, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: 'docker-compose.yml' a tushen repo. Ƙididdigar `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` da aka ɗora don ɗaukar nauyi don haka bayanai sun ci gaba da kasancewa a cikin sake farawa. Kiwon lafiya: kumburi lafiya idan `/lafiya/shirye' ya dawo 200; mai sarrafawa iff `/v1/mutunci` ya dawo tabbatarwa. Caddy auto-fetches Let's Encrypt certs. `.env` yana ba da sirrin sirri (kada ku taɓa aikatawa). `.env.example' shine samfurin.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose shine tsarin de-facto don ayyuka masu ɗaukar nauyin kwantena da yawa. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux duk suna amfani da shi. An ƙirƙira fayil ɗin rubutun Vortex daga v0.0.2 zuwa gaba; Siffar ta yanzu ta daidaita cikin v0.0.5. Madadin (k8s, nomad) an bar su azaman motsa jiki don manyan masu aiki.
ops.h2_a: Makefile shine wurin shigarwa na tsakiya don kowane aikin dev da ops. 'yi taimako' jerin maƙasudai.
ops.h2_b: `yi install` → `pip install -r bukatun.txt`. `yi dev` → uvicorn tare da sake kunnawa. `yi gwaji` → pytest + ɗaukar hoto, fitar da `coverage.xml`. `yi lint` → ruff + mypy. `yi docker-build` → `docker build -t vortex:$VERSION`. `sa db-migrate` → `alimbic upgrade head`. `yi db-backup' / `yi db-restore FILE=...`. `make ci` → cika CI bututun gida.
ops.h2_c: Makefile azaman wurin shigarwar canonical shine aikin Unix na shekaru da yawa, wanda kowane babban aikin Python ya karɓa (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Madadin kayan aikin (Poetry, Hatch, uv) dandano na-shekara ne; Make ne m da kuma duniya.
ops.h3_a: Mayen saitin shine gunkin PyInstaller (`Vortex Wizard.app`) tare da pywebview GUI wanda ke tafiya da mai aiki na farko ta hanyar turawa.
ops.h3_b: Gudun gudu na farko: zaɓi sunan kumburi → samar da maɓallin saki (Ed25519 maɓalli da aka ajiye zuwa `maɓallai/release.key`) → daidaitawa TLS (Let's Encrypt / kawo-naka / mai sanya hannu) → zaɓi URLs shigarwa (vortexx.sol / yanki na al'ada / .onth bude tashar wuta) → (iptables/ufw/pf). Bayan farawa na farko, maye yana zama azaman na'ura mai ba da hanya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa: farawa/tsayawa kumburi, duba rajistan ayyukan, maɓallan juyawa, ƙara abokan haɗin gwiwa.
ops.h3_c: Saita wizards su ne tsarin kayan aikin da za su iya ɗaukar nauyin kansu waɗanda ke yin niyya ga masu amfani da ba na sysadmin: Ghost's onboarding (2015), Saitin uwar garken Madaidaicin Bayanan kula, tambayoyin shigarwa na Mastodon. PyInstaller yana ba mu damar jigilar nau'ikan binary guda biyu mai iya dannawa; pywebview yana sanya shafi na HTML na gida wanda mai sarrafa FastAPI ya yi aiki API akan 127.0.0.1 — browser UX ba tare da sarkar gina ɗan ƙasa GUI ba.
ops.h4_a: Kowane sakin ana yiwa alama a git. Rollback shine 'git checkout <tag> && sanya docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Hijira suna da ayyuka na 'downgrade()'.
ops.h4_b: An sanya hannu tare da maɓallin saki don haka alamar da kanta ta kasance tabbatacce. Hanyar sake dawowa: duba tsohon tag, sake gina hoto, sake ƙirƙirar kwantena - hanyoyin haɗin kai suna zubowa a kan SIGTERM (kyauta ta 15 s). DB: `alimbic downgrade <rev>` yana mayar da bita guda ɗaya. Nisantar asarar bayanai: ba mu taɓa sauke ginshiƙai a cikin saki ɗaya ba; sauke yana faruwa N+1 bayan lambar ta daina karanta su.
ops.h4_c: Tsarin ƙaura na "lad-sai-code" (faɗaɗɗen ƙaura-kwangilar) daidaitaccen lokacin ƙaddamar da sifili ne. Jagoran ƙaura na Stripe (2019) ya bayyana shi mafi kyau. Vortex an ɗauke ta bayan wani lamari a cikin v0.0.3 inda ɗigon ginshiƙi ya tilasta taga gyara na mintuna 30.

  kumburi: hoto: vortex: sabon tashar jiragen ruwa: [9000:9000]
  mai sarrafawa: hoto: vortex-controller ports: [8800:8800]
  postgres: hoto: postgres: juzu'ai 16: [./data/pg:/var/lib/postgresql/data]

  caddy: hoto: tashar jiragen ruwa: [80:80, 443:443]
ops.h2_f:
sanya pip install -r bukatun.txt
yi dev uvicorn --sake saukewa
yi gwajin pytest + ɗaukar hoto
yi lint ruff + mypy
yi docker-build docker build-t vortex:$VERSION
yi db-migrate alembic haɓaka shugaban
yi ci lint + test + migrate check

  → ya ƙaddamar da taga pywebview (na gida HTML)
  → yayi magana da mai sarrafa FastAPI akan 127.0.0.1: tashar jiragen ruwa bazuwar

kwarara kwarara:

  2. ƙaura: sabon lambar ya rubuta "v2"; tsohon har yanzu yana karanta "v1"

  5. ƙaura: sauke shafi "v1".

mobile.title: Abokan ciniki ta hannu
mobile.subtitle: IOS da Android - na asali UI, yarjejeniya iri ɗaya.
mobile.intro: Dukansu abokan cinikin wayar hannu cikakkun takwarori ne, ba sirara masu rubutun yanar gizo ba. Siffar ɗan ƙasa, aikin ɗan ƙasa, haɗin kai na asali (CallKit, Sabis na Haɗin kai, widgets na allo).
mobile.h1p1: Kunshin Swift a cikin 'ios/Modules/'. 30+ fasali, kowane SOLID-raga 'api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: Manufar app a cikin 'ios/VortexApp/'. XcodeGen spec a `ios/project.yml` yana sabunta xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Crypto: CryptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Duk maye gurbi yana tafiya ta hanyar `db.write'.
mobile.h1p6: Tura: APNs ta hanyar 'UNUserNotificationCenter' + Tsawaita Sabis na Fadakarwa don yankewa.
mobile.h2p1: Aikin Gradle a cikin 'android/'. 22 fasalulluka masu fasali tare da Hilt DI, tsaga `api / impl / di / ui` iri ɗaya.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Daki mai FTS4 abubuwan motsa jiki.
mobile.h2p6: Tura: FCM + Yanke Sabis na FirebaseMessaging.
mobile.h3p1: Kundin yanki guda 146 tare da sunaye na asali (`Русский ru`, `Ingilishi en`, `中文 zh`, …).
mobile.h3p2: Katalojin-emoji iri ɗaya guda 1500 tare da nau'ikan nau'ikan 9 + sautunan fata + MRU + bincike.
mobile.h3p3: Asusu daya-daya X25519 kalubale-amsa don canzawa.
mobile.h3p4: Fayilolin hira iri ɗaya (Duk / Ajiye / al'ada) tare da sake yin odar ja-da-jigon.
mobile.h3p5: Jerin abubuwan da aka adana iri ɗaya-GIFs (babu Tenor - tarin sirri kawai).
mobile.h3p6: Saƙonnin da aka tsara iri ɗaya UI, allon lambobin sadarwa, shafi mai ƙima.
mobile.h1_a: Abokin ciniki na iOS shine Kunshin Swift tare da nau'ikan fasali 30+. Daidai HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC yarjejeniya kamar kowane abokin ciniki.
mobile.h1_b: Modules da aka tsara ta hanyar fasali: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Fayles`, `Kira`, `Tura`, `Emoji`, `Folders`, `Accounts`, `AjiyeGifs`, `Lambobi`, `Tsarin`,`Premium`, `Reactions`, …. Kowannensu ya rabu zuwa 'api/' (protocols), `impl/` (darussan kankara), `ui/` (Ra'ayoyin SwiftUI). Crypto: CryptoKit don X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift don Argon2id. DB: GRDB tare da FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFramework. Tura: APNs tare da Tsawaita Sabis na Sanarwa don ɓarna-buge-buge.
mobile.h1_c: Fakitin Modular sune daidaitaccen aikin Swift tun daga Manajan Package Swift 5.0 (2019). Rarraba mu zuwa api/impl/ui shine SOLID-ish: juyewar dogaro (modules sun dogara da api/ kawai), rabuwar damuwa, iya gwadawa (swap impl don gwaje-gwaje). Ƙididdigar ƙirar 30+ zaɓi ne don gina daidaito - kowane nau'i yana tattarawa a keɓe.
mobile.h2_a: Android abokin ciniki madubi iOS: Kotlin + Compose + Hilt DI. 22 fasali modules, iri ɗaya `api / impl / di` tsaga.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), targetSdk 34 (Android 14). Crypto: Tsaro na AndroidX + Tink don AES-GCM; argon2-jvm don Argon2id. DB: Daki mai FTS4 abubuwan motsa jiki. WebRTC: Stream WebRTC Android. Tura: FCM ta hanyar FirebaseMessagingService + rufaffen ambulaf da aka rufe. Gradle Multi-module, Hilt yana haɗa nau'ikan fasali ba tare da dogaro kai tsaye ba.
mobile.h2_c: Compose is Google's declarative UI Toolkit, barga tun 2021. Hilt (2020) is the Google-andorsed DI tsarin a saman Dagger 2. Tare suka dace SwiftUI + dukiya wrappers a kan iOS ga wani kusa-m. Vortex da aka karɓa Rubutu/Hilt daga v0.0.4 zuwa gaba; A baya Android ta dogara ne akan View.
mobile.h3_a: Dukansu iOS da Android suna haɗa nau'ikan yanki guda 146 JSON saiti tare da sunaye na asali da kasida 1500-emoji - mai amfani yana rubuta 🥹 akan iOS 17 yana fassara 🥹 akan Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Sources/I18N/Resources/Locales/*.json` madubin `android/app/src/main/kadara/locales/*.json`. Duk aikace-aikacen biyu suna ɗaukar wurin da ya dace a ƙaddamar da farko (allon zaɓin harshe) kuma sun dage zaɓi. Kas ɗin emoji rukuni ne na 9 JSON da aka aika a cikin duka biyun; yana gefe OS-matakin emoji-saitin rarrabuwar kawuna wanda in ba haka ba yana haifar da '?' glyphs akan tsofaffin OSes.
mobile.h3_c: Shipping your own emoji catalog is the pattern Telegram amfani (yasu yatsa na Twemoji) da WhatsApp da ake amfani da su har zuwa 2022. Ciniki: ~ 300 KB karin kowane app budle don emoji + ~ 1.2 MB ga gida. Cancantar shi don daidaiton dandamali.
