webclient.title: Abokin yanar gizo
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, yanayin layi, ma'aikacin sabis.
webclient.intro: Abokin yanar gizo shine vanilla-JS PWA. Babu React, babu mai haɗawa da ya wuce ESM. ~ 400 KB jimlar gzipped, gami da yankuna 146.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` shine shigarwar. Fasalolin kayan aikin kasala-ƙalla akan amfani da farko.
webclient.h1p2: Jiha: maɓallan zobe na kowane ɗaki a cikin IndexedDB, ɓoyayyiyar ɓoyayyiyar ma'ajiyar ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya. Ma'aikacin Sabis yana sasantawa.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Tasirin Gilashin Ruwa ta hanyar CSS tacewar baya. Babu tsari; Wakilan taron + masu ƙarfi masu ba da taimako.
webclient.h2p1: Duk wani rubutu da aka yi yayin layin layi zuwa IndexedDB. SW yana yin ruwa idan haɗin ya dawo.
webclient.h2p2: Maɓallin rashin ƙarfi akan kowane POST yana ba da damar sake maimaitawa suyi nasara cikin aminci.
webclient.h2p3: Karatu yana aiki cikakke a layi - duk rubutun da aka daidaita yana rayuwa a cikin IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: Yankuna 146 a cikin 'tsaye/wuri/*.json'. Allon maraba (`lang-picker.js`) yana zagayawa ta hanyar alamun sunan asali.
webclient.h3p2: Canjin wurin aiki na lokaci: `document.documentElement.lang = code` + sake yin lakabi ta hanyar halayen 'data-i18n'.
webclient.h1_a: Abokin yanar gizo shine vanilla-JS PWA. Babu React, babu wani matakin ginawa da ya wuce ESM haɗawa. Jimlar JS jigilar: ~ 400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `Templates/base.html` shine harsashi da Jinja2 ya yi. `static/js/main.js` shine shigarwar ES-module. Siffofin fasalulluka a cikin `static/js/<fasalin>/` lazy-load akan amfani da farko. CSS a cikin `static/css/` tare da al'ada 1-fayil-kowace-bangaren. Ma'aikacin Sabis yana ɗaukar cache; nauyin farko yana daga hanyar sadarwa, daga baya daga cache; sabunta bincike akan kewayawa.
webclient.h1_c: Tsayawa daga tsarin tsarin yanke shawara ne na v0.0.1 da gangan bayan ƙaddamar da React da Vue PWAs a ~1.5 MB gzipped tare da fasali iri ɗaya. Vanilla JS + ES kayayyaki yana ba mu ~ 400 KB. Kasuwancin ya fi DOM-manipulation boilerplate, wanda muke ragewa tare da ƙananan mataimaka a cikin `static/js/lib/dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Yanayin layi: mai fita yana rubuta jerin gwano zuwa IndexedDB; Ma'aikacin Sabis yana jan ruwa lokacin da haɗin ya dawo.
webclient.h2_b: Duk wani POST / PATCH mai amfani da layi yana samun maɓalli mai ƙarfi kuma ya sauka a cikin 'akwatin fitarwa' (IndexedDB). Ma'aikacin Sabis yana sauraron taron 'kan layi' kuma ya sake yin rubutu tare da maɓalli mai ƙarfi a matsayin kai. Uwar garken yana gane kwafi ta maɓalli na idempotency kuma ya dawo da martani na asali. Karatu yana aiki gabaɗaya a layi - duk rubutun da aka daidaita yana zaune a cikin IndexedDB kuma yana yanke bayanan gida tare da maɓallan ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya.
webclient.h2_c: Maɓallan rashin ƙarfi don POST masu sake gwadawa sune babban taron Stripe's 2017, wanda yawancin APIs na zamani suka karɓa. IndexedDB azaman akwatin waje shine tsarin Google Drive yanar gizo yana amfani da gyare-gyaren layi. Aiwatar da Vortex shine layin ~200 a cikin `static/js/lib/outbox.js`.
webclient.h3_a: Harshe 146 a `a tsaye/wuri/*.json`. Maraba da sake zagayowar allo ta hanyar alamomin sunan asali (`Выберите языk` / `Zaɓi yarenka` / `选择语言` / …).
webclient.h3_b: Ƙaddamarwa ta farko: `lang-picker.js' yana nuna alamar rubutu mai motsi wanda ke juyawa ta cikin wurare 97 a 45 ms/char, dakatar da 1.8 s, sharewa a 30 ms/char, ci gaba. Mai amfani ya zaɓi harshe; nace a cikin `localStorage.vortex_lang`. Kowane gudu na gaba yana karanta zaɓin da aka ajiye. Canjin lokacin aiki: `setLang(code)` yana loda JSON, yana sake fasalin abubuwan 'data-i18n'.
webclient.h3_c: Alamar rubutu-alamar rubutu girmamawa ce ga tsofaffin filayen fantsama kuma an karbe shi don UX ɗumi bayan v0.0.6 beta ya nuna masu amfani sun yi watsi da zazzagewa tsaye. Alamun hawan keke yana ba da taga na daƙiƙa 1 ga kowane mai amfani don ganin sunan harshensu kuma ya gane shi nan take.
webclient.h1_f:
harsashi: templates/base.html (jinja2 mai sabar uwar garke)
shigarwa: static/js/main.js (ES module)
fasali: static/js/{chat,rooms,auth,kira,files,bots}/...
SW: static/service-worker.js
size: ~ 400 KB gzipped duka
webclient.h2_f:
Rubutun hanyar layi:
  1. lissafta idempotency_key = rand (16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put ({url, hanya, jiki, idempotency_key, ts})
  3. a kan 'online': akwatin fitarwa
     ga kowane jere: debo (url, {hanyar, jiki, kawuna: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: cire layi
       → 4xx: juzu'i (raƙuwa na dindindin)
       → 5xx/offline: sake gwadawa daga baya
webclient.h3_f:
lang- picker.js:
  alamu = ["Выберите языk", "Zaɓi harshenku", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  rubuta alamar a 45 ms/char → dakata 1.8 s → share a 30 ms/char → dakata 0.2 s → gaba

canza lokacin aiki:
  localStorage.vortex_lang = lamba
  debo ('yankuna/' + lambar + '.json') → shafi abubuwan da suka shafi bayanai-i18n

security.title: Matsayin tsaro
security.subtitle: Samfurin barazanar, zurfin tsaro, WAF, hanyar duba, canary.
security.intro: Vortex yana amfani da zurfin tsaro: karya Layer ɗaya bai isa ba, maharin gaske yana buƙatar nasara masu zaman kansu da yawa.
security.h1p1: **Mai duba hanyar sadarwa mai wucewa**: yana ganin fakiti TLS; yayi nazarin girman/lokaci. An ci nasara da Level 1 stealth.
security.h1p2: **Mai kai harin cibiyar sadarwa mai aiki**: zai iya saukewa/jinkiri/ allura. An ci nasara ta hanyar Level 2-4.
security.h1p3: **Ma'aikacin node da aka yi la'akari da shi ***: yana ganin rubutun + metadata. Abubuwan da ke cikin saƙon sun kasance sirri.
security.h1p4: **Na'urar abokin ciniki da aka sace**: bayyanar saƙon da suka gabata. Ƙayyadaddun Ratchet sau biyu zuwa zaman yanzu; goge-on-gaba-buɗe akwai.
security.h1p5: ** Adadin abokan gaba tare da adana ababen hawa da suka gabata ***: ya ci nasara ta hanyar maɓallan zaman Kyber-768 lokacin da takwarorinsu biyu suka tallata PQ.
security.h2p1: Nemi inspector: SQLi alamu, tafarki hanya, samfur allura, LFI, NoSQLi. Sauke kafin lambar app.
security.h2p2: Ƙimar ƙimar: duniya mai laushi 1000 req/s tare da fashe; kowace hanya (shiga 10 / min, rajista 5 / min); kowane mai amfani 100 req/s bayan auth.
security.h3p1: Abubuwan da suka dace da tsaro (aikin gudanarwa, canjin tarayya, haɓaka saki, gogewar firgici) hash-chained ta hanyar `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Karyewar sarkar ⇒ an gano lalata. Jijjiga wuta.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` yana fallasa log ɗin (auth admin kawai). Append-kawai.
security.h4p1: Fayil na Canary ya sanya hannu kullun tare da maɓallin saki. Rashin rashi ⇒ sulhu da ake zargi.
security.h4p2: Sokewar gaggawa: mai gudanarwa yana watsa `{nau'in:"n", taron:"compromise", ...}' ga kowane WebSocket. Abokan ciniki suna goge maɓallan da aka adana.
security.h4p3: Juyawa: sabon maɓallin saki, sake sa hannu a bayyane, sake bugawa. Abokan ciniki sun sake yin bootstrap.
security.h1_a: Azuzuwan abokan gaba guda hudu suna tafiyar da ƙira: mai sa ido, mai kai hari, mai saɓani, na'urar da ba ta dace ba. Kowanne ya ci nasara da wani Layer daban-daban.
security.h1_b: Mai sa ido: yana ganin fakitin TLS rufaffen, yana nazarin zirga-zirga. An ci nasara ta hanyar Level 1-2. Mai kai hari mai aiki: na iya sauke/jinkiri/ allurar fakiti. An ci nasara ta hanyar Level 3-4. Mai aiki da ba daidai ba: yana ganin ciphertext + metadata. An ci nasara ta hanyar E2E crypto + rage girman metadata. Na'urar da aka lalata: yana ganin saƙon da suka gabata. Lalacewar da ke tattare da sirrin gaba (Double Ratchet) da goge firgici.
security.h1_c: Samfurin aji hudu ya fito ne daga tsarin harajin barazanar "Aikace-aikacen Cryptography" na Schneier na 1999, wanda aka tsawaita tare da abubuwan lura bayan Snowden game da masu sa ido na matakin jiha. Kowane tsari na zamani amintaccen manzo yana kawo wani abu makamancinsa. Juyawar Vortex tana ƙara aji na biyar don taswirar hanya v0.4: maƙiyi mai ƙididdigewa tare da adana ababen hawa na baya, wanda Kyber ke sarrafa.
security.h2_a: WAF yana bincika kowane buƙatu kafin ya isa lambar app, yana ƙin SQL-i, traversal traversal, template injection, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middware.py:: WAFMiddleware` yana gudanar da binciken ~50 na regex akan URL, tambaya, da jiki. Siffofin ƙeta da aka sani (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Ƙimar iyaka: duniya mai laushi 1000 req/s mai laushi tare da fashe haƙuri; kowace hanya `/login` 10/min, `/yi rijista` 5/min; kowane mai amfani 100 req/s bayan auth. Zaɓin toshe ƙasa ta hanyar `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` don biyan buƙatun takunkumi ga ma'aikatan da suka dace.
security.h2_c: WAFs a matsayin matsakaiciyar ƙirar ƙira ce - mod_security (2002), Cloudflare's WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex's yayi kadan da gangan saboda nauyi WAF yana haifar da abubuwan karya da ke nutsar da barazanar gaske. An tattara jerin sunayen regex daga OWASP Manyan sa hannu guda 10 kuma an tace su a v0.0.5 bayan dokar beta WAF ta toshe madaidaicin kirtani "DROP TABLE" a cikin sakon taɗi game da SQL.
security.h3_a: Abubuwan da suka dace da tsaro sun sauka a cikin kundin bincike mai sarkar zanta. Karye a cikin sarkar yana nuna tambari.
security.h3_b: Kowane aikin gudanarwa, canjin tarayya, haɓaka haɓakawa, ko goge firgita ana saka shi cikin `audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, details_cbor)`. Kowace jere tana ɗauke da `prev_hash = zanta(prev_row)`. Ana lissafta zaton layin na yanzu akan `ts ∥ taron ∥ prev_hash`. Idan kowane layi ya share ko aka canza, layuka masu zuwa ''prev_hash` suna karya sarkar - ana iya gano su ta hanyar sake kunna sarkar.
security.h3_c: Hash-chained log log tsoho ne (lokacin da aka danganta hash, 1991). Linux auditd yana amfani da su. Git's DAG shine ainihin tsari iri ɗaya ne. Vortex ƙara su a cikin v0.0.6 bayan mai ba da shawara ya nuna cewa kumburin da ya lalace zai iya goge layuka na gungu a shiru.
security.h4_a: An riga an shirya martanin abin da ya faru: canary ya tabbatar da maɓallin sakin ba shi da matsala; soke gaggawar yana goge maɓallan da aka adana a duk abokan ciniki.
security.h4_b: Daily `canary.txt` sanya hannu da maɓallin saki, wanda aka buga tare da mai sarrafawa. Abokan ciniki ba bisa zaɓi ba suna tabbatarwa akan farawa - rashi ⇒ yin sulhu da ake zargi. Idan an tabbatar da sulhu: mai gudanarwa yana watsa `{type:"n", event:"compromise", dalili}' akan kowane WebSocket. Abokan ciniki suna goge maɓallan da aka adana, tilasta sake shiga. Sabuwar maɓalli na saki da aka haƙa, an sake sa hannu a bayyane, abokan ciniki sun sake yin bootstrap daga madaidaicin madubi. Tsohuwar sifar rubutu da ƙira ba ta iya karantawa.
security.h4_c: Fayilolin Canary suna bin diddigin Apple's 2013 garantin canary da aikin 'canarywatch.org'. Sigina yana amfani da su. Vortex's yana sarrafa kansa: alamar cron 'canary.txt' tare da maɓallin saki kowane sa'o'i 24. Watsa shirye-shiryen sokewar gaggawa iri ɗaya ne Let's Encrypt amfani don soke takardar shedar taro.
security.h1_f:
class | tsaro
---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------
m cibiyar sadarwa | L1+L2 stealth (hantsin yatsa)
mai kai hari cibiyar sadarwa | L3+L4 stealth (ECH, pluggable)
ma'aikacin sulhu | E2E crypto + mai aikawa da karya
na'urar da aka lalata | sirrin gaba + goge tsoro
adadi (nan gaba) | Kyber-768 hybrid zaman
security.h2_f:
bincika kowane buƙatu:
  SQL allura : gano UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE,; -- da sauransu.
  Tafiya ta hanya: gano ../, ..%2f, URL-incoded bambance-bambancen
  samfur allura: gano {{, {%
  XSS : gano <script, javascript:
  NoSQLi: gano $ne, $inda, $regex
iyakoki: 1000/s duniya, 10/min shiga, 5/min rajista
security.h3_f:
jere: {ts, taron, ɗan wasan kwaikwayo, target_id, details_cbor, prev_hash, row_hash}
jere_hash = SHA-256(ts ∥ taron ∥ dan wasan kwaikwayo ∥ ... ∥ prev_hash)
tabbatar: log log, sake yin lissafin kowane row_hash, kwatanta da ƙimar da aka adana
karya ⇒ an gano lalata a wannan layin

privacy.title: Keɓantawa da yarda
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, dama-zuwa-gefewa, rage girman metadata, ɗaukar bayanai.
privacy.intro: Vortex jiragen ruwa GDPR da CCPA kayan aiki daga cikin akwatin. Masu gudanarwa a cikin hukunce-hukuncen hukunce-hukuncen suna da madaidaicin wurin gudanarwa guda ɗaya ga kowane buƙatun doka.
privacy.h1p1: Babu IP rajistan ayyukan ta tsohuwa. Juya madannin wakili `X-Real-IP` sai dai idan mai aiki ya shiga.
privacy.h1p2: `Sender_pseudo` a cikin layin saƙo yana hashes ID na mai aikawa na gaske - DB juji yana bayyana sunayen ɓoyayyiyar ɗaki kawai.
privacy.h1p3: Bincike yana amfani da rufaffiyar-alamu. Abokin ciniki yana ɓoye kalmomin shiga tare da maɓallin ɗaki; node Stores opaque tokens; dubawa yayi daidai-daidai akan alamomin ciphertext.
privacy.h1p4: An ganni na ƙarshe zuwa ƙaƙƙarfan zaɓin mai amfani.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` yana ɓoye layin mai amfani, yana goge saƙonnin da aka aiko (samuwar bayanai don ƙima), yana share fayiloli daga faifai.
privacy.h2p2: Tarayya: sa hannun tsegumi yana sanar da takwarorinsu; suna gogewa a gefen su cikin sa'o'i 72.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: Ana shigar da gogewa tare da tambarin lokaci da (hashed) id mai amfani don haka ma'aikaci zai iya tabbatar da yarda.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` yana gudana zip: profile JSON, aika/karɓi sifar rubutu, bayanan fayil tare da maɓallan tushen kowane fayil, lissafin lamba.
privacy.h3p2: Lokacin tsarawa: ~ 5 min na saƙonnin 10k, an iyakance shi da IO.
privacy.h3p3: Dole ne mai karɓa ya ɓata rubutun ciphertext a gida; Ana jigilar kayan aikin fitarwa tare.
privacy.h4p1: Dogon latsa tambarin 5 s → goge gida nan da nan: maɓalli, saƙon da aka adana, haɗe-haɗe.
privacy.h4p2: Haɗaɗɗen gogewa: `/api/privacy/firgici’ shima ya zama kabari asusun gefen uwar garken.
privacy.h1_a: Babu IP rajistan ayyukan ta tsohuwa. Babu metadata mai gano mai amfani akan layuka na saƙo. Binciken cikakken rubutu akan alamun rufaffiyar.
privacy.h1_b: Juya madannin wakili 'X-Real-IP` kafin kumburin ya gan shi sai dai idan mai aiki ya zaɓi don iyakance ƙima. Adana layin saƙo `sender_id` (na ACL) da `sender_pseudo` (na fan-out); sender_pseudo is HMAC(gishiri_daki, mai aiko_id) don haka DB juji baya bayyana wanda ya fadi abin da ke fadin dakuna. Bincika: abokin ciniki yana ɓoye kalmomin shiga tare da maɓallin ɗakin; node Stores opaque tokens; Nemo daidai-daidai ne akan alamomin rubutu, babu fihirisar rubutu.
privacy.h1_c: Rarraba metadata shine yarjejeniya bayan-Snowden - Sigina ta yaɗa shi a cikin 2014, WhatsApp ya biyo baya tare da mai aikawa a cikin 2019. Binciken ɓoyayye akan alamun ciphertext shine tsarin CryptDB (2011) da ShadowCrypt (2014). Aiwatar da Vortex sigar tsiri ce wacce ke cinikin wasu sassaucin tambaya don sauƙi.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` yana ɓoye layin mai amfani, yana goge rubutun da aka aiko, yana share fayiloli, kuma yana sanar da abokan haɗin gwiwa.
privacy.h2_b: Gefen uwar garken: 'masu amfani' filaye masu ma'ana ba a cire su ba (`sunan mai amfani = "share-<id>"`, `waya = null`, `email = null`, `display_name = "[an share]"); `messages.ciphertext` saita NULL ga duk layuka inda `sender_id = u.id`; fayilolin da aka haɗa daga waɗannan saƙonnin da aka goge daga faifai. Takwarorinsu masu haɗin gwiwa sun karɓi rattaba hannu kan `{wato: "erasure", user_id, sanya hannu_by}` tsegumi; suna gudanar da tsarkakewa guda ɗaya a gefensu cikin sa'o'i 72 (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Haƙƙin sharewa shine GDPR Mataki na 17 da ake bukata tun daga 2018. CCPA ya biyo baya a cikin 2020; LGPD (Brazil) a cikin 2021. Vortex tana jigilar kaya daga cikin akwatin don haka ma'aikatan da ke cikin ikon ba dole ba ne su gina shi. Hukumar ta 72 h SLA matches GDPR tagan martani na kwanaki 30 tare da dakin kai don yadawa.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` yana gudana zip: profile JSON, aika/karɓi sifar rubutu, bayanan fayil tare da maɓallan tushen kowane fayil, lissafin lamba.
privacy.h3_b: Generation yana async saboda manyan asusu suna ɗaukar mintuna. Buƙatun POST na abokin ciniki → node enqueues job → aiki yana gudana a bango → kuri'un abokin ciniki `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 tare da sanya hannu URL lokacin da aka shirya. Abubuwan da ke cikin zip: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (ɗaki ɗaya), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + per-file root keys), `files/` (zazzagewar-as-is-blobs).
privacy.h3_c: Matsakaicin bayanai shine buƙatun tagwaye tare da gogewa a cikin GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Sigina duk suna da kayan aikin cirewa. Vortex's yana ƙara kayan maɓalli (file_root kowane fayil) don haka masu amfani za su iya ɓoye fitar da su cikin gida - in ba haka ba fitarwa ba ta da amfani. Ba tare da wannan dalla-dalla ba abubuwan Apple / Google abubuwan cirewa suna da inganci a bayyane-kawai saboda an riga an ɓoye su.
privacy.h4_a: Shafa tsoro: dogon danna tambarin Vortex na tsawon daƙiƙa 5 don lalata duk maɓallai da bayanan da aka adana akan na'urar nan da nan. Ba zai iya jurewa ba.
privacy.h4_b: Abokin ciniki-gefen: a kan 5-na biyu dogon-latsa, nuna tabbaci; a tabbatar, kira `wipeKeychainItems()` / `clearKeystore()` / `localStorage.clear() + indexedDB.databases() .don Kowa(shareDatabase)`. Rubutun da aka adana ya tafi, maɓallai sun tafi, JWTs sun tafi. Haɗaɗɗen zaɓi na zaɓi: `POST /api/privacy/firgici' shima yana kabbara gefen uwar garken asusun kuma yana lalata tsegumi.
privacy.h4_c: Maɓallin tsoro / matattu-matattu suna da dogon tarihi a cikin amintaccen saƙo: Wickr's 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat's 2013 "Mantawa", Shawarar "Tabbataccen Sharewa" siginar (2016, ba a taɓa aikawa ba). Vortex's 5-second dogon-latsawa yana da wahala da gangan don haifar da bazata - mun yi nazarin ra'ayoyin ra'ayi akan iPhone 15 da Pixel 8 kuma mun zaɓi 5 s a matsayin wuri mai dadi tsakanin "sauri mai sauri a cikin gaggawa" da "ba za a iya yin wuta ta hanyar maɓallin aljihu ba".
privacy.h1_f:
sender_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256(gishiri_daki, mai aiko_id)[:16]
  ⇒ DB juji: {daki, mai aikawa_pseudo, ciphertext}
  ⇒ maharin ba zai iya haɗa sender_pseudo a cikin ɗakuna (gishiri daban-daban)

alamar bincike = HMAC-SHA256(key_key, keyword)
  ⇒ tambaya "sannu" ⇒ lissafin alama
  ⇒ node ba ya ganin mahimmin mahimmin kalma
privacy.h2_f:
POST /api/privacy/ shafe (bautawa kai)
  UPDATE masu amfani SET username='deleted-'||id, phone=NULL, email=NULL, ...
  UPDATE saƙonni SET ciphertext=NULL WHERE mai aikawa_id=$u
  DELETE FROM files WHERE uploaded_by=$u
  tsegumi {wato:"Goge", user_id, sig: Ed25519(release_priv, event)}
privacy.h3_f:
fitarwa.zip
├── profile.json (filayen mai amfani)
├── rooms.jsonl (daki daya akan layi)
├── messages.jsonl.enc (rubutun rubutu + per-msg file_root)
├── decrypt.py (rubutun taimako)
└── fayiloli/
    ├── <file_id>.bin (rufe-tsafe, maɓallin tushen saƙon.jsonl)
    └──...
privacy.h4_f:
dogon danna ≥ 5 s akan tambarin VORTEX:
  tabbatar da magana
  na tabbata:
    Keychain.deleteAll(prefix = "vortex.")
    UserDefaults.removeObject(donKey: "vortex.*")
    SQLite vortex.db DROP duk tebur
    haɗe: POST /api/privacy/firgita (gefen uwar garken kabari)

debugging.title: Debugging da bincike
debugging.subtitle: Kayan aiki don bin diddigin batutuwa a cikin dev, tsarawa, da samfur.
debugging.intro: Kowane tsarin ƙasa yana da tsayayyen tsarin shiga da kuma shimfida / awo. Ga littafin wasan ganewar asali na yau da kullun.
debugging.h1p1: JSON - an tsara ta ta tsohuwa. `logger.info("action", extra={"user_id": ...})` yana samar da `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"action", "user_id": ...}`.
debugging.h1p2: Juyawa a 100 MB; kiyaye gens 14 gzipped.
debugging.h1p4: Idon daidaitawa: kowane buƙatu yana samun 'Request-Id'; RPCs na ƙasa suna sake amfani da shi.
debugging.h2p1: Tsarin Prometheus a `/ ma'auni' (mai gudanarwa-antabbatacce a cikin samfur).
debugging.h2p2: RED: ƙimar / kurakurai / tsawon lokaci kowace hanya.
debugging.h2p3: USE: amfani / jikewa / kurakurai a kowane DB tafkin, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Na al'ada: ɗakuna masu aiki, saƙonni/s, lissafin matakin ɓoye-ɓoye.
debugging.h3p1: 'py-spy' don samfurin lokacin aiki. Haɗe zuwa kumburin gudu PID.
debugging.h3p2: 'memray' don bayanin martaba. Hoto na mintuna 1 yana nuna ɗigogi cikin sauri.
debugging.h3p3: Rust tsawo `vortex_chat` yana fitar da tutar `--profile' wacce ke rubuta alamar da ta dace da harshen wuta.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` yana gudanar da rajista/login/aika/karba/figawa a kan kullin gida. Yana fita ba sifili akan kowace gazawa.
debugging.h4p2: CI yana fitar da hayaki akan kowane PR haka kuma akan hadewa zuwa babba.
debugging.h4p3: Samar da hayaki: bincike na waje yana bugun asusun canary sau ɗaya a minti daya.
debugging.h1_a: An tsara rajistan ayyukan JSON ta tsohuwa. Kowane layin log ya haɗa da ts, matakin, module, saƙo, da id ɗin daidaitawa.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("user_created", extra={"user_id": u.id})` yana samar da `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"user_qed" "..."}'. Id ɗin daidaitawa ya fito daga taken 'X-Request-Id'; kowane ƙasa RPC yana sake amfani da shi. Juyawa a 100 MB; kiyaye tsararraki 14 gzipped. Matsayi kowane-module ta hanyar `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Tsare-tsare JSON shiga ita ce yarjejeniya ta yanzu - wanda Stripe, Datadog, kowane mai siyar da abin lura na zamani ya ɗauka. ID ɗin daidaitawa suna bin X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) kuma sun zama canonical a cikin ƙananan sabis ta hanyar Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex yana amfani da sauƙaƙan id ɗin haɗin kai wanda aka watsar da kai maimakon rarrabawa saboda kayan aikin da aka rarraba-rabo yana ƙara rikitarwa ba mu buƙata tukuna.
debugging.h2_a: Ma'auni na Prometheus a '/ awo' (mai gudanarwa-sahihancin samarwa). An aika dashboards na Grafana a cikin `deploy/grafana/`.
debugging.h2_b: RED ma'auni a kowane hanya: ƙimar buƙata, ƙimar kuskure, tarihin ɗan lokaci. USE ma'auni na kowane albarkatu: DB amfani da ruwa, WebSocket fan-out saturation, TURN relay bandwidth. Na al'ada: ɗakuna masu aiki, saƙonni a cikin daƙiƙa guda, lissafin matakin stealth. Dashboard mai gudanarwa a `/ admin/metrics` yana nuna manyan ginshiƙi; Prometheus yana ba da cikakken tarihin tarihi.
debugging.h2_c: RED (ƙididdigar / kurakurai / tsawon lokaci) shine acronym na Weaveworks' 2016. USE (amfani / jikewa / kurakurai) shine tsarin Brendan Gregg na 2013. Tare suna rufe siginonin matakin sabis da matakin albarkatun. Prometheus + Grafana shine tushen tushen tushen tun 2016.
debugging.h3_a: 'py-leken asiri' don samfurin lokacin aiki; 'memray' don ɗaukar hoto; `vortex_chat` Rust tsawo yana da `--profile' don alamun flamegraph.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` na tsawon s 60 yana samar da flamegraph SVG yana nuna tarin Python zafi. 'memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>' waƙa da aka raba; 'memray flamegraph mem.bin' ya fassara. Rust tsawo yana fitar da bayanan sirri na ciki azaman binciken Chrome JSON lokacin da aka kira shi da `-profile`. Haɗa kowane ɗayan waɗannan tare da gwajin lodi da ke gudana ta hanyar `scripts/smoke/all.sh` don daidaiton siffofi.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) mai ƙididdigewa mai ƙididdigewa ne wanda ba shi da hankali wanda ke manne da tsarin Python mai gudana ba tare da canje-canje na lamba ba - Go na Python profilers. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) shine mafi kyawun Python mai bayanin heap a yau. Rust Tsarin muhalli na kansa ya balaga amma ba a haɗa shi ba; Tsawancin mu yana fitar da binciken Chrome-musamman saboda kowane mai bincike yana da mai kallo da aka gina a ciki.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` yin rajistar motsa jiki/shiga/aika/karba/fita daga kumburin gida. CI yana gudanar da shi akan kowane PR.
debugging.h4_b: Hayaƙi yana gudana a cikin daƙiƙa 5. Yana ƙirƙirar sabbin asusu guda biyu, ya buɗe DM, aika sako, tabbatar da isarwa, ya fita duka. Yana fita ba sifili akan kowace gazawa. CI yana kiran shi bayan gini. Wani keɓaɓɓen kanari mai shan hayaki yana gudana kowane minti ɗaya daga binciken waje akan keɓaɓɓen asusun gwaji akan kumburin samarwa.
debugging.h4_c: Gwajin hayaki misalin masana'antar Toyota ne (1950s) - gudanar da bincike mai sauri don tabbatar da cewa tsarin bai karye ba. A cikin software sun zama daidaitattun bayan Michael Feathers' "Aiki da kyau tare da Legacy Code" (2004). Rubutun hayaki na Vortex shine ~ 200 layi na bash + curl.

testing.title: Dabarun gwaji
testing.subtitle: Layin gwaje-gwaje 29k a fadin Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Kowane Layer yana da nasa kayan gwaji. CI yana tafiyar da dukkan su cikin kasa da mintuna 10.
testing.h1p1: 'pytest app/tests' yana rufe hanyoyin sadarwa, tsaro, sufuri, bots.
testing.h1p2: Gwaje-gwaje na tushen kadarori akan crypto: `Assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` na 1000 m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style fuzz akan WAF: miliyoyin abubuwan shigar da ba su da kyau - yana tabbatar da babu leaks na 5xx.
testing.h2p1: 'Swift Test' a cikin 'ios/Modules/' yana gudanar da gwajin naúrar akan RFC 7748/8032/5869/8446 gwajin vectors.
testing.h2p2: Gwajin XCUI suna fitar da ra'ayoyin SwiftUI a cikin na'urar kwaikwayo mara kai; hoto-kwatanta.
testing.h3p1: Gwajin './gradlew' yana gudanar da gwaje-gwaje JVM-kawai (sauri).
testing.h3p2: `./gradlewconnectCheck' yana gudanar da gwaje-gwajen kayan aiki akan abin koyi mai gudana.
testing.h4p1: Mawallafin wasan kwaikwayo yana korar abokin ciniki na gidan yanar gizo, Chrome mara kai + Firefox mara kai. Ana amfani da kira tare da `--amfani-fake-ui-for-media-stream'.
testing.h4p2: Yanayi: yi rijistar asusu guda biyu → DM → aika fayil → share → tabbatar da daidaitawa → ƙare.
testing.h1_a: Python gwaje-gwaje suna amfani da ɗaukar hoto na pytest +. Kowane na'ura mai ba da hanya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa, kowane tsoho na tsaro, kowane tsarin sufuri yana da gwaje-gwaje. ~80% ɗaukar hoto.
testing.h1_b: 'pytest app/tests' yana gudanar da cikakken suite a cikin ƙasa da mintuna 2 akan cibiya ɗaya. Gwaje-gwaje na tushen kadarori akan abubuwan farko na crypto: `ssert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` don saƙonnin bazuwar 1000. Gwajin fuzz-style AFL akan WAF: miliyoyin abubuwan da ba su da kyau sun tabbatar don samar da martani na 4xx (ba 5xx). `pytest --cov=app` don ɗaukar hoto.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) shine mai tseren gwajin de-facto Python. Hasashe (2015) don gwajin tushen dukiya ya ƙaddamar da ra'ayin QuickCheck daga Haskell. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) don fuzz shine fuzzer mai ɗaukar hoto na canonical. Vortex's tari shine na yau da kullun; Abin dandano ɗaya kawai shine fifikonmu na pytest parametrisation akan gadon aji na gwaji.
testing.h2_a: Gwaje-gwaje masu sauri a cikin 'ios/Modules/' suna rufe abubuwan farko na crypto akan RFC gwajin vectors tare da gwajin hoto na SwiftUI.
testing.h2_b: 'gwajin gaggawa' daga 'ios/Modules/' yana gudanar da gwajin naúrar a ƙasa da 1 s. RFC 7748 (X25519) vectors. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) vectors. RFC 5869 (HKDF) vectors. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) wasanni. SwiftUI preview hotuna idan aka kwatanta ta hanyar bambance-bambancen hoto a kan tushen tushen git; koma baya akan kowane pixel ya gaza gina ginin.
testing.h2_c: Gwajin crypto akan sifofin gwaji na hukuma shine mafi kyawun aikin hana harsashi - idan lambar ku ta yarda da RFC vectors, yana dacewa da ma'anarsa. Gwajin hoton hoto don SwiftUI ~ 2022 yanayin fasaha ne, wanda ya shahara ta hanyar pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-gwajin. Vortex yana amfani da ƙaramin sigar cikin gida don guje wa dogaro.
testing.h3_a: Gwajin Kotlin: JVM-kawai ta hanyar `./gradlew gwajin'; kayan aiki ta hanyar `./gradlewconnectCheck` akan kwailin da ke gudana.
testing.h3_b: gwajin `./gradlew' yana gudana cikin yan dakiku - babu tsarin Android da ake buƙata, kawai JUnit + Hilt-android-testing. Makasudin gwaji na raka'a: crypto, masu gabatarwa, kwararar tushen coroutine. `./gradlewconnectCheck` yana jujjuya abin koyi, ya shigar da app, yana gudanar da gwaje-gwaje UI ta hanyar Espresso. E2E yana gudana: shiga → aika sako → duba cikin hira.
testing.h3_c: Rabe gwaje-gwaje JVM-kawai daga gwaje-gwajen kayan aiki shine taron Android 2019+. JVM gwaje-gwaje suna da sauri (dakika); gwaje-gwajen kayan aiki suna jinkirin (mintuna). Robolectric (2014) ya kasance yana cike gibin amma an maye gurbinsa da wannan rarrabuwar kawuna a ci gaban Android na zamani.
testing.h4_a: Mawallafin wasan kwaikwayo yana korar abokin ciniki na gidan yanar gizo a cikin Chrome da Firefox mara kai, yana aiwatar da rajista na gaske → DM → kwararar kira.
testing.h4_b: 'marubuci-gwajin/' yana riƙe da yanayi a cikin TypeScript. Kullin jifa + Postgres ana jujjuya shi a kowane zaman gwaji ta hanyar rubutun docker. Gwaje-gwaje suna fitar da yanar gizo UI: yin rijistar asusu guda biyu, buɗe DM, aika saƙo, tabbatar da isarwa, yin kiran bidiyo tare da `--amfani-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `-amfani-na'urar karya-don-kafofin watsa labarai-rafi' don haka Chrome ta samar da sauti/bidiyo na roba. Yanayi yana gudana a layi daya ta hanyar ma'aikatan Playwright.
testing.h4_c: Mawallafin wasan kwaikwayo (Microsoft, 2020) ya maye gurbin Selenium don mafi yawan gwajin yanar gizo E2E saboda yana da sauri, mafi aminci, kuma yana da mafi kyawun gyara kuskure. WebRTC Gwaji a cikin masu bincike marasa kai ya kasance abin jin zafi har Chrome 69 ya kara tutocin na'urar karya; tun daga nan ya zama daidaitaccen aiki.

apiSurface.title: Ƙarƙashin ƙasa
apiSurface.subtitle: Kowane HTTP ƙarshen ƙarshen kumburi yana buɗewa, an haɗa shi ta yanki.
apiSurface.intro: Wannan shine madaidaicin jerin hanyoyin jama'a. Kowane katin ƙarshen yana faɗaɗa don nuna maƙasudi, matakin tantancewa, buƙatu / tsare-tsaren amsawa, tebur kuskure, da misalin curl. Hanyoyin kiyaye gida a ƙarƙashin `/na ciki/*` ba a cire su ta hanyar manufa.

auth.title: Tabbatarwa
auth.subtitle: Yi rijista, shiga, sabuntawa, sokewa - da hanyoyin dawowa.
auth.intro: Duk hanyoyin da ke ƙarƙashin `/api/authentication/*`. JWT da ke fitowa daga shiga cikin nasara yana ɗauke da `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|refresh}` sanya hannu HS256 akan sirrin kumburi. Samun shiga yana ɗaukar mintuna 15, wartsake kwanaki 30.

register.title: POST /api/authentication/register
register.subtitle: Ƙirƙiri sabon mai amfani tare da X25519 ainihi + Argon2id kalmar sirri.
register.h1_a: Yana ƙirƙira sabon asusun mai amfani kuma ya fitar da farkon JWT biyu. Yana ɗaure maɓalli na jama'a X25519 na mai amfani zuwa asusu daga farkon kiran farko.
register.h1_b: Node yana tabbatar da duk filayen ta hanyar Pydantic, yana bincika sunan mai amfani da x25519_public_key keɓancewar, yana gudanar da Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) akan kalmar sirri, ana sakawa cikin 'masu amfani', 'na'urorin_mai amfani', 'push_subscriptions', samun damar mints + sabunta JWTs.
register.h1_c: An aika cikin v0.0.1 azaman ƙarshen ƙarshen farko. An ƙara siginar maɓalli na X25519 a cikin v0.0.2 bayan an gane ainihi kuma ana buƙatar ƙirƙirar asusu ta atomatik - in ba haka ba uwar garken zai iya MITM mai amfani tsakanin rajista da loda maɓallin farko.
register.h2_a: Yana buqata: **babu**. Matsakaicin 'app/security/middware.py::auth_required' ya kori wannan hanya kuma ya ƙi tare da `401 mara inganci' idan takardar shaidar da ake buƙata ta ɓace ko bata aiki.
register.h2_b:
- 'babu' - maras tabbas (pre-login).
- `jwt` - Mai ba da JWT alamar shiga cikin taken 'Izinin'.
- `refresh` - Mai ɗaukar alama JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT wanda da'awarsa ta ƙunshi `shine_admin: gaskiya'.
- 'sa hannu-sa-hannu' - ƙungiyar buƙatar da amintaccen maɓalli na Ed25519 ya sanya hannu.
register.h2_c: Matsayin auth yana nuna ƙa'idar mafi ƙarancin gata: wuraren ƙarshen shigowa kafin shiga sun iyakance ga ƙirƙira da dawo da asusu; duk abin da ke bayan JWT yana ganin ainihin mai amfani; Ƙarshen ƙarshen admin yana nuna alama a cikin UI don haka ana iya lura da rashin amfani.
register.h3_a: JSON jiki tare da sunan mai amfani dole + kalmar sirri + x25519_jama'a_key; waya na zaɓi (E.164), imel (RFC 5322 Lite), display_name, avatar_emoji, invite_code, kyber_public_key.
register.h3_f:
{
  "username": "alice", // [a-z0-9_]{3,30}
  "Password": "..."", // ≥ 8 chars
  "x25519_public_key": "<64-hex>", // 32 bytes hex
  "display_name": "Alice", // na zaɓi
  "waya": "+15551234567", // na zaɓi, E.164
  "email": "a@example.com", // na zaɓi
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // na zaɓi, 1 emoji
  "invite_code": "..."", // na zaɓi idan yanayin INVITE
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // na zaɓi, don PQ
}

  "display_name": "Alice",

}

login.title: POST /api/authentication/login
login.subtitle: Tabbatar da sunan mai amfani + kalmar sirri, mayar da JWT biyu.
login.h1_a: Musanya takaddun shaida don JWT biyu. An tabbatar da kalmar wucewa akan hash na Argon2id a cikin `users.password_hash`. Lokaci-lokaci akai-akai har ma da sunayen masu amfani da ba a san su ba don ƙi ƙididdigewa.
login.h1_b: Nemo mai amfani da ƙananan suna, yana gudanar da `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(an adana, ƙaddamar)'. Idan babu mai amfani, yana tabbatar da hash ɗin da aka riga aka lissafta don daidaita lokaci. Nasara → fitowar JWT + `na'urorin_mai amfani' jere.
login.h1_c: An aika tare da rajista a cikin v0.0.1. Dummy hashing na lokaci-lokaci an ƙara a cikin v0.0.2 bayan masu bincike sun nuna ƙidayar lokaci akan ƙirar farko.
login.h2_a: Yana buqata: **babu**. Matsakaicin 'app/security/middware.py::auth_required' ya kori wannan hanya kuma ya ƙi tare da `401 mara inganci' idan takardar shaidar da ake buƙata ta ɓace ko bata aiki.
login.h2_b:
- 'babu' - maras tabbas (pre-login).
- `jwt` - Mai ba da JWT alamar shiga cikin taken 'Izinin'.
- `refresh` - Mai ɗaukar alama JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT wanda da'awarsa ta ƙunshi `shine_admin: gaskiya'.
- 'sa hannu-sa-hannu' - ƙungiyar buƙatar da amintaccen maɓalli na Ed25519 ya sanya hannu.
login.h2_c: Matsayin auth yana nuna ƙa'idar mafi ƙarancin gata: wuraren ƙarshen shigowa kafin shiga sun iyakance ga ƙirƙira da dawo da asusu; duk abin da ke bayan JWT yana ganin ainihin mai amfani; Ƙarshen ƙarshen admin yana nuna alama a cikin UI don haka ana iya lura da rashin amfani.
login.h5_a: Standard Vortex kuskure ambulan `{kuskure, matsayi, hanya}`. `401' akan munanan takaddun shaida; `403' akan rashin isashen gata; `422' akan tabbatarwa; `429' akan iyaka; `5xx` akan kuskuren ciki.

refresh.title: POST /api/authentication/refresh
refresh.subtitle: Kasuwancin wartsakewa JWT don samun sabon shiga JWT.
refresh.intro: Warkar da alamar shiga - auth: ** refresh**.
refresh.h1_a: Mints sabon alamar shiga ta mintuna 15 ba tare da sake tambayar mai amfani kalmar sirri ba. Ana amfani dashi lokacin da alamar samun dama ta kusa ta kusa ƙarewa ko kuma ta dawo da 401.

logout.title: POST /api/authentication/logout

profile.h1_b: Mai kula da wannan hanya yana rayuwa a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`. An bayyana tsarin hanyar `/api/authentication/profile` tare da `@router.get('/api/authentication/profile')`.
profile.h1_c: An aika a farkon Vortex saki a matsayin wani ɓangare na iyawar 'profile'.
profile.h2_a: Ana bukata: **jwt**. Matsakaicin 'app/security/middware.py::auth_required' ya kori wannan hanya kuma ya ƙi tare da `401 mara inganci' idan takardar shaidar da ake buƙata ta ɓace ko bata aiki.
profile.h2_b:
- 'babu' - maras tabbas (pre-login).
- `jwt` - Mai ba da JWT alamar shiga cikin taken 'Izinin'.
- `refresh` - Mai ɗaukar alama JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT wanda da'awarsa ta ƙunshi `shine_admin: gaskiya'.
- 'sa hannu-sa-hannu' - ƙungiyar buƙatar da amintaccen maɓalli na Ed25519 ya sanya hannu.
profile.h2_c: Matsayin auth yana nuna ƙa'idar mafi ƙarancin gata: wuraren ƙarshen shigowa kafin shiga sun iyakance ga ƙirƙira da dawo da asusu; duk abin da ke bayan JWT yana ganin ainihin mai amfani; Ƙarshen ƙarshen admin yana nuna alama a cikin UI don haka ana iya lura da rashin amfani.
profile.h5_a: Standard Vortex kuskure ambulan `{kuskure, matsayi, hanya}`. `401' akan munanan takaddun shaida; `403' akan rashin isashen gata; `422' akan tabbatarwa; `429' akan iyaka; `5xx` akan kuskuren ciki.
profile.h5_f:
Alamar 401 mara inganci ta ɓace/marasa inganci
403 an haramta rashin isashen gata
422 tabbatarwa_kuskure an keta iyakokin filin
429_iyakantaccen yunƙuri da yawa
500 internal_error kuskuren uwar garken ba zata

  -H 'Nau'in Abun ciki: aikace-aikace/json' \
  -H 'Izinin: Mai bayarwa $TOKEN'

create.h1_a: Ya yarda `{nau'in, suna,_mai zaman kansa, shine_tashar, members}'. Mahalicci ya zama mai shi; membobin da aka ƙara a cikin ma'amala guda ɗaya; farkon ambulan root_key wanda aka haƙa gefen abokin ciniki sannan POSTed azaman kira na biyu.
create.h1_b: Mai kula da wannan hanya yana rayuwa a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`. An bayyana tsarin hanyar `/api/rooms` tare da `@router.post('/api/rooms')`.
create.h1_c: An aika a farkon Vortex saki a matsayin wani ɓangare na iyawar 'dakuna'.
create.h2_a: Ana bukata: **jwt**. Matsakaicin 'app/security/middware.py::auth_required' ya kori wannan hanya kuma ya ƙi tare da `401 mara inganci' idan takardar shaidar da ake buƙata ta ɓace ko bata aiki.
create.h2_b:
- 'babu' - maras tabbas (pre-login).
- `jwt` - Mai ba da JWT alamar shiga cikin taken 'Izinin'.
- `refresh` - Mai ɗaukar alama JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT wanda da'awarsa ta ƙunshi `shine_admin: gaskiya'.
- 'sa hannu-sa-hannu' - ƙungiyar buƙatar da amintaccen maɓalli na Ed25519 ya sanya hannu.
create.h2_c: Matsayin auth yana nuna ƙa'idar mafi ƙarancin gata: wuraren ƙarshen shigowa kafin shiga sun iyakance ga ƙirƙira da dawo da asusu; duk abin da ke bayan JWT yana ganin ainihin mai amfani; Ƙarshen ƙarshen admin yana nuna alama a cikin UI don haka ana iya lura da rashin amfani.
create.h5_a: Standard Vortex kuskure ambulan `{kuskure, matsayi, hanya}`. `401' akan munanan takaddun shaida; `403' akan rashin isashen gata; `422' akan tabbatarwa; `429' akan iyaka; `5xx` akan kuskuren ciki.
create.h5_f:
Alamar 401 mara inganci ta ɓace/marasa inganci
403 an haramta rashin isashen gata
422 tabbatarwa_kuskure an keta iyakokin filin
429_iyakantaccen yunƙuri da yawa
500 internal_error kuskuren uwar garken ba zata
create.h6_a: Kiran ''POST' na al'ada a cikin curl:
create.h6_f:
curl -X POST 'https://node.example/api/rooms' \
  -H 'Nau'in Abun ciki: aikace-aikace/json' \
  -H 'Izinin: Mai bayarwa $TOKEN'

messages.h1_c: An aika a farkon Vortex a matsayin wani ɓangare na 'saƙonnin? tun =&limit=` iyawa.
messages.h2_a: Ana bukata: **jwt**. Matsakaicin 'app/security/middware.py::auth_required' ya kori wannan hanya kuma ya ƙi tare da `401 mara inganci' idan takardar shaidar da ake buƙata ta ɓace ko bata aiki.
messages.h2_b:
- 'babu' - maras tabbas (pre-login).
- `jwt` - Mai ba da JWT alamar shiga cikin taken 'Izinin'.
- `refresh` - Mai ɗaukar alama JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT wanda da'awarsa ta ƙunshi `shine_admin: gaskiya'.
- 'sa hannu-sa-hannu' - ƙungiyar buƙatar da amintaccen maɓalli na Ed25519 ya sanya hannu.
messages.h2_c: Matsayin auth yana nuna ƙa'idar mafi ƙarancin gata: wuraren ƙarshen shigowa kafin shiga sun iyakance ga ƙirƙira da dawo da asusu; duk abin da ke bayan JWT yana ganin ainihin mai amfani; Ƙarshen ƙarshen admin yana nuna alama a cikin UI don haka ana iya lura da rashin amfani.
messages.h5_a: Standard Vortex kuskure ambulan `{kuskure, matsayi, hanya}`. `401' akan munanan takaddun shaida; `403' akan rashin isashen gata; `422' akan tabbatarwa; `429' akan iyaka; `5xx` akan kuskuren ciki.
messages.h5_f:
Alamar 401 mara inganci ta ɓace/marasa inganci
403 an haramta rashin isashen gata
422 tabbatarwa_kuskure an keta iyakokin filin
429_iyakantaccen yunƙuri da yawa
500 internal_error kuskuren uwar garken ba zata

  -H 'Nau'in Abun ciki: aikace-aikace/json' \
  -H 'Izinin: Mai bayarwa $TOKEN'

delete.h5_a: Standard Vortex kuskure ambulan `{kuskure, matsayi, hanya}`. `401' akan munanan takaddun shaida; `403' akan rashin isashen gata; `422' akan tabbatarwa; `429' akan iyaka; `5xx` akan kuskuren ciki.

download.h1_a: Yana dawo da ɗanyen rafin rubutun sifa. Mai karɓa yana riƙe maɓallin file_root (an aika a cikin saƙon ɗakin bincike) don ɓarnawa.
download.h1_b: Mai kula da wannan hanya yana rayuwa a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`. Tsarin hanyar `/api/files/{id}` an bayyana shi tare da `@router.get('/api/files/{id}')`.
download.h1_c: An aika da farkon Vortex a matsayin wani ɓangare na iyawar `{id}'.
download.h2_a: Ana bukata: **jwt**. Matsakaicin 'app/security/middware.py::auth_required' ya kori wannan hanya kuma ya ƙi tare da `401 mara inganci' idan takardar shaidar da ake buƙata ta ɓace ko bata aiki.
download.h2_b:
- 'babu' - maras tabbas (pre-login).
- `jwt` - Mai ba da JWT alamar shiga cikin taken 'Izinin'.
- `refresh` - Mai ɗaukar alama JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT wanda da'awarsa ta ƙunshi `shine_admin: gaskiya'.
- 'sa hannu-sa-hannu' - ƙungiyar buƙatar da amintaccen maɓalli na Ed25519 ya sanya hannu.
download.h2_c: Matsayin auth yana nuna ƙa'idar mafi ƙarancin gata: wuraren ƙarshen shigowa kafin shiga sun iyakance ga ƙirƙira da dawo da asusu; duk abin da ke bayan JWT yana ganin ainihin mai amfani; Ƙarshen ƙarshen admin yana nuna alama a cikin UI don haka ana iya lura da rashin amfani.
download.h5_a: Standard Vortex kuskure ambulan `{kuskure, matsayi, hanya}`. `401' akan munanan takaddun shaida; `403' akan rashin isashen gata; `422' akan tabbatarwa; `429' akan iyaka; `5xx` akan kuskuren ciki.
download.h5_f:
Alamar 401 mara inganci ta ɓace/marasa inganci
403 an haramta rashin isashen gata
422 tabbatarwa_kuskure an keta iyakokin filin
429_iyakantaccen yunƙuri da yawa
500 internal_error kuskuren uwar garken ba zata
download.h6_a: Kiran ''GET' na al'ada a cikin curl:
download.h6_f:
curl -X GET 'https://node.example/api/files/{id}' \
  -H 'Nau'in Abun ciki: aikace-aikace/json' \
  -H 'Izinin: Mai bayarwa $TOKEN'

roadmap.title: Taswirar hanya
roadmap.subtitle: Abin da aka shirya da kuma lokacin.
roadmap.intro: Babban kallo. Kwanan wata buri ne; al'amurran tsaro kafin aikin fasalin fasalin.
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ an kunna ta ta tsohuwa akan sabobin shigarwa.
roadmap.h1p2: Ƙungiyoyi har zuwa mambobi 50 000 tare da buga maɓallin Bambancin-B.
roadmap.h1p3: Fakitin Desktop (Tauri) don macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Kasuwancin Bot yana buɗewa don ƙaddamar da jama'a.
roadmap.h2p1: Ƙungiya mai sauti kawai tana kiran mahalarta 100 ta hanyar SFU.
roadmap.h2p3: Kowane ɗan takara ya yi shiru / shura cikin kiran UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Canvas na haɗin gwiwar nau'in Miro sama da CRDT (Yjs-dadan) ta hanyar layin saƙo.
roadmap.h4p1: Kan-sarkar escrow don siyan bot (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Rabon kudaden shiga na mai aiki, 10 %% kuɗin dandamali.
roadmap.h4p3: Kunnawa/kashe Fiat ta hanyar haɗin Stripe.
roadmap.h5p1: Sama daidaitacce, duban tsaro na yau da kullun, ginin da za'a iya gyarawa, SemVer daskararre.
roadmap.h5p2: Shirin kyauta na bug kai tsaye.
roadmap.h5p3: Aƙalla nazari na tsaro mai zaman kansa ɗaya tare da rubutattun jama'a.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 - sakin jama'a na biyu. Kyber PQ a kunne ta tsohuwa, manyan ɗakunan jama'a ta hanyar Variant-B, fakitin tebur na Tauri, buɗaɗɗen kasuwar bot.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 ba daidai ba don kunna don sabon shigarwa; abokan ciniki ba tare da goyan baya da ƙaƙƙarfan rage darajar ba. Dakuna har zuwa mambobi 50 000 ta hanyar maɓalli na Variant-B suna buga - babu kowane memba na ambulan akan juyawa. Desktop (Tauri 2 wrapper a kusa da abokin ciniki na gidan yanar gizo) wanda aka buga don macOS, Windows, Linux tare da bundi iri ɗaya. Kasuwancin Bot yana buɗewa ga ƙaddamar da jama'a tare da bita na kwanaki 3 na kasuwanci SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 shine game da fitar da abubuwan da ke akwai maimakon ƙirƙira sababbi. Kyber koyaushe yana kan taswirar hanya; sauyawa zuwa tsoho ya dogara da kwanciyar hankali a ƙarƙashin kaya. An zaɓi Tauri akan Electron saboda tarin shine ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. An toshe gabatarwar jama'a na kasuwar Bot akan ababen more rayuwa waɗanda suka sauka a v0.1.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 - kiran rukuni. Rukunin sauti na tushen SFU har zuwa 100; kungiyoyin bidiyo har zuwa 32; na'urar kwaikwayo na daidaitawa.
roadmap.h2_b: An aiwatar da SFU a cikin Rust don aiki. Opus DTX + FEC + simulcast don sauti. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast don bidiyo tare da SFU zabar kowane Layer na mai kallo dangane da saukar da aka ruwaito. Kowane ɗan takara ya yi bebe da bugun daga UI. Rikodin kira (an yarda, kashe ta tsohuwa) adana rufaffen rufaffiyar a ƙarƙashin tushen maɓallin kowane kira wanda aka raba tsakanin mahalarta.
roadmap.h2_c: Kiran rukuni shine fasalin da aka fi buƙata guda ɗaya daga v0.1 beta. SFU ƙira yana bin tsarin Jitsi Videobridge + Janus. Rust aiwatarwa maimakon sake amfani da mediasoup saboda mediasoup's Node.js runtime yana ƙara latency ba ma so akan hanya mai zafi.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 - zanen haɗin gwiwa. Allo da aka raba nau'i-nau'i sama da CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) ta hanyar saƙon da ke akwai.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT daftarin aiki daidaita piggybacks akan saƙonnin ɗakin da ke akwai. Kowane aikin gyaran allo CRDT aiki ne da aka jera shi azaman CBOR, rufaffen ɓoye tare da maɓallin ɗakin, wanda aka buga azaman saƙo na 'nau'i:"board_op"'. Abokan ciniki sun lalata, nema, bayarwa. Kasancewar siginan kwamfuta na ainihi ta hanyar wani nau'in saƙon 'board_cursor'' daban. Fitarwa zuwa PNG / SVG / PDF ta hanyar zane-zane na gefen abokin ciniki.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTs (Shapiro et al. 2011) ya zama samarwa-mai yiwuwa tare da Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma sanannen ya gina haɗin gwiwar su akan tsari na al'ada CRDT. Manufar sake amfani da ɓoyayyen saƙonmu maimakon gina tashoshi daban-daban na WebSocket sun zo daga ka'ida: ƙananan hanyoyin sufuri, ƙarancin kwari.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 - biya. On-chain escrow (Solana + EVM) + fiat kunnawa/kashe ramp ta Stripe Connect.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot yana siyan hanya ta hanyar kwangilar escrow akan sarkar. Mai saye ya yarda; 24 h da sauri; sannan a saki kudi ga mai siyar da rage 10% kudin dandamali. Takaddama tana zuwa ga masu sasantawa a cikin al'umma da aka zaba ta hanyar yanke hukunci. Fiat on-ramp: Stripe Connect asusun kowane mai aiki ko kowane mai siyar da bot; Off-ramp: canja wurin banki kai tsaye ko USDC sasantawa. Tallafin Crypto: SOL, USDC, USDT akan duka Solana da Ethereum.
roadmap.h4_c: Kwangiloli masu wayo na Escrow sun tsufa (OpenBazaar 2016) amma har yanzu suna kusa da gefuna dangane da UX. Vortex ya gaji hadaddun amma yana ɓoye mafi yawansa - masu siye suna ganin maɓallin "saya" da aka saba. Kuɗin dandalin 10% ya dace da ƙa'idodin Store Store (ko da yake Apple yana ɗaukar 30%); ƙananan yanke yana da gangan don jawo hankalin masu sayarwa.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 - kwanciyar hankali. Binciken tsaro, ginanniyar ginawa a duk faɗin dandamali, SemVer daskararre.
roadmap.h5_b: Binciken wani ɓangare na uku da aka tsara kafin 1.0 daskare - mai yiwuwa Trail of Bits ko NCC Rukuni bisa la'akarin kasuwanci. Gine-ginen da za a iya maimaitawa yana nufin itacen tushe guda yana samar da binaries iri ɗaya akan kowane injin gini guda biyu; wannan yana gano tabarbarewar sarkar samar da kayayyaki. SemVer daskararre yana nufin ka'idojin waya, tsarin ajiya, da sararin jama'a SDK saman suna samun garantin koma-baya a cikin 1.x. An ƙaddamar da shirin kyautar bug tare da babban matakin $25k don aiwatar da lambar nesa akan kumburi.
roadmap.h5_c: Tsarin daidaitawa-audit-daskare shine siginar ƙirar, Tor, I2P, da WireGuard duk suna biyo baya. Gine-ginen da za a iya sake bugawa ya zama na yau da kullun bayan aikin Gina Mai Sauƙi (2014). Vortex yana amfani da kayan aikin Reproducible Builds. Kyautar bug daidaitattun ma'auni ne ga kowane aikin sarrafa bayanan mai amfani; $25k shine matsakaicin matakin ta 2025.
roadmap.h1_f:
v0.2 bayarwa (shirya):
  PQ hybrid tsoho: Kyber-768 kunna ta tsohuwa
  manyan dakuna : Maɓallin Bambanci-B da aka buga, har zuwa mambobi 50k
  tebur: Tauri 2 don macOS / Windows / Linux (~ 5 MB)
  kasuwar bot: ƙaddamar da jama'a, bita na kwanaki 3 SLA
roadmap.h2_f:
v0.3 bayarwa (shirya):
  Injin SFU: Rust, yana sake amfani da libwebrtc
  Ƙungiyoyin sauti: ≤ 100 mahalarta, Opus simulcast
  kungiyoyin bidiyo: ≤ 32 mahalarta, VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast
  yin rikodi: fita shiga, E2E- rufaffen ɓoye a ƙarƙashin maɓallin call_root
roadmap.h3_f:
v0.4 bayarwa (shirya):
  zane: Yjs-mai dandano CRDT, piggyback akan saƙon daki
  Tsarin aiki: CBOR{v:1, op_type, target, payload}
  kasancewar siginan kwamfuta: nau'in = "board_cursor", mai matsawa zuwa 10 Hz
  fitarwa: abokin ciniki-gefen PNG / SVG / PDF
roadmap.h4_f:
v0.5 bayarwa (shirya):
  escrow : Solana shirin + EVM kwangila, 24h holdback
  Kudin dandamali: 10% na jimlar
  fiat: Stripe Connect kowane mai siyarwa
  crypto: SOL, USDC, USDT akan Solana + Ethereum
  jayayya : masu sasanta al'umma, kuri'a masu nauyi
roadmap.h5_f:
v1.0 bayarwa (shirya):
  Tsaro duba: Trail of Bits ko NCC (Q3)
  reproducible builds: source SHA256 → deterministic binary SHA256
  SemVer daskare: ka'idar waya da SDK API barga tsakanin 1.x
  Kyautar kwaro: $25k max tier don RCE akan kumburi
