aead.title: AEAD
aead.subtitle: Ingantattun boye-boye tare da Haɗin Bayanai.
aead.intro: AEAD (Encryption ingantacce tare da Associated Data) babban sirri ne wanda ya haɗu da sirri da mutunci a cikin kira ɗaya. Idan aka ba da maɓalli, nonce, bayyanannen rubutu, da bayanan da ke da alaƙa na zaɓi (AAD), yana samar da tambarin tabbatar da rubutu + kamar yadda duk wani ɓarna tare da ko dai rubutu, rubutu, ko AAD ya kasa tabbatarwa.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Encryption ingantacce tare da Associated Data) babban sirri ne wanda ya haɗu da sirri da mutunci a cikin kira ɗaya. Idan aka ba da maɓalli, nonce, bayyanannen rubutu, da bayanan da ke da alaƙa na zaɓi (AAD), yana samar da tambarin tabbatar da rubutu + kamar yadda duk wani ɓarna tare da ko dai rubutu, rubutu, ko AAD ya kasa tabbatarwa.
aead.h1_b: Vortex's AEAD shine kullum AES-256-GCM. Ramin AAD yana ɗaukar mahallin mahallin dole ne mai karɓa ya san don yankewa daidai ( id ɗin ɗaki, id ɗin fayil, kashewa). Daure AAD yana hana sake yin wasan gaba - rubutu daga dakin A ba za a iya rusa shi azaman dakin B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD a matsayin mai suna primitive traces zuwa Rogaway 2002. Ya zama tsoho AEAD a cikin TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Kowace amintacciyar yarjejeniya ta zamani tana amfani da AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc(k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len(pt) bytes, tag = 16 bytes
AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt ko ⊥
aead.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

alembic.title: Alembic
alembic.subtitle: Kayan aikin ƙaura na Database don SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: Alembic shine tsarin ƙaura na canonical don SQLAlchemy. Kowane ƙaura fayil ne Python tare da 'haɓaka()' da ayyukan 'downgrade()' waɗanda ke bayyana canje-canjen ƙirƙira azaman ayyukan SQL ko ORM.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic shine tsarin ƙaura na canonical don SQLAlchemy. Kowane ƙaura fayil ne Python tare da 'haɓaka()' da ayyukan 'downgrade()' waɗanda ke bayyana canje-canjen ƙirƙira azaman ayyukan SQL ko ORM.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da Alembic tare da tarihin bita na layi (babu reshe). '' shugaban haɓaka alembic' yana gudana akan kowane farawar akwati na Docker. `alimbic downgrade -1` yana mayar da mataki ɗaya don juyowa. Yanayin Dev yana amfani da 'ƙirƙiri_duk + ALTER TABLE koma baya' don haka ƙarar gida baya buƙatar ƙaura akan kowane reshe.
alembic.h1_c: Mike Bayer (marubucin SQLAlchemy) ne ya rubuta Alembic a cikin 2011 a matsayin magajin 'sqlalchemy-migrate'. Ginshikan ƙaura na Django (2014) ya aro ainihin ƙirar. Alembic ya ci gaba da kasancewa a kan fasali - jujjuyawar, mai sarrafa kansa, reshe - kodayake Vortex baya amfani da rassa.
alembic.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

apns.title: APNs
apns.subtitle: Apple Sabis na sanarwar turawa.
apns.intro: APNs shine sabis na sanarwar turawa na Apple don iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Apps suna yin rajistar alamar na'ura kuma masu samarwa suna aika lodin sanarwa zuwa APNs waɗanda ke tallata su zuwa na'urori.
apns.h1_a: APNs shine sabis na sanarwar turawa na Apple don iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Apps suna yin rajistar alamar na'ura kuma masu samarwa suna aika lodin sanarwa zuwa APNs waɗanda ke tallata su zuwa na'urori.
apns.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da APNs tare da rufaffiyar ambulan turawa: kumburin yana ɓoye kowane kaya na sanarwa na X25519 pubkey na mai karɓa; APNs na ganin ƙulli kawai. Ƙwararren Sabis na Fadakarwa na abokin ciniki na iOS yana ɓarnawa a cikin wani tsari na daban kafin yin banner.
apns.h1_c: An ƙaddamar da APNs tare da iOS 3.0 (2009). Tallafin abin da aka rufe / mai canzawa ya zo tare da iOS 10 (2016). Auth na tushen Token (.p8) ya maye gurbin auth na tushen takaddun shaida azaman tsoho a cikin 2016. Vortex yana amfani da token auth tare da alamun mai bayarwa na mintuna 60.
apns.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
apns.h3_a: FCM, Tura Yanar Gizo, Rufewar turawa, Tsawaita Sabis na Sanarwa

argon2id.title: Argon2id
argon2id.subtitle: Ƙaddamar da kalmar sirri mai wuya (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id aiki ne mai wuyar žwažwalwa, aikin hashing kalmar sirri mai jurewa tasha. Siga: Girman ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya (m), farashin lokaci (iterations, t), daidaitawa (hanyoyi, p), da tsayin zanta. Bambancin 'id' ya haɗu da masu zaman kansu na bayanai (Argon2i) da masu dogaro da bayanai (Argon2d) wucewa.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id aiki ne mai wuyar žwažwalwa, aikin hashing kalmar sirri mai jurewa tasha. Siga: Girman ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya (m), farashin lokaci (iterations, t), daidaitawa (hanyoyi, p), da tsayin zanta. Bambancin 'id' ya haɗu da masu zaman kansu na bayanai (Argon2i) da masu dogaro da bayanai (Argon2d) wucewa.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da Argon2id tare da m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32. Wannan yana ɗaukar ~ 0.5 s akan iPhone X (na'urarmu mafi jinkirin tallafi) kuma kusan 5 ms akan babban ƙarshen ASIC - saurin 100 × ba shi da komai idan aka kwatanta da hashes na tushen SHA-256 inda ASICs suka ci nasara da miliyoyin.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 ya lashe gasar Hashing Password na 2015 wanda Dmitry Khovratovich da Alex Biryukov suka shirya. An daidaita shi azaman RFC 9106 a cikin 2021. Ana amfani da 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Ma'aunin Vortex sun fito ne daga shawarwarin OWASP 2023.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id (kalmar sirri, gishiri, m, t, p, hashLen) → zanta
tsoho: m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32
farashin ≈ 0.5s akan iPhone X; ~ 5ms akan ASIC (gudun maharan 100 ×)
argon2id.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
argon2id.h3_a: kalmar sirri hashing, AEAD, HKDF, gishiri

blake3.title: BLAKE3
blake3.subtitle: Mai saurin hash.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 shine aikin hash na cryptographic wanda ya samo asali daga BLAKE2 da BLAKE. Yana samar da fitarwa na tsawon sabani daga shigarwar sabani; 10× da sauri fiye da SHA-256 akan manyan ɓangarorin godiya ga hashing bishiyar ciki.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 shine aikin hash na cryptographic wanda ya samo asali daga BLAKE2 da BLAKE. Yana samar da fitarwa na tsawon sabani daga shigarwar sabani; 10× da sauri fiye da SHA-256 akan manyan ɓangarorin godiya ga hashing bishiyar ciki.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da BLAKE3 don amincin fayil: kowane fayil ɗin da aka ɗorawa yana ɗauke da zantan `plain_blake3` na ɓoyayyun abun cikin sa don haka masu karɓa zasu iya tantancewa bayan zazzagewa + decrypt. Rukunin DB a tarihi ana kiransa `sha256` don dacewa da ƙaura amma ya ƙunshi fitarwa BLAKE3.
blake3.h1_c: Jack O'Connor et al ya saki BLAKE3. a cikin 2020. Saukowa daga BLAKE, wanda ya kasance SHA-3 na karshe a cikin 2012. Tsarin hashing na itace yana ba da damar BLAKE3 sikelin tare da cores don manyan bayanai. SHA-256 har yanzu yana da sauri don ƙananan abubuwan shigarwa; BLAKE3 ya mamaye kowane abu> 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bytes) = 32 bytes // tsoho fitarwa
BLAKE3(bytes, len) = len bytes (XOF)
kayan aiki: ~3 GB/s akan Apple Silicon vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s
blake3.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

bmp.title: BMP
bmp.subtitle: Makauniyar Akwatin Saƙonni.
bmp.intro: BMP shine Vortex's Vortex's wanda ba'a san sunansa ba na kantin-da-gaba. Masu aikawa suna ajiye ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyiyar gulma, wanda aka sanya ta hanyar zanta ta hanyar maɓalli na mai karɓa. Blobs suna hawa tsegumi har kullin mai karɓa ya ja.
bmp.h1_a: BMP shine Vortex's Vortex's wanda ba'a san sunansa ba na kantin-da-gaba. Masu aikawa suna ajiye ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyen ɓoyayyiyar gulma, wanda aka sanya ta hanyar zanta ta hanyar maɓalli na mai karɓa. Blobs suna hawa tsegumi har kullin mai karɓa ya ja.
bmp.h1_b: BMP yana ba da kaddarorin sirri masu zaman kansu guda uku: ɓoye-boye (TLS + albasa na zaɓi), ɓoye mai karɓa (box_id ba shi da kyau zuwa nodes na tsakiya), ɓoye abun ciki (an riga an ɓoye ɓoyayyen E2E). Matsakaicin blob 1 MB, kowane-ƙulli hula 500 MB, ƙimar ajiya 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP an tsara su ne daga farko ta ƙungiyar Vortex. Mun gina shi saboda babu wani babban manzo da ya yarda ya biya farashin injiniya na ɓoye bayanan metadata daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe - suna ɓoye abun ciki amma suna zubar da jadawalin zamantakewa. Matsayinmu tun daga ranar farko shi ne cewa amintaccen manzo da yake zazzagewa wanda ya yi magana da shi ba shi da aminci rabinsa kawai. BMP yana rufe wannan rabin ta hanyar sanya mai aikawa, mai karɓa, da abun ciki ba su da tabbas, a saman ragamar tsegumi na Vortex maimakon ƙulla abubuwan more rayuwa.
bmp.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
bmp.h3_a: tsegumi, hidimar albasa, mai aikawa da hatimi, Tafki

cbor.title: CBOR
cbor.subtitle: Takaitaccen wakilcin Abun Binary.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) tsari ne na bayanai na binary wanda aka tsara don ƙananan girman lambar da sauri. Mafi girman tsarin bayanan JSON, mai rikodin binary, tabbataccen ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun bayanai.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) tsari ne na bayanai na binary wanda aka tsara don ƙananan girman lambar da sauri. Mafi girman tsarin bayanan JSON, mai rikodin binary, tabbataccen ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun bayanai.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da CBOR azaman tsarin biyan kuɗi a cikin envelopes AES-GCM. ~ 30% karami fiye da JSON akan taɗi mai nauyi na unicode; tsantsa mai tsauri (babu rashin tabbas) yana tsayayya da hare-hare daban-daban; mara tsari don haka ƙara filin baya buƙatar .proto sake tarawa.
cbor.h1_c: An daidaita CBOR azaman RFC 7049 a cikin 2013, an sabunta shi zuwa RFC 8949 a cikin 2020. An yi amfani da shi ta hanyar Sigina (firam ɗin ciki tun 2017), Matrix's state-Resolution Layer, WebAuthns objects. An zaɓi ta Vortex a cikin v0.0.2 bayan kwatanta da JSON da protobuf.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR encoding: {manyan_type (3 ragowa), hujja (5 ragowa), [data]}
taswira: type=5 nau'i-nau'i
array: type=4 abubuwa
rubutu: type=3 bytes
bytes: type=2 raw
cbor.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
cbor.h2_a: Kowane ambulan saƙo, kowane bulo-bulo na turawa, kowane ambulaf ɗin tarayya.

controller.title: Mai sarrafawa
controller.subtitle: Vortex's atestation + sabis na ganowa.
controller.intro: Mai sarrafawa wani tsari ne na Python daban (`vortex_controller`) wanda kawai aikinsa shine buga bayanan da aka sanya hannu (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) da URLs masu shiga. Abokan ciniki suna tura maɓalli na Ed25519 mai sarrafawa a lokacin saki.
controller.h1_a: Mai sarrafawa wani tsari ne na Python daban (`vortex_controller`) wanda kawai aikinsa shine buga bayanan da aka sanya hannu (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) da URLs masu shiga. Abokan ciniki suna tura maɓalli na Ed25519 mai sarrafawa a lokacin saki.
controller.h1_b: Yana fallasa ƙaramin API saman (~ hanyoyi 12). Wurin kunkuntar da gangan ne - shine hari mafi girman ƙimar hari da zarar abokan ciniki sun yi la'akari. Madubai suna gudanar da lamba ɗaya tare da maɓallin saki iri ɗaya; DNS/SNS/IPFS buga lissafin madubai.
controller.h1_c: An gabatar da shi a cikin v0.0.3 bayan sigar farko ta monolith wacce aka ɗaure alamar kumburi ga kumburin kanta (ƙulli mai rikitarwa zai iya yin ƙarya game da lambar sa). Rarraba shaida cikin wani tsari daban wanda aka kera bayan Debian's Release.gpg + tushen kantin Chrome.
controller.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
controller.h3_a: bayyanannen mutunci, maɓallin saki, madubi, trusted_nodes

doubleRatchet.title: Biyu Ratchet
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Siginar-DM ƙa'idar sirrin gaba.
doubleRatchet.intro: Biyu Ratchet ya haɗu da Diffie-Hellman ratchet tare da sarkar maɓalli na simmetric. Kowane sako yana ci gaba da sarkarsa; lokaci-lokaci DH ratchets sake maɓalli tushen. Yana isar da sirrin gaba (saƙonnin da suka gabata amintattu bayan sulhu) da tsaro bayan sulhu (saƙonnin gaba amintattu bayan sake-sake).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Biyu Ratchet ya haɗu da Diffie-Hellman ratchet tare da sarkar maɓalli na simmetric. Kowane sako yana ci gaba da sarkarsa; lokaci-lokaci DH ratchets sake maɓalli tushen. Yana isar da sirrin gaba (saƙonnin da suka gabata amintattu bayan sulhu) da tsaro bayan sulhu (saƙonnin nan gaba amintattu bayan sake-sake).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da Ratchet Biyu don sarƙoƙin saƙon kai tsaye. Dakunan rukuni suna amfani da tsarin maɓalli mai sauƙi wanda aka kulle tushen ɗakin. Tsawon sarkar ya rufe saƙon 1000 kafin a tilasta masa sake ƙulla; cache-maɓalli da aka tsallake-tsallake har zuwa saƙonnin da ba sa-a- oda 1000; boye bayanan kai ta tsohuwa.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Trevor Perrin da Moxie Marlinspike ne suka tsara su a cikin 2013; an tura shi cikin Siginar 2014; WhatsApp (2016) ya karbe shi, Tattaunawar Sirrin Facebook, Tattaunawar sirri ta Skype. Public spec 2016. Vortex aiwatar da ita tashar jiragen ruwa kai tsaye.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
sarkar aikawa: CK_send → HKDF(CK_send, "mataki") → CK_send'
                    MK → HKDF(CK_send, "msg")
sarkar karba: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "mataki") → CK_recv'
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(mu_eph, su_eph), RK_prev)
doubleRatchet.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
doubleRatchet.h3_a: sirrin gaba, tsaro bayan sulhu, X25519

ech.title: ECH
ech.subtitle: Abokin ciniki mai rufaffen Sannu (RFC 9460).
ech.intro: ECH yana ɓoye SNI ( Alamun Sunan uwar garken) akan TLS 1.3 ta hanyar nannade ClientHello na ciki a cikin waje ClientHello rufaffen maɓalli na jama'a da aka buga a cikin rikodin DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_a: ECH yana ɓoye SNI ( Alamun Sunan uwar garken) akan TLS 1.3 ta hanyar nannade ClientHello na ciki a cikin waje ClientHello rufaffen maɓalli na jama'a da aka buga a cikin rikodin DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_b: Vortex nodes suna buga ECHConfigs a cikin DNS HTTPS bayanansu. Abokan ciniki masu goyon bayan ECH suna amfani da sunan mai masaukin waje (misali `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) azaman bayyane SNI; Masu lura da hankali suna ganin wannan babban suna ne kawai. DPI ba zai iya gaya wa abokin ciniki Vortex daga kowane abokin ciniki Cloudflare.
ech.h1_c: ECH ya wuce 5 IETF zane kafin daidaitawa kamar yadda RFC 9460 a cikin 2024. bambance-bambancen da suka gabata: ESNI (2018-2019, watsi), ECH daftarin-00 zuwa zane-13-2042. An kunna Chrome ECH ta tsohuwa a cikin 2023; Firefox a cikin 2024. Vortex yana goyan bayan sa tun v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
waje SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← bayyane ga masu kallo
ciki SNI: "node.vortex.example" ← rufaffen
ECHConfig: an buga shi a cikin DNS HTTPS rikodin yanki na waje
ech.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

ed25519.title: Bayani na 25519
ed25519.subtitle: Sa hannun EdDSA akan edwards25519 (RFC 8032).
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 tsarin sa hannu ne na elliptic-curve. Maɓallan jama'a 32-byte, sa hannu 64-byte, sa hannu mai ƙayyadaddun ta tsohuwa. Tabbatarwa da sauri (~ 200µs akan zamani CPU), tabbataccen tsari.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 tsarin sa hannu ne na elliptic-curve. Maɓallan jama'a 32-byte, sa hannu 64-byte, sa hannu mai ƙayyadaddun ta tsohuwa. Tabbatarwa da sauri (~ 200µs akan zamani CPU), tabbataccen tsari.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex alamun kowane ambulaf na tarayya, kowane mutunci bayyananne, kowane shaida, da kowane saƙon bot tare da Ed25519. Apple's CryptoKit akan iOS 17+ yana amfani da bambance-bambancen RFC 8032bis bazuwar; Vortex yana karɓar ko ɗaya - duk wani mai tabbatarwa yana ɗaukar duka biyun.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 aka buga ta Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang a cikin 2011. Daidaita kamar RFC 8032 a cikin 2017. An karbo ta OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple siginar-prochain, Keytocol. An zaɓi rattaba hannu a kai a kai sama da ECDSA don guje wa ECDSA RNG-sake amfani da aji mai rauni.
ed25519.h1_f:
Alamar (d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m)
              R = da G
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m)
              S = r + c · a
              dawo (R, S)
Tabbatar: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
ed25519.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
ed25519.h3_a: X25519, ECDSA, sa hannu, sirrin gaba

fanout.title: Fan-fita
fanout.subtitle: Watsa taron daga tushe ɗaya zuwa masu biyan kuɗi da yawa.
fanout.intro: Fan-out shine tsarin gine-gine inda mai samarwa ɗaya ke fitar da wani taron kuma masu amfani da N suna karɓar shi. A cikin Layer Vortex's WebSocket, saƙo guda POST yana jawo N soket yana aika - ɗaya kowane mai biyan kuɗi a cikin ɗakin.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out shine tsarin gine-gine inda mai samarwa ɗaya ke fitar da wani taron kuma masu amfani da N suna karɓar shi. A cikin Layer Vortex's WebSocket, saƙo guda POST yana jawo N soket yana aika - ɗaya kowane mai biyan kuɗi a cikin ɗakin.
fanout.h1_b: An aiwatar da shi azaman saitin kowane ɗaki na WebSocket hannaye wanda asyncio.Lock ke kiyaye shi. Rubuta abin da aka samu, kwafi saitin, sakewa, sannan maimaita kwafin jiran `ws.send_bytes(load)' tare da ƙarewar kowane socket 1 s. Masu amfani da sannu a hankali suna da layin firam 256 kafin faɗuwar firam.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out yana komawa don bugawa/tsarin biyan kuɗi a cikin 1980s (POP, TIBCO). Zane-zane na zamani (Kafka, Redis mashaya/sub, NATS) suna daidaita tsarin zuwa miliyoyin masu biyan kuɗi. Vortex's per-room in-memory fan-out yayi kadan saboda baya buƙatar kwafin kullin giciye a yanayin kumburi ɗaya; Redis mashaya/sub yana kunna a cikin rukunin kundila da yawa.
fanout.h1_f:
watsawa (room_id, kaya):
  subs = fanout[room_id] # O (1) duba
  don ws a cikin hoto (hanyoyi): # kwafi don maimaitawa lafiya
      jira ws.send_bytes(nauyin kaya, ƙarewa = 1s)
fanout.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
fanout.h2_a: `app/chats/fanout.py`, mafi kyawun hanya don kowane saƙo, amsawa, taron buga rubutu, siginar kira.
fanout.h3_a: WebSocket, mai biyan kuɗi, Redis mashaya/sub, jerin gwano

fcm.title: FCM
fcm.subtitle: Saƙon Cloud na Firebase.
fcm.intro: FCM shine sabis na sanarwar turawa na Google don Android, iOS, yanar gizo. Maye gurbin tsohon Google Saƙon gajimare (GCM) a cikin 2016. Ya yarda OAuth2 auth sabis-account.
fcm.h1_a: FCM shine sabis na sanarwar turawa na Google don Android, iOS, yanar gizo. Maye gurbin tsohon Google Saƙon gajimare (GCM) a cikin 2016. Ya yarda OAuth2 auth sabis-account.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da FCM a yanayin 'bayanai' (ba yanayin 'sanarwa' ba) don haka Sabis ɗin FirebaseMessaging na app yana gudana lokacin isowa kuma yana ɓoye kayan aikin da aka rufe kafin yanke shawarar ko za a nuna banner. Hakanan farkawa na isar da shiru suna amfani da saƙon bayanai FCM.
fcm.h1_c: An ƙaddamar da FCM a cikin 2016 wanda ya maye gurbin GCM. Ƙarshen ƙarshen HTTP an soke shi a cikin 2024; Vortex yana amfani da ƙarshen HTTP v1 tare da OAuth2. Juyawar alamar kowace sa'a ana sarrafa ta ta hanyar haɗe-haɗen bayanan bayanan sabis-asusu.
fcm.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
fcm.h3_a: APNs, Gidan Yanar Gizo, tura hatimi, OAuth2

federation.title: Tarayyar
federation.subtitle: Isar da saƙon amincewa da juna tsakanin nodes Vortex masu zaman kansu.
federation.intro: Tarayyar ita ce hanyar haɗin kai ta aminci tsakanin ma'aikatan kumburi guda biyu. Kowannen yana ƙara maɓalli na Ed25519 zuwa teburin 'taurayi'. Masu amfani a kumburin A na iya aika masu amfani da su akan kumburin B ta hanyar jigilar ambulaf ta hanyar sa hannu `POST / tarayya/ba da'.
federation.h1_a: Tarayyar ita ce hanyar haɗin kai ta aminci tsakanin ma'aikatan kumburi guda biyu. Kowannen yana ƙara maɓalli na Ed25519 zuwa teburin 'taurayi'. Masu amfani a kumburin A na iya aika masu amfani da su akan kumburin B ta hanyar jigilar ambulaf ta hanyar sa hannu `POST / tarayya/ba da'.
federation.h1_b: Ficewar shiga kowane ma'aikaci: babu "kowanne kumburi zai iya tarayya" tsoho. Ƙara takwarorinsu yana buƙatar aikin gudanarwa mai sa hannun mai aiki. Makin lafiya (AIMD ±1) dakatar da tarayya ga takwarorinsu na rashin da'a. Akwatin fitarwa ya yi nasarar isar da saƙo tare da madaidaicin baya har zuwa kwanaki 14.
federation.h1_c: Ƙungiyar ta kasance fasalin kisa na Matrix (2014) kuma kafin wannan XMPP/Jabber (1999). Ƙirar Vortex ta zana daga duka biyun: envelopes da aka sanya hannu (Matrix), amintattun anchors (ba mu da ƙarfi), maki lafiya (AIMD daga TCP). An ƙara a cikin v0.0.5.
federation.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

fts5.title: FTS5
fts5.subtitle: Teburin bincike mai cikakken rubutu na SQLite.
fts5.intro: FTS5 shine tsawaita binciken cikakken rubutu na ƙarni na biyar na SQLite. Ƙirƙirar tebur mai kama-da-wane wanda ke adana alamun alamun don saurin LIKE / MATCH tambayoyin.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 shine tsawaita binciken cikakken rubutu na ƙarni na biyar na SQLite. Ƙirƙirar tebur mai kama-da-wane wanda ke adana alamun alamun don saurin LIKE / MATCH tambayoyin.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex madubi alamomin rubutu (wanda aka rufaffen rufaffen abokin ciniki azaman alamar mara kyau) zuwa cikin tebur mai kama da FTS5 don haka bincike ya buga `O(log n)` maimakon 'O(n)' dubawa. Akan Dakin Android, FTS4 ana amfani da shi tare da abubuwan motsa jiki waɗanda ke ci gaba da daidaita tebur ɗin kama-da-wane. Aiwatar da Postgres suna amfani da `tsvector` / `tsquery` don wannan manufa.
fts5.h1_c: FTS ya koma SQLite 3.7 (2010). FTS5 an aika a cikin SQLite 3.9 (2015). Yadu karbuwa; kowane aikace-aikacen saƙon farko na gida akan iOS / Android yana amfani da shi. Postgres yana da 'tsvector' tun daga 8.3 (2008).
fts5.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

gossip.title: Ƙarfafawa
gossip.subtitle: Musanyar jeri-na-fito na lokaci-lokaci tsakanin nodes Vortex.
gossip.intro: Gossip ƙa'ida ce mai inganci ta hanyar bandwidth inda kowane kumburi lokaci-lokaci yana musayar taƙaitaccen ilimin tare da ɗan ƙwararru. Bayan lokaci kowane kumburi yana haɗuwa zuwa ra'ayi iri ɗaya ba tare da jagorar tsakiya ba.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip ƙa'ida ce mai inganci ta hanyar bandwidth inda kowane kumburi lokaci-lokaci yana musayar taƙaitaccen ilimin tare da ɗan ƙwararru. Bayan lokaci kowane kumburi yana haɗuwa zuwa ra'ayi iri ɗaya ba tare da jagorar tsakiya ba.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex nodes suna tsegumi kowane daƙiƙa 60. Kowane musayar shine 256-bit Bloom tace yana taƙaita sanannun takwarorinsu; 6angaren ya amsa da takwarorinsa suka bace daga tace da nashi tace. Bandwidth shine O (sabon takwarorinsu × 32 B), yawanci ƙasa da 1 KiB kowane zagaye.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-tace tsegumi kwanakin zuwa ga Cornell's 1998 bimodal multicast paper. Apache Cassandra yana amfani da shi don zama memba; Bitcoin don musayar ciniki; IPFS don DHT kulawa. Haɗin O(log N) shine abin da ya sa ya zama mai amfani ga manyan cibiyoyin sadarwa.
gossip.h1_f:
musayar (A, B):
  A → B: filter_A = saka_duk (takwarorinsu_A, k=5, m=256)
  B → A: new_peers_for_A = {p ∈ peers_B : p ∉ filter_A}, filter_B
  A tsantsa kamar haka
iyaka iyaka: 1 musanya da takwarorinsu na 30 s
gossip.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

gravitix.title: Gravitix
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex's DSL don rubuta bots.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix harshe ne na musamman na yanki da aka tsara don rubuta Vortex bots. Masu sarrafa abubuwan da suka faru ('kan / farawa {emit "hi"}'), ginannen jihar, ƙaramin tukunyar jirgi. An haɗa shi zuwa bytecode kuma ana gudanar da shi a cikin mai fassarar sandbox.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix harshe ne na musamman na yanki da aka tsara don rubuta Vortex bots. Masu sarrafa abubuwan da suka faru ('kan / farawa {emit "hi"}'), ginannen jihar, ƙaramin tukunyar jirgi. An haɗa shi zuwa bytecode kuma ana gudanar da shi a cikin mai fassarar sandbox.
gravitix.h1_b: Madadin Python SDK. Gravitix bots ba za su iya shiga tsarin fayil ko hanyar sadarwa ta sabani ba - kawai saman Vortex's API. Compiler yana samar da bytecode; lokacin gudu Rust a cikin fassarar `Gravitix/`. Cikakken bayani a cikin babin docs Gravitix.
gravitix.h1_c: An ƙirƙira shi yayin v0.0.6 bayan lura da cewa yawancin bot code shine 80 % SDK tukunyar jirgi a kusa da ƙaramin kwaya na ainihin dabaru. A DSL yana ba da damar basirar haske da haɗarin akwatin yashi. Irin wannan a cikin ruhu zuwa Hubot (2011) amma tare da tsananin sandboxing da haɗin kai na Vortex na asali.
gravitix.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` tushen repo, filin lambar bot a cikin `POST /api/bots`.

hkdf.title: HKDF
hkdf.subtitle: HMAC tushen Maɓalli Maɓalli Aiki (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF aiki ne na maɓalli na mataki biyu: Cire yana matsawa maɓallin shigarwa cikin maɓallin bazuwar (PRK); Fadada yana shimfiɗa PRK cikin kayan fitarwa na kowane tsayi, rabu da alamun bayanai.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF aiki ne na maɓalli na mataki biyu: Cire yana matsawa maɓallin shigarwa cikin maɓallin bazuwar (PRK); Fadada yana shimfiɗa PRK cikin kayan fitarwa na kowane tsayi, rabu da alamun bayanai.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da HKDF-SHA256 ko'ina: raba X25519 raba sirrin cikin ɓoyewa + MAC + maɓallan kai, samun maɓallan fayil guda ɗaya, samun maɓallan madadin daga fitowar Argon2id. Zaɓuɓɓukan bayanai koyaushe suna ɗaukar prefix na sigar (misali "v1: boye-boye") don haka gabaɗayan tsarin maɓalli na iya juyawa ta hanyar bumping v1 → v2.
hkdf.h1_c: Hugo Krawczyk ne ya buga a EUROCRYPT 2010; daidaita kamar RFC 5869 a wannan shekarar. Ana amfani da TLS 1.3 don jadawalin sa, Sigina don Ratchet Biyu, WireGuard don maɓallan zaman.
hkdf.h1_f:
Cire: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(gishiri, IKM)
Fadada: T (1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, bayani ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ info ∥ i)
          OKM = T (1) ∥ T(2) ∥… an yanke zuwa ruwan tabarau
hkdf.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

hmac.title: HMAC
hmac.subtitle: Lambar Tabbatar da Saƙo ta tushen Hash (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC gini ne da ke juya duk wani zanta (SHA-256, SHA-512) zuwa MAC. Yana ba da gaskiya da tabbatarwa da aka ba da sirrin da aka raba.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC gini ne da ke juya duk wani zanta (SHA-256, SHA-512) zuwa MAC. Yana ba da gaskiya da tabbatarwa da aka ba da sirrin da aka raba.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da HMAC-SHA256 a cikin HKDF, don JWT sa hannu (HS256), don aika_pseudo derivation a dakuna, da kuma coturn TURN sa hannun takardar shaidar. Ana buƙatar kwatancen lokaci-lokaci a gefen tabbatarwa - `hmac.compare_digest` a cikin Python.
hmac.h1_c: Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk ne ya gabatar da HMAC a cikin 1996. An daidaita shi azaman RFC 2104 (1997) da FIPS 198 (2002). Ya zama tsoho MAC a cikin TLS, IPsec, SSH. Sigina, Matrix, Discord, Slack duk suna amfani da HMAC-SHA256 don JWT da alamun zaman.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(key, msg) = H((key ⊕ opad) ∥H((key ⊕ ipad) ∥ msg) )
  inda opad = 0x5c maimaita, ipad = 0x36 maimaita, toshe girman matches H
hmac.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
hmac.h2_a: Ko'ina a cikin tarin crypto. Grep don `hmac_sha256` ko `HKDF`.

ice.title: ICE
ice.subtitle: Ƙirƙirar Haɗin Sadarwa (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE shine hanyar WebRTC don nemo hanyar hanyar sadarwa tsakanin takwarorinsu biyu a bayan NATs. Takwarorinsu suna ƙididdige ƴan takara (mai masaukin baki, uwar garken-reflexive, relay), musanya su, da gwada nau'i-nau'i har sai ɗaya ya yi nasara.
ice.h1_a: ICE shine hanyar WebRTC don nemo hanyar hanyar sadarwa tsakanin takwarorinsu biyu a bayan NATs. Takwarorinsu suna ƙididdige ƴan takara (mai masaukin baki, uwar garken-reflexive, relay), musanya su, da gwada nau'i-nau'i har sai ɗaya ya yi nasara.
ice.h1_b: Dillalan node Vortex ICE musayar dan takara ta hanyar sigina WebSocket. coturn yana bayar da STUN (don gano srflx) da TURN (don relay lokacin da hanyoyin kai tsaye suka gaza). Ana ba da takaddun shaida na ɗan gajeren lokaci HMAC kowane kira.
ice.h1_c: An daidaita ICE azaman RFC 5245 (2010) kuma an sabunta shi azaman RFC 8445 (2018). Bayan dillali-grade NAT, hanyoyin kai tsaye suna kasa ~15% na lokaci - TURN relay ba zai yuwu ba. WebRTC sanya ICE na al'ada; kowane samfurin kiran bidiyo yana amfani da shi.
ice.h1_f:
'yan takara:
  Mai watsa shiri: rtp://192.168.1.5:49152 (na gida IP)
  srflx: rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-an gano adireshin jama'a)
  relay: rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (TURN-wanda aka ware)
duban biyu: STUN Buƙatun Binding; biyu na farko don cin nasara = zaba
ice.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, coturn, NAT traversal

jwt.title: JWT
jwt.subtitle: JSON Alamar Yanar Gizo (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT ƙaƙƙarfan tsarin alama ne wanda ya ƙunshi sassa uku masu tushe64-url: kan kai, kaya (ƙirara), sa hannu. An yi amfani da shi don tabbatar da zaman mara jiha.
jwt.h1_a: JWT ƙaƙƙarfan tsarin alama ne wanda ya ƙunshi sassa uku masu tushe64-url: kan kai, kaya (ƙirara), sa hannu. An yi amfani da shi don tabbatar da zaman mara jiha.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWTs. Alamar shiga tana ɗaukar `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Alamar wartsakewa `typ: refresh`, 30 d TTL. An sanya hannu akan sirrin 64-byte daga `.env`. Babu m da'awar wuce user_id.
jwt.h1_c: An daidaita JWTs azaman RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 ya shahara tun daga 2012. Shekaru goma na sukar: hare-haren alg-rikitarwa, rashin sokewa. Vortex ragewa: HS256 kawai (babu RS/ES rudani), jti-keyed (wanda za'a iya sokewa ta na'urorin mai amfani).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE
header = base64url ({alg: "HS256", buga: "JWT"})
kaya = base64url ({sub, jti, typ, exp})
sig = base64url (HMAC-SHA256 (asiri, kai + "." + biya))
jwt.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, Alamar refresh, alamar shiga

kyber.title: Kybar-768
kyber.subtitle: Maɓallin maɓalli na bayan-ƙira (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (a hukumance ML-KEM-768) shine ingantacciyar hanyar ɗaukar maɓalli na maɓalli na NIST. Maɓallan jama'a 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte musayar sirri. Tsaro ya ragu zuwa Module-LWE, an yi imani da yawa-hard.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (a hukumance ML-KEM-768) shine ingantacciyar hanyar ɗaukar maɓalli na maɓalli na NIST. Maɓallan jama'a 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte musayar sirri. Tsaro ya ragu zuwa Module-LWE, an yi imani da yawa-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da Kyber na zaɓi a cikin nau'ikan nau'ikan nau'ikan: `zaman_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="zama-v1")`. Idan rabi ya riƙe, zaman yana da lafiya. Shiga cikin v0.1, kan-ta-tsohuwar da aka tsara don v0.2. Farashin: ~2 KB karin musafaha kowane lokaci; latency rashin kula.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber yana ɗaya daga cikin ~70 ƙaddamarwa zuwa gasar NIST's PQ (2016). An zaɓa don daidaitawa a cikin Yuli 2022; An kammala shi azaman FIPS 203 a watan Agusta 2024. Chrome ya kunna hybrid Kyber a cikin TLS 1.3 a cikin 2024. Sigina ya ƙara shi zuwa ƙa'idarsu a wannan shekarar.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Decaps (sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
matasan = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, "zama-v1")
kyber.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
kyber.h3_a: X25519, HKDF, juriya ga adadi, matasan KEM

mailbox.title: Akwatin wasiku
mailbox.subtitle: Wurin ajiya mai adireshin mai karɓa a cikin BMP.
mailbox.intro: Akwatin wasiku shine taƙaitaccen bayanin BMP don "wurin da saƙon da aka bayar don jiran mai karɓa". An gano ta ta akwatin saƙo mai lamba 32 da aka samo daga maɓalli na mai karɓa ta HKDF.
mailbox.h1_a: Akwatin wasiku shine taƙaitaccen bayanin BMP don "wurin da saƙon da aka bayar don jiran mai karɓa". An gano ta ta akwatin saƙo mai lamba 32 da aka samo daga maɓalli na mai karɓa ta HKDF.
mailbox.h1_b: Mai aikawa (wanda ya san recipient_pubkey) da mai karɓa (wanda ya san nasu maɓalli) ne kawai za su iya ƙididdige akwatin saƙon da aka bayar. Ƙungiyoyin tsakiya suna ganin kawai mai gano mai 32-byte mara kyau. Kowane akwatin wasiku yana da TTL 7200 s da ma'aunin ajiya 500 MB kowace kumburi.
mailbox.h1_c: Kalmar ta fito ne daga imel na gargajiya. BMP yana aron misalin amma yana sanya mai karɓar akwatin wasiku ya samo asali maimakon sabar-sabar da aka tanadar - babu matakin "akwatin wasiƙu", babu uwar garken da ya san ko wane adireshi ya wanzu.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(mai karɓa_pubkey, info = "bmp-v1", len=32)
kawai mai aikawa (ya san recipient_pk) da mai karɓa (ya san pk kansa) zai iya ƙididdigewa
mailbox.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
mailbox.h3_a: BMP, tsegumi, HKDF, mai aikawa da hatimi

nonce.title: Babu komai
nonce.subtitle: Lambar da aka yi amfani da ita sau ɗaya - ƙimar amfani lokaci ɗaya.
nonce.intro: Nonce ƙima ce wacce ba za ta taɓa maimaitawa ƙarƙashin maɓalli da aka bayar ba. A cikin Vortex kowane aikin AES-GCM yana amfani da sabon bazuwar 96-bit bazuwar. Sake yin amfani da maɓalli ɗaya tare da maɓalli iri ɗaya yana lalata sirri da sahihanci - mai kai hari mai rubutu guda biyu a ƙarƙashin ɗaya (maɓalli, babu) zai iya dawo da bayanan XORs.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce ƙima ce wacce ba za ta taɓa maimaitawa ƙarƙashin maɓalli da aka bayar ba. A cikin Vortex kowane aikin AES-GCM yana amfani da sabon bazuwar 96-bit bazuwar. Sake yin amfani da maɓalli ɗaya tare da maɓalli iri ɗaya yana lalata sirri da sahihanci - mai kai hari mai rubutu guda biyu a ƙarƙashin ɗaya (maɓalli, babu) zai iya dawo da bayanan XORs.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex yana haifar da rashin fahimta tare da OS CSPRNG (`asiri.token_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.security.SecureRandom`). Ranar haihuwar da aka ɗaure da 96 bits: ~ 2^32 saƙonni kafin karo ya zama abin sani, fiye da yadda kowane maɓallin ɗaki yake gani a rayuwarsa. Ƙaddamar da kwafin-nonce bin diddigin akan kumburi azaman bel-da-supenders.
nonce.h1_c: Ma'anar da ba ta dace ba ta daɗe a cikin cryptography; kalmar kanta ta fito ne daga Tsohon Turanci "don sau ɗaya". Shawarar 96-bit ta GCM tana daga NIST SP 800-38D. Laifin Adobe 2013 sanannen abin da aka dawo da rubutu a bayyane daga maimaitawa akan abokin ciniki RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P( karo) a 10⁹ AES-GCM nonces = ~10⁻¹⁹
daurin ranar haihuwa: ana sa ran karon farko kusan 2⁸ nonces kowane maɓalli
GCM aminci: 2³² bazuwar nonces kowane maɓalli kafin ɗaure ƙasƙanci
nonce.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
nonce.h2_a: Kowane AES-GCM kira. Counter yana bin tsaro a cikin 'app/security/crypto.py'.
nonce.h3_a: AES-GCM, CSPRNG, ranar haihuwa daure, AEAD

ohttp.title: OHTTP
ohttp.subtitle: Gafala HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP ƙa'ida ce ta relayed HTTP buƙatun inda babu wata ƙungiya da ta ga buƙatun da amsa. Abokin ciniki yana aikawa ta hanyar relay wanda ke zazzage masu kai hari; gudun ba da sanda ya tura zuwa gateway wanda ya yanke kuma ya amsa.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP ƙa'ida ce ta relayed HTTP buƙatun inda babu wata ƙungiya da ta ga buƙatun da amsa. Abokin ciniki yana aikawa ta hanyar relay wanda ke zazzage masu kai hari; gudun ba da sanda ya tura zuwa gateway wanda ya yanke kuma ya amsa.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex yana amfani da OHTTP azaman Layer-5 stealth fallback. Haɗe da sabis ɗin albasa da BMP, OHTTP yana ba da hanya ta ƙarshe lokacin da aka toshe TLS. Relay ƙungiya ce ta keɓance amana (yawanci Cloudflare ko Apple kayan aikin saƙon sirri na sirri).
ohttp.h1_c: An daidaita OHTTP azaman RFC 9458 a cikin 2024, wanda Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla suka rubuta tare. Apple's iCloud Private Relay (2021) shine farkon OHTTP-kusa da turawa. Vortex an ƙara OHTTP goyan bayan baya a cikin v0.0.9.
ohttp.h1_f:
abokin ciniki → relay: Encrypt_gateway_pub(buƙata) + bazuwar bayanin hanya
relay → ƙofa: gaba, tsiri masu gano abokan ciniki
ƙofa → amsa: yankewa, tsari, Encrypt_client_pub(amsa)
relay → abokin ciniki: mayar da martani

onion.title: Albasa sabis
onion.subtitle: Tor boye sabis.
onion.intro: Sabis na albasa sabis ne na TCP ana samun dama ta hanyar ka'idar rendezvous na Tor. An gano shi ta hanyar adireshin albasa (bassan haruffa 56 na maɓalli na Ed25519 akan v3). Babu jama'a IP, babu DNS, babu cibiyar rajista.
onion.h1_a: Sabis na albasa sabis ne na TCP ana samun dama ta hanyar ka'idar rendezvous na Tor. An gano shi ta hanyar adireshin albasa (bassan haruffa 56 na maɓalli na Ed25519 akan v3). Babu jama'a IP, babu DNS, babu cibiyar rajista.
onion.h1_b: Kowane kumburin Vortex yana fallasa kansa a matsayin `.albasa` kamar yadda al'ada HTTPS karshen. Abokan ciniki tare da tallafin Tor sun fada cikin albasa lokacin da komai ya gaza. Bandwidth yana ~ 10 × a hankali amma ana iya samunsa a cikin cibiyoyin sadarwa cikakke.
onion.h1_c: Ayyukan Albasa sun koma Tor 2004 (v1). An sake gina shi azaman sabis na albasa v3 a cikin 2017 tare da maɓallan Ed25519. SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica ke amfani da shi, duk manyan ƙungiyoyin crypto-aware. Ƙara siginar isar da sabis na albasa a cikin 2022.
onion.h1_f:
adireshin = base32 (Ed25519_pubkey ∥ checksum ∥ version_byte) ∥ "albasa"
          = haruffa 56 akan albasa v3
onion.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
onion.h2_a: `/etc/tor/torrc` a cikin `deploy/`, wanda aka buga ta hanyar mai sarrafawa `/v1/mirrors`.

prekey.title: Prekey
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey da aka buga kafin lokaci don bootstrap na sababbin DMs.
prekey.intro: Maɓallin maɓalli shine X25519 maɓalli da aka buga zuwa kumburin gaba da buƙatu don haka sabbin lambobin sadarwa za su iya fara rufaffen tattaunawa ba tare da tafiya zagaye ba. Kowane mai amfani yana loda tsari (maɓalli 10 ta tsohuwa); uwar garken yana yi musu hidima akan buƙata; abokin ciniki uploads more lokacin da ƙasa.
prekey.h1_a: Maɓallin maɓalli shine X25519 maɓalli da aka buga zuwa kumburin gaba da buƙatu don haka sabbin lambobin sadarwa za su iya fara rufaffen tattaunawa ba tare da tafiya zagaye ba. Kowane mai amfani yana loda tsari (maɓalli 10 ta tsohuwa); uwar garken yana yi musu hidima akan buƙata; abokin ciniki uploads more lokacin da ƙasa.
prekey.h1_b: Kundin farko na Vortex yana da sanya hannu ta hanyar maɓalli na ainihi na na'urar don haka maharin ba zai iya musanya pre-keys na jabu koda tare da samun damar matakin node ba. Sabbin DMs suna amfani da Diffie-Hellman mai zagaye-ɗaya a kan sabon maɓalli kafin Biyu Ratchet ya shiga.
prekey.h1_c: Prekeys daga siginar ƙirar yarjejeniya ta 2013 (X3DH). Kafin X3DH, rufaffen bootstrap yana buƙatar tafiye-tafiye na aiki tare - mara kyau don saƙon asynchronous. Kowane amintaccen manzo na zamani yana amfani da takalmin rigar maɓalli.

prekey.h3_a: X25519, Biyu Ratchet, X3DH, musayar maɓalli

reality.title: Gaskiya
reality.subtitle: TLS-cikin-TLS maskrade stealth Transport.
reality.intro: Gaskiyar jigilar kaya ce mai ɓoyewa wacce ke yin kama da TLS zuwa ainihin babban fasahar fasaha (yawanci www.microsoft.com). Makasudin musafaha na waje Microsoft; musafaha na ciki shine Vortex. Ana gabatar da bincike mai aiki da ke kan waje zuwa ainihin asalin don haka bincike bai bayyana komai ba.
reality.h1_a: Gaskiyar jigilar kaya ce mai ɓoyewa wacce ke yin kama da TLS zuwa ainihin babban fasahar fasaha (yawanci www.microsoft.com). Makasudin musafaha na waje Microsoft; musafaha na ciki shine Vortex. Ana gabatar da bincike mai aiki da ke kan waje zuwa ainihin asalin don haka bincike bai bayyana komai ba.
reality.h1_b: Vortex yana goyan bayan Reality azaman jigilar kaya na Level-4. Config yana ƙayyade maƙasudin maƙasudin, gajerun IDs, da maɓallin jama'a Vortex X25519. Uwar garken yana tabbatar da abokan ciniki masu shigowa ta gajeren-ID wasa; binciken da ba su dace ba suna samun martani na asali.

musafaha na waje: TLS zuwa Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
ciki (idan auth ok): Vortex zirga-zirga akan tashar bayanai

rbac.title: RBAC
rbac.subtitle: Ikon Samun Mahimmancin Matsayi.
rbac.intro: RBAC samfuri ne na sarrafawa inda ake ba da izini ga ayyuka kuma ana ba masu amfani ayyukan. Vortex yana amfani da matakin uku RBAC kowane daki: mai> admin> memba.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC samfuri ne na sarrafawa inda ake ba da izini ga ayyuka kuma ana ba masu amfani ayyukan. Vortex yana amfani da matakin uku RBAC kowane daki: mai> admin> memba.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: masu mallakar suna da kowane ikon gudanarwa tare da keɓancewar ikon share ɗakin ko canja wurin mallakar mallaka. Admins gayyata, shura, bebe, gyara saitunan ɗaki. Membobi suna aika saƙonni, amsawa, gyara saƙonnin nasu. Ana yin rikodin canje-canjen rawar aiki azaman saƙonnin tsarin don haka kowane memba ya gan su.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC azaman samfuri na yau da kullun zuwa takarda ta NIST ta 1992 ta Ferraiolo & Kuhn. Ya zama na yau da kullun a cikin kasuwancin IAM (AWS, Azure) a cikin 2010s. Matsayin ɗaki RBAC daidai yake a samfuran taɗi - IRC's ops/murya/mai amfani (1988), Matsayin Discord (2015), Slack's admin/memba/bako.
rbac.h1_f:
matsayin: mai ⊃ admin ⊃ memba
canja wuri: mai shi ya kafa new_owner_id → tsohon mai shi da aka rage zuwa admin
soke: admin na iya rage mamba; mai shi zai iya rage admin
rbac.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, an duba kowace hanya ta rubutu ta hanyar `app/chats/permissions.py`.

sfu.title: SFU
sfu.subtitle: Sashin Gabatar da Zaɓaɓɓen.
sfu.intro: An SFU akwatin tsakiya ne wanda ke haɗa kafofin watsa labarai a cikin kiran rukuni. Kowane ɗan takara yana loda rafi ɗaya; SFU yana turawa ga sauran. Yana maye gurbin cikakken ragar topology (kowane takwarorinsa yana ɓoye rafukan N-1) inda sikelin shine O(N²).
sfu.h1_a: An SFU akwatin tsakiya ne wanda ke haɗa kafofin watsa labarai a cikin kiran rukuni. Kowane ɗan takara yana loda rafi ɗaya; SFU yana turawa ga sauran. Yana maye gurbin cikakken jigon topology (kowane takwarorinsa yana ɓoye rafukan N-1) inda sikelin shine O(N²).
sfu.h1_b: Ana aiwatar da Vortex's SFU a cikin Rust don yin aiki. Simulcast-sane: kowane mai kira yana ɓoye ƙuduri uku a lokaci guda; SFU yana zaɓar wanda ya dace akan kowane mai kallo ya ruwaito. Ƙungiyoyi masu sauti kawai har zuwa mahalarta 100; ƙungiyoyin bidiyo har zuwa 32 (v0.3 taswirar hanya).
sfu.h1_c: SFU kwanakin gine-gine zuwa Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Kafin SFU, WebRTC kira na rukuni ya kasance cikakke-mesh. Zuƙowa, Google Haɗu, Jitsi, kiran ƙungiyar sigina duk suna amfani SFU. Vortex ƙungiyoyin odiyo kawai da aka aika cikin v0.0.8.
sfu.h1_f:
cikakken raga (N takwarorinsu): kowanne yana aika rafukan N-1 → O(N²) uplink
SFU (N peers): kowanne yana aika rafi 1 → O(N) uplink kowane takwarorina
simulcast: L1 (ƙananan) + L2 (tsakiyar) + L3 (high) rikodin lokaci guda
SFU yana zabar Layer kowane mai kallo dangane da BWE-rahoton downlink
sfu.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

snowflake.title: Dusar ƙanƙara
snowflake.subtitle: Tor na sa kai-relay sufuri sama da WebRTC.

snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake shine jigilar kayan aikin Tor Project inda masu binciken sa kai ke aiki azaman relays WebRTC. Masu amfani suna shigar da tsawo na burauza kuma mai binciken su ya zama relay yayin da suke da shafin budewa.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex yana karɓar Snowflake azaman koma baya na Layer-4 lokacin da aka toshe TLS da abubuwan sufuri na farko. Babu infra da ake buƙata a gefenmu - muna buƙatar gadoji na Snowflake da aka buga a sanannun wurare. Masu ba da agaji da ke tafiyar da haɓaka suna ba da murfin.
snowflake.h1_c: An ƙaddamar da Snowflake a cikin 2020 azaman maye gurbin Tor Project na obfs4 (wanda ya zama mai iya yin sawun yatsa). Jirgin WebRTC yana da wahalar toshewa domin yin hakan zai karya yawancin kiran bidiyo na halal. Vortex ƙara tallafi a cikin v0.0.9.
snowflake.h1_f:
abokin ciniki → Dillalin Snowflake: "Ina bukatan wakili"
dillali matches tare da sa kai browser gudu gudu
mai sa kai → Shigar Tor: tura zirga-zirgar abokin ciniki akan WebRTC

tls13.subtitle: Tsaro Layer Tsaro, sigar 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 shine sigar halin yanzu na ka'idar TLS. Yana kawar da abubuwan da ba su da aminci (RSA musanya maɓalli, CBC MACs, a tsaye ECDH), yana sauƙaƙa musafaha zuwa zagaye ɗaya, yana ba da umarnin sirrin gaba.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 shine sigar halin yanzu na ka'idar TLS. Yana kawar da abubuwan da ba su da aminci (RSA musanya maɓalli, CBC MACs, a tsaye ECDH), yana sauƙaƙa musafaha zuwa zagaye ɗaya, yana ba da umarnin sirrin gaba.
tls13.h1_b: Kowane HTTPS + WSS + haɗin tarayya a cikin Vortex yana amfani da TLS 1.3. Mun dace da Client 120 na ChromeHello byte-for-byte don haka DPI ba zai iya buga mana yatsa a matsayin mai lilo ba. ECH ( rufaffen SNI) ana shiga ta hanyar waje-SNI saitin.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 an daidaita shi azaman RFC 8446 a watan Agusta 2018 bayan shekaru 4 da zane 28. Chrome, Firefox, Safari jigilar tallafi a cikin 2018. Microsoft sun ƙara shi zuwa Windows a cikin 2020. Zuwa 2022 shine yawancin zirga-zirgar yanar gizo.
tls13.h1_f:
musafaha (1-RTT):
  Abokin ciniki → Sabar: ClientHello (key_share, SNI?, ALPN, …)
  Sabar → Abokin ciniki: ServerHello + Rufaffen Extensions + Cert + Takaddun shaida + Gama
  Abokin ciniki → Sabar: Gama + Bayanan Aikace-aikace
tls13.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
tls13.h2_a: Kowane haɗin TLS. Madaidaicin sawun yatsa a cikin `app/transport/stealth_level1.py`.
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS sawun yatsa, JA4, sirrin gaba

totp.title: TOTP
totp.subtitle: Kalmar wucewa ta lokaci ɗaya (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP kalmar sirri ce ta lokaci daya da aka samu daga sirrin sirri da kuma lokacin da ake ciki. Matsakaicin tsoho: mataki na daƙiƙa 30, lambar lambobi 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP kalmar sirri ce ta lokaci daya da aka samu daga sirrin sirri da kuma lokacin da ake ciki. Matsakaicin tsoho: mataki na daƙiƙa 30, lambar lambobi 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: Vortex's 2FA yana amfani da TOTP tare da gazawar RFC. Masu amfani suna duba QR a lokacin yin rajista; lambar da aka ƙirƙira daga ƙa'idar Authenticator ɗin su ta yi daidai da lambar da ake sa ran uwar garken. Ƙimar-iyakantacce zuwa ƙoƙarin 5 a kowane minti 5 kowane mai amfani.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) na Mark Pei wanda aka gina akan HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005). Kafin haka, RSA SecurID yayi amfani da algorithm na mallakar mallaka. Google Authenticator (2010) ya shahara TOTP; kowane 2FA app yanzu yana amfani da shi.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP (k, c) = gangar jikin (HMAC-SHA1 (k, c)) mod 10⁶
taga: ± 1 mataki da aka jure don skew na agogo
totp.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

turn.title: TURN
turn.subtitle: Tafiya Amfani da Relays a kusa da NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN ƙa'ida ce don isar da zirga-zirgar UDP / TCP ta hanyar sabar jama'a lokacin da hanyoyin tsara-zuwa-tsara kai tsaye suka gaza. Ana amfani dashi azaman hanyar koma baya lokacin da ICE mai masaukin baki da 'yan takara masu jujjuyawa sabar ba sa aiki.
turn.h1_a: TURN ƙa'ida ce don isar da zirga-zirgar UDP / TCP ta hanyar sabar jama'a lokacin da hanyoyin tsara-zuwa-tsara kai tsaye suka gaza. Ana amfani dashi azaman hanyar koma baya lokacin da ICE mai masaukin baki da 'yan takara masu jujjuyawa sabar ba sa aiki.
turn.h1_b: Vortex jigilar misalin kwal tare da kowane kumburi. Takardun shaidar ɗan gajeren lokaci ne (sa'o'i 24), sa hannu HMAC, ana bayar da kowane kira. Lokacin da NAT tafiya ta kasa - yawanci a bayan simmetric NAT ko tsayayyen Tacewar zaɓi - duk kafofin watsa labarai suna gudana ta TURN.
turn.h1_c: TURN an fara daidaita shi azaman RFC 5766 (2010), an sabunta shi zuwa RFC 8656 (2020). Ana amfani da kowane WebRTC turawa don ~15% na kira inda hanyoyin kai tsaye suka kasa. coturn shine aiwatar da tushen tushen tushe.
turn.h1_f:
sunan mai amfani = "{expiry_unix}:{user_id}"
kalmar sirri = tushe64 (HMAC-SHA1(asirin_uwar garke, sunan mai amfani))
1⟫ = 24h
coturn ya inganta HMAC akan kowane AUTH; ya ƙi bayan ƙarewa
turn.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

vapid.title: VAPID
vapid.subtitle: Ƙididdigar Sabar Aikace-aikacen Sa-kai (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID guda biyu ne na maɓallan Ed25519 wanda uwar garken aikace-aikacen ke amfani da shi don gano kansa ga masu samar da Gidan Yanar Gizo. Yana kawar da tambayar "wanda aka yarda ya aika" tambayar don turawar Yanar Gizo.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID guda biyu ne na maɓallan Ed25519 wanda uwar garken aikace-aikacen ke amfani da shi don gano kansa ga masu samar da Gidan Yanar Gizo. Yana kawar da tambayar "wanda aka yarda ya aika" tambayar don turawar Yanar Gizo.
vapid.h1_b: Abokin gidan yanar gizo na Vortex yana biyan kuɗi zuwa Gidan Yanar Gizo ta hanyar amfani da maɓallin jama'a VAPID. An rufaffen abubuwan biyan kuɗi tare da keɓan maɓalli mai hatimi (p256dh) kowane biyan kuɗi. Juyawa: maɓallin VAPID yana da tsawo amma kayan aikin da aka sa hannu suna da gajeriyar ƙarewar salon JWT.
vapid.h1_c: An daidaita VAPID azaman RFC 8292 a cikin 2017. Kafin VAPID, Gidan Yanar Gizo yana buƙatar biyan kuɗi na FCM-dillali ko na'ura ta daban. VAPID yana sauƙaƙe jigilar kai-babu aikin Firebase da ake buƙata.
vapid.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, wanda aka buga ta mai sarrafawa `/v1/health` don ganewar asali.
vapid.h3_a: Gidan Yanar Gizo, turawa mai hatimi, Ed25519, JWT

waf.title: WAF
waf.subtitle: Firewall Application na Yanar Gizo.
waf.intro: A WAF shine middleware wanda ke bincika buƙatun HTTP kuma yana toshe hanyoyin da aka sani-malicious (SQL allura, traversal, template injection) kafin su kai ga lambar aikace-aikace.
waf.h1_a: A WAF shine middleware wanda ke bincika buƙatun HTTP kuma yana toshe hanyoyin da aka sani-malicious (SQL allura, traversal, template injection) kafin su kai ga lambar aikace-aikace.
waf.h1_b: Vortex's WAF yana gudana azaman 'app/security/middware.py:: WAFMiddleware'. ~ 50 na regex akan URL, tambaya, jiki. Toshe `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config}}`, `$where`, sanannun XSS alamu. Hakanan yana tilasta iyakokin ƙimar duniya (1000 req/s), iyakokin kowace hanya (shiga 10/min, rajista 5/min), iyakokin kowane mai amfani.
waf.h1_c: WAFs kwanan wata zuwa mod_security (2002). Cloudflare's WAF (2014) ya inganta tsarin. Kowane tsarin gidan yanar gizo na zamani yana jigilar tsoffin saitin cak. An haɗa lissafin regex na Vortex daga OWASP Manyan sa hannu guda 10.
waf.h1_f:
akan kowace bukata:
  don tsari a cikin SQLI_PATTERNS: idan pattern.search(url + tambaya + jiki): ƙi
  don tsari a cikin TRAVERSAL: idan pattern.search(url): reject
  don tsari a cikin TEMPLATE: idan pattern.search(jiki): reject
Ƙimar-iyaka ta (IP, hanya, user_id)
waf.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex
waf.h3_a: Ƙayyadaddun ƙimar kuɗi, log log, OWASP, SQL allura

x25519.title: X25519
x25519.subtitle: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman akan Curve25519 (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 shine elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman akan Curve25519 a cikin sigar sa ta Montgomery. Maɓallan sirri na 32-byte da na jama'a, sirrin raba 32-byte. An yi amfani da shi don yarjejeniya mai mahimmanci.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 shine elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman akan Curve25519 a cikin sigar sa ta Montgomery. Maɓallan sirri na 32-byte da na jama'a, sirrin raba 32-byte. An yi amfani da shi don yarjejeniya mai mahimmanci.
x25519.h1_b: Kowane madaidaicin na'urar, kowane maɓalli na lokaci-lokaci, kowane biyan kuɗin da aka hatimi a cikin Vortex yana amfani da X25519. Aiwatar da tsani-Montgomery lokaci-lokaci ne kuma yana da kariya ga nau'in hare-haren tashoshi na gefe waɗanda suka addabi masu lankwasa a baya.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 Bernstein ya buga (2005); daidaita shi azaman RFC 7748 (2016) tare da suna X25519 don bambancin DH. Wanda aka karɓa ta sigina, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (matasan bayan-ƙira). Mai girma a cikin zamani mai amfani da cryptography.
x25519.h1_f:
maɓalli na sirri: a ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes ƙaramin-endian, manne)
Maɓalli na jama'a: A = a · G (madaidaicin madaidaicin 32-byte)
shared: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, → HKDF shigarwa)
aiki: ~ 100 µs a kowace DH akan iPhone 11
x25519.h2: Inda aka yi amfani da shi a cikin Vortex

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket fan-out internals
websocketFanout.subtitle: Yadda kumburi ɗaya ke ba da taron ga dubban masu biyan kuɗi.
websocketFanout.what: The WebSocket fan-out ne Python-yan ƙasa saitin masu biyan kuɗi kowane ɗaki. Lokacin da aka POSTed saƙo, mai aikawa da fan-fitarwa yana sake maimaita saitin kuma ya jera jeri na firam akan layin aika masu biyan kuɗi.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out yana guje wa farashin N-kwafin watsa shirye-shirye: ɓarna ɗaya a gefen mai aikawa, firam ɗin serialized guda ɗaya, N aika jerin gwano. Kowane turawa shine O (1); Ana tura kuɗin kwafin akan kernel a lokacin `aika()` ta hanyar buffers sifili lokacin da OS ke goyan bayan su.
websocketFanout.where: An aiwatar a cikin `app/chats/fanout.py`. Babban matakin 'FanoutRegistry' yana riƙe da 'dict[room_id, saita[WebSocket]]'. Rubutun rajista ana kiyaye su ta `asyncio.Lock'; karantawa hotuna ne marasa kullewa.
websocketFanout.how: A kan saƙo POST na'ura mai ba da hanya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa ya kira 'jira fanout.broadcast(room_id, payload_bytes)'. Hanyar tana kwafin saitin a ƙarƙashin kulle, ta sake fitowa, sannan ta sake maimaita kwafin da ke jiran `ws.send_bytes(load)' tare da ƙarewar daƙiƙa 1 ga kowane soket. Matsalolin da aka kayyade ana yiwa alama mara kyau kuma an share su.
websocketFanout.when: Kowane saƙo, amsawa, rasidin karantawa, alamar bugawa, siginar kira, da jujjuyawar maɓalli na ɗaki suna gudana ta cikin wannan fan-out iri ɗaya. Girman firam yana da iyaka a 64 KiB; Ana ƙi manyan abubuwan biya kuma ana mayar da su ga mai kira ta HTTP.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` - kowane mai biyan kuɗi yana aika zurfin jerin gwano. Ambaliyar ruwa tana sauke mafi tsufa firam.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — babba akan `aika_bytes`. Yin wuce gona da iri yana nuna mummunan soket.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` - ya ki yarda da fitowar dakunan da suka fi wannan girma. Manyan dakuna suna amfani da yanayin tashoshi da tsarin ja maimakon.
websocketFanout.fail1: Mabukaci a hankali - jerin gwano-socket ya cika. Tsofaffin firam ɗin sun faɗi. Abokin ciniki yana ci gaba ta hanyar 'tun' akan sake haɗawa.
websocketFanout.fail2: Matattu soket - `aika_bytes` yana ɗaga ''ConnectionClosed'. Dispatcher yana cirewa daga saiti kuma ya ci gaba.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty producer - idan mai samarwa ya kasance> 5 × sauri fiye da tara bandwidth na mabukaci, matsa lamba na baya yana shiga ta hanyar 'jira' yana dakatar da mai aikawa.
websocketFanout.fail4: Ƙwaƙwalwar ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya - jerin gwanon kowane mai biyan kuɗi wanda aka rufe a firam 256; a 64 KiB kowanne wanda ke da 16 MiB max ga mabukaci a hankali. Mabukaci da ya gudu za a cire haɗin ta hanyar binciken rayuwa kafin ya buga wannan silin.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus ma'auni `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{daki, mai amfani}` - kowane-zurfin jerin gwano.
websocketFanout.mon2: Counter `vortex_fanout_drops_total{dali}` - firam ɗin da aka sauke ta dalili (cirewa, ƙarewar lokaci, rufe).
websocketFanout.tune1: Haɓaka `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` ga abokan ciniki akan hanyoyin sadarwa na jinkirin amma tsayayye.
websocketFanout.tune2: Ƙarƙashin `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` a cikin manyan rukunoni masu tasowa inda jinkirin soket ke kashe wasu.
websocketFanout.tune3: Raba manyan dakuna zuwa ƙananan dakuna ko canza su zuwa yanayin tashoshi tare da sabuntawa na tushen ja.
websocketFanout.edge1: Ana aika abubuwan da suka faru na juyawa daki ('nau'in:"k") tare da ƙarewar s 2 maimakon s 1 saboda dole ne abokan ciniki su sake shigo da maɓallai kafin karɓar ƙarin saƙonni.
websocketFanout.edge2: Ba a sake gwada abubuwan da suka faru ba - rasa "mai amfani ya daina bugawa" ba shi da illa.
websocketFanout.edge3: An daidaita ɗaukakawar gaban: yawan kasancewar masu amfani da yawa a cikin tagar 250 ms iri ɗaya ana haɗa su cikin firam ɗaya.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 da aka yi amfani da kowane ɗaki `asyncio.Queue`s - an maye gurbinsa a cikin v0.0.5 ta tsarin kwafin-kwafi don ƙananan kowane saƙo CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Nan gaba: lokacin da Redis yake samuwa, fan-out zai fi son mashaya/sabis don haka tarin rukunoni masu yawa suna maimaita abubuwan da suka faru ba tare da fitar da raga ba.
websocketFanout.ts1: Babban faduwa: duba hanyar sadarwa zuwa jinkirin mabukaci; girman jerin gwano; bincika halayen abokin ciniki.
websocketFanout.ts2: Tsawon lokacin aikawa: mai yiyuwa TLS ana ci gaba da tattaunawa ko NAT lokacin wucewa; duba rajistan ayyukan kernel don sake watsawa TCP.
websocketFanout.ts3: Ƙwaƙwalwar ƙwaƙwalwa: duba 'vortex_fanout_queue_depth' kowane mai amfani; yi alama ga kowane mai amfani da zurfin zurfi> 200 azaman mai yuwuwar jinkirin ko abokin ciniki qeta.
websocketFanout.faq1: Tambaya: Menene zai faru idan abokin ciniki ya rasa firam yayin cire haɗin? A: Yana sake haɗawa tare da `tun = <last_seen_id>` kuma uwar garken yana sake kunnawa daga DB. The fan-out shine mafi kyawun ƙoƙari na ainihin lokaci; karko yana rayuwa a cikin DB.
websocketFanout.faq2: Tambaya: Shin mai biyan kuɗi na mugunta zai iya rage gudu? A: Suna rage layin nasu, wanda ya cika, ya sauke firam ɗin, kuma yana cire haɗin su. Babu tsangwama ga masu biyan kuɗi.
websocketFanout.faq3: Tambaya: Ta yaya zan yi kuskuren isar da takamaiman mai amfani? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` suna zubar da zurfin layinsu, aika tambarin ƙarshe, da faɗuwar kwanan nan.

nonceManagement.title: Gudanarwa ba tare da izini ba
nonceManagement.subtitle: Yadda Vortex ke kiyaye AES-GCM na musamman a cikin na'urori, dakuna, da sake kunnawa.
nonceManagement.what: Kowane aiki na AES-GCM yana ɗaukar 12-byte ba tare da MUST ya zama na musamman don maɓalli da aka bayar. Sake yin amfani da maɓalli ɗaya tare da maɓalli iri ɗaya yana lalata sirrin sirri da amincin duka biyu - maharin da ke da rubutu guda biyu a ƙarƙashin maɓalli ɗaya (maɓalli, ba da baya) zai iya dawo da bayyananniyar rubutu XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex yana samar da maɓallin daki ɗaya kuma yana amfani da shi don dubban saƙonni. Rashin daidaituwa tsakanin saƙo biyu zai fito fili. Don haka ana samar da duk abubuwan da ba su dace ba tare da OS CSPRNG a 96 bits - yankin da aka daure ranar haihuwa kusan saƙon 2^32 ne a kowane maɓalli, fiye da kowane maɓalli guda ɗaya zai ɓoye.
nonceManagement.where: Ƙungiyoyin da ba na abokin ciniki ba suna rayuwa a cikin `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node). Kumburin kuma yana gudanar da binciken kwafin-nonce na kariya.
nonceManagement.how: Mataki-mataki: abokin ciniki yana haifar da bazuwar bytes 12, ya wuce zuwa AES-GCM rufa-rufa, ya tsara rubutun a matsayin `{ciphertext, nonce}` da POSTs. Rubutun node `(room_id, nonce)` a cikin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya LRU cache mai girman shigarwar 10^6. A kan POST, kumburi yana bincika cache - kwafin ⇒ 400 `kwafin_nonce`. Karkashin amfani na yau da kullun wannan baya yin wuta (P( karo) a saƙon 10^9 shine ~ 10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: A kan kowane aika. Bangaren mai karɓa: babu sake dubawa - alamar AES-GCM tana ɗaukar mutunci. Idan ba a maimaita ko ta yaya ba, na biyun zai ci gaba da yin nasara amma za a lalata sirrin.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — adadin nonces na baya-bayan nan da ake bin diddigin kowane kumburi.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` - tsofaffin shigarwar da aka fitar bayan sa'o'i 24 (mafi yawan maɓallai suna juyawa cikin sa'o'i ko ta yaya).
nonceManagement.cfg3: `NONCE_DUPLICATE_ACTION= ƙi | log | ba da izini' - ƙi tsoho.
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG gazawar akan abokin ciniki - wanda ba zai yuwu ba tare da OS-samar da CSPRNG. Ba za mu taɓa komawa ga RNGs marasa ɓoyewa ba.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache ya ɓace akan kumburin sake kunnawa - karɓuwa saboda cache yana da zurfin tsaro; Abokan ciniki ba su taɓa sake yin amfani da abubuwan da ba daidai ba don haka kuskure ba zai buɗe taga harin ba.
nonceManagement.mon1: Counter `vortex_nonce_duplicates_total{daki}` - yakamata ya tsaya a sifili.
nonceManagement.mon2: Ma'auni `vortex_nonce_cache_size` - yakamata ya tsaya kusa da hular cache.
nonceManagement.tune1: Manyan dakuna: ƙara girman cache don rufe tagogi mai tsayi mai jujjuyawa.
nonceManagement.tune2: Rukunin kumburi da yawa: raba cache ta hanyar Redis idan akwai.
nonceManagement.edge1: Sake haɗa abokin ciniki na kan layi tare da saƙon layi: kowane saƙon da aka yi layi yana ɗaukar nasa bazuwar komai. Ba a buƙatar haɗin kai.
nonceManagement.edge2: Aika na'urori da yawa: duka na'urori biyu suna haifar da bazuwar bazuwar. P(ci karo) a na'urori 2 × 10^4 saƙon = babu komai.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 an yi amfani da su a taƙaice masu ƙima da aka shuka da na'urar id - ta ƙare bayan wata takarda ta nuna karon na'urori a ƙarƙashin agogo-skew. Random-96 yanzu shine kawai hanya mai albarka.
nonceManagement.ts1: Dubi 'kwafin_nonce' kin amincewa: duba abokin ciniki don buggy RNG; duba tushen entropy na'urar.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: bincika girman cache daidai da ƙimar rubutun ɗakin; ko dai ya ɗaga girma ko ƙasa TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: Tambaya: Me zai faru idan abokan ciniki biyu suka karɓi iri ɗaya ba kwatsam? A: A 96 ragowa na bazuwar, ana tsammanin karon farko a duk masu amfani yana cikin saƙon ~ 2^48 - yawancin rayuwar Vortex amfani. Idan ta taɓa faruwa, kumburin zai ƙi na biyun.
nonceManagement.faq2: Tambaya: Me yasa 96 bits kuma ba 128 ba? A: AES-GCM daidaitaccen tsayin daka. 96 bits kuma yana adana bytes 4 akan kowane saƙo.

keyRotation.title: Maɓalli na juyawa
keyRotation.subtitle: Yaushe da kuma yadda ɗaki, na'ura, da maɓallan saki suke birgima.
keyRotation.what: Kowane maɓalli mai tsayi a cikin Vortex yana jujjuyawa akan jadawali ko kan faɗakarwa. Maɓallan ɗaki suna jujjuyawa akan canjin memba ko lokaci-lokaci (kowane sati). Maɓallan na'ura suna juyawa kowane zaɓin mai amfani. Maɓallan sakewa suna juyawa lokacin da ake zargin sulhu.
keyRotation.why: Juyawa yana ƙayyadadden radius na sulhu. Maɓallin ɗakin da aka sata daga jiya ya daina ɓarna saƙonnin yau. Maɓallin sakin da aka sata daga 2024 ya daina ba da shaida ga fitowar 2026.
keyRotation.where: 'app/maɓallai/' dabaru jujjuyawar gefen uwar garken. Gefen abokin ciniki: `ios/.../Maɓallai/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Jujjuya daki: kowane admin na iya jawowa; jujjuyawa na yau da kullun akan hutu yana atomatik. Rotator ya sami sabon tushen 32-byte, sake-sake ambulan zuwa sauran membobin, posts `POST /api/rooms/{id}/juya` tare da sabbin ambulan. Node yana sabunta 'keys_keys' da watsa shirye-shirye '{type:"k"}'.
keyRotation.when: Daki: a kan hutu, kan fararwa mai gudanarwa, kowane kwanaki 7 ta atomatik. Na'ura: kowane kwanaki 90 ta tsohuwa (mai daidaitawa). Saki: ad-hoc akan sulhu da ake zargi.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=gaskiya` - kashe don tsallake jujjuyawa akan hutu (yana rage tsaro don ƙananan CPU).
keyRotation.fail1: Abokin layi na layi yayin jujjuyawa: yana kama hanyar haɗi na gaba. Rukunin node yana jujjuyawa 5 na ƙarshe don haka sake haɗawa koyaushe suna samun ambulaf ɗin su.
keyRotation.fail2: tseren mining ambulaf: admins biyu suna juyawa lokaci guda. Node yana karɓar na farko kuma ya mayar da 409 Conflict zuwa na biyu.
keyRotation.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rotation_duration_ seconds` — agogon bango kowane juyi.
keyRotation.tune1: Dakunan jama'a a> membobi 1000: canzawa zuwa buga maɓalli na Variant-B. Juyawa akan izinin zama babu-op; membobin sun amince da sa hannun mabuɗin da aka buga.
keyRotation.tune2: Dakuna masu saurin lokaci (misali tashoshin tushen aikin jarida): gajeriyar jujjuyawa (kullum ko sa'a).
keyRotation.edge1: Dakin memba ɗaya bayan duk wasu sun tafi: juyawa ba dole ba ne amma har yanzu yana haifar da daidaito; mamba ɗaya kaɗai ya sami sabon ambulan wa kansu.
keyRotation.edge2: Mai shi ya bar: Canja wurin ikon mallakar zuwa ga mai gudanarwa mafi dadewa; an soke tsohuwar ambulan mai shi.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 ya juya akan izini kawai. v0.2 yana ƙara jujjuyawar lokaci-lokaci ta `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS`.
keyRotation.ts1: Abokan ciniki sun makale suna yankewa: duba tebur ambulan; tabbatar an watsa taron juyawa.
keyRotation.ts2: Raunin juyawa: yawanci hanyar sadarwa zuwa memba a hankali. Sake gwada ƙidayar shiga cikin hanyar duba.
keyRotation.faq1: Tambaya: Shin juyawa yana sake ɓoye tsoffin saƙonni? A: A'a. Tsohuwar rubutun yana tsayawa ƙarƙashin tsohon maɓalli; abokan ciniki suna adana tsoffin maɓallai a cikin ma'ajin su na gida don ɓarnawar tarihi.
keyRotation.faq2: Tambaya: Idan mai amfani ya shiga ya fita da sauri sau 100 fa? A: Kowane aiki yana juyawa. A kan manyan ɗakuna wannan yana da tsada - muna ƙididdige ƙayyadaddun abubuwan zama membobin zuwa 1/min kowane mai amfani.

rateLimiting.title: Ƙayyadadden ƙima
rateLimiting.subtitle: Per-IP, kowane mai amfani, iyakoki-bucket token kowane hanya.
rateLimiting.what: Iyakoki na ƙididdigewa shine babban kariya daga cin zarafi mai yawa: shiga-ƙarfi, ambaliya ta rajista, saƙon saƙo, gajiyar loda fayil.
rateLimiting.why: Ba tare da iyaka ba, duk wani ingantaccen mai cin zarafi zai iya shayar da faifai, cika fan-fito, ko ƙara ƙarfi mai lamba 4 2FA. Iyakoki suna da arha (~ 10 ns kowane cak) kuma suna juya hare-hare marasa kan gado zuwa masu tsada.
rateLimiting.where: 'app/security/liits.py' yana riƙe da iyaka. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` sirara ce ta nade don ingantaccen hanyoyin.
rateLimiting.how: Algorithm na Token-guga kowane (ikon, maɓalli). Cika guga akan ƙimar R, ƙarfin C. Buƙatun yana ɗaukar alamar 1. Bokiti mara kyau ⇒ 429. Ma'ajiya ta Tracker: in-memory dict on single node; Redis lokacin da `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Kowane buƙatu ta hanyar WAF middleware. Tsallake lissafin don kadarorin da ke tsaye da kuma duba lafiya.
rateLimiting.cfg1: `_AUTH_RATE_LOGIN=10` a cikin 60 s a kowace IP.
rateLimiting.cfg2: `_AUTH_RATE_REGISTER=5` a cikin 60 s a kowace IP.
rateLimiting.cfg3: `MSG_RATE_PER_USER=30` a minti daya ga mai amfani.
rateLimiting.cfg4: `FILE_UPLOAD_RATE=10` a minti daya ga mai amfani.
rateLimiting.fail1: Halaltaccen mai amfani da ke bayan raba NAT (ofis, makaranta) ya ci kowane-IP iyaka - mai amfani da ke fuskantar 429 tare da saƙon ladabi.
rateLimiting.fail2: Ƙwaƙwalwar ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya a babban fashe - an rufe shi a maɓalli daban-daban 100k; LRU kora.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_ seconds` — ya kamata ya tsaya ƙasa da 100 µs.
rateLimiting.tune1: Bayan CDN wanda ke cire ainihin IP: saita `TRUSTED_PROXIES` don haka mu karanta `X-Forwarded-For`. In ba haka ba duk zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar zirga-zirgar ababen hawa tana kan iyaka a ƙarƙashin CDN's egress IP.
rateLimiting.tune2: Bots mai girma: ba da maɓallin API tare da `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: muna iyakance kowane / 64 maimakon kowane adireshi don asusu don babban rabon ISP.
rateLimiting.edge2: Wurin fita: muna amfani da iyaka mai sassauƙa (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) don guje wa azabtar da masu amfani da Tor akan ficewar da aka raba.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 da aka yi amfani da `slowapi` tare da kayan ado-kowace hanya - an yanke shi a cikin v0.0.5 don tsakiya na tsakiya.
rateLimiting.ts1: 429-tabbatacce: bincika amintaccen saitin wakili, bincika saitin raba-NAT, iyakacin iyaka idan halaltaccen zirga-zirga yana buge shi.
rateLimiting.ts2: Ketare: duba rajistan shiga ga masu zagin IP; ƙara zuwa `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var don toshe mai wuya.
rateLimiting.faq1: Tambaya: An raba iyakoki a ko'ina? A: A cikin yanayin kumburi guda ɗaya, iyakoki su ne kowane kumburi. Tare da Redis, iyakoki na duniya a cikin tari.
rateLimiting.faq2: Tambaya: Ta yaya zan ba da ƙarin don kaina? A: Ingantattun masu amfani za su iya neman mafi girma keɓaɓɓu ta hanyar `/api/admin/quota`. Admins sun amince da shari'a-da-harka.

emojiCatalog.title: Kataloji na Emoji
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Saitin bayanan emoji 1500 da aka raba a duk abokan ciniki.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex yana jigilar nasa saitin emoji maimakon dogaro da samuwar nau'in Unicode. 1500 emojis an tsara su zuwa rukuni 9 (murmushi, mutane, dabbobi, abinci, tafiya, ayyuka, abubuwa, alamomi, tutoci). Haka JSON da ake amfani da shi akan iOS (`Emoji/Resources/emoji.json`), Android (`android/app/src/main/assets/emoji.json`), da abokin ciniki na yanar gizo (`static/assets/emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Daidaitawa: mai amfani da ke aika 🥹 akan iOS 17 dole ne yayi kamar 🥹 akan Android 9. Tsarin Emoji na asali yana bambanta tsakanin nau'ikan OS da shekaru 1-3, don haka muna jigilar namu don kiyaye taswirar taswira.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON Tsarin: `{category: [emoji_char, ...]}'. Abokan ciniki suna ɗaukar kaya a farawa, sun daidaita cikin fihirisar bincike, kuma suna bayarwa ta LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid.
emojiCatalog.when: A farkon app kuma duk lokacin da mai amfani ya buɗe mai ɗaukar hoto. Ana ci gaba da lissafin MRU a cikin UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Kwanan baya: 30 akan iOS, 30 akan Android, 20 akan yanar gizo.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: An gyara rukunoni cikin tsari - sake yin oda yana karya shimfidar zaɓe.
emojiCatalog.fail1: Mai amfani OS ba zai iya yin emoji ba: ya koma '?' glyph. Mun zaɓi maki code daga Unicode ≤ 15.0 wanda kowane zamani OS ke tallafawa.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Fakitin emoji na al'ada: masu amfani za su iya shigar da fakitin siti waɗanda ke yin irin wannan amma suna yin hotunan raster.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Bambance-bambancen sautin fata: kasidarmu tana adana emojis tushe kawai; bambance-bambancen karatu an haɗa su ta gefen abokin ciniki ta hanyar jerin ZWJ.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Tutar Emojis: nau'ikan alamar alamar yanki; iOS yana nuna tuta, wasu nau'ikan Android suna nuna nau'ikan haruffa.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 yayi amfani da emoji.json daga emoji-mart sama. v0.0.5 an yi cokali mai yatsa don lika kasidar kuma a datsa zuwa 1500 don dalilai masu girman tarin.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Rashin emoji: sake gina kadarori; a tabbata JSON yana aiki; wasu na'urori suna adana tsoffin juzu'ai da ƙarfi - share cache app.
emojiCatalog.faq1: Tambaya: Zan iya ƙara emoji na al'ada? A: Ba ta hanyar kasida ba. Yi amfani da fakitin sitika.
emojiCatalog.faq2: Tambaya: Me yasa ba a amfani da Twemoji? A: Lasisi + Girman dam. Twemoji shine CC-BY-4.0 amma saitin PNG yana ƙara 20 MB kowane abokin ciniki.

smartReply.title: Amsa mai hankali - tunani
smartReply.subtitle: Takaitaccen tsarin tsarin.
smartReply.what: smartReply tsari ne na Vortex. Yana shiga cikin ƙa'idar ƙarshen-zuwa-ƙarshen manzo kuma an rubuta shi tare da sauran tsarin da ke cikin wannan batun.
smartReply.why: Ƙarƙashin tsarin yana wanzuwa saboda ƙa'idar tana da fayyace madaidaicin ramin sa. Cire shi zai bar gibin aiki wanda masu amfani suka dogara dashi.
smartReply.where: Duba itacen tushen Vortex. Yarjejeniyar suna 'app/<feature>/' akan kumburi, `static/js/<feature>/` akan abokin ciniki na gidan yanar gizo, `ios/Modules/ Sources/<Feature>/` akan iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<feature>/` akan Android.
smartReply.how: Abokan ciniki suna kiran tsarin ƙasa ta hanyar API samansa; hanyoyin kumburi, shagunan, da magoya baya kamar yadda ya dace. Cikakkun bayanan aiwatarwa suna rayuwa a cikin README module ɗin inda akwai.
smartReply.when: Duk lokacin da smartReply ya dace - duba lambar don shafukan kira.
smartReply.cfg1: Saitin tsoho yana aiki don shari'ar gama gari.
smartReply.cfg2: Tutar fasali akwai a cikin `.env.example` - nemi `SMARTREPLY_ENABLED`.
smartReply.cfg3: Kunna kunna kunnawa da aka rubuta a cikin tsarin README.
smartReply.fail2: Ma'auni na haɓaka; faɗakarwar wuta idan ƙofa ya wuce.
smartReply.fail3: Sake gwadawa yana da iyaka; babu madaukai marasa iyaka.
smartReply.mon3: Shiga INFO don samun nasara hanyoyin, WARN don kurakurai masu iya dawo da su.
smartReply.tune1: Fara a abubuwan da ba a so.
smartReply.tune2: Kula da ma'auni na mako guda kafin canzawa.
smartReply.tune3: Yi bayanin dalilin kowane canje-canjen kunnawa.
smartReply.edge1: Yana kula da shari'o'in gefen da ake tsammanin bisa ga ƙayyadaddun ƙa'idar yarjejeniya.
smartReply.edge2: Ana shigar da shari'o'in gefen da ba a san su ba don nazarin ma'aikata.
smartReply.mig1: Bita na Alembic ya ƙunshi kowane canjin tsari.
smartReply.mig2: Ana goyan bayan Rollback don ƙaramin siga ɗaya.
smartReply.ts2: Tace rajistan ayyukan ta hanyar haɗin id.
smartReply.ts3: Tuntuɓi sashin warware matsalar README module.
smartReply.faq1: Tambaya: Shin wannan yanayin ya tabbata? A: Ee, ƙaramar sigar barga. Manyan nau'ikan na iya karya daidaituwa.
smartReply.faq2: Tambaya: Zan iya kashe shi? A: Ee ta hanyar tuta.
smartReply.faq3: Tambaya: An kunna ta ta tsohuwa? A: Ya dogara; duba `.env.misali`.

intro.p1: Architex harshe ne na shelanta UI da aka gina don Vortex Mini Apps. Maimakon rubuta JavaScript da ke canza DOM, kuna kwatanta allon da kuke so kuma lokacin aiki yana kiyaye pixels tare da yanayi ta atomatik.
intro.p2: Harshen ƙanƙanta ne: sanarwa guda huɗu (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), prefix ɗaya don masu canjin amsawa (~), da sarkar mai aiki ɗaya don salo (::).
intro.p3: Idan kun taɓa rubuta HTML + CSS + JS, Architex zai ji daɗi amma tare da ƙaramin tukunyar jirgi 10 ×. Idan ba haka ba, Architex shima gabatarwa ne a hankali ga shirye-shiryen amsawa saboda yaren yana da kankanta zaka iya rike shi duka a cikin ka.
intro.p4: Kowane sashe na wannan tunani yana ginawa akan waɗanda suka gabata. Tsallaka cikin duk inda kuke so idan kun riga kun san wani tsari na UI; karanta sama zuwa kasa idan kun fara sabo.
intro.li1: Sanarwa - bayyana siffar UI, ba matakan gina shi ba.
intro.li2: Reactive - aiki ɗaya yana sabunta kowane lakabin dogara, aji, ko kumburi
intro.li3: Portable - guda .arx yana gudana akan gidan yanar gizo, iOS, da Android runduna
intro.ct1: Architex yana da takamaiman yanki. Ba zai maye gurbin harshe na gaba ɗaya ba - amma don jigilar allo a cikin taɗi yana da sauri fiye da kowane tsarin da muka auna.
intro.ct2: Kowane ginawa a cikin taswirar harshe zuwa farkon lokaci guda. Babu wani sihiri da ba za ku iya bayyanawa ba.
intro.h1_a: Architex harshe ne na shelanta UI da aka gina don Vortex Mini Apps. Maimakon rubuta JavaScript da ke canza DOM, kuna kwatanta allon da kuke so kuma lokacin aiki yana kiyaye pixels tare da yanayi ta atomatik.
intro.h1_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Mene ne Architex?". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.

syntax.p1: Kowane shirin Architex an gina shi daga manyan matakai huɗu: @screen, @theme, @import, @component, da @for madauki jiki. Kowane yana farawa a shafi 0; duk abin da ke ƙasa na wannan katanga ne.
syntax.p2: An rubuta masu canji masu amsawa ~name - prefix na tilde yana nuna su azaman sel da aka sa ido. Karanta da ~name, sanyawa da =, yi lissafta da :=.
syntax.p3: Abubuwan da aka haɗa sune abubuwan ganowa akan layin nasu: text, button, image, col, row, da sauransu. Hujjarsu ta zo nan take bayan: text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Masu gyara suna haɗawa bayan ::. Kuna iya sarƙa kamar yadda kuke so: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Ayyuka suna rayuwa bayan =>. Aiki ɗaya a kowace kibiya; sarkar kibau masu yawa: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.

syntax.cc2: // nau'in annotation na zaɓi ne amma yana taimakawa autocomplete + saƙonnin kuskure
syntax.cc3: // Abubuwan da aka gyara gida ta hanyar indentation - wurare 2 a kowane matakin, babu shafuka
syntax.cc4: // masu gyara suna haɗe zuwa sashin akan layin da ya gabata
syntax.cc5: // daya mataki a kowace kibiya - sarkar da yawa kibiyoyi a kan layi daya idan kana bukatar su a jere
syntax.td7: Tushen allo mai iya jurewa - kowane app yana da ɗaya.
syntax.td10: Ƙayyade ɓangaren da za a sake amfani da shi tare da sigogi masu suna.
syntax.td11: Bayar da toshe yaro ɗaya ga kowane kashi na lissafin amsawa.
syntax.td12: Daidai da na sama amma kuma ɗaure fihirisar tushen sifili.

variables.p1: Maɓallin amsawa yana riƙe da ƙima kuma yana sanar da duk wanda ya karanta ta atomatik lokacin da kuka rubuta sabuwar ƙima. Bayyana da =, sake sanyawa da =, sabunta tare da += / -= / *= / /=.
variables.p2: Matsalolin da aka lissafta suna samun ƙimar su daga furci mai sake kimantawa a duk lokacin da kowace shigarwa ta canza. Sanarwa da := maimakon =. Babu biyan kuɗin hannu, babu kurakurai masu ƙima.
variables.p3: Bayyana nau'in tare da : Type bayan sunan. Nau'ikan tallafi: number, string, boolean, array, object. Bayanin na zaɓi ne; ana kwatanta nau'in daga ƙimar farko.
variables.p4: Yi amfani da ƙaramin CamelCase ko maciji; Architex baya tilastawa ko. Rike sunaye gajere: allo mai dozin dogayen sunaye yana lalatar da shigar ciki.
variables.p5: Matsakaicin iyaka: madaidaicin amsawa da aka bayyana a cikin @screen ana iya gani a cikin jikin allo kawai. @theme Alamu suna bayyane a duniya.
variables.p6: Rayuwar rayuwa: jihar tana raye muddin an ɗora allon. Kewaya yana halaka shi; kewayawa baya yana sake ƙirƙirar shi a ƙimar farko.
variables.p7: Dagewa: don wuce allo, kira send(action: "save", data: ~state) kuma bari mai masaukin bot ya dage.

state.p1: Kowane tantanin halitta mai amsawa yana rayuwa muddin an sanya @screen kewayenta. Buɗe allo yana gudanar da bayanin sa sama-zuwa ƙasa; barin ta back() ko goto() yana halaka su.
state.p2: Idan kuna buƙatar jihar don tsira daga kewayawa, samo shi daga mai watsa shiri: ko dai POST zuwa bot tare da send() kuma sake sake buɗewa, ko nace a cikin gida ta hanyar kiran store(key, value).
state.p3: Sake saitin: sake sanyawa zuwa ƙimar farko. Babu reset keyword saboda sake-assignment riga yayi aikin; lokacin gudu yana bambanta kuma yana sake mayar da abin da ya canza kawai.
state.p4: Ana ƙididdige jihar da aka samo ta hanyar :=. Architex yana bin abubuwan dogaro ta atomatik, don haka ba za ku jera su da hannu ba. Bin diddigin dogara daidai ne ga kowane dukiya, ba kowane abu ba.
state.p5: Ana kwatanta tsararru da abubuwa ta hanyar tunani. Don tilasta sake sakewa, sanya sabon tsari / abu. An yi watsi da maye gurbi na tsohuwar - ciniki na niyya don ilimin tarukan sabunta tatsuniyoyi.
state.cc1: ~jeri = [...~jeri, sabon abu] // tilasta sake sakewa tare da sabon tsarin tunani
state.cc2: ~ obj = & # 123;...~ obj, suna: "x""  // tsari iri ɗaya don abubuwa
state.li3: Daidaituwa: zaren guda ɗaya a kowane allo. Ana shirya sabuntawa cikin microtask guda ɗaya.
state.li4: Daidaituwa: tsantsa (===) - sanya darajar iri ɗaya ba ta sake haifar da komai ba.

types.p1: Architex yana da nau'ikan farko guda biyar: number, string, boolean, null, da kuma hadaddiyar object / array. Ana wucewa ta kwanan wata azaman kirtani (ISO 8601) ko lambobi (unix ms).
types.p2: Lambobi sun ninka 64-bit (IEEE 754). Integer lissafi har zuwa 2^53 daidai ne.
types.p3: Zaɓuɓɓuka suna UTF-8; tsayi yana ƙidaya maki code, ba bytes ba. Interpolation yana amfani da takalmin gyaran kafa.
types.p4: Booleans suna true / false. Babu jujjuyawar juyawa daga kirtani.
types.p5: Ana ba da oda da tsararru, 0-fihirisa. Shiga ta hanyar ~arr[0]; tsayi ta hanyar ~arr.length.
types.p6: Abubuwan maɓalli ne marasa tsari → taswirorin ƙima. Shiga ta ~obj.name ko ~obj["name"].

layout.p1: Architex yana da ainihin kwantena guda biyu masu haɗawa: col (a tsaye) da row (a kwance). Komai sauran bangaren ganye ne.
layout.p2: Zurfafa yara matakin zurfi fiye da akwati. Babu alamar rufewa - parser yana amfani da indentation shi kaɗai.
layout.p3: Kwantena suna karɓar gap(px) don sarari tsakanin yara, pad(px) don padding ciki, center zuwa tsakiya tare da giciye axis, grow don cike sauran sarari tare da babban axis.
layout.p4: Masu gyaran gyare-gyare sune matakan kwantena: center a cikin cibiyoyin col a kwance; a cikin row yana tsaye a tsaye. align(left) / align(right) / align(top) / align(bottom) an soke su a bayyane.
layout.p5: Girma: ta tsohuwa kowane sashi yana raguwa don dacewa da abun ciki. Yi amfani da w(px), h(px), grow, ko bayyane maxW(px) / maxH(px) don matsewa.

layout.cc4: jere :: girma // ɗauki duk sauran sarari kwance
layout.li2: row - yaran layi na hagu zuwa dama
layout.li4: Yaran da ke da grow sun raba sauran sarari daidai da idan ba a ba da ma'auni bayyane ba.

control_flow.p1: Architex ba shi da bayanin if a saman matakin ma'auni. Ana bayyana sharadi UI ta hanyar hidden(~flag) / visible(~flag) masu gyara ko ta kalamai na uku a cikin ƙimar sassa.
control_flow.p2: Ternary yana aiki a duk inda aka karɓi ƙima: gardamar ɓangarori, hujja mai gyara, ƙima mai ƙima.
control_flow.p3: Don fiye da rassa biyu, gida na ternary. Architex yana nazarin dama-zuwa-hagu don haka nesting yana karantawa ta halitta.
control_flow.p4: Don dabaru masu kama da switch akan abu, yi amfani da bincike da aka lissafta: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active].
