loops.p1: Maimaita toshe na UI kowane kashi tare da @for item in ~list. Zuba jiki; kowane yaro yana yin sau ɗaya a kowane kashi.
loops.p2: A ɗaure fihirisar tushen sifili tare da tsari mai suna biyu: @for item, idx in ~list.
loops.p3: Lokacin gudu yana bin sahihancin sahihancin abin da kansa ta tsohuwa. Tsayawa zuwa jerin jeri 10 000 yana biyan O(1) DOM aiki - mai yin sa ya bambanta ta hanyar tunani, ba ta matsayi ba.
loops.p4: Nest @for kyauta. madaukai na ciki suna ganin haɗe-haɗe na madauki na waje.
loops.p5: Tsarin maimaitawa shine tsarin tsararru. Don juyawa, maimaita juzu'in da aka lissafta: ~reversed := [...].reverse().
loops.li1: Jikin maimaitawa yana zurfafa mataki ɗaya fiye da layin @for.
loops.li2: Jiki na iya ƙunsar kowane sashi, gami da wani @for.
loops.li3: Ƙara / cirewa a ƙarshen kyauta ne; bambance-bambancen tushen asali ne.
loops.li4: Lambobi marasa ma'ana ba su haifar da komai ba - babu ramin mai riƙe da wuri.

theme.p1: Wani toshe @theme a saman fayil yana bayyana alamun ƙira azaman masu canji masu amsawa. Duk wani mai gyara ko sashi na iya duba su da ~tokenName.
theme.p2: Alamu sun zama masu canji na yau da kullun. Maɓallin yanayin duhu na lokacin aiki shine layi uku: waƙa ~isDark, bari jigon ya ayyana alamomi azaman ternaries, kuma ɗayan toggle yana jujjuya mai canzawa.
theme.p3: Jigogi da aka kafa: @screen na iya ƙetare takamaiman alamu a cikin shingen @theme na gida. Alamun da ba a fayyace su ba sun gaji daga iyakar waje.

reactivity.p1: Duk wani amsa da aka karanta a cikin lissafin ƙididdiga ko hujjar mai gyara yana yin rijistar dogaro. Lokacin da kowane abin dogaro ya canza, kalmar zata sake kimantawa a cikin ƙaramin aiki na gaba.
reactivity.p2: Rubuce-rubucen an haɗa su: ayyuka da yawa a cikin mai gudanar da taron guda ɗaya sun ƙone daidai fasinja ɗaya a ƙarshen. Wannan shine dalilin da ya sa => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 yana da arha koda tare da masu karatu da yawa.
reactivity.p3: Daidaito yana da tsauri (===). Rubutun ƙima ɗaya ba ya sake gudanar da komai. Don tilasta sabuntawa tare da nau'ikan tunani, sanya sabon tsari ko abu.
reactivity.p4: Ana gano kewayon cikin abubuwan dogaro da aka ƙididdige (~a := ~b + 1 da ~b := ~a - 1) a lokacin bayyanawa kuma an ruwaito su azaman kurakurai.
reactivity.p5: Sabuntawar Async: send() wanda ke dawo da ƙima yana sabunta tantanin halitta da kuka sanya sakamakon, yana tsara hanyar wucewa lokacin da Alƙawarin ya warware.

errors.p1: Tsara kurakurai suna kunna wuta a lokacin loda fayil. Lokacin gudu yana ba da rahoton layi, ginshiƙi, da alama. Dalilai na yau da kullun: rashin daidaiton indent, ɓacewar =, gyare-gyaren da ba a sani ba, igiyar da ba a rufe.
errors.p2: Kurakurai lokacin aiki suna ƙonewa yayin kimantawa. Yawancin suna amsawa - furci yana nuni da tantanin halitta da ba a bayyana ba, ko nau'in rashin daidaituwa a cikin lissafi. Rikodin lokacin aiki, yana nuna banner ja akan samfoti, kuma ya tsallake sabuntawar firam ɗin.
errors.p3: Kurakurai masu gyara (masu gyara ba a san su ba, nau'in jayayya mara kyau) suna wuta a lokacin tantancewa. Architex yana da tsattsauran ra'ayi game da gyare-gyaren da ba a san su ba don kare dacewa ta gaba.
errors.p4: Gyara kuskure: kunsa maganganun da ake zargi a cikin debug(...). Lokacin gudu yana yin rikodin kowane ƙima zuwa na'ura wasan bidiyo ba tare da canza ƙimar ba. Haɗa tare da mai duba Architex don shiga cikin canje-canjen jihohi.
errors.p5: Haɗin edita: Architex IDE a cikin Vortex bot studio yana jadada kurakurai a ainihin lokacin, kafin a adana fayil ɗin.

host_builtins.p1: Abubuwan ginannun runduna ayyuka ne da aka samar da dandamali. Su ne manne tsakanin DSL da app ɗin da ke kewaye.
host_builtins.p2: Allon allo: copy(~text) sanya hujjar akan allo; paste() => ~x = it karanta allo a cikin tantanin halitta. share(~text) yana buɗe takardar rabon tsarin.
host_builtins.p3: Haptics: haptic("light"|"medium"|"heavy") yana haifar da martani akan na'urori masu tallafi. vibrate(ms) shine kugi mai tsayi mai tsayi.
host_builtins.p4: Ƙaddamarwa: alert("message") yana nuna modal tare da OK. confirm("message") => ~ok = it nuni OK + Soke; it gajeriyar hannu ita ce ƙimar dawowa.
host_builtins.p5: Kewayawa: goto("ScreenName", arg: val, ...) yana tura allo; back() bubbuga daya; close() yayi watsi da duka Mini App.
host_builtins.p6: Ƙunƙarar Rayuwa: @on mount, @on unmount, @on focus, @on blur. Kowannensu yana ɗaukar shingen jiki wanda ke gudana lokacin da abin ya faru.

examples.p1: Jirgin ruwa na canonical Mini App guda hudu a cikin Architex/examples/. Kowannensu yana ƙarƙashin layi 40 kuma yana gwada wani ɓangaren harshe daban-daban.
examples.p2: Counter - yanayin amsawa, ƙididdigewa, masu sarrafa maɓalli, ɗaure rubutu. Karanta shi farko; yana gabatar da kowane ginin syntactic a ƙarƙashin layi 30.
examples.p3: Todo - yin lissafin, ƙara / cirewa, gyaran layi. Yana nuna yadda @for ke hulɗa tare da tsararraki masu amsawa da kuma yadda ɗaurin layi input ke aiki.
examples.p4: Profile - hoto, bajoji, yanayin gani, kewayawa. Nuna hidden / visible masu gyara da goto sauyi.
examples.p5: Siffofin Kisa - jigogi, shigo da kaya, shafuka, abubuwan toasts, lambobi da aka tsara, ternaries, masu canji da aka buga, maɓallan mai sarrafa da yawa. Kome yanzu yanzu.
examples.li1: Kwafi kowane misali a cikin shafin Architex don gwaji.
examples.li2: Gyara kai tsaye - samfoti masu zafi-sake lodi akan ajiyewa.
examples.li3: Hanyoyin tashar jiragen ruwa a cikin naku fuska - misalan ba su da lasisi don kowane amfani.
examples.li4: Ba da shawarar sabbin misalai ta hanyar kasuwar bot; shahararrun alamu sun sami karbuwa.

bestpractices.cc5: ɓata bayanan da ke jawo kiran cibiyar sadarwa
bestpractices.cc6: bari lokacin gudu ya bambanta tsararrun - guje wa tanadin hannu
bestpractices.cc7: sanya dogayen samfura a cikin sel masu ƙididdigewa
bestpractices.cc8: kauce wa zurfafa zurfafa - matakan 3 na col/jere suna da yawa

bestpractices.cc10: fi son girma + tsakiya sama da bayyane w/h don amsawa

bestpractices.p1: Architex yana ba da lada mai sauƙi. Kowane allon da ke da wahalar karantawa tabbas yana da matakan gurbi guda ɗaya da yawa, ɗaya maɗaukakin layi mai yawa, ko sashi ɗaya yana yin ayyuka biyu.
bestpractices.p2: Lokacin da shakka, cire. Layi mai lamba 5 @component ya fi sauƙi ga gungume fiye da shingen layi 30 @screen.
bestpractices.p3: Fi son gyare-gyare akan nade. A text :: pad(16) ya fi nade a cikin col :: pad(16).
bestpractices.p4: Bari lokacin gudu yayi aikin. Tutoci hidden na hannu don kowane abu a cikin jeri ba su da lalacewa - lokacin aiki ya bambanta.
bestpractices.p5: Sunan abu ga mai karatu, ba mai tarawa ba. ~isLoading > ~l.
bestpractices.li1: Ƙarƙashin layi 200 a kowane allo - raba idan ya fi tsayi
bestpractices.li2: Babu fiye da matakan gida guda 3 - mai gyara idan ya fi zurfi
bestpractices.li3: Babu fiye da ternaries 2 a kowace magana - yi amfani da ƙididdiga
bestpractices.li4: Babu fiye da allo 1 kowane fayil - sai dai idan an haɗa su sosai

forms.p1: Abubuwan shigarwa suna ɗaure ta hanyoyi biyu zuwa tantanin halitta mai amsawa: input ~email. Buga yana sabunta tantanin halitta; sabunta tantanin halitta yana sabunta filin.
forms.p2: Tabbatar da ƙididdigan boolean: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Yi amfani da masu gyara hidden / visible akan alamun kuskure.
forms.p3: Ƙaddamarwa maɓalli ne na yau da kullun tare da ayyuka masu ɗaure. Toshe ƙaddamarwa yayin da tabbatarwa ta gaza ta hanyar disabled(!~formOk).
forms.p4: Nunin kuskure: sanya text ko label tare da visible(!~fieldOk) don nunawa kawai lokacin da ba daidai ba. Aiwatar da color(~danger) don jaddada gani.
forms.p5: Debouncing: ƙara :: debounce(300) don jinkirta tabbatar da goyon bayan hanyar sadarwa har sai mai amfani ya daina bugawa na 300 ms.
forms.p6: Mai riƙe wuri: :: placeholder("...") yana nuna alama lokacin da tantanin halitta ya zama fanko. Alamu tana ɓacewa akan bugun maɓalli na farko.
forms.p7: Nau'in shigarwa: a sarari input rubutu ne; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date daidaita keyboard da masking.
forms.cc6: shigarwa ~ bincike :: debounce(300) => aika (aikin: " bincike", q: ~ bincike)
forms.li1: Daure hanya biyu ce - bugawa yana canza tantanin halitta kuma akasin haka.
forms.li2: Tabbatarwa kawai ƙididdiga ta tantanin halitta boolean.
forms.li3: Nuna / ɓoye kurakurai tare da masu gyara ganuwa.
forms.li5: Yi watsi da ingancin cibiyar sadarwa don guje wa spam.

animations.p1: Architex yana raye-raye a fakaice lokacin da ƙima mai amsawa ta motsa lamba ko mai canza launi. Tsohuwar canji shine 200 ms sauƙi-fita. Shake da :: animate(ms, curve).
animations.p2: Shigar / fita jujjuyawar: nodes na yanayin da aka sanya (hidden / visible) mai rai ciki da waje. Keɓance ta hanyar :: animate.enter(...) da :: animate.exit(...).
animations.p3: Curves: ease-out (default), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring. Spring yana ɗaukar hujja stiffness da damping na zaɓi.
animations.p4: Hannun Hannu: :: draggable da :: swipeable haɗe masu gane karimcin da suka dace da dandamali. Haɗa tare da yanayin amsawa don rayar da ja.
animations.p5: Rage motsi: mai watsa shiri yana mutunta saitin damar mai amfani. Lokacin da raguwar motsi ke kunne, raye-raye suna raguwa zuwa ƙasa da 100 ms kuma masu lanƙwasa na bazara sun zama madaidaiciya.
animations.cc1: col :: animate (300, sauƙi-in-out) bg (~ haskakawa? ~ na farko: ~ bg)
animations.cc2: maballin "Load" :: animate (150, bazara) bg (~aiki? ~ haɗari: ~ na farko)
animations.li2: Maɓallan bazara suna jin ƙarin yanayi don ja mai mu'amala.
animations.li3: Rage motsi runduna suna gajarta komai ta atomatik.
animations.li4: Ficewar canja wuri yana jinkirin buɗewa har sai an gama raye-raye.

network.p1: send(action: "name", ...args) shine gada ga mai masaukin bot. Mai watsa shiri yana karɓar saƙon JSON RPC, aiwatarwa, da dawo da sakamako.
network.p2: Ana sanya sakamakon zuwa tantanin halitta ta => ~result = it. it shine gajeriyar hannu don ƙimar dawowa.
network.p3: Kasawar saman kamar ~result.error. Duba kafin karantawa ~result.data. Yi amfani da ternaries don lodawa / nasara / jihohin kuskure.
network.p4: Jihohin lodawa su ne naku boolean: juya tantanin halitta ~loading kafin kiran, koma baya. Nuna spinner bangaren da aka kulle akan ~loading.
network.p5: Yanayin tsere: idan mai amfani ya kunna send sau biyu kafin farkon warwarewa, na biyu ya sake rubuta tantanin halitta. Don hanawa, kofa tare da disabled(~loading).
network.cc4: rubutu "Kuskure: & #123;~data.error"" :: launi (~ haxari) bayyane (! ~ loading & amp; & ~ data.error)

network.li3: Kurakurai suna tafiya azaman ɓangare na sakamakon, ba a matsayin keɓancewa ba.
network.li4: Kare kan sallama sau biyu tare da tuta ~loading.

a11y.p2: Tsarin mayar da hankali yana bin tsarin tushen ta tsohuwa. Shake da :: a11yOrder(n) don shimfidawa na musamman.
a11y.p3: Nau'in Dynamic: Ma'aunin masu gyara rubutu tare da girman damar samun damar rubutu na OS har zuwa 200% ba tare da yankewa ba. Lokacin aikin sake buɗe kwantena a kan tashi.
a11y.p4: Yanayin bambanci mai girma: masu gyara tare da bayanan gaskiya suna samun cikawa mara kyau; Iyakoki sun yi karo daga 1 px zuwa 2 px. Atomatik - babu lambar da ake buƙata fiye da mutunta alamun jigo.
a11y.p5: Bambancin launi: Tsohuwar jigon Vortex ya hadu WCAG AA (4.5:1) a cikin haske da yanayin duhu. Ya kamata jigogi na al'ada su gwada bambanci da kowane kayan aiki na bambancin launi kafin jigilar kaya.

performance.h3: Guji aiki akan kowane bugun maɓalli
performance.p1: Reactivity yana da kyau-girma: kawai abubuwan da suka karanta canza tantanin halitta sake sakewa. Babu wani abu da ka rubuta "kyauta" da ke haifar da cikakkiyar sake fasalin itace.
performance.p2: Jerin dubban abubuwa suna da kyau. Lokacin gudu yana bambanta ta asali ta asali, don haka prepending shine O(1). Guji kalmomin da aka lissafta waɗanda ke sake kimanta jerin duka akan kowane canji - karya aikin zuwa sel ɗin da aka lissafta kowane abu.
performance.p3: Abubuwan shigar da mitoci masu girma: yi amfani da :: debounce(ms) akan kowane input da ke jawo kiran cibiyar sadarwa. 300 ms yawanci daidai ne.
performance.p4: Girman Bundle: Architex parser + renderer yana ƙasa da 30 KB gzipped. Fayil ɗin ku na .arx yana ƙara girman nasa - ajiye hotuna daga gunkin ku loda su ta URL.
performance.p5: Bayanan martaba: mai duba Architex yana nuna ƙididdiga ga kowane bangare da ƙididdige ƙididdigar ƙimar tantanin halitta. Duk wani tantanin halitta da ke kimanta fiye da sau ɗaya kowane hulɗar mai amfani shine manufa mai bayyanawa.

runtime.p1: Lokacin Runtime na Architex fakitin TypeScript ne da aka buga azaman architex. Yana da nau'o'i hudu: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Lexer yana karanta rubutun tushe kuma yana fitar da alamu. Shi ne kawai bangaren da ke kula da sararin samaniya - kowane samfurin ƙasa yana aiki akan alamu da AST nodes.
runtime.p3: Mai binciken yana gina AST. AST nodes ana buga su da serialisable don haka za'a iya aika su a cikin iyakokin tsari (mai amfani don sakewa mai zafi da samfoti na nesa).
runtime.p4: Mai gabatarwa yana tafiya da AST tare da mahallin mai bayarwa wanda mai watsa shiri ya bayar (web DOM / SwiftUI gada / Rubuta gada) kuma yana samar da ra'ayoyi na asali.
runtime.p5: Runduna suna aiwatar da ƙunƙuntaccen mu'amala: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, da aikace-aikacen gyarawa. Ƙara sabon rundunar yana ɗaukar kusan layin 500 na lambar manne.
runtime.li2: Parser: yana samar da nau'in AST.
runtime.li3: Mai gabatarwa: yana tafiya da AST, wakilai zuwa mai masaukin baki.
runtime.li4: Mai amsawa: bin diddigin dogaro ta atomatik + sabuntawa.

migration.p1: Architex yana bin semver. Faci ba sa karya komai. Yara ƙanana suna ƙara fasali. Majors na iya karya abubuwa tare da taga ɓatawar watanni 12.
migration.p2: Fasalolin da aka yanke suna ci gaba da aiki ta cikin dukkan ƙaramin jerin. Lokacin aiki yana yin rikodin gargadin yankewa akan amfani da farko; IDE yana nuna alamar da aka yanke.
migration.p3: Compat na gaba: fayilolin da aka rubuta akan ƙaramin sigar farko koyaushe suna nunawa iri ɗaya akan lokacin aiki na gaba. Ba mu taɓa sake canza ilimin tauhidi ba.
migration.p4: Ana sanar da ƙetare canje-canje a cikin kundin canji tare da jagororin ƙaura. Kayan aikin ƙaura ta atomatik suna rufe yawancin canje-canjen inji.
migration.p5: LTS: kowane babban sigar yana da taga tallafi na watanni 24 don mahimman matakan tsaro, koda bayan manyan jiragen ruwa na gaba.
migration.li2: Ƙananan yara: ƙarin fasali, masu dacewa da baya.
migration.li3: Manyan: sauye-sauye masu karya, tare da raguwar watanni 12.
migration.li4: LTS: Tallafin tsaro na watanni 24 ga kowane manyan.

faq.p1: Tambaya: Zan iya rubuta cikakken app a Architex? A: An ƙera Architex don Mini Apps - allon da ke zaune a cikin taɗi. Don cikakken ƙa'idar ɗan ƙasa kuna son SwiftUI / Rubuta / React.
faq.p2: Tambaya: Yaya aka kwatanta da Flutter? A: Flutter ya fi girma amma yana da lokacin aiki na kansa (Dart VM + Skia). Architex karami ne kuma yana gudana akan primitives mai masaukin baki. Idan kuna buƙatar kulle dandamali, Flutter; Idan kuna buƙatar isa, Architex.
faq.p3: Tambaya: Me yasa babu if toshe? A: Domin hidden / visible masu gyara suna rufe kashi 95% na UI sharuɗɗan mafi tsabta. Ga sauran 5%%, maganganu na ternary suna aiki.
faq.p4: Tambaya: Architex buɗaɗɗen tushe ne? A: Ee - duba GitHub repo. MIT-lokacin aiki mai lasisi, babu igiyoyin haƙƙin mallaka.
faq.p5: Tambaya: Zan iya kiran lambar asali? A: Sai kawai ta hanyar ginanniyar ginanniyar ginin gida ko ayyukan bot send(). Gada kai tsaye ba a tallafawa da gangan - zai karya ɗaukar hoto.
faq.p6: Tambaya: Maxaukar nauyin allo? A: Lokacin aiki cikin kwanciyar hankali yana ɗaukar sel masu amsawa 10k da abubuwan lissafin 100k. Bayan haka, shiga cikin allon fuska da yawa.
faq.p7: Tambaya: Zan iya dagewa? A: Ee, ta hanyar store(key, value) (kowace-Mini-App na gida) ko send(action: "save") zuwa bot (gefen uwar garken).
faq.p8: Tambaya: Yana aiki a layi? A: Ee don tsarkaka-UI fuska. Duk wani abu mai kira send() yana buƙatar hanyar sadarwa.
faq.p9: Tambaya: Ta yaya zan ƙara bangaren al'ada? A: Ko dai @component a cikin Architex, ko kuma (idan kuna buƙatar asalin asali) ba da gudummawa ga kunshin masaukin Architex.
faq.p10: Tambaya: Ayyukan sama da na ɗan ƙasa da aka rubuta da hannu? A: Yawanci 3-8% a hankali fiye da rubutaccen SwiftUI / Rubuta. Mutum-wanda ba ya iya ganewa don allon al'ada.
faq.li1: Matsakaicin allo: ~ 10 k Kwayoyin, ~ 100 k abubuwan lissafin.
faq.li2: Mafi girman fayil: 1 MB .arx tushen kafin gargadi.
faq.li3: Matsakaicin zurfin shigo da kaya: matakan 16.
faq.h1_a: Tambaya: Zan iya rubuta cikakken app a Architex? A: An ƙera Architex don Mini Apps - allon da ke zaune a cikin taɗi. Don cikakken ƙa'idar ɗan ƙasa kuna son SwiftUI / Rubuta / React.

faq.h1_c: Tsarin "Gabaɗaya" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.
faq.h2_a: Tambaya: Yaya aka kwatanta da Flutter? A: Flutter ya fi girma amma yana da lokacin aiki na kansa (Dart VM + Skia). Architex karami ne kuma yana gudana akan primitives mai masaukin baki. Idan kuna buƙatar kulle dandamali, Flutter; Idan kuna buƙatar isa, Architex.
faq.h2_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Comparison". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.

faq.h3_a: Tambaya: Me yasa babu if toshe? A: Domin hidden / visible masu gyara suna rufe kashi 95% na UI sharuɗɗan mafi tsabta. Ga sauran 5%%, maganganu na ternary suna aiki.
faq.h3_b: Bayanin aiwatarwa don "Iyakoki". Ana aiwatar da tsarin a cikin tsarin da ya dace a ƙarƙashin `app/`, `ios/Modules/ Sources/`, ko `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Tsarin README yana kiran ainihin hanyoyin fayil.
faq.h3_c: Tsarin "Iyakoki" ya samo asali a cikin Vortex sakewa. Zane ya samo asali ne daga binciken da aka buga da ayyukan samar da manzanni da suka gabata. Tarihin sigar a cikin rikodin `CHANGELOG.md` lokacin da kowane yanki ya sauka da abin da ya motsa shi.

gotchas.p1: Architex yana amfani da sarari 2 kowane matakin indent. Ana ƙi shafuna a lokacin tantancewa. Yawancin IDE suna canzawa ta atomatik; idan kun ga kurakuran haƙoran da ba zato ba tsammani, bincika gaurayawan sararin samaniya.
gotchas.p2: Rufewa a cikin maganganun da aka ƙididdige suna karanta sel masu amsawa a lokacin kimantawa, ba a lokacin bayyanawa ba. ~a := ~b + 1 koyaushe yana amfani da ~b na yanzu, ba kimar da ake bayyanawa ba.
gotchas.p3: Async send() yana sanya wa tantanin halitta lokacin da Alkawari ya warware, wanda zai iya yin rashin tsari idan yawancin aika aika suna cikin jirgi. Tsare tare da tuta ~loading ko lambar jeri.
gotchas.p4: Nau'in tilastawa: "5" + 1 yana kimanta zuwa "51", ba 6 ba. Yi amfani da Number("5") ko bayyana tantanin halitta azaman : number.
gotchas.p5: Zurfafan abubuwa masu amsawa: canza dukiya (~obj.x = 5) baya haifar da sabuntawa akan masu karatun ~obj. Sake sanya duka abu maimakon.
gotchas.p6: Oda mai gyarawa tsakanin dangi: masu gyara launi suna warware nasara-marubuci na ƙarshe. Kar a yi sarkar biyu color(...) tsammanin haduwa.
gotchas.p7: @for dole ne a zurfafa jiki daidai matakin zurfi. Yaro a matakai biyu ba kuskure ba ne amma kuskure ne na fassarar fassarar - lokacin gudu yana ɗaukar shi azaman ɗan'uwan @for.
gotchas.li2: Kwayoyin amsawa a cikin rufewa suna karanta halin yanzu, ba lokacin bayyanawa, ƙima ba.
gotchas.li3: Async send() na iya warwarewa ba tare da tsari ba - tsaro tare da tutoci.
gotchas.li4: Sake sanya abubuwa/tsari maimakon filaye masu canzawa.
gotchas.li5: Masu gyara launi suna warware nasara-marubuci na ƙarshe.
